tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 32 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas/ srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces bshus〉 zhesapa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gisanor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyesabu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu ring mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bzhad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khrugs pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mche/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus lang tsho rgyasashing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri dzo re zhu las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu kho/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal ba4/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos wo nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste / da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhus/sa pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni spo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam ba 'ag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / ma rman rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus lubor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song bi krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / sge tre 1 6 3 'a / grang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge spyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam/ nga/byangs kun dga'i rma tshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gnyu kas te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos/ —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhus drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus de kyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhud bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phog mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhas bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod wo po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang ngo/ bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'kho ra lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi stso shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel wo pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyi rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa bzhugs/ 1ston pa shākya'i dbang po'i mdzad pa brgya pa'i bris yig rje btsun kun snying gis mdzad pa bzhugs/ 8bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i mdzad pa mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs/ 128

༄༅// /bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa bzhu/gas/oṃ swā skyi/ bde legs phan dang bde ba ni/ kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba la/ /gang zhig cung zad dad byed pa/ /de la'ang phun tshogs thams cad 'byung / /rmongs rnams skal ba dman pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba la yang mos bral zhing / /dam pa'i chos las phyir phyogs pa/ /'di dag ba lang mngon sum bzhin/ /bzlas brjod smra ba ji snyed pas/ /yon tan lan cig brjod pa mchog //thang na mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /smra na 'di nyi da smra bar shog khams gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ khyod dang mnyam pa'ang ma mchis na/ /lhag pa'i dri yang ga la zhig /mnyam med mi mnyam mnyam la 'dud/ /dnge/ gzhan rnyed par ma gyur nas/ /rnam gzigs la sogs dper bgyid snyam/ /khyed dag de dag ye shes kyi/ /sku dbyer med pas dpe ma rnyed/ /'gro kun phan bder 'god pa'i byams pa dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob thugs rje can/ /nye ring mi mnga' btang snyoms tshad med de/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas khyod la 'dud/ /ji ltar bu gcig gdung ba'i ma bzhin du/ /nam yang brtse bas nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /sdug bsngal 'gro la g.yel ba med par gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyan lngan la phyag 'tshal/ /tshig dang don dang nges tshig ma lus —1—

la/ /'gro ba'i mgon po'i spobs pa zad mi shes/ /nyon mongs spyod ba'i sems can kun 'dul ba/ /mi mchog 'dul ba'i gtso la gus phyag 'tshal/ khyod ni rtag tu mnyam par 'jog mdzad kyang / /lhun grub chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /sems can kun gyi the tshom gcod mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser skya grog mkhar rgyas pa me bzhi 'jug /sna tshogs bzhas gnyen gshin rje me la sogs/ /log par smra ba'i dri ma kun bkrus pa/ /drang srong chen po de la gus pas 'dud/ /zhi ba 'phrog byed dbyig gi snying po sogs/ /byed por smra rnams shin tu rmongs pa'i gnas/ /stong nyid chos kyi rnga bo che brdung pa/ /lha yi lhar gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /srid gsum bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'bod mkhas pa/ /sngon med dam chos rin chen gter gyur pa'i/ /go taX chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'jig rten rtog byed pa/ khres par smra rnams lta ba'i thibs por chud / /gang dag cir yang gang zag ma dmigs pas/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog la 'dud/ /chos rnams nam yang rang bzhin ma mchis kyang / /rgyu 'bras sum̐9/ la bslu ba med pa ni/ /mgon po khyod kyis mkhyen zhing gzigs nas bstan/ /dbu ma'i lam gyis 'gro ba sgrol la bstod/ /yod med dngos dang dngos med mtha' dbus sogs/ /phan tshun la ltos blo yis btags par zad/ /skye 'gag rang g.yin gnyis kar ma dmigs zhes/ /stong nyid tshangs pa'i dbyangs —2—

kyis ston la 'dud/ /mi sbyin bha ra dh+wa dza 'od bsrungs sogs/ /byed po tha dad rtog ges rnam par brtags/ /rgyal khyod sems tsam byed por gzigs nas ston/ /phra zhing rtogs dka' mkhyen pa khyod la 'dud/ /thal ba pa sogs gdung ba rtsom la dga'/ /'jig rten rnams ni 'dod la rnam par 'chus sa/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i spyod pa yi/ /lam ston khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro dang 'ong ba rnam bral zhing/ /chad pa ma lags rtag ma lags/ /mchis(dang ma mchis ma lags pa/ /skye med sku la phyag mtshal lo/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed kun/ /dus gsum ye shes gcig kho nas/ /skad cig gcig la mkhyen mod kyang / /dmigs pa mi mnga' khyod la 'dud/ /tshad med 'og min zhing mchog tu/ /ston pa mthong na mi mthun med/ /sras mchog theg chen dbang bskur bas/ /chos kyi dga' ston rgyun mi 'chad/ /'on kyang ma lus zhing rnams su/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba der/ /de de'i tshul du ston mdzad kyang / /lhun grub rnam par rtog mi mnga'/ /smon lam dbang gis 'gro ba ni/ /mos pa dbang po khams tha dad/ /ji bzhin ma 'khrul don mdzad pa/ /dmigs med thugs rje ngo mtshar rmad/ /rnam mi rtog la thugs rje che/ /ma rtags (brtags kagatang snyom/sa mi mnga' ba/ /'gal ba 'dra la mi 'gal te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal/ khyod ni thugs rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /sna tshogs tshul dang spyod pa bstan/ /thogs med dus nas byang chub kyang / /da dung skye rabs dus mthar ston/ khyod sngon nyon mongs bcas tshe yang/ /rgyal srid —3—

btsun mo mdzes ma dang / /dbu dang sku yang grangs med stsal/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la 'dud/ /lha dang drang srong dbyangs can dang / /seng ge stag dang ri bong sogs/ /'byung ba bzhi sogs 'gro ba yi/ /nyer 'tsho kun tu sprul par mdzad/ /gzo yi las rnams sna tshogs dang / /rig sngags sna tshogs tshul yang ston/ /dge ba cung zad ji snyed pa/ /de kun mgon po khyod kyi mthu/ /'phrin las pha mtha' ma mchis pa/ /'di la su zhig dpyod par sems/ khres rab med na sbyin sogs gang / /thar par 'jug par nus ma yin/ /bsod nams tshogs ni med gyur na/ khres rab kyis kyang mya ngan 'da'/ /gang zhig tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs pas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa brnyes/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs rdzogs pa/ /mgon po khyod 'dra gzhan ma mchis/ khyod kyi 'khor gyi tha chung yang / /'jig rten gsum gyi brgyan du gyur/ khyod kyis thabs mang yid byed dang / /dmigs pa'i khyad par kun bstan kyang / /'di na rnam par mi rtog dang / /so sor rtog la phan tshun smod/ khyod sngon byang chub dus mtha' ni/ /blo ldan sus kyang mi rtogs mod/ /grangs med gsum gyis tshogs rdzogs pa'i/ /tshul yang phyi nas yang yang bstan/ /lam dang sa las rab 'das kyang / /sa bcu sgrod pa'i tshul yang ston/ /me khyer bye ba khrag khrig gis/ /sa gzhi rir bcas gsal mi nus/ /nyin byed gcig gis kun gsal ltar/ /'phags dang byis pa'i bsod nams khyad/ /mtha' yas rgyu las sgrubs pa yi/ /sku yang yon tan dpag tu med/ /mtshan dang dpe byad re re yang / /bsod nams —4—

ye shes dpag med las/ /mngon par sgrubs na chos kyi sku'i/ khyu rnams mtha' yas lta ci smos/ /dga' ldan gnas kyi gzhal med khang / /mdzes byed dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /gzhon nu rgyal tshab nges 'byung dang / /dka' ba spyod dang bdud btul dang / /byang chub tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das ston sogs/ khyod kyi thabs mkhas 'ba' zhig lags/ khyu rkyen las dang rnam smin mo/si pa khams/ /dbang po lam dang bsam gtan sngon gyi gnas/ /phyi ma'i dus dang zag pa zad mkhyen pas/ /stobs bcus bdud bzhi 'joms par mdzad la 'dud/ /chos rnams kun la mkhyen pa'i snang ba rgyas/ /gegs rnams dang ni lam dang 'gog ston la/ /srid gsum 'di na rgol ba'i gnas ma mchis/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod lam ma 'khrugs ca co mi mnga' zhing / /dran pa ma nyams rtag tu mnyam par bzhag /gdul bya'i don la ma brtags btang snyoms med/ /'dun da nga brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin/ khres rab rnam grol ye shes nyams mi mnga'/ /chags thogs mi mnga' dus gsum cig car gzigs/ /sku gsum thugs kyi cho 'phrul 'phrin las la/ /ye shes sngon 'gro rjes su 'jug pa ste/ /ma rig sgrib 'joms rdo rje 'jigs bral bas/ /seng ge dang mtshungs mkha' ltar ma 'dres chos/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs dka' bas/ /'phags pa kun gyi'ang bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /zhing kun sgrod mdzad sems kyi spyod kun mkhyen/ /thams —5—

cad skad kyis 'chi 'pho sngon gyi gnas/ /gzigs nas nges 'byung mkhyen pas gzhan la 'doms/ /mngon par mkhyen nas don mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /spyan lnga ldan pas bag chags thams cad spangs/ /gtsang ma rtogs pa bde ba'i sku brnyes shing / /dam pa'i bdag nyid rin chen gter mtshungs pa/ khyod la rtag par snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa thog mtha' smra dang rgyu med dang / /byed po dus sogs snying po med gzigs nas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rten 'brel las dang 'bras/ /sdug bsngal rnam grol rgyu bcas ston la 'dud/ khyod gsung rdo rjes 'jigs tshogs lta ba'i ri/ /rtsa bcas bcom zhing 'khor bar rtag 'khyams rnams/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i lam la 'khrid/ /chu bo las sgrol ded dpon mchog la 'dud/ /phyin ci log bzhi'i rgya mtshor bying pa rnams/ /mi gtsang mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ /dran pa 'jog byed blo gros grur bcug nas/ /thar pa nor bu'i gling du sgrol la 'dud/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang rnam thar zil gnon brgyad/ /zad par bcu thob zhugs 'bras mngon byas pa/ khyod rjes 'jug na blo brtul rnams kyang ste/ /zhing gi rdul snyed de rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba las gzhan rnam dag lam ston pa/ /dus rnams kun tu yod pa ma yin pas/ /skye ba kun tu ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /skyob pa khyod la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /chu gter chen po skyal ba yis/ /ji lta bur na rgal bar byed/ /'dren pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la/ /'di ltar 'jug pa'ang ga zho'i rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i bstod pa nam mkha' —6—

la/ /rgyal sras mkha' lding 'jug mod kyang / /bstod byed rang nyid chog shes kyi/ /bsngags 'os dag gi mtha' ma mthong / /bdag gis cung zad bstod byas pa'ang/ rmongs pas ma yin phyogs lhung min/ /bdag la dgos phyir ma yin te/ /yon to ldan phyir dad pas bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod bstod mod/ /bsam pa blun po'ang gus bstod pas/ /dpag yas chos kyi rgyal por shog /bdag lus zhing rdul snyed sprul nas/ /rgyal ba ze re'i spyan sngar gnas/ /re re'ang gdung dang lce de snyed/ /tshig gi brjod pa'ang de snyed kyis/ /phyogs rnga༅ dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /gsung la bdag kyang rab 'jug pas/ khyod la bstod cing bsngags bgyid la/ /de kun bdag gis thob par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi yon to dang / /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las dag /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyis/ khyun mi 'chad par thob gyur cig /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba ste rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o/ /maṅga lam bi stur ku sa /'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa lag zla med pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gtsug lag khang chen 'dir/ /mgon po khyod nyid bskal par bzhugs nas kyang / /bdag sogs sems can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs// //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā// par yig gnyis kyi 'du byed rdzong ri ba/ /byams pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis zab te bskos// maṅga laX// //—7—

rje btsun kun snying gis mdzad pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa nas brtsams te/gdul bya mchog dman thams cad la thun mong du snang ba'i mdzad pa rnam thar rags rim grags che che 'dri tshul ni/ dang por nam mkha' la dga' ldan lha'i gnas mtshon byed sprin gyi dbus na rin po che'i ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs me tog dang / mtsho rdzing dang / nags tshal dang / khang bzang mang po yod pa tsho gsum/ sa gzhi gcig la 'brel ba'am/ ma 'brel ba dga' ldan gyi bkod pa tshar gsum/ stabs gang bde ba zhig 'bri/ bkod pa rgyas shos shig tu/ dam pa tog dkar 'khor lha thams cad la chos gsung pa'i tshul zhig 'bri/ gcig tu dam pa tog dkar de dung dkar 'bud pa dang / lha mang po rol mo sna tshogs byed pa dang / lha gnyis kyi zhu ba byed pa'i tshul bya/ yang gnas gcig shos der/dam pa tog dkar gyi byams pa la dbu brgyan phrog zhu bskon pa'i tshul byed/ sa gzhi la grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu/ rgyal po pad ma chen po dang mnyan yod du rgyal po rtsibs kyi ring 'thur dang / 'phags rgyal du rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas dang / ko sha zhi ru rgyal po dmag brgya pa dang / grong khyer ser skyar rgyal po zas gtsang ma btsun mo'i mchog gnyis dang bcas pa/ grong khyer lhas bstan du rgyal —8— ma

po legs par rab sad rnams bzhugs pa'i bkod pa bya ste/ khang bzang pho brang drug po de dag lnga po ni/ bar mtshams che ba dang bcas 'bri zhing / ser skya lhas bstan gnyis kyi bar na chu yod pa cung zad thag nye ba zhig yod pa bya/ de rnams spyir gang bde ba de la 'bri na'ang / ngom che sa zhig tu ser skya yod pa byed/ bar snang la lha phran mang ri po phan tshun du 'gro ba dang gtam smra ba'i chul 'bri zhing /rgyal po pad ma chen po'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags tshal gcig tu/ rang sangs rgyas mang du tshogs pa dang / nam mkha' la 'phags te lus las 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba gcig dang / lus las sprin spros shing glog dang char 'bab pa zhig dang /me 'phro ba gcig 'bri/ grong khyer de rnams kyi nye 'khor so so na/ spyir bkod pa gang legs dang/ c-i 'i spyil po dang / lo ma'i spyil po dang / phug pa sogs na mu stegs ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad rnams 'bri'o/ /de dag las rang sangs rgyas la/ deng sang gtsug tor 'bri ba'i srol 'dug kyang 'bri mi dgos/ smin mtshams su mdzod pu nar mo zhig bya ste mi nor ba'i phyir yin/ bshad tshod med/ sku mas rab byung spyi dang 'dra ba la/ chos gosal gra mi dgos shing/ lhung bzed nag po'i tshab tu/ ku ba'am slong phor gyi rnam pa thogs pa/ 'ag‘spru zhig chu shing gi 'khar ba bsnams pa sogs kyang rud/zhabar gsil dang/ chos gos gra drug dang/ lhung bzed dang po ti sogs mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med pa'i skabs su rang rgyal 'byung ba yin pas so/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la/ rdzogs byed la sogs pa rtog ge pa drug po'i rim can du/ dang po skra bregs shing gos tsag btsos kyi smad —9—

g.yogs chung ngu gyon pa/ gnyis pa ral ba khams ser bcings shing / rgya gar pa'i 'dom dkris gru gsum yod pa/ /lhag ma gos spangs zhing rna brgyan chung ngu yod pa/ lus la thal bas byugs pa/ gsum pa ni skra bregs shing / dbyug gu rtse gcig pa dang / spyi blugs yod pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas smad dkris pa/bzhi pa ni skra bregs shing / 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po nag po gyon pa/ lnga pa yang de dang 'dra ba las/ ral pa nag po can gos dkar po gyon pa/ drug pa ni gcer bu 'dom dkris kyang med pa/ skra rnams btogs pas zad zad por gyur pa/ dkyil krungs mnyam bzhag byas pa/ bram ze rgyus rgyal la sogs pa drug kar mtshungs par bram ze'i cha byad yin pas/ phrag pa g.yas ston pa'i tshangs skud dkar po mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'am/ ras dkar po'am dmar pos 'dom gang tsam du ring ba smad dkris su byas pa/ rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi gon lugs dang mthun pa/ dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs dang po ti sogs 'chang ba/ dpral pa tsan dan gyi thig le gyen du bgreng ba gsum mam/ gcig gi 'phreng la gsum bsgrigs sam/ sked nyag gser bre dngul bre dbyibs 'dra rung yod pa sogs so sor ji ltar 'os pa 'bri/thams cad kha sbu ring ba dang / sgra gzhan bregs shing gtsug phud spyi bor bcings pa'am/ ral pa ma yin par bshad/ mgo thor cog spyi gtsug tu yod pa bya/ rgan gzhon la sogs pa dmigs gsal gyi khyad yod na ma gtogs bram ze 'bri dgos phal cher la cha lugs 'di bzhin du byed/ bram ze yin zer nas bod pa'i rtogs ldan rgad po'i 'dra ba kho na mi 'bri'o/ ring phur la sogs pa snyoms —10—

'jug pa drug po ri/ ral pa bcings shing 'dzings pa leb leb pa/ kha skru dang sen mo ring po/ 'doms dkris gru gsum dang / ri dwags kyi pags pa dang/shing lo'i gos ci rigs pa yod pa/ bya ma bum ra 'khris su bzhag pa/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas pa 'bri/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad de rnams la/'khor re gnyis sam cung zad re byed/ de dag dga' ldan du skye ba mngon par 'byung ba'o/ 7 /rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i pho brang ma mo de dang nye ba'i khang bzang gcig tu/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo mnal mdzad pa'i tshul dang / khang bzang rge steng gi nam mkha' nas/ glang po che dkar po mche ba drug pa 'bab ba'i tshul dang / gzhan yang /sprung bzang de'i nam mkha' la mja' 'od zlum po 'dra ba bzhi'i nang du/ yur/ gyi rmi ltas bzhi po hal tshon lta bu la phra mo re bri bar bya ste/gcig tu glang po rang gi lus la zhugs pa/ gcig tu yum nyid nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ gcig tu yum nyid brag ri la 'dzegs pas rtse mor phyin pa/ gcig tu skye bo mang po yum nyid la phyag 'tshal ba 'bri'o/ /dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i skor ro/ /(ka) yang de dag dang nye ba'i khang bzang gcig tu/ yum gyi sku'i lto ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' lhums su zhugs pa ni/ lha'i sku 'dra ba 'od zer 'phro bas brgyan pa dang / yum gyi sku g.yas g.yon du lha'i bsrung ma bzhi/ ral gri dang / mdung dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che rnams 'dzin pa yod pa/'khor g.yog mang po mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa 'bri'o/ /de nas rgyal pos btson rnams btang ba dang/ kun tu rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba/ da lta'i swā bya shi'i —11—

cha lugs 'dra ba cig gis/ rgya mtsho bzhi'i chu yum la 'dren pa'i rnam pa rnams 'dri'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang de gnyis na nye ba na bzhugs pa re bya/ khang bzang de dang ma 'brel bar bar stong yod tsam du gzhan zhig tu/ lum bu'i tshal de skyed mos tshal shing sna tshogs yod pa gcig bya/ de na 'khor mang pos skor nas/ rang yum nyid khyogs byams khri la g.yog ma 'ga' re dang bcas pa lum+bi na'i tshal du 'byon pa'i tshul dang / tshal der sku bltams pa'i bkod pa sbyi dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha' nas chu rgyun gnyis dbu'i steng du 'bab pa dang / lha rnams kyi gdugs dang rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs pa 'bul zhing /tshal de'i phyi nang thams cad 'od kyi khyab pa ma sto byed du/ phyi nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor zlum pos skor ba 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs rnams su/ rgod ma rte'u 'breng pa mang po dang / glang chen mo phrug gu 'breng ba/ bud med khye'u dang bu mo thogs pa dang / sa 'og nas rin po che'i gter kha bye ba rnams lnga brgya mtshon byed/ lnga tsam re 'bri/ khang bzang gzhan gcig tu rgyal po zas gtsang ma la rgyal phran mang pos phyag 'bul zhing 'bul ba byed pa/ yang khang bzang gcig na 'khor mang po can yab kyis pang na/ byang chub sems pa khye'u'i gzugs kyi bzhugs pa la/ mdun du bram ze mang po 'bri/ de nas lam du shing rta'i steng du rgyal po bzhugs pa la 'khor mang pos skor ba dang / khyogs byams khri skye bo mang pos btegs pa'i dbus na byang chub sems dpa' ma ma rnams dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ lha khang zhig na gnod sbyin lus la khra gyon pa zhig 'ong nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'bul ba/ de nas grong khyer ser skya'i bkod pa —12—

gzhan zhig gi khang bzang du/ yab kyi sku pang du bzhugs pa la/ mdun du drang srong kha dog mi sha kha nag po/ ral pa ser skya 'dzings shing kha sbu nag po can/tshangs skud dang dbyug gu spyi blugs yod pa/ rgan pa'i cha byad can zhig gi byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing / lag pa g.yas cung zad sgreng ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig tu drang srong de rgyal po'i drung du mchil ma 'don pa'i tshul bya ba dang /pho brang de'i phyi rol na drang srong de tshur yong dus kyus ma yong ba dang / phar 'gro dus ni sgo'i phyi nas dar ras sogs skyang ba'i steng / de dang nye ba'i brag phug gcig tu de nyid bsam gtan la gnas pa'i tshul dang / de'i mdun du drang srong gzhon nu gcig 'bri/ de dag ni lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i skor ro//(ba) de nas ma ma brgyas skor ba'i byang chub sems dpa' byis pa'i tshul gyi gser gyi gzhong pa shin tu che ba 'bras kyis bkang ba/ phyogs gcig nas glang po che mang po la btags la/ byang chub sems dpa' khye'u'i phyag mdzub gcig gis/ gzhong pa nas 'then pas/ glang po che rnams kyang 'dred stabs su sdong drud pa/ 'bras chen nas gsol ba'i rnam pa yang 'bri ste/ phyag g.yon pas snod nas 'then tshul dang/ g.yas pas gsol ba'i rnam pa byas na legs/ de nas cung zad sku cher skyes pa'i rnam pa la/ yi ge'i slob dpon gyi drung du yi ge slob pa dang / rtsis kyi slob dpon gyi drung du rtsis slob pa dang / rdzo po bzang len la rta dang glang po che'i sgyu rtsal slob pa dang / mda' sogs mtshon cha'i 'phrul gyi slob dpon la de dag slob tshul cung zad re dang / lhas sbyin gyi glang po che bsad pa dang / dga' bos 'jug ma nas bor ba dang / byang chub —13—

sems dpas phyag gi ring du 'phang pa rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'di la zhabs kyi mthe pos 'phang pa theg chen gyi lugs yin/ sngon 'gyung lugs dang / 'dul ba sogs nas phyag gi 'phang pa gsal bar bshad/ shing mang po ral gris bcad pa/ gzhan rnams kyis bcad pa tsho bcad ma thag 'gyel/ byang chub semasadapas de bcad kyang ring du ma 'byel ba dang / rlung po byung nas 'gyel ba 'bri/de nas mda' tsha bas 'dren pa'i bkod pa spyi dang 'dra/ spyir sgyu rtsal lnga brgya'i bar du 'gran pa yin kyang / sngon 'byung dang 'dul ba las lo rgyus lhag ma gsungs pa med pas skabs 'dir de tsam gyis chog /sgyu rtsal mkhas par bstan pa'i skor ro/ /(ga) byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol nas nang du 'byon pa dang / bram ze mang po phyir 'gro bzhin pas lung bstan byed pa dang / khyams yangs pa zhig tu shākya'i bu mo sna tshogs pa la/ dngos po'i khyad par re re sbyin zhing / grags 'dzin ma sku'i mdun du gus pas 'dug pa la sor gdub gnang ba dang / yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu grags 'dzin ma 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa'i dga' ston gyi bkod pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan thig tu/ shing sdong chen po zhig 'gyel bas/ rgyug chu bkag ste/ grong khyer phyogs gcig la chu nyen yod pa dang / shing de la skye bo mang pos 'then pa'i tshul dang / de'i phyogs gcig nas sprul nag po zhig byung ba/ gzhon nu mdzes pa thod bcings pa zhig gi ral gris sked pa nas bcad pa dang / lhas byin gyi ngang ya la mda' 'phangs nas sa la lhung ba/ byang chub sems dpas gsos pa dang / byang —14—

chub sems dpas shing sdong de phyag ya gcig gis nam mkha' la 'phen pa dang /shing sdong de dum bu gnyis su song nas chu 'gram g.yas g.yon du lhung pa dang /yang khang bzang zhig gi steng nas/ sa mtsho mas byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing/ rkang pa ya gcig gi mthe bo'i shugs kyi thog gi mthil brdol ba dang /shing rta'i steng nas dra/snang chub sems dpas kyang / sa mtsho ma la gzigs shing /phyag na lcags kyi mda' dum bur song ba dang / khang bzang mchog tu sa mtsho 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa dang / yang phyogs ji ltar 'os pa zhig tu/ khang bzang gcig dang nye ba nas/ byang chub sems dpa' shing rta la zhugs nas 'byon pa dang / khang bzang gi skar khung nas ri dwags skyes ma la lta zhing 'dug pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' mu tig 'phreng ba 'phangs pa/ de'i mgul du mkhril ba dang / khang bzang mchog tu ri dwags skyes 'khor bcas khab tu bzhes pa'i bkod pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs bstan pa'i skor ro/ /(nga ) nge/ dag phyogs gang yang rung bar pho brang gi sgo bzhi nas/rgas pa dang/ na ba ’dang/ shi ba dang/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul rnams spyi dang 'dra/zhing las byed pa'i sa/ra phebs nas zhing pa rnams dang / glang sogs btang ste ci bde bar btang ba dang / nang gi las sna tshogs pa byed pa rnams kyi sar phebs te/ de dag kyang btang ba dang / shing 'dzam bu'i rtsa bar kho nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ grib mas sku lus ma bting ba la yab kyi phyag mdzad pa dang / de nas ser skya'i phyi rol 'obs dang lcags ri bdun bdun gyi skor zhing / lcags kyi sgo 'phar dril bu chen po can mi lnga brgyas 'byed gcod byed pa mtshon byed —15—

dang / skas chen po mi lnga brgyas 'dzugs shing bsdu ba mtshon byed dang / lcags ri'i bar bar thams cad dmag mi'i bsrung zhing / pho brang snying po'i phyogs bzhi nas/ rgyal po sku mched bzhis mel tshe mdzad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyid dang / pho brang gi khang bzang gcig tu bud med mang pos rol mo dang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / ma 'gags pa zhes bya ba rgyal po dang cha byad 'dra rung zhig gi lta nyul byed cing skor ba dang / khang bzang gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' mnal ba'i tshul dang / 'khor gyi bud med thams cad gnyid kyi non pas cha byad bkod pa mi sdug pa'i rnam par gyur pa dang / khang bzang gi nang la zlum skor lnga'i nang du byang chub sems dpa'i mnal ltas lnga 'bri ste/ ri rab dbus sngas su bcug sa gzhi gdan du gting / phyag g.yon nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug g.yas shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug zhabs gnyis lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la bcug pa dang / gcig tu lte ba nas rtswa sngon po skyes pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags pa dang / gcig tu bya lus dkar la mgo bo nag pa mang pos zhabs la gshugs pa dang / gcig tu bya sbu mdog sna tshogs pa phyogs phyogs nas 'dus pa sku mdun du rigs gcig tu song ba dang / gcig tu mi gtsang ba'i phung po'i steng zhabs 'chag pa mdzad kyang / mi gtsang bas ma gos pa'o/ /grags 'dzin ma yang / byang chub sems dpa'i drung du nyal ba'i bkod pa 'bri zhing / rmis ltas brgyad bshad kyang 'bri mi dgos/ des nas phyogs gcig tu lcags ri'i bar gyi dmag mi sogs thams cad gnyid du song zhing / lcags ri'i nang rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ chibs pa bsngags ldan la phyag gi bzhams pa —16—

dang / rta rdzi bdun pas sga sgron pa'i grabs 'bri/ khang bzang gi rtse mo'i phyogs gcig na/ rgyal po zas gtsang mnal du song ba la/ byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mdzad cing thal mo sbyar ba dang / ma 'gags pas rgyal po'i na bza' nas 'then zhing mnal bsod tshul byed pa dang / de nas chibs la chibs nam mkha'i ngos nas gshegs pa sogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rta'i rkang pa bzhi 'degs byed/ rgyal chen bzhis mi byed par lha'i gyad bzhi yin la/ sku'i mdun nas tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis 'gro zhing / lha gzhan mang pos mchod pa 'bul ba 'bri dgos/ rta bsngags ldan la rgyan bkal ba dang / rta rdzi bdun pa dang bcas pa rnams phyir klog pa dang yul du sleb pa yang 'bri/ rta bsngags ldan la dad pa gser ldan zer nas dung pa re gtong yang kha skad tsam yin gyi khungs med/ rgya gar gyi ri mo khung ma dkar por yong bas de bzhin bya/ de nas ri dwags rngon pa'i gzugs can zhig gis ngur smig gi gos phul ba dang / mchod rten gyi drung du nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad pa dang / gtsug phud lhas khyer ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gser gyi lo ma can gyi nags tshal zhig na drang srong mang po 'dug pa dang / de shing 'phags pa'i nags tshal du song ba la/ drang srong rnams mi dga' ba dang / de'i drung du bya : ri chub sems dpa' byon te bzhugs pa rnams 'bri ste nges par ཿnga ba'i skor ro/ /ṇa) de nas grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi khang bzang gi rtse mo nas/rgyal po gzugs can snying pos lta ba dang / lam srang na byang chub sems dpa' shing lo tsems pa'i lhung bzed bsnams te bsod snyoms mdzad pa dang / byang —17

chub sems dpa' shing drung du bzhugs pa'i drung du/ rgyal po 'khor bcas byon te zhu ba mdzad pa 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i nags gcig tu/ drang srong la la rkang pa ya gcig 'breng ba dang / la la me lnga gdung ba dang / la la chu la zhugs ba dang /la la du ba 'thung ba la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang dka' thub de gnyis ldabs su mdzad pa 'bri/ de nas yang nags g.yin zhig tu/ lo ma'i skyal po na/ drang srong ring 'phur yod pa 'khor bcas kyi drung du byon pa dang /yang lhag spyod kyi drung du byon pa yang de kho na 'dra ba dang / 'di'i ring phur dang lhag spyod ni/ gong gi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyi snyoms 'jug pa drug gi nang tshan yin/ de nas nags gcig tu/ 'khor lnga drung na yod cing / gzhan mi mang po zhig ldog 'gro ba 'bri/ de nas chu klung ne rañja na'i 'gram mtha' nags kyi skor ba'i ne'u gsing gi dbus shing drung gcig tu dka' thub mdzad pa'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ spyi khyab dang 'dra/ dka' ba rnam pa drug spyod pa'i rim pa mang po yod kyang / de tsam gyi chog pa 'dug phyug rdzis snyan la shing 'dzugs pa dang / lha gsum gyi gtam rjes su sgrog pa sogs kyang 'bri/ de nas phyogs gcig tu khrus mdzad cing / mi ro la dbu sngas mdzad de gzims pa 'bri ste dka' ba spyod pa'i skor ro/ /(t+tha) de nas phyogs gcig tu khrus mdzad pa dang / 'khor lnga kun tu rgyu'i cha byad gzhan du 'gro ba dang / 'bras chan gsol ba'i tshul bya/ de nas bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas 'o thug phul ba dang / gser snod chu bo ne rañja nar bor ba dang / de klus khyer ba dang / brgya byin bya khyung du sprul nas de —18—

phrogs te lha yul du khyer ba dang / brag de'u me tog gis brgyan pa la bzhugs pas/ brag nyil ba dang / lhas bskul te de nas phar gshegs pa la/ chu nang nas klu'i rgyal po dus can zhes byas bstod pa dang / rtswa 'tshong bkra shis 'khor bcas kyi rtswa phul ba dang / byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i skor ro/ /(zhe byang chub kyi shing gi drung du rtsa btang ba'i steng du bzhugs pa mnyam ba theg mdzad pa la/ bdud kyi sprul pa'i pho nya bdun 'ong ba dang / yang de dang nye bar/ bdud 'dul gyi bkod pa spyi dang 'dra ba 'bri ba las/ rin po che'i bzhugs khri mi da rgas/ yang byang chub shing gcig gi rtsa ba na/ bzhugs tshul mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la/ shing gi yal ga che la dkar ba lo ma rnams lha mang pos 'dzin pa 'bri/ /mngon byung dang/ 'dul ba'i lugs la/ slu brid ston pa'i bdud kyi bu mo gsum kho na 'bri ste/ bdud btul pa'i skor ro/ /(nya) bdud 'dul ba dang sangs rgyas pa gnyis dus mtshan mo gcig kho na la yin kyang / mdzad pa'i khyad par shin tu che ba'i phyir/ byang chub brnyes pa logs su 'bri mi dgos te/ byang chub shing drung du rtsa'i gdan la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ sku'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas tshangs ris kyi lha re re'i bstod pa byed pa 'bri/ de nas rgyal chen bzhis rdo'i lhung bzed phul ba dang / tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la lhas lung bstan nas bsod snyoms phul zhing / sangs rgyas kyi chos gsung pa dang / yang brgya byin gyi a ru ra phul ba dang / phyogs gcig na bdud kyi thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ de nas chu'i nang klu btang bzung gi pho brang du byon zhing / sbrul gyi —19—

gdeng ka byas pa dang / klu de rnams la chos gsung pa dang / yang byang chub shing gi rtsa bar rtsa'i gdan la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa ste/ de dag kyang spyi dang 'dra/mngon par byang chub pa'i skor ro/ / 6) de nas tshangs pas 'khor lo 'bul gyi chos gsung par bskul ba dang/ wa ra nā si'i phyogs la phebs pa'i lam du/ 'tsho ba pa kun tu gcig dang mjal ba dang / gru mkhan gyi gru ma btang ba la/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas wa ra nā si'i phyogs la drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags te/ ri chung la nags yod pa zhig tu/ 'khor lnga sde kun tu rgyu'i cha byad can rnams kyi sangs rgyas rgyang ring po nas 'byon pa lta zhing/ phan tshun du gtam smra ba'i tshul dang / 'khris su byon pa na/ gcig gi gdan gding /gcig gi zhu ba zhu/ gcig gi 'kha/sa bkru/ gcig gis bsu ba byed/ gcig gis phyag 'tshal zhing / na bza' 'khur ba'i tshul byed/ de nas phyogs gcig tu pha bong 'dra ba zhig gi steng du ston pa bzhugs shing / lnga sde dge slong gi rnam pa can gyi chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / g.yas g.yon dang nam mkha' nas lha chos nyan pa'i tshul mang du bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu/ ston pa'i drung du dge slong gsum 'dug cing / dge slong gnyis kyi grong khyer nas bsod snyoms len pa'i tshul dang / yang de dang nye ba na/ khyim gcig na grags pa bud med kyi 'khor gyi skor ba dang / khyim gcig phyogs gcig tu bud med rnams gnyid du song ba/ grags pa sgo phye ste 'gro/ grags pa'i pha sgron me thogs te 'tshol ba dang / chu 'gram zhig tu lham bzhag chu'i phar phyogs na sangs rgyas kyi drung du grags pa chos nyan pa —20—

dang / de dang nye bar grags pa'i pha langs nas 'dug pa'i tshul 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na nye ba'i lnga sde ste/ dge slong lnga sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / de rnams kyi nye du mang po tshur yong ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang skyed mos tshal gcig tu/ mi mang po bud med rol mo thogs pa mang po dang lhan cig tu 'dug pa las/ rol mo thogs pa'i bud med gcig bros shing mi gcig 'tshol du 'gro ba sangs rgyas dang mjal ba dang / phyogs gcig tu kar pa sa'i tshal mtsho ni byed nags tshal gcig tu/ bzang sde drug bcu rab tu byung ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi cho se gsung pa'i tshul nga/nga bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma la chos gsung pa'i tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig tu/ bud med rgyan gos phun sum 'tshogs pa rgan gzhon gnyis la chos ston pa dang / bram ze lha zhes bya ba dang / de'i chung mas bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang / de gnyis la chos gsang pa dang / bram zes sa stong gcig nas brgyan mang po rnyed pa dang / chung mas gser gyi bum pa rnyed pa'i tshul 'bri ste/ wa ra nā sir chos 'khor bskor ba'i skor ro/ /(ste tha) de nas drang srong steng rgyas 'od srung gi nags su gshegs shing / drang srong gi bsu ba byas shing gdan la bzhugs pa dang / me khang gcig tu klus me sbar zhing du ba 'thul ba dang / ston pa'i sku las me dang du ba de las kyang cher spros te/ klu de'i mtha' rnams mes 'khor ba dang / klu des zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba 'bri/ 'di la sngon gyi kha che dang bal bo'i ri mo khungs ma las/klu de lha'i lus can mdog sngon po sprul mgo'i gdeng ka yod pa/ ral gri 'dzin pa'i rnam pa yod pa mthong / phyogs gcig tu drang srong 'od srung gi spyan drangs —21—

shing / ston pas lhung bzed kyi nang du klu de bcug nas bsnams pa'i tshul dang /phyogs gcig tu drang srong mang pos me sbor ma thub pa dang / ston pas rang sbar du byung ba dang / bram ze rnams kyis me bsad kyang ma shi ba dang / ston pas rang zhir mdzad pa dang / steng rgyas 'od srung la'ang de lta bu dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du rgyal chen bzhi lus me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas chos nyan pa dang /yang brgya byin yang de ltar chos nyan pa dang / tshangs pa yang de dang 'dra bar nyan pa ste/ de gsum kar la yang 'od bsrung rto spyil gyi sgo drung nas lta ba dang / yang phyogs gcig tu 'od srung la skye bo mang po phyag byed cing / yo byad mang po 'bul bar 'dus pa dang / drang srong rang yang sbyin bsreg dang mchod pa byed/ sangs rgyas phyogs gzhan zhig la thegs 'gro ba dang / yang phyogs gcig tu drang srong gcig pu zas nor mang pos skor pa'i sar/ sangs rgyas tshur byon pa dang / drang srong 'od srung la sangs rgyas kyi lhung bzed kyi nang nas shing 'bras chen po gnang ba dang / chung ngu gnang ba dang / ma smos pa'i lo thog gi 'bras skyos mar gnang ba'i tshul dang / de bzhin du lha'i bdud rtsi gnang ba ste bzhi po de la re re zhing drang srong rang gis kyang sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang / chu mig rdol ba la khrus mdzad pa dang / shing gi yal ga rang dud du byung ba la/ phyag 'jus te bzhengs pa dang / rdo leb chen po'i steng du sku 'khru ba dang / rdo leb chen po'i steng du sku chos brkyangs te skem pa dang / ston pa chu'i steng du zhabs 'chag mdzad cing / drang srong 'od srung sdong gru chung ngu gcig gi nang du bzhugs te 'ong pa dang / chu 'gram du ston pa dang 'od bsrung gsung gleng mdzad pa dang / drang —22—

srong rnams 'dus pa la 'od srung nyid gtam smra tshul dang / de dag 'khor bcas kyi ral pa bregs pa rnams dang / phrags gdan dang / dbyug gu la sogs pa thams cad chu la bor ba dang / de rnams kyi rab tu byung ba'i chas su sgyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba dang / drang srong gi chas chus khyer ba/ ga ya 'od bsrung dang / chu klung 'od bsrung 'khor bcas kyi mthong ba dang /de gnyis steng rgyas 'od bsrung 'tshol du 'ong ba dang / kho rang rnams kyi chas kyang sngar bzhin chu la bor te rab tu byung ba dang / ri ga ya'i rtse mo la/ ston pa nyid bzhugs shing ra 'a/ pa can stong rab tu byung ba rnams la chos ston pa/ de'i nam mkha' la sangs rgyas nyid gshegs pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa dang / stod nas me 'bar zhing smad nas chu 'bab pa sogs kyi bkod pa dang / ri'i rtsa rnga spro na rgyal po'i pho nya mdung thung thogs pa ri la lta ba zhig 'bri/yang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa/ pho brang gi rtse nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po blon po'i tshogs kyi skor ba la pho nya gcig gi zhu ba zhu zhing /pho nya gcig 'phri ca/ par gtong pa'i tshul dang ri'i rtse mo na sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa bzhug bro/ pa'i drung du pho nya sleb ste/ zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la che/ du phebs pa'i tshul/ rgyal po pho brang nas phyir byon pa'i grong khyer gyi srang kha ru shing rta la bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sa la bying ba dang / btson mang po btang bskya chul dang / yang rgyal po'i dbu rgyan sgo'i ya them la thegs pa dang / yul gzhan na las ka la yod pa'i mi rnams tshur bsdud pa dang / de nas rgyal po 'khor ba) 5sa lam du zhugs pa dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / shing ḍā—23—

dang / rkang thang dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag du ma yang 'bri/ sha pa'i tshal lam tang brang gi tshal zhes pa skyed mos tshal 'dra ba khang bzang ched pa'i nags mthong zhig tu dbus su sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs/ g.yas su steng rgyas 'od bsrung dge slong dbu skra dkar po can/ g.yon nam mdun du rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba yang logs gcig na rgyal po thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas g.yon rgyab phyogs rnams su dge slong mang po dang / mdun phyogs shes che bas mtha' skor du khrom 'tshogs pa dang / g.yas g.yon gyi steng gi nam mkha' la/'od bsrung dge slong sgres po de kha 'dra ba bzhi/ me 'bar ba dang / chu 'bab pa dang / 'od 'phro ba dang / nam mkha' la 'chag pa'i tshul byed pa re re bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i g.yas zur 'og gi phyogs nas des phyag 'tshal ba 'bri/yang rgyal po'i pho brang snga ma dang 'dra rung la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas grong khyer gyi nang du phebs pa dang / pho brang nang gi bzhugs khri la bzhugs shing /rgyal pos bsod snyoms dang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ 'od ma'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang 'bri dgos te/ de yang dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po/ mtha' khang bzang chung ngu mang po dang / khang mig gis skor ba/ khang bzang gi g.yas g.yon dang / mtha' skor du shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ phyi'i mtha' ra bas skor ba/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen por de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang / khang bzang gzhan dang / khang mig rnams na dge slong mang po dag bzhugs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ yang 'od ma'i tshal de dang 'dra rung mdor bsdus pa zhig la/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun gyis —24—

'khor gyi skor ba/ chos 'chad pa zhig bya/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas bram ze kun tu rgyu gnyis/ gcig ni sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba dang / gcig 'khor gyi nyan thos gcig la phyag 'tshal ba dang / de gnyis kyi rjes nas bram ze mang po yong ba/ sku'i g.yas phyogs su de gnyis dang / gzhan bram ze de thams cad rab tu byung bar gyur pa/ lag na lhung rba zed dang bya ma bum thogs pa 'bri/ gtsug lag khang de nas 'gyang tsam du grong khyer gyi bkod pa zhig 'bri zhing / de'i byang lam du dgra bcom pa gcig gis bram ze gcig la chos ston pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan cig tu bram ze cig la bram ze gcig gi chos ston pa dang / grong khyer gyi gseb tu bram ze gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro ba dang / nags shig tu de gnyis nam mkha‘spru la lta ba dang / yang dge slong mang po dang / skye bo mang po gtam smra ba 'bri ste/mchog zung gnyis rab tu 'byung ba 'a bkod pa yin no/ /de) //yang phyogs gcig tu wa ra nā si mtshon byed grong khyer cung zad dang / ri chung ngu nags tshal can la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa/drang srong dar bab zhig ri'i rtsa ba nas 'ong zhing / ston pa'i sku gzhogs su dge slong du gyur pa dang / grong khyer cig gi gseb na bram ze'i khye'u zhig lag pas g.yas na shing gi glag bu la yi ge bris pa dang / g.yon na cung zad gyen du bteg pa/ mtha' skye bo mang pos skor ba dang / de dang drang srong de gtam smra ba 'bri'o/ /yang grong khyer ri de ga 'dra rung sangs rgyas 'khor bcas sngar bzhin bzhugs nga la/ sku'i g.yas phyogs nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yong ba 'dra ba la/ 'khor tshogs mang po lta ba'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs gzhan cung zad thag —25—

ring grong khyer gyi rnam pa can gcig nas/ sprul gyi mjug ma thon pa la mgo bos wa ra na si mtshon byed sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i ri 'gram gyi grong khyer der sleb pa/ sbrul de'i mgo la shing sdong bdun skyes shing / bya dang sbrang bu la sogs pa 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang / sbrul de'i skang pa'i thad tsam na gnod spyin lag na rdo rje 'bri ste/ ngo bo bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag yin yang / gsang sngags kyi sgrub thabs nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid mtha' dag tshang ba rang yang mi dgos te/sku mdog sngo sang khro bo'i cha byad la/ sbrul dang dar sngon po dang / stag lpags la sogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ phyag g.yon pas skyabs spyin dang / g.yas pas rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin pa bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku drung du/ klu zhig chos nyan pa'ang 'bri ste/ ka t+ya ya na'i sde tshan no/ /'a) yang bkod pa gcig la/ bar ri nags kyi chod pa'i lung tsho gsum bya/ tshur phyogs der nags kyi dbus ri chung zhig la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas ri dwags mang po dang / mdun du dge slong gcig yod pa la bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang / phyogs gcig tu dge slong mang po sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba dang / dge slong gtso 'khor de rnams phar phyogs la 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ yul ljongs bar ma de na/ khang pa gcig na bram ze gcig bud med gcig bu mo mchog gcig rnams 'dug pa sgo'i phyi nas gar mkhan rnams gar byed pa/ gar mkhan gcig lag tu thum po zhig thog nas bram ze de la gtam smra ba dang / yang khang pa de kha 'dra ba la/ khang steng na bud —26—

med de la lag pa la 'gram pa gtad cing lta ba dang / mdun du bud med gtam smra ba dang / phyogs gcig nas 'dreg mkhan mos skra 'dreg pa dang / tshur phyogs nas dgra bcom pa dpon slob de rnams lam nas yong ba dang / bud med des gar mkhan la skra'i chun po zhig sprod pa dang/ gar mkhan de la snod gcig tu dod rtsa mang po bcug nas ster ba dang / khang pa de'i rgyab na/ dur khrod du mi ro bsreg pa dang / phyogs yangs sa zhig tu/ dge slong dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bud med des gdugs tshod gsol ba'i rnam pa 'bri/yul phar phyogs de ru grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa'i grong gi sgo'i them pa la/ dgra bcom pa de zhabs bzhag cing / dge slong rnams kyang rjes la 'ong ba/ nam mkha' nas lhas me tog gi char 'beb cing / 'byung po mang po thag ring du bros pa dang / de la grong khyer gyi sgo'i steng nas mi gcig gi lta zhing / mi de rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba 'bul ba dang / phyi khyams su dge slong rnams la mchod ston gsol ba dang / yang khang bzang gnyis byas pa'i gcig tu dge slong dang /gcig tu mu stegs can rnams la chos ston gsol/ sgo so so nas de gnyis ni so sor gyes 'gro ba la/ mi res dri ba re byed tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig na glang po che'i ra ba re rer/ dge slong dang mu stegs can la kha zas ngan pa re 'dren pa dang / yang so sor gyes 'gro ba la gtam 'dri ba'i mi dang / grong khyer pho brang de kha 'dra ba'i dbus kyi khang bzang gcig tu/ dge slong 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod 'bul zhing / rgyal po yang thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa dang / grong khyer gyi sgo nas/ bu mo mchog ras kyi gos g.yogs pa dang / 'khor dang bcas —27—

pa 'jug pa dang / 'byung po mang po thag ring du 'bros pa dang / de la mi rnams lta ba dang / khang bzang gcig na/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis dang / gzhon nu gcig dang / bram ze dang blon po gcig rnams yod cing / phyi rol gyis khyams zhig na/ glang po che dang / glang mo dang / rnga mong dang/ rta mchog dang / mi ba dan ring po thogs pa gcig rnams 'bri/ phyi rol kyi sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu dgra bcom pa des/ skye bo mang po la chos 'chad pa dang / yang khang bzang gcig tu rgyal po mnal log pa dang / nam mkha' la 'od khyim zlum po brgyad kyi nang na/tsan+dan dkar pos lus byugs pa'i mi dang / dmar pos lus la gtor ba'i mi dang / ri gcig dang / ngang pa gnyis dang / mi'i mchan khung gnyis nas sprul 'a myong ba dang / mi gcig gi mgo la me 'bar ba dang / mi'i rkang pa la nya gnyis 'khril ba dang / bya gong ma bsreg gcig dang bcas pa brgyad po de rnams hal sto te/ ri mo phra mos 'bri'o/ /yang khang bzang de'i phyogs gcig na/ dgra bcom pa la rgyal pos zhu ba byed pa dang / khralas yangs pa gcig tu rgyal bo la be'u ras dang / la dmar rin po che dang / glang chen gcig rta gnyis/ gser dang rin po che spel ba'i 'phreng ba/ ral gri gnyis/ nor bu'i lham cha rnams 'bul mkhan byung ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ yang phyogs yangs pa gcig tu/ dgra bcom pa la be'u ras dang /bud med gcig la gser 'phreng / gcig la la dmar/ bram ze la rta/ gzhone nu la lham/ blon po la ral gri rnams byung ba dang / phyogs gcig tu dgra bcom pa la rgyal pos thal mo sbyar zhing zhu ba 'bul ba dang / yang gtsug lag khang —28—

gcig na dgra bcom pa de yul ljongs thog ma'i phyogs la gdong gtad cing thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba 'bul tshul dang / de yul de'i phyogs gcig tu/ gtsug lag khang gcig nas sangs rgyas kyi de la bka' stsole ba'i tshul 'bri/ sngar gyi rgyal bo'i pho brang gi 'khris der/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/'bru dang na bza' dang / snod spyad dang / nor dang yo byad sna tshogs pa dag dang /rta dang ba glang la sogs pas 'bul snod dpag tu med pas mtha' skor zhing 'bul ba'i tshul dang / rgyal po yang thal mo sbyar zhing smon lam 'debs pa 'bri ste/ 'phags pa ka t+ya ya na mngags te/ grong khyer 'phags rgyal du rgyal po rab snang la sogs nga/ skye bo thams cad dge ba la 'god par mdzad pa'i skabs kyi le tshan no/ /(pa) yang khyim yangs pa gcig tu sangs rgyas la khyim bdag mo gnyis kyi bsod snyom 'bul ba dang / yang de'i sgo drung phyi nang gang bde ba zhig na/ ston pas khyim bdag mo de la lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshul bya/ yang khyim de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig tu gcer bu pa dang khyim bdag de gros byed pa dang / khyim bdag mo sbrum ma/ de'i dku mnye ba dang / de shi ste phung po 'don pa'i bkod pa dang / dur khrod gcig tu skye bo mang po tshogs pa'i dbus su/ de'i phung po bsregs pas/ lto gas pa'i dkyil nas/ pad+ma'i sdong po dang pad+ma kha phye ba'i dbus na khye'u yod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' stsal nas rgyal bu mtsho byed gzhon nu de len par rtsom pa dang / sngar gyi khyim bdag de gcer bu pa'i gdong du lta ba 'bri/ nge/ dang nye bar gzhal med khang gcig tu/ gzhon nu zhig lha mo —29—

mang po dang / lha'i 'byor pa lta bu dang ldan pa 'bri ste/ me skyes lung bstan pa'i skabs so/ /(2) yang bkod pa gcig la/ ri gcig gi drung na/ dur khrod zhig yod pa na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i bkod pa dang / de'i drung na khyim bdag cig chos nyan pa'i tshul bya zhing / de dang mi ring ba'i grong khyer gcig gi khang bzang na/ skye bo mang po zas g.yo ba'i las byed pa dang / khyim bdag gnyis gros byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ phyi khyams kyi sgo'i nang na khyim bdag de 'gro bzhin pa la/bar snang nas lha'i rnam pa zhig gis gtam smra ba dang / khyim bdag de dang nyan thos zhig sdebs nas sangs rgyas kyi drung na bkod pa phyi ma rnams kyi sa la phar 'gro ba'i tshul zhig bya/ sngar gyi khang bzang mi mang po las byed pa de dang 'brel ba'i khang pa gzhan zhig tu/ sangs rgyas 'khore bcas la khyim bdag gcig gis mchod pa 'bul ba'i rnam pa byed/ de rnams dang ma 'brel bar theg yod pa'i phyogs g.yin gcig tu/ khang bzang gcig gi sgo drung na/ mu stegs pa cha byad sna tshogs pa mang po 'dus pa dang / de la khyim bdag des gtam smra ba dang /mtha' shing gis skor ba'i sa phyogs gcig gser gyi sbram bur brdal zhing / mi mang pos gser gyi khur po sa cha der skyel ba'i rnam pa dang / khyim bdag dang rgyal po'i bu gnyis gtam smra ba'i rnam pa byed/ yang mi gzi brjid che ba bzhi'i rtsa na/ khyim bdag rgyal po'i bu dang brtsod pa'i tshul dang / rgyal—po zhig gi drung du yang khyim bdag dang mu stegs rnams/ phan tshun du gtam smra ba'i tshul byed/de nas phyogs gzhan gcig tu skye bo mang po 'dus pa la/ phyogs gcig tu —30—

'phags pa shā ri'i bu khri la 'dug pa dang / de'i phyogs nas rlung langs pa/ glang po che bya khyung rnams yod pa/ phyogs gcig na mun stegs 'ga' re 'dug pa/de'i phyogs la shing sdong dang pad tshal mtsho sbrul rnams yod pa/ shing sdong gcig rlung bus dum bur bcag pa rtsa ba nas bton pa dang / pad+ma'i rdzing bu glang po che chen po zhig gi dkrugs shing / pad+ma zos pa dang / sbrul mgo bdun pa chen po zhig 'ong ba la/ bya khyung mang pos sbrul gyi mgo nas za ba dang / ro lang zhig byung ba la/ sha ri'i bus phur bu'i btab pa dang / ro lang gi mu stegs can gcig brdas pa dang / mu stegs de shā ri'i bu la phyag 'tshal zhing / shā ri'i bus ro langs kyi phur ba bton pa dang / yang phyogs gcig na mtha' shing sdong gis skor ba'i dbus der/ skye bo mang po gtsug lag khang brtsig pa dang / de kha'i phyogs kyi zur la la na/ thig sna gcig shā ri'i bus bzung / gcig khyim bdag gcig gis bzung nas thig 'debs pa'i tshul dang / de kha'i thad kyi nam mkha'i thad mthon por gser gyi khang bzang gcig dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi khang bzang gcig 'bri/ khang bzang de gnyis dang 'og gi gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i steng der/ gser ris lta bu ri mo zhig gi sbrel/ gtsug lag khang brtsig pa de dang nye ba'i shing drung gcig na/ shā ri'i bu zhabs 'chag byed pa/ gyad lcags kyi dbyug pa thogs pas/ mu stegs mang po 'ded pa dang / shā ri'i bu khri la bzhugs nas mu stegs mang rnge sto/ la chos ston pa dang / rab tu byung ba 'bri ste/ phyogs gcig la mu stegs kyi cha lugs dang / phyogs gcig la rab byung gi chas yod pa rnams 'bri ba legs/ gtsug lag khang de'i sgo khang gi thad na/ rgyal po'i bus bkod —31—

pa byed cing / sgo khang brtsig pa 'bri/ bkod pa 'di tsho dang sngar gyi dur khrod yod pa de'i bar stong la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas lam du bzhugs nas 'byon pa/lam gyi sa stongs su 'khor bcas bzhugs shing / skye bo mang pos mchod pa sna tshogs byed pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ sngar gyi gtsug lag khang brtsig bzhin pa'i bkod pa de dang nye bar/ mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po'i dbus na rgyal po pho brang dang bcas pa yod pa la/ de dang nye ba na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon zhing / sa mthil la skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang / steng gi nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyi me tog gi char mang po 'bebs pa dang / sngar brtsig bzhin pa'i gtsug lag khang de grub pa'i tshul du byas pa/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ khang bzang chen po khang bzang bcu drug gis skor ba/ de'i mtha' khang mig drug cus skor ba mtshon byed dang / phyi lcags ris skor ba/ lcags ri'i phyinang thams cad shing sna tshogs pas btibs pa/ 'di ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal yin te/ de'i nang du sangs rgyas 'khor du mas skor ba la/ khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin gyi gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs nas chab 'bul ba'i steng ka byed pa/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol gcig tu nyan thos gcig gi lhung bzed chen po gcig bzed/ khyim bdag spyi blugs chen po gcig thogs nas/ lhung bzed der chu ldugs pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi nang gi sangs rgyas 'khor ra bcas la mchod pa'i yo byad mang bo yod pa zhig 'bri/ yang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de 'dra rung la/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i sku'i mdun du/ rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khor mang po dang bcas te thal mo sbyar nas chos nyan pa 'bri/ de —32—
