dag ni rgya la bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bzhengs shing / rgyal po gsal rgyal dad pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /(ba) de nas rgyal po'i pho brang zhig nas pho nya ba zhig mngags te/pho brang gzhan zhig tu 'gro ba'i bkod pa dang / pho brang phar phyogs de na rgyal po zas gtsang lag pa la 'gram pa gtad de sems khong du chud pa'i tshul la/ de'i mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char ka blon po'i rnam pa mi sha kha nag po zhig gi rgyal po la zhu ba byed pa lha re tshul bya/ pho brang tshur phyogs de dang nye ba na/ khang bzang snga ma 'dra ba la mdor bsdus pa gcig tu/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun nas 'char ka des zhu yig gi sgrom bu 'bul ba la/ yang de kha'i phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas khri la bzhugs pa/ sku mdun na 'dug pas bka' nyan pa dang / yang de dang 'brel ba'i phyogs gcig tu 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'char ka rab tu byung ba nga/nga / 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyi drung nas phar 'gro ba rnams 'bri/ pho brang phar phyogs de dang nye bar khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi mdun na/ 'char ka rab tu byung ste gtam smra ba dang / rgyal bu rgyal byed tshal gyi bkod pa'i ras bris ston pa/ sgo'i phyi na 'char ka gnas pa mi gzhan zhig la lon sprod pa'i tshul 'bri/ de dang nye ba'i skyed mos tshal zhig gi dbus su gtsug lag khang bzhengs bzhin pa'i bkod pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan gcig nas sangs rgyas 'khore bcas lam la gshegs pa dang / chu 'gram zhig tu dge slong rnams khrus byed pa dang / ser skya'i grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa dang /de'i mdun nas tshur la shing rta dang / shing rta 'dren byed kyi rta dang / shing rta la —33—

btsugs pa'i dar po che dang / ba dan dang / shing rta'i nang na yod pa'i mi rnams kyi gos lham thod rnga yab la sogs pa'i yo byad thams cad kha dog mtshungs pa ste/ thams cad dkar po dang / thams cad sngon po dang / thams cad dmar po dang / thams cad ser po dang / thams cad khra bo la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po 'bri zhing / tshur phyogs nas sangs rgyas ta la bdun srid kyi nam mkha' nas 'byon zhing / sprul pa mang po 'gyed pa sogs rdzu'aphrul gyi bkod pa spyi dang 'dra ba dang / 'khor rnams ta la drug srid kyi nam mkha' la 'byon pa sogs mtshon byed bya/ pho brang de dang nye ba na/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de 'dra rung gi sgo drung na/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po dang / sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa phebs pa la/ rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba dang / kun dga' ra ba de'i nang du sangs rgyas la 'khor mang pos skor zhing rgyal po la sogs pa chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ de'i sgo drung du mi brgyan dang ldan pa gcig la skye bo mang pos smad cing sdigs pa'i tshul 'bri/ de dang nye ba na skyed mos tshal gnyis su sangs rgyas la rgyal po'i rnam pa re re gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor mang po chos nyan pa dang / sgo drung du mi rgyan ldan gcig la/ mi mang pos smod pa'i snga ma dang 'dra ba 'bri/ de nas khang bzang gcig na rgyal po zas gtsang yod pa'i mdun du/ dgra bcom pa gcig gdan mtho ba la bzhugs pa dang / steng gi nam mkha' dgra bcom pa de kha'i sku las sprul pa'i dge slong nam mkha' la 'chag pa dang / gzims pa dang / 'od zer 'gyed pa dang / smad nas me 'bar zhing / stod nas chu 'khrum pa la sogs pa 'bri/ n+ya gro dha'i kun —34—

dga' ra ba snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ lcags ri sogs thams cad shel ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du yod pa/ dbus su sangs rgyas la brgya byin la sogs pa lha 'ba' zhig gis skor ba dang / sgo bzhi na rgyal chen bzhi 'khor mang po dang bcas pas bsrung ba/ dgra bcom pa des rgyal po zas gtsang khrid nas/ sgo drung du sleb cing / yul 'khor bsrung dang gtam smra ba dang / yang khang bzang gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du/ rgyal po zas gtsang chos nyan pa'i bkod pa 'bri/de nas khang bzang gzhan gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po zas gtsang 'khor bcas kyis bsod snyoms 'bul ba'i rnam pa dang / khang bzang gzhan gcig tu bcom/ ldan 'das 'khor bcas la/ btsun mo'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / yang khang bzang gzhan gcig tu/ rgyal po zas gtsang dang /mched gsum dang / skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang / rgyal po'i rnam pa zig gi yi ge bris pa la rgya'/ rigs thams cad kyi nyan pa'i tshul dang / khang bzang chung ngu gcig na rgyal rigs gnyis/ gtam smra zhing / mal stan la snyes pa'i cas dang /shākya rnams glang po che la zhon/ gdugs dang rnga yab sogs dang / gos rgyan gzab par byas pa dang / kha gcig shing rtar bzhugs pa dang / kha gcig khyogs byams khri la bteg nas 'gro ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang / g.yas g.yon nas skye bo mang po lta ba dang / phyogs gcig nas sa'i steng du gdan khri la rgyal po zas gtsang bzhugs/ 'khor kha re dang / bram ze bzhi lnga tsam/ shākya rnams la lta ba 'bri/ shākya de rnams kyi nang nas rjes na kha gcig las/ gcig gi gtsug gi nor bu dmar po khras khyer ba dang / gcig gis mu tig gi do shal sa la lhung —35—

ba dang / gcig gi 'khris su bong bu skad 'don pa 'bri/ phar phyogs su n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba sngar gyi de kha 'dra rung zhig byas nas/ phyi 'khyams su ras bting pa'i steng du/ de rnams kyi rgyan thams cad sbud pa dang / 'dreg mkhan gyi skra 'dreg pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du khrus byed pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi khang bzang gi nang zhig tu/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su de rnams rab tu byung ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ dge 'dun gyi nang gi dge slong gcig sngar gyi 'dreg mkhan de rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa la/ shākya gsar du rab tu byung ba zhig gis zhabs la mgo bos 'dud pa 'bri/ gzhan rnams sha mdog dkar ba la/ 'dreg mkhan de sku sha sngo sangs su bris na legs par go ste/ rab tu byung ba'i gnas skabs na 'phags pa nye ba 'khor yin no/ /de dag ni yab sras mjal ba'i sde tshan no/ /rdzo) yang n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'i bkod pa lnga brgya bstan pa mtshon byed la/ chu sogs ji ltar rigs pa khang bzang gcig na bzhugs pa dang / khang bzang gzhan gcig nas btsun mo grags 'dzin mas zas mchog gis gang ba'i snod sgra gcan 'dzin byis pa'i rnam pa can gyi lag tu gtod pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po bzhugs pa de rnams kyi nang gi sangs rgyas gcig la sgra gcan 'dzin gyi zas mchog 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun gyis 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ bud med kyi tshogs mang pos chos nyan pa dang / nam mkha' la sangs rgyas mang po 'phur ba dang / 'od zer sna —36—

tshogs pa 'phro ba dang / phyag tu ri bo bsnams pa dang / zla ba nyi ma la phyag gis reg pa dang / sku'i ba sbu'i khung bu nas bya khyung dang klu dang / glang po dang / seng ge la sogs pa sna tshogs pa spro ba dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi sku las/ sangs rgyas dkar po/ dmar po/ ljang khu sogs spro ba dang / yang sku las/ lha dang / lha mo dang / bram ze dang / dge slong sogs spro ba dang/ de bzhin du stod nas me 'bar zhing / smad nas chu 'bab/ smad nas me 'bar zhing / stod nas chu 'bab pa la sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa zhig 'bri/ yang khang bzang gcig gi nang du/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dge 'dun dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / bud med mchog gcig gis zas mchog bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang / khang bzang de'i phyogs gcig gi rtse mo nas bud med de nyid 'phyongs pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas gnod pa med par slang ste sa la bzhag pa dang / de'i nye skor gyi phyi rol sa mtho ba zhig tu sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas/ bud med mchog de la chos ston pa/ bud med de da lta rab tu byung ba'i gzugs med kyang dgra bcom pa thob cing / rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub pa mtshon byed du/ lus las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba zhig 'bri/ yang phyogs g.yin zhig tu/ sangs rgyas khang bzang gi mdo'i phyi khyams 'dra ba zhig tu bzhags pa la/ khang bzang de'i sgo thams cad phye zhing / khyim gyi phug nas byis pa zhig sangs rgyas mthong bas dga' zhing rgyugs te 'ong ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung du phyin pa des/ thal mo sbyar zhing chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / sgo nang nas sangs rgyas phar phebs pa'i rjes su byis pa 'gro ba dang / sgo'i phyi rol du pha ma dang nye du rnams kyis byis pa de skor ba la/—37—

de ngu ba'i tshul dang / de rnams la sangs rgyas kyi bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang /byis pa de glang po che'i steng du bskyon/ 'khor g.yog 'ga' re yang glang po che la zhon pa dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo sna tshogs byed pa sogs 'khor mang po bskor ba dang / glang po che des me tog ut+na la'i sdong bu sna zhugs kyi sa nas bton te za ba'i tshul dang / de'i nye skor nas skye bo mang po lta ba dang /yab rgyal po bdud rtsi zas de nyid kyang lta ba dang / bram ze lung bstan byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs su gtsug lag khang gi nang du/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ byis pa de rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ de ni 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ mu tig 'khri shing ngam/ mu tig can gyi lo rgyus kyi rtsa ba de skabs 'dir 'brel che ste/ khang bzang chung ngu zhig gi sgo nas/ shākya ming chen rgyal phran gyi cha byad can gyis 'jug pa dang / khang pa'i nang du ming chen thal mo sbyar ste/ de rang gi mdun sa phyogs dma' ba na/ rang gi bud med khyad 'phags 'dug pa la gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ bud med de rgyan ci rigs khyim du 'jog pa dang / skye rgu'i bdag mo bud med gzi brjid che ba la/ 'khor shākya mo thams cad kyis bskor te 'gro ba dang / de rnams bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pa dang / de dag gi nang nas gcig rang gi mu tig gi do shal ril lta zhing 'dug pa dang / ming chen gyi chung mas g.yog mo zhig rang gi khyim du rdzangs pas 'gro ba'i tshul dang / lag tu gro ga'i gleg bu yi ge can thogs pa dang / lam du ba grus ma zhig gis brdung ste shi ba'i tshul 'bri/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i tshul yang 'di dang 'grel bar bris na legs te/ khang bzang gi sgo drung du sangs rgyas bsod —38—

snyoms la phebs pa dang / khang bzang gi nang nas dga' bo rgyal po'i cha byad zas mchog thogs pa dang / de'i btsun mo pun da ri kas/ gos sa la gting ba'i steng du chu'i ri mo zlum po 'bri ba'i tshul bya/ khyim gyi phyi nas sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rjes su dga' bo lhung bzed zas mchog gis bkang ste 'gro ba dang /gtsug lag khang gi nang sangs rgyas kyi sku drung du dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i chas bskon zhing skra bregs pa'i tshul bya/ phyogs gcig nas de rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs su sgyur zin nas/ phyag dar byed pa'i tshul dang / gtsug lag khang de'i g.yas g.yon ga pa ri rung gi phyogs gcig tu/ shing gi yal ga dud pa'i phag na de yod pa la/ sangs rgyas kyang der byon pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos gos kyi grwa la de 'jus nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / ri nags tshal yod pa/ shing gcig la spre'u mo zhar ma yod pa zhig 'bri/ de dang nye ba na ston pa dang dga' bo gnyis gsung gleng mdzad pa dang / yang ston pa'i chos gos kyi grwa la 'jus te/ston pa nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / ri rab kyi rtse mo mtshon byed rin ngo/ che'i ri'i rtse mo na ston pa zur gcig na bzhugs shing / khang bzang bzhi lnga zhig bris pa'i gzhan rnams na/ lha pho mo gnyis chags re dang / gcig na lha mo 'ba' zhig dang khri stong pa zhig 'bri/ de dag re re'i sgo drung na dga' bo re re 'bri zhing /ston pa'i drung du dga' bo zhu ba byed tshul bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyes gzhi me 'bar ba dang / de'i zur gcig tu bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shing / dga' bos zhu ba byed tshul dang / phyogs gzhan nas phar la gzhan rje'i mi/ rnams kyi zangs chen por dmyal ba'i sems can mang po —39—

'tshod pa dang / sdug bsngal gzhan yang mi 'dra ba'i rnam pa gnyis gsum bris la/ gcig na zangs snod zangs zhun gyis gang ba bkol bzhin pa sems can med pa zhig 'bri/ de dag re re'i rtsa na dga' bo re re 'bri/ yang gtsug lag khang gcig na/ dga' bo ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing / lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ dmyal ba'i bkod pa ston pa dang / dgra bcom thob pa'i tshul 'di gnyis ston pa ser skyar bzhugs pa'i dus skabs min yang / lo rgyus snga ma'i zhabs su 'brel che bas bkod pa yang 'dir 'bri'o/ /gcung dga' bo 'di ni gtsug tor dang mdzod sbu na ma gtogs pa'i mtshan sum cu dang ldan par bshad la/ pags pa gser mdog 'dra rung / mi gzhan pas lus tshad kyang cung zad che bar 'bri/ ming chen gyi g.yog mo skye ma shi ba dang / dga' bo rab tu byung ba 'di yab sras mjal ba'i rjes thob rang min pa 'dra yang / lo mang ma 'das pa mi ring ba'i dus su byung bar mngon/ de ltar ston pa phyogs mtho sar bzhugs pa zhig la skye rgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa/ bud med gos dkar po gyon pa mang po thal mo sbyar ba dang / yang bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun dang bcas pa lam gcig na gshegs pa'i phyi nas bud med de dag skra bregs shing gos tshem bu can gyon te 'gro ba dang / yul na de kha'i grong khyer mtshon byed gcig gi nang du/ ston pa'i sku mdun du de dag thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa dang / ston pa'i drung du dge slong gcig gis zhu ba'i tshul dang / gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung na/ dge slong de la bud med de rnams kyis zhu ba byed pa'i tshul bya/de nas yang phyogs gcig na gtsug lag khang gi dbus na ston pa bzhugs pa la/—40—

de dag dge slong mar gyur nas chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ bud med rab tu byung ba'i skabs 'di yang / yab sras mjal ba'i rjes lo mang ma song ba zhig gi phyis yin pa 'dug na'ang / bkod pa 'bri ba'i skabs grong khyer ser skya'i phyogs dang 'brel ba'i phyir dang / 'di tsam gyi bris sku logs pa yongs rdzogs su mi longs pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi de tsho'i sdebs la bris na legs so/ /grong khyer ser skyar 'gro don mjad pa dang 'grel pa'i sde tshan no/ /(na yang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du/ nye sde dge slong ston pa'i sku mdun na yod cing / shākya lnga brgya rab tu byung ba la chos gsung ba 'bri/ yang dge slong mang po mnyam bzhag byas pa lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ yang rgya mtsho'i dbus na gzings btang ba zhig la/ tshong dpon gcig dang / tshong pa mang po gru nang du gtar/ mang po smra ba zhig dang gru rin po ches gang ba tshur 'khor ba dang / khyim rin po tsho che sogs nor sna tshogs kyi gang ba na/ khyim bdag gcig dang tshong dpon de gtam smra khri ka'i tshul dang / tshong dpon de gcig pu rang nyid lam du zhugs pa'i tshul dang / khang bzang gcig gi sgo drung du sleb pa dang khang bzang de dang / sngar gyi de'i bar la ri sogs kyis chod pa zhig 'bri/ khang bzang de'i nang du/ tshong dpon de dang khyim bdag gzi brjid can zhig gtam smra ba 'bri/ de dang nye ba na/ gtsug lag khang zhig gi nang du/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang / de gnyis gtsug lag khang gi phyogs su 'gro ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi sku'i drung du/ tshong dpon de rab tu byung ba'i rnam par gyur pa dang /de yul gzhan la 'gro tshul/ grong khyer chung ngu gcig gi nye 'khor dben pa —41—

gcig tu mnyam bzhag byed pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ phar phyogs thag ring ba zhig la/ rgya mtsho chen po la gzings phar 'gro ba dang rgya mtsho'i phar phyogs gling phran na tshong pa mang po tsan dan gyis shing gcod pa dang / gru tshur lam tsan+dan sa mchog gis bkang ste 'ong pa la/ rlung nag po langs te rgya mtsho'i 'khrugs pa gru nang gi mi rnams thal mo sbyar ba dang / gru'i dbus su dge slong de dkyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs pa dang/ rlung phyir log rgya mtsho'i 'khrugs pa zhi ba 'bri/ gru'i zur nas dge slong de dang / chu'i steng nas gnod spyin srin lus can zhig gtam smra ba 'bri/ de nas gru chu 'gram du sleb pa dang / de dang nye ba zhig tu tsan+dan gyi shing rnams las gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i bkod pa dang /dge slong de dang khyim bdag gcig gi khar lta byed pa'i tshul bya/ de kha'i khris su shing gi /spang bzang de yang rags pa grub pa'i rnam pa dang / dge slong de dang khyim bdag de'i pus mo btsugs shing thal mo sbyar la/ mdun du spos dang me tog dang gser snod chus bkang ba mang po bzhag de gnyis la skye bo mang pos lta ba'i tshul bya/ mchod pa de rnams 'khris der sngar gyi bkod pa de khas nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang / nam mkha' mtho sa nas me tog rang las grub pa'i khang bzang gi rnam pa dang / bdug spos ni sprin gyi rnam pa dang / chu ni bi khu rlu'i rnam par song / tshur ngos nas gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du me tog gi khang bzang sogs mchod pa de dag 'bab pa dang / de'i nye skor yul grong phra mo rnams su dge slong mang po yod pa rnams kun dga' bos tshul shing thogs nas bsdu ba'i tshul dang / de nas sangs —42—

rgyas 'khor bcas tsan+dan gyi khang bzang phyogs btad de nam mkha' la 'byon pa'i tshul dang / yul phyogs gcig tu bud med rgyan spangs pa mang po nam mkha' la lta ste thal mo sbyar ba dang / ston pa 'khor bcas sa gzhi la phab ste/ mtha' gcig tu bzhugs nas bud med de dag la chos ston pa dang / dbu skra dang phyag sen gnang nas ba gu li'i grong khyer sa zhes bya ba'i mchod rten brtsigs pa yang 'bri/ yang yul gzhan zhig tu/ sa skya bo dang nag por song ba dang / shing skam pa sogs yid du mi 'ong ba zhig dang / de dang 'brel ba ne'u gsing dang / shing dang chu sogs yod pa drang srong du ma gnas pa yid du 'ong ba zhig 'bri/ de'i mtha' zhig tu sangs rgyas kyi drang srong de rnams la chos ston pa dang / de rnams rab byung du skad cig gis gyur pa dang / yang sangs rgyas dang lhan cig tu nam mkha' la 'phur zhing gshegs pa dang / phar ngos na grong khyer slob ma can du dbus na pho brang sgo bco brgyad pa/ lcags sgo bcu bdun na rgyal po'i bu re re /gcig na rgyal po yod pa/ de rnams spos phor 'dzin zhing / skye bo gzhan rnams kyang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul zhing lta ba/ rgyal po'i drung na/ khyim bdag gsum dge slong gcig gis/ rgyal po la bshad pa byed pa'i tshul/ yang rgyal po'i drung du sa la ma babs tsam bar snang la yong ba'i tshul gyi dge slong 'ga' re dang /yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas gser gyi 'od zer spros pa/ grong khyer de'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'od zer lta bus khyab pa/ dge slong bar snang la yod pa de tsho'i phar phyogs nas kyang cung zad mtho bar nam mkha' nas tshur la seng ge dang / stag dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / sbrul dang / ba lang dang / bya khyung —43—

sogs la chings pa'i dgra bcom pa dang / shing rtar zhugs pa dang / khang bzang du zhugs pa dang / lus las sprin 'phro ba dang / glog 'gyu ba dang / 'ga' zhig sa'i dkyil nas btol te 'ong ba sogs 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs na sangs rgyas la lha klu sogs thams cad kyis mchod pa byed pa dang / gser gyi 'od kyang de'i thugs ka nas byung ba'o/ /yang grong khyer de kha 'dra rung ba'i dbus su sangs rgyas byon pa la rgyal po sogs phyag 'tshal ba dang / khang bzang du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa la rgyal po thams cad kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de dang nye ba na tsan+dan gyi khang bzang dbus su sangs rgyas bzhugs/ khang bzang de'i phyi nang thams cad 'khor sna tshogs pas skor te chos nyan pa dang / khang bzang de yang shel ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du song ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du klu'i gtso bo gnyis sogs klu mang po la sangs rgyas chos gsung pa dang / mtsho nang na klu gnyis po de lus las sprin sprul te/ chu rgyun 'dra ba'i char pa mang po 'bebs pa dang / de dag gi chu rgyun rnams gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun chu 'gram du byung ba la/ dge slong zhig gis de nas lhung bzed du chu blang ste bcom ldan 'das la 'bul ba dang / gzhan mchod pa mang po dang bcas pa 'bri/de nas bcom ldan 'das dang / dgra bcom pa gcig nam mkha' la gshegs pa 'bri/ bar mtshams de nam mkha' sngo sangs kyi bcad pa'i pha rol na/ yul phyogs phun sum tshogs pa gcig dang / bar bar na gling bzhi ri rab kyi rnam pa chung ngu mang po sgrigs pa'i ri rab re re'i rtse mo na dgra bcom pa re re yod pa/phar phyogs kyi zhing khams de na/ dgra bcom pa de'i phyogs su bu mo gzhon nu —44—

zhig rgyugs te 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas gyi bu mo de la chos ston pa dang / skye bo mang po 'dus pa 'bri ste/ grong khyer glog ma can du gshegs pa dang / 'od zer can gyi zhing khams su byon pa'i sde tshan no/ /(3) yang nags kyi dbus zhig na ston pa bzhugs pa la/ skye bo mang po mchod pa byed pa 'bri/ yang de nyid kyi 'khris su ston pa'i sku'i mtha' skor du bram ze mang po se skor ba dang / sku mdun gyi 'og phyogs cung zad ring ba na/ bram ze gzhon nu zhig lham yu bcad gyon zhing lag pa sgreng ste gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ yang bram ze'i khye'u de kha 'dra ba zhig bris pa'i 'khris su phyag na rdo rje bzhugs te/ rdo rje me 'bar bas de la sdigs pa'i tshul dang / ston pa'i sku mdun na bram ze de nyid thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul dang / de dang nye ba'i nags mthong de kha 'dra ba zhig tu/ ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ bram ze rgan po zhig gi zas mchog 'bul ba dang skor ba byed pa/ nags gseb sna tshogs na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams dge slong gcig gis brdung ba'i tshul dang / yang de'i phyogs gcig na// bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze rgan po de la chos ston pa'i tshul dang / bkod pa de'i phar phyogs bar thag cung zad yod pa zhig na/khang pa rgya chen po yod pa'i phyogs gcig tu/ bram ze rgan po de'i mdun du sngar gyi bram ze khye'u de 'du ga te gtam smra ba dang / khang pa'i phyogs gzhan zhig tu/bram ze rgan po des lham yu bcad lag tu thogs te/ bram ze gzhon nu la rdeg pa'i tshul bya/ khang pa dang nags kyi bar der/ phyogs gcig nas bram ze mang po phar 'gro ba dang / tshur yong ba'i bkod pa gnyis ka byed cing / phyogs gcig —45—

nas bram ze rgan po des/ shing rtar zhugs shing 'khor bcas sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i phyogs la 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya ste/ yul 'dod pa mthun par bram ze pad+ma'i snying po 'khor bcas brtul ba'i bkod pa'o/ /(dzo) de nas yang bkod pa g.yin ni/ ri rab la sprul gnyis 'khril te gcig gi dbugs 'byin pa dang / bya dang ri dwags mang po lhung ba dang / sprul gcig gis za ba'i bkod pa bya/ yang phyogs gcig na/ sbrul chen po gnyis 'khril te nyal ba'i steng du dgra bcom pa zhabs 'chag byed pa dang /sprul kyi khog pa'i nang du dgra bcom pas rgyug pa phyi gsal nang gsal dang /sbrul gyi sna nas cho 'phrul dang bcas te 'thon pa dang / sbrul chen po de gnyis shin tu che ba'i sbrul gyis mnan pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bram ze gnyis 'bros shing / dge slong gnyis gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ de nas dge slong gcig la klu gnyis chos nyan pa dang / yang ston pa'i sku mdun na klu'i rgyal po dkar po gnyis klu mang po dang bcas pa/ chos nyan zhing mchod pa 'bul ba dang / me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ khang bzang gcig na ston pa'i sku mdun na lha'i bu gnyis dang / phar phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas khang bzang gi nang na lha re yod pa/ gnyis tshur 'ong ba'i tshul dang / yang khang bzang gzhan gcig na/ ston pa'i sku mdun du khyim bdag gnyis 'bri/ de gnyis ka la yang mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma yod pa bya/ khang bzang phyi nang gi khyim dang bcas pa zhig tu/bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na khyim bdag gnyis 'dug pa dang / rgyal po zhig bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba yang 'bri/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo —46—

phyogs gcig na/ rin po che'i lcags ri rim pa gnyis ring por 'then pa dang /de dag gi steng na sbrul mgo yod pa'i mi mtshon cha thogs pa yang 'bri/ sgo gzhan gcig gi phyi nas rgyal po 'khor bcas 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang / sgo'i g.yas g.yon du go cha gyon pa ral gri thogs pa 'ga' re yang 'bri/ de'i phar logs pho brang gi rnam pa yod cam gyi khyams dang bcas pa zhig tu/ rgyal po btsun mo blon po 'khor g.yog dang ri bcas pa yod pa la/ steng gi nam mkha' la sprin nag 'jigs su rung ba ye de pa dang / sprin gseb nas glog dang mtshon cha nyug nyug yod pa/ bar snang der me tog gi char 'bab pa'i rnam par song ba/ de dang sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i bar de'i phyogs gcig na/ dge slong mnyam bzhag byas pa zhig 'bri/ yang phyi rol gyi sa gzhi la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun na rgyal po 'khor bcas yod pa dang / mi mang po mthu ba me tog gis bkang zhing / me tog :de rnams sa la skyur ba na/ ral gri dang gri sgrog dang / dgra sta dang/ mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs su gyur nas sa la 'babs pa 'bri/ yang khang bzang gcig tu rgyal pos dge slong zhig la mcho da pa 'bri/ klu dga' bo dang nyer dga' brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(rme) yang nags gseb gcig na mi gyad kyi rnam pa mda' gzhu bkang ba lnga brgya lnga brgyas gang ba'i dong pa gnyis phrag par thogs pa/ tshong pa mang po dang lhan cig tu 'gro ba 'bri/ chom rkun mang po sa la 'gyel shing shi ba dang / mda' rnams sa dang shing la phyed tsam thim pa'i rnam pa dang / chom rkun —47—

mang po 'bros pa'i tshul bya/ nags mthong zhig tu khang bzang de'i nang na gyad de 'khor bud med mang pos skor ba dang / phyi rol na grong khyer dang tshong 'dus kyang yod pa'i rnam pa bya/ yang phyogs gcig tu gyad des mchog zung la sogs pa dge slong 'ga' re la bsod snyoms gsol zhing mchod pa 'bul ba'i bkod pa dang / lha khang gcig gi nang na mchod sdong rding btsugs pa 'dra ba'i steng na/ rdo pad gzugs kyi steng du rin po che'i tog yod pa 'dra ba dang / bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor mchod pa thogs pa dang bcas pa lha khang de la mchod cing bskor ba byed pa'i tshul byed/ rdzing yod cing mtha' rwa bas bskor ba gcig gi 'gram du/ gyad de skra 'khru ba'i tshul/ gshed ma mtshon cha thogs pa mang po mtha' skor ba/ de'i nye skor du rlung nag gi gseb nas mdog nag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ go mtshon thogs pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ 'khris de dang nags mthong /de dang grong khyer snga ma bzhin la/ de'i phar tshad kyi nam mkha' la/ rnam thos sras be con dang ne'u le thogs pa 'khor gnod spyin mang pos skor ba'i drung du gnod spyin nag po go mtshon can de/ rnam thos sras kyi bka' lung nyan pa'i tshul bya/ grong khyer de nas phung po 'don pa dang / dur khrod du bskyel ba'i rnam pa gnyis gsum 'bri/ skye bo tshogs pa la bram ze mang pos lung bstan byed tshul dang / shing rta dang bcas pa'i mi mang po 'bros brtsams pa la/ srin po 'jigs su rung bas lam bkag pa dang / phyogs gcig tu gnod spyin gyi lha khang sha khrag mang pos lang long du gang ba gcig gi phyi rol nas/ ba lang drug gi drangs ba'i shing rta/ gtor ma dang bza' bca' sna tshogs kyi gang ba/ mi gcig zhags pas —48—

bcings pa yang der bzhag pa dang / mtha' skor du glu gar rol mo byed pa 'bri/yang de dang nye ba zhig tu khang pa gcig na skyes pa gcig dang / bud med bu chung thogs pa gtam smra ba 'bri/ khang steng nas bud med des mchod pa mang po bshams nas thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ de'i phar logs gcig tu gnod spyin gyi gnas sngar gyi de kha 'dra ba la nang gi phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa/sgo na sngar gyi gnod spyin nag po des gtam smra ba'i tshul la sangs rgyas phyi nas 'byon pa dang / sgo gzhan gcig nas sangs rgyas nang du 'byon pa dang / phyi rol phyogs gcig nas shin tu mi sdug cing mche ba btsigs pa/ zhal ras la kha dog ma nges pa/ phyag mang po na ma sto cha sna tshogs dang / zhabs mang po can/ me rlung 'tshub pa'i dbus na yod pa zhig gi mdun du/ gnod sbyin nag po de brgyal zhing 'gyel ba zhig 'bri/ 'di lung rnam 'byed kyi dpe la lan med pa ni chad pa ste/dpe dag pa rnams dang / skabs gzhan gyi lo rgyus la yod do/ /sngar gyi lha khang de 'dra ba'i nang na/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du gnod sbyin de chos nyan pa'i tshul dang /shing rta sogs kyi bkod pa yang sngar gyi de kha 'dra rung la/ mi bcings pa'i tshab tu bu chung gcig bzhag pa/ lha khang de kha'i nang gi phyogs gcig tu/ bu chung de gnod sbyin des blangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi phyag tu phul ba dang / lha khang gi phyi rol du sangs rgyas kyi de'i pha ra/ khyim bdag pho mo'i rnam pa can la/ khye'u de gtod pa'i tshul 'bri/ gnod spyin 'brog gnas brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(na) de yan chad ni sngar gyi klu gnyis brtul ba sogs kyi dus de dang nye ba yin no/ /yang bkod pa de dag dang nye bar nags mthong gi grong khyer —49—

snga ma dang 'dra ba'i sgo drung du/ bud med gzhon nu zhig shing rtar zhugs nas 'khor bcas nang du 'gro ba dang / khyim bdag gzhon nu zhig shing rtar zhugs shing 'khor bcas phyi la 'gro ba'i shing rta'i gnya' shing sne thug pa dang / grong khyer nang gi khang bzang gcig bud med des khyim bdag de la mchod pa dang /khyim de'i phyi rol phar phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas la khyim bdag des chos nyan pa dang / gtsug lag khang lcags ri nye skor dang bcas pa zhig tu ston pa 'khor bcas bzhugs pa la phyi rol nas skye bo mang po bskor ba byed pa dang / nang du mchod pa 'bul ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na khyim bdag de dus las 'das pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha mtshon byed lha gser gyi mdog can na bza' rab byung 'dra rung la thor tshugs dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer 'bar bas yul phyogs khyab par byed pa/ ri la thogs pa med pa yong ba gcig dang /lha de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du chos nyan pa 'bri/ de'i phar phyogs yul ljongs gcig tu/ khyim bdag dar bab gcig dang / rgyal po gcig dang / rgyal po blon po tshong dpon sogs kyi gzugs bris pa'i thang ka lag tu thogs pa'i mi mang po dang / bud med gzhon nu zhig phyogs gzhan zhig la me tog 'dor ba'i rnam pa dang / de dag la skye bo mang po 'dus shing lta ba'i tshul 'bri/ de dag ni 'brog gnas su dbyar gnas pa mdzad cing lag rgyud bden pa la bkod pa'i bkod pa yin te/ mdzad pa 'di gnod sbyin 'brog gnas brtul ba'i rjes la/ lo mang po zhig 'das pa'i skabs su yin kyang/ sngar gyi de dang 'brel bas sdebs gcig la 'bri'o/ /—50—

za yang yul ljongs gnyis la/ bar du ri nags sogs sa stong cung zad yod par bya/ phar phyogs de na rgyal po'i pho brang na go cha gcig sdogs nas sgrom bur 'jug tshul dang / yang khang bzang phyogs gcig tu rgyal po dang tshong pa rnams gtam smra ba dang / yang phyogs gcig rgyal po'i drung du tshong dpon 'ga' re la/ rgyal ce'i 'phrin gyi yi ge dang sgrom bu gtong ba 'bri/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de na pho brang gcig tu rgyal po la tshong pas de rnams 'bul ba dang /de'i khang bzang gi hre she/ sa gcig tu rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa go cha sde/ la lta ba dang / phyogs gcig tu rgyal po blo rten ma mnyes te/ lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de don bsam pa'i tshul gyi mdun du skye bo 'ga' res zhu ba byed pa'i chul dang / phyi rol 9smung bzang gzhan zhig tu/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du rgyal pos zhu ba byed pa'i tshul dpa ri / phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas bzhengs pa dang / ras gzhi skyang ba la sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer spros shing / ras gzhi'i steng du 'od kyi gzugs brnyan sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra ba byung ba la/ ri mo bas tshon 'gyed cing /sku'i steng 'og gnyis su yig mkhan gyi yi ge 'bri ba'i tshul bya/ 'di skabs su lung rnam 'byed las sku'i grib ma btang zhes 'byung ba ni/ rgya gar gyi skad du tshwa ya zhes pa/ bod kyi skad du grib ma dang gzugs brnyan gnyis ka la 'jug ste/me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la yang tshwa ya zhes/ rgya gar ba thams cad la grags pa yin nga/sa/ gzugs brnyan gyi grib ma yin gyi nyi 'od lta bu sgribs pas grib ma lta bu ma yin te/ bod skad la grib ma grags pa 'di yin na/ zhal spyan la sogs pa'i rnam pa mi dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dra long pa dka' bas so /—51—

yang khang bzang de dag dang nye ba gcig na/ rgyal po'i mdun na thang sku gser gyi dong bur bcug pa'i tshul dang / dngul snod gser snod ras kyi g.yogs pa sogs kyang brdeg pa dang / phyi rol du yi ge dang bris sku de tshong dpon la gto pa dang / gnyis po'i bar lam gyi sa la glang po che'i rgyab tu bris sku de bskal/gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod pas skor/ de dang lhan cig tu tshong pa mang po 'gro ba 'bri/ sngar gyi yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i grong khyer snga ma de dang 'brel ba'i/ stod smad gang wo du/ grong khyer pho brang phyi rol gyi sa stong sogs yod par byas te/ pho brang nang du rgyal po la pho nyas yi ge gtad pa/ phyogs gcig tu blon po rnams dang gtam smra ba dang / lam srang phyag dar byed pa dang / khang thog thams cad du rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba dang / spos dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang / sa gzhi la ras khra btings ba sogs dang / sa steng der bris sku shing ring po'i rtse mo la btags te zhal phye/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo mang po bsu ba'i bkod pa dang / g.yas g.yon nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul mkhan mang po/ steng gi nam mkha' la lha rnams me |zhe gi char 'bab pa 'bri/ pho brang nang gi khang bzang gcig tu bris sku bkram zhing mchod pa 'bul ba la/ rgyal po nyid lta ba dang / rgyal po'i lus las 'od zer cung zad 'phro ba 'bri/ yang yul phyogs de nyid ka yin kyang / sbung bris nas bkod pa 'dzings par 'gyur bas/ yul ljongs sngar gyi gnyis po 'dra rung la/ yul tshur phyogs de na/ rgyal po'i pho brang gnyis na rgyal po la 'phrin yig skyes dang bcas pa 'bul ba'i tshul dang / gtsug lag khang gnyis na sangs rgyas re re la rgyal pos zhu ba —52—

'bul ba re re dang / de gnyise kyi phyogs gzhan re re na/ sangs rgyas kyi dge slong gzi brjid che ba 'khor bcas la bka' stsol ba dang / dge slong ma gzi brjid che ba la bka' stsol ba'i tshul re re 'bri/ grong khyer gyi rnam pa gnyis yod pa'i gcig tu/ dge slong mang po bsod snyoms byed pa dang / cig shos su dge slong mang po bsod snyoms byed pa dang / yul phar phyogs der phyogs gcig tu dge slong mang po ‘sro1na pa la rgyal pos bsu ba byed pa dang / khang bzang du dge slong gcig khri la bzhugs/gzhan mang pos skor ba la rgyal pos mchod pa byed pa dang / phyi rol du khri la dgra bcom pa bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad cho lo nyan pa dang / yang phyogs gcig tu bkod pa de kha 'dra drang la/ dge slong ma'i tshogs 'byin pa dang / khang bzang du btsun mo'i tshogs kyis mchod pa dang /khang bzang de'i phyi khyams su dge slong mas btsun mo'i tshogs la chos ston pa 'bri/ yang zur gcig tu dgra bcom pa la khyim bdag chos nyan pa dang / de gnyis rab tu byung ba dang / de gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur te rdzu 'phrul ston pa la/ skye bo mang po lta zhing phyag byed pa dang / mchod rten chos 'khor bzhi re yod pa gnyis la mi rnams mchod pa byed pa 'bri/ yang khang bzang gcig na rgyal po pi waX brdungs zhing / mdun du bud med gar byed pa dang / yang de dang 'brel ba'i khang bzang gcig na rgyal po mnal ba'i sngas mgo nas lhas lung ston pa dang / rgyal pos gsal rgyal srid la bskos shing / blon po gnyis kyang bskos pa dang / 'khor nyung ri shas dang bcas te yul ljongs tshur phyogs gyi lam du mas/—53—

yul ljongs tshur phyogs de'i zur na/ ston pa 'khor bcas kyi spyan sngar rgyal po de 'ong zhing rab tu byung ba'i bkod pa dang / de'i nye skor gcig tu rgyal po de skyed mos tshal na sdad pa dang / rgyal po gnyis po pho brang nang na yod pa dang / phyi sgo nas bsu ba dang bcas te/ de spyan drangs te pho brang gi nang du 'gro ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ de dag ni rgyal po u tra ya ṇa bris skus brtul zhing / grong khyer sgra sgrogs su bstan pa dar ba'i sde tshan no/ /('a) 'di'i lo rgyus lhag ma ngo mtshar can yod kyang / ston pa nyid kyi rnam thar la med kyang chog pa dang / bkod pa mi mdzes pa'i phyir re zhig bzhag go /yang nags gseb gcig na ston pa rab byung dang / khyim pa dang tshong pa dang slong mo ba sogs sna tshogs dang lhan cig gshegs pa/ mdun du byis spro gnyis las gcig gi rnga sked nyag 'dra ba gzhan gcig dang mda' gzhu thogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ras su lta ba dang / zhal las 'od zer byung ste/steng 'og gnyis su song / slar mgrin par thim/ sku gzhogs nas dge slong gcig gis zhu ba zhu/ de nas nags mthong gcig tu ston pa 'khor bcas shing drung so so na bzhugs pa dang / shing skam po gcig gi rtsa bar me btang zhing /khong stong gi nang nas sprul 'phyang ba dang / ri de'i phar phyogs na 'khor rnams ston pa'i rjes la yong ba/ rgyang ring po nas seng ge tshur rngam zhing tshur rgyug pa dang / phyag sor las seng ge lnga sprul te/ seng ge brdas shing / phar phyogs kyi mtha' mes 'khor ba dang / yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du seng ge des chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / yang de'i phyogs su sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du lha —54—

zhig chos nyan pa 'bri/ byis pa gnyis lung bstan zhing seng ge ral pa can brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /rdzo) bar 'dir sog ma med kyi dang po'i lo rgyus sbyor rgyu yin yang 'dir ma bris so/ /yang grong khyer gcig gis 'gram na chu chen po gcig 'bab pa la/ nya pa mang pos dol chen po gnyis btab pa la/ sde tshan gcig gis srog chags mang po zin/ des mi rnams sde gcig gi 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i chu srin nya'i rigs ca na mgo mang po de zin/ des mi rnams chu nang du 'dren grabs la/ mi gzhan ma pa ri po yang rgyug cing 'then pa'i tshul dang / nya chu srin de bskam la thon pa dang / de lus po nya la mgo bo bco brgyad yod de/ glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mong dang / bong bu dang / glang dang / spre'u dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / gung dang / byi la dang / ra dang / lug dang / ri dwags dang / ma he dang / phag dang / khyi'i mgo bo rnams so/ /bskam la bton zin pa de'i mtha' ri la skye bo mang po dang / mu stegs ston pa drug la sogs pa yang yod cing / gtsug lag khang gcig nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas tshur 'byon pa dang / yang phyogs gcig tu ston pa byon te/ ston pas nya pa rnams la bka' stsal zhing / chu srin de ma gtogs srog chags gzhan thams cad nya pa des chu la gtong pa dang / ston pas chu srin nya de la dri ba mdzad pa dang / dge slong gcig gi langs te zhu rnga/ 'bul zhing / gzhan 'khor tshogs mang po la chos gsung ba/yang phyogs gcig tu nya pa lnga brgya po de dag tshur shog gi snyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / /thang nags tshal gcig tu ljon shing so so'i sar bcom ldan —55—

'das 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang / dge slong mang pos nor mang po rnyed nas tshur 'ong ba dang / yang phug pa dang / shing drung mang por dge slong mang po mnyam bzhag byed pa dang / lus las 'od mang po 'phros zhing / rdzu 'phrul mang po ston pa'i dge slong mang po yang 'bri/ nya pa rnams rab tu byung ba'i 'khris der lha gcig la sangs rgyas chos gsung pa 'bri/ nya pa lnga brgya brtul zhing dgra bcom pa la bkod pa'i skor ro/ /(ra) khyim gcig na bram ze gser brgyan khri la 'dug pa dang /khang bzang gi phyogs gcig na/ bram ze bzang po gos rgyan bzang po zhig gi mdun na/ bram ze gzhan 'ga' re langs te gtam smra ba dang / khyim gyi sgo bzhi nas gser las byas pa'i lha mo'i gzugs brnyan 'dra ba re thogs te phyogs bzhir 'gro ba'i tshul dang / yang yul gzhan gcig na/ bud med gser gyis mdog can gcig gi drung du gser gyi sku gzugs de bzhag pa dang / khang bzang gcig na bram ze gtso bo gcig gi drung du/ bram ze 'ga' re langs te shis pa brjod pa'i tshul bya/ bud med gser mdog de shing rtar bzhugs 'khor mang po dang bcas te tshur 'ong ba dang / khang bzang gcig tu/ bud med gser mdog de gdan la 'dug cing / bram ze'i khye'u de chags pa'i tshul dang / yang khang bzang gzhan zhig byas te/ rab byung dang bram ze dang / dbul 'phongs mang po la khyim gyi nor thams cad sbyin par gtong tshul/ bram ze de ston pa drug po re re'i drung du dri ba re byed pa'i tshul/ bud med gser mdog de gcer bu pa slob dpon 'ga' re'i drung du/ skra bregs shing thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul dang / mthar bram ze de —56—

grong khyer gcig gi 'gram bu mang po'i mchod rten zhes bya ba/ mchod rten gcig gi 'gram du/ ston pa'i spyan sngar rab byung du gyur te thal mo sbyar bas 'dug pa dang / yang phyogs gcig tu bram ze dge slong du gyur pa de mnyam bzhag la bzhugs shing lus las 'od zer 'phro ba dang / yang ston pa na bza' phyags dar khrod rdo tshos ma gsol ba dang / dgra bcom pa rnam sbyar shin tu dmar ba gsol pa bzhengs te gtam mdzad pa'i tshul dang / snam sbyar gtad pa'i steng du ston pa bzhugs pa dang / dge slong des snam sbyar dmar po bcom ldan 'das la phul zhing / ston pa'i rdo tshos ma de la gnang ba dang / de tshos gos rdo tshos de gyon nas nags tshal na 'dug pa dang / yang de rdo tshos ma de gsol/ dbu skra dang kha skru cung zad ring bar byas nas/ ston pa chos gsungs pa 'khor gyis bskor ba'i mtha' nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / yang de kha dang 'dra ba la/ ston pas de la bstan pa byed gnang ba ste/ bzhugs gdan gcig la gral sgrigs kyi tshul du 'dug pa dang / yang de 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig na/ sngar gyi bud med gser gyi mdog can de/ dge slong mar gyur nas ston pa la chos nyan pa ste/ de dag ni 'od bsrung r+ṣa po bden pa la bkod pa sogs kyi skor ro/ /(la) yang ston pa nags tshal gcig na bzhugs pa la/ shing gi steng na spre'u shing lo'i 'dom dkris 'khril shing gi yal gas sdoms thag byas pa zhig yod pa dang / yang shing gi rtsa bar de babs nas/ ston pa'i lhung bzed len pa'i grabs byed pa la/ dge slong gcig gis de ldogs pa dang / yang lhung bzed —57—

blang nas shing gi rtse mor song ste/ lhung bzed du sbrang rtsi blugs pa dang / yang ston pa'i sku gzhan zhig bris pa'i sku mdun du 'bul tshul byas kyang / ston pa mnyam bzhag mdzad nas mi bzhes pa dang / yang spre'u des lhung bzed sbrang rtsis gang ba 'khyer nas sa stong gcig tu/ sbrang bu'i ro rnams phyir sel ba dang / chu mig gcig gi 'gram du rung chu blugs pa dang / yang ston pa la phul zhing ston pas bzhes pa dang / spre'u de dga' nas gar byed pa 'bri/ de dang nye bar phyi 'gros su phyin pas khron pa la shor ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings na lha'i gzhal med khang gi nang du lhar skyes pa dang / yang lha de ston pa'i drung du 'ongs nas mchod pa 'bul zhing chos nyan pa 'bri ste/ yul yangs pa can du spre'u sa sbrang rtsi phul ba'i bkod pa'o/ /gzhan lo rgyus de kha dang 'dra ba la/ lhar skyes pa'i tshab tu bram ze las drug la brtson pa'i bur skyes te/ btsas ma thag tu sbrang rtsi'i char 'babs pa dang / mthar rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /(ga) yang brag phug dang / rtswa spyil dang / lo ma'i spyil po dang /nags gsebs dang / shing gi drung dang / spyil po sogs dben pa'i gnas mi 'dra ba drug tu/ gong du bshad pa'i rtog ge ba drug ste/ mu stegs ston pa drug tu grags pa re re yod pa'i de dag re re'i mdun du yang / me 'bar ba dang / 'od 'byin pa/ char pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ston mkhan lnga tsam re yod pa 'bri/ 1 de nas skyed mos tshal 'dra ba zhig tu ston pa drug kar tshogs pa zhig 'bri/ 2 rgyal po'i pho brang zhig gi nang du/ rgyal po'i drung du ston pa drug tshogs pa dang / phyi la —58—

'gro ba 'bri/ 3 gtsug lag khang zhig na sangs rgyas bzhugs shing / rgyal po yang glang bo zhon nas/ sangs rgyas mjal du 'gro ba'i lam du/ ston pa drug gi rgyal po la/ gtam smra ba dang / 4 yang de nas phyogs gzhan du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phar phyogs la thegs pa'i rjes nas ston pa drug 'khor mang yang 'bri/ 5 de nas yang pho brang gzhan zhig dang / sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang / rgyal po gzhan zhig sangs rgyas mjal du 'gro ba'i lam du ston pa drug langs ba dang / sangs rgyas la rgyal po des zhu ba byed pa dang / yang rgyal po de phyir byung nas/ ston pa drug sa la bsdad pa la gtam smra ba dang / ston pa drug dang mu stegs pa mang po grong khyer chung chung sna tshogs su bkram ste 'gro ba dang / mtsho gcig gi nang nas drang srong gcig 'dug pa des/ ston pa drug la gtam smra ba dang / ston pa drug po ma dga' zhing khros nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang / ri dang nags tshal yod pa zhig na drang srong mang po yod pa'i sar/ ston pa drug dga' ba'i tshul rnams mtha' la 'bri zhing / 7 dbus kyi phyogs su grong khyer tho re ba 'ga' re dang / khang bzang gcig gi rtse nas bud med gyi me tog 'phreng ba 'phangs pa/ rgyal po'i bu'i rnam pa 'dra ba sngo sang zhig gi lus la phog pa dang / grong gseb der de'i rkang lag rnams rgyal po'i gshed mas bcad cing gnyen gyi mtha' bskor nas 'jus pe—'dug pa/ ston pa drug po de'i 'khris nas phar gdong sa la bab ste 'gro ba dang /de'i 'khris de khar dge slong gcig gi de la bden stobs brjod pas/ yan lag bcad pa rnams slar 'grig pa dang / 8 de rnams kyi mtha' bskor ci —59—

rigs par ston pa'i cho 'phrul khang pa rtsig mkhan dang / mi gzhan 'ga' res mu stegs drug po yang cho 'phrul khang ba rtsig pa'i tshul 'bri yang phar phyogs su/ 9sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du bram ze zhig spos phor thogs te spyan 'dren zhu ba'i tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig tu ston pa'i cho 'phrul khang bzang rgya chen po zhig gi sgo drung du rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dus pa dang / sangs rgyas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing 'byon pa dang / sgo drung du rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba dang / cho 'phrul khang pa de'i dbus na sangs rgyas bzhugs shing / sgo gcig nas me 'bar ba dang / drang srong mang po nam mkha' la 'phur zhing 'ongs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun du chos nyan pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi rnam pa zhig gi shing sdong lo 'bras rgyas pa bya sna tshogs kyi khengs pa zhig khang bzang de'i g.yon du 'dzugs pa dang / khyim bdag gcig gi rin po che'i 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing gos rgyan du ma yal kha las 'byung ba zhig g.yas phyogs su 'dzugs pa dang / cho 'phrul khang pa de'i phyi nang gi zur kun nas/ mi kha dog ma nges pa/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar bo/ sngon po sogs 'ja' 'od dang 'brel ba ci rigs ci rigs 'byung ba 'bri'o/ /sangs rgyas bzhengs pa sgo'i them pa la zhabs kyi mnan pa zhig kyang 'bri/ sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul khang pa de dang nye ba na/ 10 mu stegs kyi cho 'phrul khang pa chung ba drug gi nang na/ ston pa drug po re re dang / phyi nang na de rnams kyi ge nar dang / yon bdag ci rigs pa 'bri/ 11 yang cho 'phrul khang pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ khang bzang phyi rol rdo chal 'dra ba yangs pa zhig tu pad+ma'i sdong po shin tu rgyas pa'i rtse —60—

mo la ston pa sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs pa/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag byed/gzhan yal ga rnams las gyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po la/ sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul sna tshogs pa dag 'bri/ steng gi nam mkha' la bzhedas pa dang / bzhug/sa pa dang / mnal ba dang / 'chags pa'i tshul ston pa dang / klog 'gyu ba dang/sprin 'phro pa dang / 'od 'gyed pa dang / me 'bar zhing chu 'khrugs ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mtha' skor thams cad du rgyal po la sogs pa/ skye bo dpag tu med pas yongs skor zhing / de dag gi phyi mtha' ma/rta/ glang po/ rnga mong / rma bya la sogs pa dang nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i dud 'gro mang po dang / nam mkha' la lha mang pos/ me tog dang / rin po che dang / gos kyi char 'bebs pa/ g.yin yang gnod spyin dang mi ma yin/ srin po dang klu la sogs pa mang po 'khod cing cho 'phrul la lta ba 'bri/ pad sdong gi g.yas g.yon du dgra bcom pa rnams de la lta ba dang / sku mdun phyogs na rgyal po gsal rgyal langs te thal mo sbyar ba 'bri/ pad sdong de rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa dang / gtso bo'i pad+ma gser gyis rang bzhin yin pa bshad/ khang bzang des phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas nas dgra bcom pa gcig dang /g.yon nas dge bsnyen ma gcig gi zhu ba zhu tshul byed/ yang de dang 'brel ba'i khang bzang gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na dge slong bya ma bum thogs pa mang po sbung bris su bris/ 12 de'i phyi rol tu rgyal pos ston pa drug la gtam smra ba'i tshul dang / ston pa drug po gcig gis gcig la gru sug byed pa'i tshul dang / yang ston pa drug gnas pa'i steng / nam mkha'i dbyings na —61—

lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'bar ba thogs pa'i 'gram nas/ char rlung drag po mi zad pa byung bas de rnams bros 'gro tshul dang / de dag las thag ring rnams kyi mtha' rnams su/ gcig brag phug tu bzhugs pa dang / gcig rtswa 'thug po'i gseb dang / gcig nags dang / gcig mgron khang dang / gcig lha khang du gab nas bsdad pa dang / rdzogs byed lam du 'gro ba la/ mi ngan ngon gcig gis sdigs shing smod pa'i tshul dang / yang de'i phyogs gcig tu bum pa bye mas gang ba mgul du btags te/ rdzing bu'i nang du 'phyongs te shi ba'i bkod pa dang / char rlung byung sa de'i 'khris su/ mu stegs kyi cha byad 'ga' re tshogs shing gros byed pa dang / lam du zhugs shing / bud med gcig la gtam 'dri ba dang / rdzogs byed shi ba la lta ba dang/ de dang nye ba'i chu la bum pa mgul du btags te 'phyong ste shi ba 'ga' re bris/ de rnams mtha' la bris zhing / dbus yangs sa zhig tu/bzhugs khri mthon po la sangs rgyas bzhugs shing / 'khor dge slong sogs 'khor rnam bzhi dang / skyes pa bud med lha klu sde brgyad sogs mang po dang / mu stegs can yang mang po 'dus pa la/ chos gsung ba'i tshul bya/ de dag ni cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i sde tshan sgo /(sa) cho 'phrul nyi ma gcig pa 'di ni/ 'dul ba sogs nas bshad pa theg pa thun mong gi lugs yin la/ cho 'phrul nyi ma bco lnga pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i lugs yin te/ lugs 'di gnyis kyang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir mdo sde mdzangs blun yang theg chen yin gyi/ nyan thos kyi mdo min no/ /de bzhin du dran pa nyer bzhug mdo yang theg chen kho na yin pas/ bshes gnyen —62—

chen por grags pa rnams gsung ca bcol mi 'byon par zhu kho/ /yang gtsug lag khang dbus ma zhig na sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag la bzhugs pa dang /gzhan gnas khang so so na dge slong so so dag la mchod pa dang yo byad kyi khyad par mang po dang / phyi nang du skye bo 'du 'tshogs byed pa'i 'bri'o/ /yang gnas de kha 'dra ba gcig tu dgra bcom pa zhig bzhugs khri la 'dug 'khor mang po chos nyan pa'i tshul 'bri/ de ni cho 'phrul bstan pas dge slong rnams yo byad 'phel ba dang / des chos spyod 'gribs pas rnyed bkur gyi rgyun gcod par bzhed nas lha yul du gshegs pa/ gnyen yod du mo 'gal gyis dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /snga ma de'i 'khris su dgra bcom pa sa stegs mtho ba gcig la bzhugs pa la/ rab byung dang skye bo mang po zhu ba byed pa 'bri/ de dang nye ba na ri rab kyi bkod pa rjes mthun pa byas te/ ri'i rtse mo rgya che ba zhig byed/de'i phyogs gcig na lha'i grong khyer gyi phyogs sa ma sto byed dang / phyogs gcig na skyed mos tshal gyi dbus na/ shing sdong shin tu che ba gcig yod pa/des rtsa ba na brag leb mo dkar po shin tu che ba'i dbus na/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang / ston pa'i sku mdun du lha mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig dang / mtha' skor du lha mang po chos nyan pa'i bkod pa bya/ de'i 'khris su yang bkod pa de kha 'dra ba zhig la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dgra bcom pa zhig gi zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ de nas yang steng gi nam mkha' la lha gnas gzhan rnams 'bri ste/ go skabs yangs zhing 'bri stabs bde na/ 'dod lha rigs gzhan bzhi dang / gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun du sangs —63—

rgyas 'byon pa'i bkod pa 'bri dgos pa yin kyang / steng 'og tu de tsam shongs dka' bar 'dug pas/ nam mkha' la 'dod lha gong ma'i gnas mtshon byed sa gzhi ri nags/ me tog rdzing bu gzhal med khang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ lha pho mo mang po dang bcas pa'i yul phyogs gcig sprin gseb tu 'bri ste/ gnas de rang gi steng la yang sprin kha dog sna lnga dang / nor bu dang me tog gi rol dpyad kyi char 'bab pa'i tshul dang / lha pho mo mang po'i dbus na sangs rgyas chos gsung pa'i tshul dang / yang de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la/ sa gzhi mtha' ris bskor ba 'dra ba/ dbus su gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa thams cad kha dog dkar po nyag gcig shing dang sprin dang bya dang mtsho la sogs pa med pa/lha thams cad kha dog ser po/ gos dkar po sha dag yod pa/ lha pho 'ba' zhig yin la/ de lta bur sangs rgyas chos gsung pa ni/ gzugs khams phal pa'i gnas rnams mtshon byed dang / yang de'i steng gi nam mkha' la sa gzhi ri sogs med pa'i gzhal med khang dkar po yangs pa zhig na/ sangs rgyas la 'khor lha kha dog ser po/ /na bza' dra sogs med pa ma gtogs rab 'byung 'dra rung las/ thor gtsug dang rgyan gyis brgyan pas bskor te chos nyan pa ni/gnas gtsang ma mtshon byed do/ /ri rab de'am gzhan zhig bris nas/ de'i rtse nas mar skas kyi rnam pa byed pa'am/ yang de 'bri stabs mi bde na nam mkha'i dbyings lha gnas gzhan gcig nas skas gtsugs pa byas kyang yod/ nags mthong zhig na rab byung dang / khyim pa'i skye bo shin tu mang ba 'dus pa gcig gi dbus su skas bshams gtsugs pa dgos te/ skas dbus ma sngon po/ /g.yas —64—

ge ge ge ser ba// g.yon pa dkar ba/ skas dbus ma'i dkyil tsam na sangs rgyas dang /skas g.yas pa na ston pa'i mdun tsam du tshangs pa rnga yab dkar po 'dzin pa/skas g.yon pa ston pa'i sku rgyab tsam du/ brgya byin mig stong dang ldan pa gdug dkar po gser gyi yu ba can 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon steng rnams nas lha dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / skas kyi phyed smad tsam na/ ston pa nam mkha' la 'byon pa gcig kyang 'bri/ yang nags mthong de kha 'dra ba zhig tu sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos ston pa dang / lha mang pos nam mkha' nas mchod pa dang /phyogs gcig nas tshur 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor bcas yong ba'i tshul dang / phyogs gcig shos de na/ shing drung gcig na dge slong gcig dang /gcig mnyam bzhag byed pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung na da ge slong kha dog mi sha ma yin pa'i sngo sang rang btang pa zhig phyag 'bul ba rnams 'bri ste/ lha las babs pa'i skor ro/ /(ta) yang ston pa 'khor bcas lam du gshegs pa dang / sku mdun kyi thad la/ ljon shing gsar pa mang po dang / chu dang rdzing bu yid du 'ong ba me tog can mang po dang / khang bzang stong pa 'ga' re yod pa 'bri zhing / g.yas g.yon 'ga' re na shing bcad pa dang / khang pa bshig pa dang / rdzing la 'ga' zhig gi dug 'debs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de'i pha rol grong khyer chen po lcags ri skor ba/ grong khyer gyi srang kha dang 'brel ba'i rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ mu stegs mang pos skye bo mang po la gtam smra ba dang / grong khyer de'i lcags ri sgo sdam sa shing / lcags ri'i phyogs gcig nas mar skas btsugs pa la/ bud med —65—

sgron me chen po thogs pa zhig 'bab pa dang / grong khyer gyi phyi rol kyi gnas zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bud med de chos nyan pa dang / grong khyer de'i nang khang bzang gcig na/ khyim bdag gcig dang /gzhan skye bo 'dus pa la/ bud med des khas len spong pa'i tshul/ yang grong khyer de kha yin kyang / bkod pa logs pa bya ste/ grong khyer du khyim bdag gcig gis srang kha'i bzhi mdor/ gser dong tse mang po skrung shing / lcags ri'i skas de la 'bab pa dang / phyi rol tu ston pa'i sku drung du chos nyan pa dang / grong khyer gyi nang gi khang bzang zhig gi sgo ru gser gyi phung po dang / nor bu'i phung po sbungs shing / skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang / grong khyer gyi sgo nas phar mi mang po 'gro zhing / lcags ri'i phyogs gcig na/ phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje gdeng ba'i tshul dang /de'i thad kyi lcags ri 'gyel ba'i thad nas mi mang po 'gro ba/ de'i phar phyogs na bzhugs khri la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i sku'i mtha' bskor thams cad skye bo sna tshogs pas bskor zhing chos nyan pa'i bkod pa dang / steng nas lha rnams kyis mchod pa dang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gnas de 'od zer gyi khyab pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i pha rol khang bzang zhig tu khyim bdag dar ma yol ba zhigamadzod gcig gi dra mig nas lta ba/ mdzod de nor gyi khengs pa/ bud med gcig snod gcig tu 'bras 'tshod cing / snod gzhan mang po 'bras kyi gang ba dang /gzhon nu gcig sked pa nas snod gcig gi nang nas gser dngul mang po gzhan la gtong ba'i tshul dang / bud med gzhon nu zhig gis snod gcig tu dri bzang ldugs par byed cing / snod gzhan mang po zhig dri bzang gis gang ba dang / khyim —66—

gyi phyi rol tu g.yog po'i gzugs zhig zhing gcig rmos pas zhing mang por rmos par gyur pa dang / khyim gyi sgo nang na g.yog mo'i gzugs zhig tso shing thogs nas 'bras sbru ba/ g.yas g.yon du snod mang po 'bras kyis gang pa rnams 'bri ste/ grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(a) bar 'dir khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ston pa'i sku gzugs bya bar zhus pa de yang / khyim bdag gcig gi khyim du gcer bu pa mang po la kha zas g.yos pa'i 'gram nas mi gcig gi bzhad gad byed pa'i rnam pa dang / khyim gyi phyi sgo'i nang du 'bras kyi khu ba la gcer bu pa 'gred cing / rdog pa'i shugs kyis then pa bud pa 'bri/ phyi rol sa stong gcig tu/ gcer bu ba de mgo la rma dkris byed cing / khyim bdag cig dang gtam smra ba dang / yang khang pa gcig gi nang na mi mang po zas sna tshogs sbyor zhing / de rnams la dug 'debs pa dang / sgo khang du dong byas par/ phyogs gcig nas me ldugs/phyogs gcig nas rtsa'i thog 'gebs/ de'i steng du sa rab rim mthor ba dang /de'i phar phyogs bar stong cung zad yod par byas nas/ gtsug lag khang khang bzang du ma yod pa'i khang bzang gcig tu/ sangs rgyas la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba 'bul ba dang / khang bzang gcig nas sangs rgyas bzhengs shing 'byon pa la/ lha 'ga' zhig gis ldog pa'i tshul dang/ gtsug lag khang dang sngar gyi de'i bar la/ grong khyer gyi rnam pa cung zad byas pa'i 'gram nas/ sangs rgyas phebs pa la yang / lha zhig gis ldog pa'i tshul dang / me dang dug sbyor sogs yod pa'i khyim de kha'i 'khris su/ khyim de'i kho na 'dra ba yangs pa zhig byas nas/—67—

de'i sgo drung ma sleb tsam na/ sangs rgyas thog mar phebs shing / dge slong rnams phyi nas 'byon pa'i tshul bya/ sku mdun du yang lha zhig gis ldog tshul byed/ khyim de'i sgo khang yang par pad+ma'i mtsho/ dang ba dang me tog sna tshogs kyi gang ba/sangs rgyas kyis pad+ma de dag gi steng du zhabs bzhag ste 'byon pa'i tshul dang /khang bzang gi rtse nas/ gcer bu pa gcig dang / khyim bdag gcig lta ba dang /khang pa de'i sgo gzhan zhig nas gcer bu pa de 'bros pa dang / khang bzang de'i dbus na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dang / khyim bdag pho mo gnyis g.yog dang bcas pas/ gdugs tshod gsol ba las snod snga ma'i nang na kha zas nag por yod pa/ lhung bzed kyi nang du/ blugs pa'i tshe kha dog dkar por song ba 'bri/ khang pa de'i phyi rol sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu/ 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs 'bri ste/ khyim bdag dpal sbed la sogs pa brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /(ska) yang ri dang nags tshal dang ne gseng yod pa zhig na/ lha mo 'dra rung mdog dmar ba bzhin zhi ma khro mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa la/ 'khor byis pa rgan gzhon gyi rim pa sna chogs pa/ srin po'i phrug gu 'dra ba rgyan mang pos brgyan pa/ la la mi'i byis pa bzung ste za ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ grong khyer gcig nas bud med bu thogs pa mang po bros te 'gro ba'i tshul la/ srin po'i gzugs kyi 'gags pa'i rnam pa dang/ 'ga' zhig thag ring por bros thub pa'i rnam pa'ang 'bri/ phyogs gcig tu skye bo mang po bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba zhu ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de nas mi ma yin gyi khang pa sha khrag rus pa thod pa tho re ba —68—

gcig gi sgo rtsar/ sangs rgyas bzhugs shing sku'i drung du/ byis pa gser mdog gcig la lhung bzed 'gebs grabs mdzad pa 'bri/ sngar gyi lha mo 'dra ba'i gnod spyin mo dmar mo de kha yin pa la/ rings par rgyugs pa'i tshul/ skra 'dzings pa'i rnam pas grong khyer gyi srang kha la bu 'tshol du 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang /ri nag po dgu dang / gangs can sogs la pus mo btsugs te 'gro ba dang /tsog por 'dug pa'i tshul gyi sdod pa dang / slar yang rgyugs pa dang / tsha dmyal gyi gnas lcags bsregs dang / me dang / dmyal ba'i sems can sdug bsngal myong ba'i rnam pa yod pa gcig gi sar yang 'tshol ba dang / grang dmyal gyi gnas mtsho ni byed gangs ri dang / sa gzhi dkar po sems can lus tshal par gas pa yod pa gcig tu yang de'i tshol ba rgyugs pa/ ri rab steng 'og tu bang rim dang bcas pa rtse mo tshang ba/ mtsho nang nas skyes pa logs la phyang tsam phag nas 'thon pa zhig 'bri/ de'i bang rim dang rtse mo rnams su de rgyugs pa dang / ri rab gyi rtse mo'i phyogs gcig na lha dang gnod spyin khro bo 'ga' zhig gi de bzung zhing phyir slog pa dang / ri rab kyi bang rim gyi phyogs gcig na/ rnam thos sras bzhugs pa'i drung du gnod sbyin mo de zhu ba byed pa dang / tshur de dga' ba'i tshul gyi log yong ba dang / yang gnod sbyin mi ma yin gyi khang pa sha khrag tho re ba snga ma de dang 'dra ba'i drung na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du/ de thal mo sbyar te chos nyan pa dang / sku'i g.yas su lhung bzed kha sbub pa dang / g.yon du khye'u gser mdog de nyid yod pa 'bri'o/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ de las cung zad rgyas par byed na/ thog ma'i skabs de'i bkod pa la/ grong khyer gyi steng du/—69—

gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ dar mang po phyar/ sa gzhi la me tog dor/ spos mang po btang / lha rten mang po yod pa'i sar/ gtor ma dang mchod pa sna tshogs bsha/mas pa dang / skye bo mang po tshogs pa la nam mkha' nas lha gcig gis gtam smra ba dang / gzhug tu yang grong khyer chen por mi rnams dga' ston byed pa'i rnam pa 'bri ste/ gnod sbyin mo phrog ma brtul ba'i sde tshan no/ /('i) yang bkod pa gcig la yul ljongs gnyis 'bri zhing / de gnyis kyi bar ri dang nags tshal dang / yul phra mo mang pos bar chod pa/ yul ljongs phar phyogs de cung zad chung bar bya ste/ grong khyer gyi dbus na pho brang che ba zhig bya/ de'i dbus su rgyal po chen po gcig la rgyal phran mang po 'dud pa dang / blon po dang dmag mi sogs 'khor tshogs mang pos skor ba/ yang de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig tu/ khang bzang gi mdun gyi khyams yangs pa'i dbus su rgyal po chen po de dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du blon po 'ga' re dang / mdun nas tshong pa 'ga' re'i skyes 'bul ba dang / gtam bya ba'i tshul bya/ de dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i khang bzang zhig rgyal pos pho nya drug tsam la bka' gnang zhing / bka' yig gi sgrom bu gtod pa dang / yang yul de'i phyogs gcig nas/rgyal po de'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang / 'khor gos rgyan bzang po can mang pos bskor nas/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs der yong ba'i tshul dang / yang yul ljongs gnyis pa'i bar mtshams de la pho nya ba rnams phar 'gro dang tshur yong ba'i bkod pa bya/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs de la/ mtha' skor du grong khyer pho brang dang bcas pa drug 'bri/ de re re bzhin rgyal po re'i mdun du/ pho nya re re'i —70—

sgrom bu gtod pa re 'bri/ yul ljongs de'i dbus kyi cha la/ gung du gtsug lag khang gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i mtha' skor du/ dge slong gzi brjid che ba gcig dang / gzhan dge slong mang po dang / mtha' la skye bo sna tshogs pa 'bri/ de'i g.yas khang bzang chen po gcig gi mdun/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang bcas pa/ phyag g.yon du gzhu 'dzin zhing / mda' lnga nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i mi de'u rtse la pad+ma re/ pad+ma'i lte ba la rgyal po re re/ de re re las 'od zer steng 'og thams cad du 'gro ba'i tshul bya/ de'i sku mdun du sngar gyi yul ljongs phar phyogs kyi rgyal po de la blon pos gzhu gtod pa'i tshul dang / rgyal po de'i gzhu 'then kyang / 'then ma thub pa dang / de 'khor dang bcas pas rgyal ngo/ de la phyag 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang de'i g.yon gyi phyogs su khang bzang gcig gi nang du/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po gcig gis zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshul 'bri'o/ /de dag ni rgyal po ka pi na 'khor bcas brtul ba'i skor ro/ /(gi) yang yul phyogs gnyis shig bya ste/ yul phar phyogs de na/khang bzang gcig tu rgyal po gcig gis khyim bdag gcig la bka' stsol ba dang / yang khyim bdag des khyim gcig gi rtsar 'dod yon sna tshogs bshams/skye bo mang po la spyin pa gtong ba'i bkod pa byed/ de'i drung du bram ze drang srong mang po yod pa la/ zas nor mang po ster ba zhig 'bri/ logs gcig na bram ze drang srong de rnams/ yul gzhan nas der 'ong ba'i bkod pa 'bri/ dgos pa la thog mar/ thag ring gcig nas 'ong pa la/ nye skor gzhan na chu med pa la/ shing —71—

sdong gcig gi phyogs gcig nas bram ze drang srong rnams kyi snod so so nas chu 'dzed cing / shing gi rtse mo nas gzugs med pa'i lag pa lag gdub can zhig brkyang ste bum pa bzung nas snod de rnams su blugs pa'i tshul dang / phyogs gcig nas de dag gis shing la gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ de nas ri gcig rgyab pa'i yul zhig tu/ shing gi g.yas g.yon gnyis nas drang srong rnams gtam smra ba'i tshul bya/ ri'i phag zhig na mtsho chu bya dang me rta ge gis gang ba/ 'gram na zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod bzhag pa/ drang srong la la de phyogs la rgyug cing / la la der sleb nas/ mtsho nas 'thung ba dang kha zas za ba'i tshul 'bri/de dang sngar gyi sbyin gtong gi khang pa'i bar du yang ri gcig gis chod pa 'bri/spyin gtong khang pa'i rgyab tu/ sngar gyi khyim bdag de dang drang srong de rnams gtam smra ba dang / khang bzang gcig tu khyim bdag gcig rgyal po la zhu ba byed pa dang / khyim bdag de dang drang srong rnams sdebs te/ yul phyogs tshur der 'ong ba'i bkod pa dang / yul tshur phyogs de na/ khang bzang chen po'i phyi khyams kyi sgo drung na/ khyim bdag dang drang srong de rnams tshogs pa dang / khang bzang gi nang khyim bdag de dang / khyim bdag gzi brjid can zhig stan gcig la sgrigs/ drang srong de rnams kyang mdun na 'dug pa dang / khang bzang de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig na phar/ khyim bdag gzi brjid che ba des/ khyim bdag dang drang srong rnams khrid cing 'gro ba dang / de'i yang tshur phyogs nas sangs rgyas 'khor mang pos bskor te/ chos gsungs pa dang / de rnams kyang phyag 'tshal zhing chos nyan pa rnams 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi drung du/ drang srong de —72—

rnams rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar du 'bri/ yang gtsug lag khang stogacig gi nang du bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba zhu zhing / sgo'i phyi nas khyim bdag de yul phar phyogs su 'gro ba'i tshul 'bri/ bskul byed zhes bya ba'i dgra bcom pa zhig dang / lhan cig du bar lam de nas 'gro ba dang / yul ljongs phar phyogs der de gnyis kyi kha lta byed cing skyed mos tshal zhig gi dbus su gtsug lag khang rtsig pa dang / yul tshur phyogs der sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi drung du pho nya zhig sleb pa dang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas yul phar phyogs der gshegs pa'i tshul dang / bar lam de na mchod pa mang po dang bcas bzhugs pa dang /yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i dom che sa zhig tu/ gtsug lag khang rgya che bar byas te/ de'i phyi nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa la skye bo mang pos bsu ba dang / mchod pa dang / lta ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi khang bzang gi nang na/sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de gnyis char gyi steng gi nam mkha' nas/ lha rnams kyi me tog gi char 'bebs pa 'bri/ yang rgyal po'i pho brang phyi khyams rdo chal 'dra ba zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi mchod pa dang / chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig gi phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po'i btsun mo 'khor bcas khri dang gdan zhig la 'dug cing / g.yog mo rgur mo zhig langs te tshig brjod pa'i tshul dang /yang de kha'i phyogs gzhan gcig tu/ g.yog mo de khri la bzhag btsun mo 'khor bcas chos nyan zhing lus la 'od 'phro ba'i rnam pa bya/ yang khang bzang de 'dra ba la/ glo dkar shin tu mang ba gtod pa nas/ btsun mo 'khor bcas lta —73—

zhing / phyi rol kyi sa gzhi la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phebs pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i yul ljongs logs pa chung ngu zhig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas grong khyer du gshegs pa zhig dang / grong khyer de dang nye ba'i nags na/ sangs rgyas phar 'byon pa dang de'i rjes bar thag yod pa gcig na/ bram ze gcig dang / bud med gcig dang / bu mo lang tsho la bab pa gcig rnams 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya/ nags de brgal ba'i nags mthong gcig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i phyogs gcig tu/ de rnams sleb pa dang / nye skor phyogs gcig na bud med lus sbom pa/ skra brdzes pa/ mig zhus bu'i mig lta bu 'jigs pa'i lus su gyur pa zhig 'bri/ de nas phar phyogs yul ljongs snga ma der/ skyed mos tshal gcig na bram ze gcig dang bud med gzhon nu gcig 'dug pa la mi mang pos skor ba dang / rgyal po'i pho brang gi khang bzang gnyis na/ rgyal po btsun mo che chung gnyis dang bcas pa zas kyi bkod pa mang po yod pa re 'bri/ khang bzang gcig gi 'og khang na/ mi gos ngan pa gyon pa/ khyim bya thogs pa zhig dang /gcig gi 'og tu btsun mo chung ba/ bya'i sha thogs pa zhig 'bri/ yang 'khor sa'i khyams zhig na/ btsun mo che ba 'khor bcas 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos rgyang nas mda' gzhu 'gengs pa dang / mda' gcig bar lam du lhung ba dang / gcig tshur log nas rgyal po rang gi drung du lhung ba dang / yang khang pa de khar btsun mo de khri la 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos thal mo sbyar zhing bzod pa gsol ba'i tshul 'bri/ yang khang bzang gzhan zhig tu btsun mo de rnams 'khor bcas la yo byad mang po'i mchod pa dang / de rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bka' klog pa dang /—74—

yi ge 'bri ba'i bkod pa bya/ 'dir de tsam zhig 'bri ste/ yul ko sha sprir gshegs shing/ khyim bdag gdengs can gyi kun dga' ra ba phul ba dang / rgyal po shar pa la sogs pa yul de'i skye bo rnams dge ba la bkod pa'i skabs so/ /ngi) yang yul gcig tu rgyal po'i rnam pa gcig gi mdun na/ rin po che'i khri la/ gzhon nu mdzes pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ lhag ma rgyan cung zad tsam dang / gos dkar po can/ lag na par bu 'dzin pa gcig la/ mi mang pos phyag 'tshal zhing 'bul ba byed pa 'bri/ yang gzhon nu de kha skyed mos tshal 'dra ba rwa bas bskor ba gcig na/ slob ma gos dkar po gyon pa/ gtsug phud ma gtogs skra bregs pa/ rna rgyan ma gtogs rgyan spangs pa mang po zhig la bshad pa byed pa'i tshul bya zhing / de rnams la la po ti dang / la la par bu dang /la la gzeb ma 'khris su bzhag pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na gzhon nu de 'dug pa 'bri/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i sku chos kyi gral 'jus te 'gro ba dang / ri nags tshal dang sman du mas gang ba gcig gi rtse mor rdo leb gcig la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu nags tshal dang / sman ljongs nas sman mthu ba'i tshul dang / yang ri'i phyogs gcig tu sman rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du sbung / ston pa la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / yang ston pa'i chos gos kyi gra la 'jus pa la tshur 'byon pa'i bkod pa dang / skyed mos tshal gyi dbus na gtsug lag khang yod pa gcig na sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms 'bul zhing gzhon nu de nyid chos nyan pa 'bri/'tsho byed gzhon nu pos 'phags pa'i gnas la bkod pa'i skor ro/ /—75—

yang yul ljongs gcig na/ khang bzang phyi rim nang rim mang po yod pa gcig na/ lha mo'i gzugs can shin tu mang pos khyab pa/ dbus kyi khang bzang na lha mo gcig dang / rgyal po gcig rnams gnas pa/ khang bzang dang shing sogs thams cad nas 'od 'byung ba gcig dang / yang de dang nye bar khang pa de kha 'dra ba 'od med pa/ mi phal pa lang long sna tshogs kyis gang ba/khang bzang na rgyal po gcig yod pa/ gzhan pho brang rnam pa gcig na/ 'od 'phro ba dang / lha mo dang nor bus gang ba/ khang bzang na sngar gyi khyim bdag de dang /lha mo zhig 'bri'o/ /pho brang gi rnam pa 'dra ba de'i phyi rol na/ yang khang pa gzhan gcig na/ 'od dang nor bu lha mo sogs sngar bzhin la/ phyi la dmag mi tho re ba yod pa/ rgya phibs kyi bya 'dabs 〈go cha gon pa'i mi 'ga' re rgyab gzhung kam pa'i oṃ tsam bya 'dabs/〉la 'phyar ba dang / rmog gyon pa'i mgo bya 'dabs 'phyar zhing lus kyang 'phrul du 'dug pa gcig dang / yang khyim bdag de'i khyim gyi yo byad thams cad rab byung dang / bram ze dang / phongs pa rnams la ster ba'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'gro ba dang / sbyan sngar rab tu byung zhing lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri ste me skyes rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa thob pa'i skor ro/ /(tshe) yang phyogs gcig na mtsho kha zhing che bas chod pa'i phar phyogs gling gi rnam pa zhig tu khang bzang dang / pho brang dang / rtswa shing lo ma'i khyim dang bcas pa 'bri/ pho brang de'i skar khung nas bu mo zhig gi nyan pa dang /grong khyer gyi gseb na/ tshong pa mang po'i gseb nas tshong pa 'ga' zhig kha ston byed pa/ phyi'i phyogs gcig tu bu mo mchog de 'khor dang bcas pa tshong pa de —76—

rnams la gtam 'bri ba/ yang phyogs gcig tu des de rnams la yi ge skyes bcas gtod pa 'bri/ yang gling de khar de dang ma 'dres tsam byas nas/ tshong pa mang pos sangs rgyas kyi bris sku phye ba shing ring po la btags pa/ bu mo dang rgyal po dang / skye bo mang pos mchod pa byed cing / steng gi nam mkha' nas lhas mchod pa byed cing me tog gi char 'babs pa/ khang bzang gcig tu bris sku de bkrams pa'i mdun na/ lus srang thal mo sbyar lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ yang phyi rol phyogs gcig na/ bu mo de 'khor bcas kyi mu tig mang po snod du rdeg pa dang / yig snod tshong pa la gtod pa 'bri/ bar gyi rgya mtsho la tshong pa rnams gzings la zhugs te phar 'gro ba dang / tshur yong ba gnyis kar 'bri/ tshur phyogs der chu 'gram nas/ thang dang ri dang nags la sogs pas tshur phyogs kyi yul ljongs na/ gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas la/ tshong pas yi ge 'bul ba'i tshul dang / yang gtsug lag khang gzhan gcig gi mdun na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun du ras gzhi rgyangs pa la bris pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la 'dra len byed tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros ras gzhi de la phog sku'i rnam pa gzugs brnyan du shar ba la/ tsho ni 'gyed pa dang / yig mkhan gyi thang ka de'i stod smad du yi ge 'bri tshul dang /bris sku snod du bcug de/ tshong pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyis gtod par mdzad pa dang / yang phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i mdun du/ tshong pa rnams kyi yi ge dang sgrom bu 'bul ba dang/sgrom bu kha phye nas mu tig tsho gsum du bgos pa 'bri/ yul ljongs phar phyogs —77—

gling der/ chu dang thang la mu tig 'dzin pa'i nya phyis dang / rin po che du ma dang /nags tshal la glang po ches khyab pa/ khyim gyi bud med rnams bud med kyi mchog 'ba' zhig 'bri'o/ /de ni rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can bden pa la bkod pa ste/lo rgyus snga ma'i 'phros so/ /(ji) yang bkod pa gzhan zhig la/ yul ljongs phan tshun gnyis byas shing / bar de na ri dang nags tshal dang / yul ljongs chung ngu 'ga' re bya/yul ljongs tshur phyogs de na khang bzang gcig na bcom ldan 'das 'khor nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas ste bzhugs pa dang / yang khyim bdag pho mo gzi brjid che ba'i mdun na/ bu mo mchog 'khor 'ga' re dang bcas pa 'bri/ khyim de kha'i sgo drung na/ gcer bu pa'i cha byad gzhon nu gcig dang / gzhan slong ba po 'ga' re khang bzang la lta ba 'bri/ yang khyim gyi sgo gcig nas/ gcer bu pa'i gzugs can de la bud med mchog des phye snod gang ster ba dang / des kyang snyug thags kyi snod gcig tu 'dzed pa 'bri/ bu mo des de la smod pa'i tshul yang 'bri/ yang de dang nye ba gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba zhu ba dang / phyogs gcig nas bu mo de shing rtar bzhugs nas yul phar phyogs de la gtad nas 'gro tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang gi phyi khyams na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog gi khang bzang dang / bdug spos kyi sprin dang / chu nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can yod pa dang / dge slong gcig langs pa la bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsol ba dang / yul chung phra mo mang po na/ dge slong mang po yod pa'i sar/—78—

dge slong re res tshul shing 'grems pa'i tshul dang / yang yul ljongs gnyis po'i bar gyi yul chung ngu de rnams su sangs rgyas re re skye bo mang po la chos ston pa dang / yul chung phra mo mang po na/ dge slong mang po yod pa de sar ljongs phar phyogs de na/ sngar gyi bu mo 'khor bcas tshur yong ba dang / grong gi khang bzang du khyim bdag gi bu khyu mchog ces bya bas/ de bag mar slong ba'i bkod pa dang /yang khyim de'i phyogs gcig na sgyug mos mna' ma de la gtam smra ba dang /'khordo ra sa'i khyams yangs pa zhig tu/ gcer bu pa mang po 'dus pa zhig la/sgyug mo de dang khyim bdag de mchod pa byed cing / bu mo de gdong phyir phyogs de 'dug pa dang / yang khyim de'i phyogs gcig na/ bu mo des de gnyis la gtam smra ba dang / khang steng na mchod pa bshams shing / bu mo des yul ljongs tshur phyogs de la gdong phyogs de thal mo sbyar ba dang / mchod pa nam mkha' la 'phags pa la skye bo mang po lta ba ste/ bkod pa de rnams yul ljongs de kha'i 'og phyogs su yong bar bya zhing / de'i stod kyi phyogs dom che sar/ phar phyogs dang nye ba shas che ba'i nam mkha' la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa dang / tshur phyogs sa mthil la/ grong khyer pho brang sogs 'bri ste/ de yang grong khyer du sleb la khad kyi nam mkha' la/ shing rta'i steng na dge slong gcig glog 'gyu ba dang /char 'bebs pa/ de'i rgyab phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon steng 'og nges med la/ shing dang bya dang me tog gi rgyan pa'i brag ri'i rtse mo la/ dge slong yod pa gcig dang /seng ges drangs pa'i shing rta la dge slong gnas pa zhig dang / glang po che thal kar mche ba drug pa la chibs pa'i dge slong dang / gser gyi pad+ma be+e khu rlu'i sdong —79—

bu dngul gyi ge sar can la gnas pa'i dge slong dang / bya khyung gis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong dang / spyod lam shin tu zhi bas nam mkha' la 'byon pa'i dge slong zhig dang / gser gyi ta la'i nags na gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang / be+e khu rla las grub pa'i khang bzang na gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang /glang dkar pos shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang / ngang pas drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i dge slong zhig dang / nags tshal na 'chag cing 'ong pa'i dge slong zhig dang / rgyal srid sna bdun/ dpung yan lag bzhi/ bu stong dang bcas pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig 'ong ba'i rnam pa dang / la la me 'bar ba la la char 'bebs pa/ la la 'od 'gyed pa/ la la gdan gyi zur bzhi nas lha'am gnod sbyin gyis 'degs pa/ la la dkyil krung gi gnas pa sogs thams cad kyang nam mkha'i mthong nas 'ong ba/ de thams cad kyi rjes mtho sar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sku'i rgyab nas phyag na rdo rje/g.yas na brgya byin/ g.yon na myongs pa/ steng na gnas gtsang ma'i lha/ 'og nas 'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyis mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul zhing / sku mdun nas zur phud lnga pa sogs dri za rnams kyi rol mo brdung pa/ sku'i gser gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha' khyab pa 'bri/ mnyan yod nas byon nas de'i bar du mi dang mi min gyi srog chags bdun khri bdun stong bden pa la bkod do/ /de nas grong khyer dang nye ba'i sa sgang mtho ba na/ khyim bdag dang dge slong sogs skye bo mang po la/ bu mo des de dag ston pa'i tshul dang / tshur phyogs de'i sa gzhi la/sangs rgyas 'khor bcas phebs shing / skye bo dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang /—80—

sgo bco brgyad nas/ ston pa sku'i bkod pa re re 'jug cing / dbus kyi khang bzang gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing /mchod pa dpag tu med pa gtibs pa dang / gcig na khang bzang shel las grub pa/ phyi nang thams cad 'khor gyis gang ba la chos/ ston pa/ steng gi nam mkha' nas me tog gi char 'beb cing / lha dang mi ma yin du mas mchod cing chos nyan pa 'bri/ de ni grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du byon zhing / ma ga dha bzang mo la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod pa'i le tshan no/ /ṇa) yang yul yangs pa can mtshon byed kyi grong khyer gcig dang /de dang nye ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig tu/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag la bzhugs/gtsug lag khang dang / rtswa'i spyil po sogs gnas mal sna tshogs pa na dge slong dag 'khod pa dang / dge slong nam mkha' nas 'byon pa mang pos/ lhung bzed shing tog gis bkang nas dge slong gzhan la ster ba dang / 'bras la sogs pa 'khru mang pos bkang nas ster ba dang / kha zas kyi khyad par blangs nas ster ba dang / sa la 'dug nas rang nyid kyang longs spyod pa sogs 'bri/ de nas yang sa stong gcig tu/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun na/ dge slong rtags mtshan yod pa gcig zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul bya ste/ de lhas sbyin no/ /rtags mtshan ni kha dog dbyibs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'am/ gos la sogs pa'i rtags mtshan no/ /de'i dgos pa 'di rnams grangs du ma 'bri dgos pas/ ma nor bar go ba'i ched do/ /yang dge slong gzhan mang po so sor 'dug pa'i rtsa na yang lhas sbyin de zhu ba —81

zhu ba'i tshul bya/ grong khyer gzhan gcig tu lhas sbyin de dgra bcom pa gcig gi zhabs la gshugs pa yang 'bri/ spyil po gcig na lhas sbyin de mnyam bzhag byas pa yang 'bri/ yul de dang bar du chu bo ga ṅga gis chod pa'i yul gzhan zhig tu/ rgyal po'i pho brang sgo 'ga' re yod pa zhig gis sgo gcig nas glang po che dkar po nang du 'ong ba dang / gcig nas phyir 'gro ba dang / gcig nas rta rgyan gyis brgyan pa yong zhing / gcig shos nas phyir 'gro ba dang / dge slong snam sbyar gon pa dang / khye'u dang bu mo dang / rma bya la sogs pa gzhan yang gzugs sna tshogs dang / de la khang bzang gi nang nas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra de/ rgyal po dar bab gcig gi rnam pas lta ba dang / yang khang bzang gcig tu byis pa lo bdun brgyad 'gro ba'i rnam pa/ gser gyi mdog can rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig rgyal po'i pang du 'gro ldog byed pa dang / yang phyogs gcig na spyil po'i gnas khang na lhas spyin la 'khor dge slong mang po yod pa dang / rgyal po shing rta la zhugs/ 'khor phru ba zas kyis gang ba mang po dag thogs pas bskor ba ste/lhas sbyin gyi phyogs su 'gro ba dang / lhas spyin 'khor bcas phyogs yangs pa zhig tu gral sgrigs te kha zas la longs spyod pa dang / de dag las gzhan pa'i phyogs gcig gi re zhig gi rtse na/ dgra bcom pa gcig gi mdun na/ lha ser po gos dkar gyon pa zhig gis gtam smra ba dang / sngar gyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye ba zhig na/ gtsug lag khang phyi ra ba gcig gi nang khang bzang logs gcig na/sangs rgyas la dgra bcom pa gcig gis zhu ba byed pa dang / khang bzang gzhan zhig tu/ ston pa'i drung na lhas sbyin zhu gsol byed cing / sgo drung de nas de khros —82—

te/ mgo bcogs shing 'gro ba'i rnam pa bya/ de nas ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' stsal ba'i tshul dang / dge slong ston pa la rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang /de dang nye bar dge 'dun rnams phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa dang / phyogs gcig tu lhas sbyin la dge slong gcig gis gtam smra ba dang / dge slong zhig la dge slong gzhan zhig gtam smra ba dang / de nas yang phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ pho brang gcig mas rgyal po bgres nyams yod pa/ shing rtar zhugs pa 'khor bcas snod mang po kha zas kyis bkang pa thogs pa dang bcas pa la/ pho brang de nyid kyi phyogs gzhan gcig nas rgyal ngo dar bab des/ rdo rje rtse gcig par grags pa'i mdung phyed pa 'phangs pas/ snod rnams chag ste/ kha zas bo ba dang /phyogs gzhan sa khul thag ring tsam zhig tu khang pa khyad par can gyi steng nas/gzhon nu rgyan gyis brgyan pa nam mkha' la thal mo sbyar ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil nas dgra bcom pa zhig byung ste/ khang steng du babs pa dang /phyogs gcig tu de la chos ston pa'i bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa des rdzu 'phrul gyis kha zas kyi snod chen po blangs te nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshul dang /bkod pa snga ma de'i sdebs la/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun du/ dgra bcom pa des kha zas de 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ yang bkod pa gzhan la yul phyogs rim pa gnyis byas te/ bar du chu phran chung ngus chod par bya/ tshur phyogs de na gtsug lag khang na sangs rgyas mnyam par bzhag pa dang / dge slong rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyis shing 'bras dang / 'khru dang zas blang nas dge slong gzhan la ster ba snga ma dang 'dra ba 'bri/ de'i 'khris —83—
