phyogs gcig na/ lha sbyin 'khor bzhi dang bcas pas dge slong mang po la kha zas dang chos gos ster ba yang 'bri/ de nas dge slong mang po lhas sbyin gyis khrid nas 'gro ba dang / chu'i pha rol kyi yul de'i sne zin pa'i nags kyi gung zhig tu dge slong de rnams kyis mtha' bskor te 'dug /lhas spyin dbus su 'dug nas gtam smra/ dge slong gcig tshul shing 'grems pa'i tshul bya/ yang de 'khor bcas phar song ste gnas gcig tu 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos shing rta mang po bza' bcas bkang ste skyel ba dang / yang sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu/ lhas sbyin chos ston pa'i tshul byed pa/ g.yas g.yon du dge slong gnyis bzhag pa la gru sug byed pa dang / rgyang ring po nas mchog zung gcig 'byon pa'i tshul bya/ yang lhas spyin gyi g.yas g.yon nas dge slong gnyis 'bros pa dang / mchog zung gcig g.yas g.yon du 'greng ste bzhugs pa'i bkod pa gcig yang lhas sbyin chos gos sngas su bcug nas gnyid log pa kha gdengs te nyal pa dang / mo 'gal gyi bus nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa dang / shā ri'i bus 'khor rnams la chos ston pa dang / dge slong gcig gis lhas sbyin gnyid log pa mdzub mos ston pa dang / de nas mchog zung gcig gis dge slong dag khrid de byon/ lhas sgyin gnyid kyi non pa/ dge slong gcig gi gnyid gsod tshul byas kyang ma sad pa dang / de'i 'khris na rjes la gnyid sad nas phyir snyegs sprod pa'i tshul la/ mdun du grog po chen pos lam chod de mthar nas/ tshur ldog nas khong rang gi grogs dge slong gcig la khu tshur bsnun pa'i tshul dang / de nas chu brgal ba'i yul tshur phyogs der mchog zung dge slong de dag lam nas —84—

yod pa'i tshul dang / ston pa'i drung du de rnams thams cad chos nyan pa/ tshogs pa'i mtha' skor du 'od zer gyis bskor pa 'bri/ de dag ni dge 'dun gyi dbyen byung zhing mchog zung gcig gis bsdum pa'i skabs so/ /(te) de nas khang pa zhig gi nang na rgyal po bgres nyams cung zad yod pa cig lus rid cing skems pa btson du zhugs pa'i rnam pa dang / de'i mdun na dge slong gcig chos ston pa'i tshul dang / de'i phar phyogs ri'i ngos la sangs rgyas zhabs 'chag pa'i tshus dang / sku las 'od zer 'phros pa/ btso ni khang de'i dkar khung chung ngu gcig dang / brtsig pa gas pa'i ser kha nas zhugs te/ btson khang gi nang 'od zer gyis khyab pa dang / yang btson khang de'i phyogs gcig nas skye bo mang po 'dzugs pa dang / khang pa de'i phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po de yang 'das pa dang / de'i thad kyi nam mkha' la gzhal med khang gcig na/rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi pang na lha'i bu gser mdog gcig yod pa/ de dang btson khang de'i bar gser ris kyis sbrel/ yang phyogs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun du/ lha'i bu gser mdog des mchod pa mang po byed pa 'bri/de ni gzugs can snying po rnam thos bu'i gnas su skyes pa'i bkod pa ste gzhan dang 'brel ba ma skyes dgra sdig pa'i grogs pos bzung ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod de/ bkod pa mi mdzes pas re zhig bzhag go /de nas ston pa'i sku mdun na gar mkhan 'ga' zhig gis gar sgyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhal las 'od zer spros te/ steng 'og gnyis la mtha' med du song pa dang / 'od zer gyi sne gcig sku'i mgrin par thim pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ de na phyi rgya gcig gi khang pa mi —85—

'dra ba gsum na/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra dar bab de dang / lhas sbyin gros byed pa'i tshul re re 'bri/ yang yul ljongs grong tho re ba'i rnam pa'i phyogs gcig na/mi gcig gi gser bzhu ba dang / 'ga' zhig gi lhas sbyin gyi lus la gser byug pa dang / de'i 'khris su lhas sbyin lus gcer bu gser gyi mdog srab sreb tu song ba gcig 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu lhas sbyin rtsig pa'i tshur phyogs na yod pa/ rtsig pa'i bu gar rkang pa gnyis bcug nas rkang pa phar phyogs su thon pa/ de la lcags mgar 'ga' zhig gis lcags sregs kyi 'khor le'i par thog nas/ lhas sbyin kyi rkang mthil la sbyor ba dang / de bzhin du lag mthil la yang byed pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu grong khyer gyi g.yas phyogs kyi lam du/ mi mang po mtshon cha thogs pa dang / g.yon phyogs kyi lam bzhi mdo na yang de lta bu dang / g.yin yang lam gyi bzhi mdo dag mi mtshon cha thogs pa 'ga' re 'ga' re yod pa dang / sa'i sgang ngam ri chung po do gcig gi rtse na/ lhas sbyin rang yang ral gri dang phub thogs nas gnas pa/ sgrogs 'cha' ba lta ba ri gcig gi rtse mo na/ skyogs 'cha' ba'i tshul dang / ri de'i ri 'gram na gyad 'dra rung zhig 'khor bcas la/ lhas sbyin gyis mu tig gi do shal sogs ster ba dang / ri de'i phar phyogs brag g.yangs su yod pa/ de la skas btsugs nas mi mang du 'bab pa dang / sgrogs bshams pa'i rtse nas/ gyad lta bu de dang mi gzhan zhig gtam smra ba yang 'bri/ ri de'i phar phyogs ri bo nags tshal gyis brgyan pa zhig la sangs rgyas zhabs 'chag pa'i tshul 'bri/ yang de'i steng 'og nye skor gang 'os su/ ri de gnyis ka sngar dang 'dra ba la/ g.yang sa la btsugs pa'i skras ka de med pa/—86—

ri'i steng la lhas spyin 'dzegs pa dang / ri'i rtse mo lhas sbyin nyid kyis skyogs thag 'then nas/ sgrogs 'phen tshul dang / skyogs rdo shin tu che ba bar snang la byung bas/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes/ sgrogs rdo de phyed mar btang ba dang /gnod sbyin gyad gyi gzugs 'dra ba zhig sgrogs rdo de'i dum bu che ba gcig dang thug nas sa la lhung ba dang / phar phyogs kyi ri de'i sked pa na/ ston pas gyad 'dra ba'i mi de sogs mi mang po la chos gsung zhing 'khor bcas 'od zer 'phro ba/ ri'i rtse mo'i phug zhig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong la/ rdo'i dum bu phra mo zhig phog ste sku mtshal byung ba'i rnam pa dang / ri'i sked nas phar gyad 'dra ba de sogs mi rnams mgyogs par bros pa'i rnam pa 'bri/yang ri bo nags tshal dang ldan pa de kha 'dra ba zhig gi ngos la/ ston pa 'khor ci rigs dang ldan pa/ zhabs kyi mthe bong las/ sku mtshal gyi rgyun phra mo 'bab pa/zhal las gser gyi 'od zer spros pa/ steng 'og tu song wo / 'od zer gyi rtse mo mgrin par 'du ba/ de 'dra tshar gsum yod pa las/ gcig gi sku mdun na cha dpon gyis tsan dan sa mchog 'bul ba dang / gcig gi sku mdun na bud med gcig gi rang gi 'o ma snod chung gcig tu 'bul ba dang / gcig la sman pa 'dra ba gnyis las/ gcig gis sman 'debs pa dang / gcig gis sngags 'debs nga/'i tshul bya/ yang de kha 'dra ba gzhan gcig la/ zhal las 'od zer spro ba mi dgos/ sku mdun na dge slong dar yol gcig thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa dang /sku mtshal gyi rgyun chad pa 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na/ shing drung gcig na lhas spyin mnyam bzhag byed pa ltar rdzu ba dang / skye bo mtshon cha thogs pa 'ga' re —87—

yong zhing / de mthong nas ldog 'gro ba dang / bkod pa de dag thams cad kyi bar na/ dge slong gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tshogs nas gtam byed pa'i tshul mang du 'bri/ de nas yang phyogs gcig na/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi nang na rgyal po dang lhas sbyin gros byed pa dang / grong khyer gyi gseb na rgyal po'i nang 'khor thod bcings shig mtshon cha btags pa/ ba dan ring po thogs pas mi rnams la dril sgrog pa'i tshul dang / ra ba gcig na glang po che mang po'i dbus na/ glang po che ches che ba yod pa/ rgyal po'i nang 'khor des glang rdzi la gtam smra ba'i tshul dang / khyim bdag gcig gis khang pa yangs po zhig gi phyogs gcig na kha zas mang po sbyor tshul dang / gtsug lag khang sangs rgyas dang dge slong mang pos gang ba'i phyogs gcig na/ sangs rgyas la khyim bdag gcig gis zhu ba zhu/ phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas kyi mdun du khyim bdag de mchi ma 'byin pa'i tshul bya/sngar gyi pho brang de'i thog kha nas/ rgyal po dang lhas sbyin gnyis lta ba'i tshul dang /gtsug lag khang dang / khyim bdag gi khang pa'i bar sa stong yangs sar bzhag la/ sangs rgyas phebs pa la phyogs gcig nas glang po che de sbad cing / de yang khros nas rgyugs pa'i tshul dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na dge slong gcig 'dug cing / gzhan rnams phan tshun du bros pa dang / yang sangs rgyas kyi phyag g.yas pa'i phyag sor lnga brkyangs ba las/ seng ge ral pa can lnga byung nas/glang po che phar bdas shing phar phyogs g.yang sa dang mes 'khor te 'dug pa dang / yang glang po che de tshur ldog nas sangs rgyas la snas phyag 'tshal ba dang /sangs rgyas kyis glang po la phyag gis byugs pa mdzad pa dang / khyim bdag gi —88—

khyim de'i phyogs gcig gi nang nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing /mchod ston gsol/ sgo drung na glang po che de 'dug de phyogs kyi khang pa yang shel ltar dwangs par song / sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang la gshegs shul du glang po che de yang 'gro ba dang / yang glang po che de dbang med du bkug nas rwa bar bcug pa dang / rwa kha'i nang du sna zhags kho rang gi rdog pas mnan te shi ba dang /gtsug lag khang gi khyams na/ ston pa'i drung du lha zhig chos nyan pa 'bri ste/glang chen smyon pa brtul ba ste/ de dag dge 'dun gyi dbyen gyi rjes su 'brang ba/lhas spyin rgyal po dang bcas pas bkur sti ma yin pa bgyis kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par mtho bar gyur pa'i sde tshan no/ /(za) de nas sangs rgyas mnyan yod du gshegs pa'i tshul dang /mnyan yod du rgyal po sogs la chos ston pa'i tshul/ yang yul u dum zhes bya ba mtshon byed kyi grong khyer zhig tu byon nas chos gsung pa de dang / ri nags kyi bar chod pa'i nags mthong zhig gi mtsho 'gram zhig na/ rin po che'i phung po'i steng du bzhugs khri 'cha' ba'i lha mang po dang / phar phyogs nags gseb kyi spyil po gcig na drang srong gcig yod pa'i drung na/ gnod sbyin go mtshon thogs pa gcig kyang 'dug pa dang / yang sangs rgyas 'khor nyung ngu dang bcas te grong khyer de la bsod snyoms la phebs pa'i bkod pa dang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mtsho 'gram gyi nags gcig na ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang /bzhugs khri snga ma 'dra ba'i steng du ston pa bzhugs pa la/ yul 'khor srung dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor bas nor bu sna tshogs thogs pa dang / 'phags skyes po —89—

grul bum gyi tshogs kyis skor bas mu tig gi thu ba bkang ba dang / mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis skor bas me tog sna tshogs dang / rnam thos sras gnod spyin gyi tshogs kyis skor bas gser sna tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / ston pa'i drung du de rnams 'khor bcas thal mo sbyar te chos nyan pa dang / de'i mtha' na drang srong de yang chos nyan pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na rgyal chen bzhi yod pa dang / de'i mtha' g.yas na dgra bcom pa cung zad bgres pa zhig dang g.yon du dar bab zhig 'bri/ yang de dang ris chod cing nye ba'i nags mthong grong tho re ba na/ gnas gcig tu drang srong snga ma de'i drung na drang srong gzhan zhig yod pa bram ze'i khye'u 'dra ba gzhan mang po kha zas g.yo ba'i bya ba byed pa/ yang phyogs gcig tu sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ drang srong de gnyis kyis mchod ston gsol ba/ yang phyogs gcig tu drang srong gnyis po 'khor bcas chos nyan pa/ phyogs gcig tu de dag thams cad dge slong du gyur pa 'bri/ de nas yul 'bab chu bzang po zhes bya ba mtshon byed/ grong khyer gcig gi stod na a mra'i tshal gdugs lta bu zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du ston pas dge slong gsum la bka' gnang ba/ khang bzang gsum na dgra bcom pa gsum la gcig la 'khor mang ba dang / gzhan gnyis la cung zad nyung ba'i 'khor dge slong gi tshogs kyis skor ba 'bri/ rgyal chen bzhi bden pa la bkod cing / drang srong ke na'i bu dang/ drang srong ri bo 'khor bcas bden pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /—90—

yang yul gcig na/ bram ze gcig slob ma gtso bo gcig sogs slob ma mang po la rig byed slob pa'i tshul dang / bram ze gtso bo de yul gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshul dang / yang sngar gyi khyim de 'dra ba na/ bud med gcig dang / bram ze'i khye'u zhig gtam smra ba dang / khyim de'i phyogs gcig na/ bud med khri la nyal ba gos rnas ba gyon pa/ skra 'dzings pa zhig la bram ze'i gtso bo de gtam smra ba dang / khyim gyi phyi rol phyogs gcig na/ bram ze'i gtso bo de mdun na ral gri gcig sa la btsugs/ slob ma'i gtso bo de la chos ston pa'i tshul bya/ de nas bram ze'i slob ma de/ shin tu stobs dang ldan pa 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam par song nas phyogs gzhan gcig na/ lag na ral gri thogs pa/sor mo'i 'phreng ba mgo la thogs pa/ g.yas g.yon du sor mo bcad pa'i mi mang po shi nas 'gyel ba/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs dang bcas pas dur khrod ltar gyur pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan gcig tu/ de rngam zhing ral gri thogs nas rgyugs/ phar phyogs thag ring ba na/ bud med cung zad rgan pa kha zas thogs pa gcig dang / de'i bar na sangs rgyas phar gshegs shing phyi ltas mdzad pa zhig/ 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig tu/ sa stegs gcig na sangs rgyas bzhugs ste/ de la cho se gsung pa'i rnam pa dang / gtsug lag khang gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa'i dbus na/ de yang thal mo sbyar te 'dug 4dang / yang phyi rol sa phyogs yangs pa gcig tu/ sangs rgyas nyid sor mo'i 'phreng pa can sogs skye bo mang po mang po la chos gsung pa/ sor 'phreng de la me ris skor ba/ phar log nas rgyal po dpung yan lag bzhis skor te yong ba dang /—91—

'khor de'i mtha' rgyal po yang glang po che las babs pa'i tshul dang / 'khor tshogs de'i dbus su rgyal po thal mo sbyar te bzhugs pa 'bri/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba brtul ba'i skor ro/ /lke) yang bkod pa zhig la/ mtha' ri dang nags tshal gyis skor ba/ yul ljongs chen po mi med pa/ klu dang gnod sbyin mi'am ci sogs gnas pa gcig gi lung zur gcig na/ grum mtsho gru bzhi pa gcig gi dbus na pad sdong skyes pa/ dbus na sangs rgyas gzhan yal ga'i pad+ma rnams la/ nyan thos re re yod pa las/ sku'i 'khris kyi g.yas g.yon mtho sa'i pad+ma gnyis stong par yod pa/ mtsho 'gram nas dge slong zhig phyogs gzhan la 'gro tshul/ yang mtsho pad sdong de kha rang 'dra ba la/ sku'i g.yas kyi pad sdong mtho sa de la nyan thos gcig bzhugs shing / g.yon gyi de la med pa/ g.yon phyogs kyi nam mkha' la/nyan thos gcig pha tshad nas 'byon pa/ yul ljongs de nyid kyi dbus sogs ngom che sa na/ g.yas na gser gyi brag ri brag phug can la/ ri chung 'ga' res skor ba/ g.yon na nags kyi dkyil na shing sdong shin tu che ba zhig yod pa de'i 'khris na rdzing zlum po che ba gcig la/ rdzing chung 'ga' res skor ba/ de na glang po che mche ba drug pa 'ig nyal ba/ dbus na mtsho gru bzhi chen po/ chu bya dang nya srog chags du ma dang / nor bu du mas gang ba/ phyogs bzhi nas chu 'bab pa mtshon byed/ rgyab ma gtogs phyogs gsum gyi pha tshad nas/ brag gi khung bu nas chu re 'bab pa/ mtsho'i dbus su pad sdong dbus kyi pad+ma gser mdog lan sangs rgyas chos 'chad mdzad pa/ yal ga'i me tog mang po la nyan thos re re bzhugs —92—

pa/ pad sdong gi 'og chu'i steng na/ klu dkar po gsum pad sdong gi yal ga 'degs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku rgyab kyi phyogs mtsho 'gram nas/ shing sdong shin tu che ba skyes pa/ rtse mo dbu'i gtsug tor las kyang yar thal ba yal ga lo 'dabs 'bras bu shin tu rgyas pa zhig 'bri/ de dang ri mang pos chod pa'i phar phyogs yul gcig tu/ sa mthil la grong mang po yod pa'i ri/ rtsa ba nags dang rtse mo g.ya' lta bu gcig na/ phyogs gcig na nyan thos gcig snam sbyar 'tshem pa'i tshul gyis mdun na nyan thos gcig bzhengs pa/ de kha'i 'khris na/de gnyis kar gyi sor mo lnga char gyis tshem bu byed pa/ yang de kha'i 'khris su/ ri de kha dang 'dra ba'i brag rtse gcig la/ ske rags kyi sno brtags pa/ ske rags kyi sne phyogs gcig gis snam sbyar bcings te/ dge slong gcig gis nam mkha' la 'dren pa dang / ri de yang g.yo ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de kha'i 'khris der ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa yo ba zhig la/ snga ma ltar ske rags kyi sne btags shing /snam sbyar de dag dge slong gis thogs nas nam mkha' la 'dren pa zhig 'bri/tshem bu 'tshems pa'i ri de nyid la/ dge slong zhig gnas shing / dge slong gcig shos nam mkha' la gnas pas snam sbyar thogs/ ske rags thag gu lta bu shin tu phra ba de/ yul ljongs snga ma'i zur na bris yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi pad+ma la nyan thos med pa'i pad sdong de la btags pas g.yo 'gul ma byung ba 'bri/ las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i skabs kyi sde tshan no/ /(pe) de nas yul ljongs tsho gnyis bris pa'i/ tshur phyogs na sangs rgyas 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa dang / phar phyogs de'i phyogs gcig na/—93—

rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer gyi sked pa zhig dang / pho brang de na rgyal mo khri la gnas pa dang / khri gzhan zhig la rgyal po dar ban zhig yod sems khong du chud pa dang / phyi rol kyi grong khyer khang pa so so'i nang na mi 'ga' zhig na ba'i rnam pa dang / phung po khyogs la btegs nas dur khrod du skyel pa dang / grong khyer gyi mtha' rnams dmag gi phru mas skor ba dang / chu rnams bskams pa dang / mtshe'u la dug 'debs pa'i rnam pa dang / sprin gseb na sprul gdug pa sogs gnas pas ser ba 'bebs pa dang / lce 'bab pa rtswa shing gseb tu sbrul gyis gang ba 'bri/ pho brang de'i phyogs gcig na rgyal pos pho nya zhig mngags pa dang / yul ljongs tshur phyogs der gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi drung na pho nya de zhu ba byed pa'i tshul dang / yang de'i phyogs gcig na/ khyams yangs pa zhig tu/rgyal po dang skye bo mang pos sangs rgyas la gdugs tshod gsol ba dang / yul ljongs tsho gnyis po de'i bar nas sangs rgyas phar gshegs pa dang / ljongs phar phyogs der/ grong khyer gcig gi 'gram nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas 'byon pa dang / sku mdun nas rgyal po sogs kyis bsu zhing / skye bo mang pos mchod pa dang steng nas lha rnams kyis mchod cing me tog gi char 'bebs pa/ gzhan yang mtha' rnams nas char 'bab pas/ chu gsar pa rgyug cing rdzing bu khengs pa dang /mtha'i dmag rnams phyogs phyogs su gyes 'gro ba'i rnam pa dang / de nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gtsug lag khang gcig la 'byon pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi nang na bzhugs pa sogs 'bri/ yang pho brang gcig gi ba gam gyi 'og na/rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / sras dang / blon po drug gis gros byed pa'i tshul —94—

dang / de'i 'gram na rin po che'i dbu rgyan can gos dkar po gyon pa/ langs te 'dug pa 'bri/ pho brang de'i sgo drung nas glang po che gcig gi gnya' bar gos dkar po can de zhon zhing / lcags kyus kha bsgyur/ glang po che'i rgyab tu/ rgyal po dang gdugs dang rnga yab 'dzin pa sogs 'khod/ g.yas g.yon du glang mo sogs mang po la/ bud med dpal 'bar thogs pa 'ga' re dang / gzhan yang yo byad thogs pa dag zhon nas 'gro ba'i bkod pa bya/ phar phyogs na gtsug lag khang gcig yod pa'i phyi rol gyi ne gsing rnams su/ glang po dang / glang mo de dag gtod nas bzhag sgo nas rgyal po dang / gos dkar po gyon pa de 'gro ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi khang mig rnams na dge slong rnams bsam gtan byed pa dang / dbus kyi khang bzang na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na/ rgyal po de thal mo sbyar zhing / ston pas chos gsung pa'i rnam pa dang / gos dkar po gyon pa de sgo drung na 'dug pa 'bri/ yang logs gcig tu rgyal po pho brang gi phyi khyams na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khore bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing / chos nyan pa dang/ sangs rgyas lam du 'byon pa mthong ba la/ rgyal po khang bzang gi rtse nas 'phyongs/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas gcig gis bar snang nas blangs te sa la 'jog pa dang / yang rgyal po glang po che'i steng na yod pas sangs rgyas rgyang nas mthong ba na/ glang po che'i steng nas 'phyongs pa dang / sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bar snang nas bzung nas sa la 'jog pa dang / de'i rjes su lhas sbyin bya ba ma yin pas nyam thag pa'i gtam brgyud mang po zhig yod kyang / thams cad 'bri mi langs la/ lhas sbyin shing drung gcig na 'dug pa'i drung na/ 'od srung —95—

rdzogs byed kyi rdza'i ril ba spyi blugs bcag pa dang / sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig gi phyi na lhas sbyin sman mar za zhing / thug pa'i sno da 'khris su bzhag pa dang / nang du zhugs pa'i ston pa'i sku gzhogs su yang / sman mar gyis gang pa'i snod yod pa dang / phyi rol phyogs gcig na lhas sbyin na zhing 'dre ldog byed pa dang / dge slong 'ga' res 'dzin zhing / la las lta ba dang / khang bzang gcig na ston pa bzhugs pa'i phyag brkyang ba/ shing sdong la sogs pa gzhan gyi phag nas song ste/ na ba de'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pa dang / nad drag ste langs nas bzhad gad smra ba'i tshul dang / yang ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing bzod pa gsol ba'i tshul la/ ston pa'i zhabs shel du byin gyis brlabs/ lhas sbyin gyi sen mo chag cing / sen mo'i srubs su bcug pa'i reg dug sa la lhung ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na dge slong zhig yod pa la ston pas bka' stsol ba'i tshul dang / des kyang lhas sbyin bskyor pa'i tshul dang /sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i rgyang ma nas/ lhas spyin 'gro ba'i rkang pa'i 'og sa'i gseb nas me lhag lhag byung ba dang / sags shing me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du lhas sbyin mgo rdog tsam ma gtogs shor/ lag pa thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ sa steng nas kun dga' bos gdams pa byed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas bkod pa'i bar mtshams bcad de/ 'og gi phyogs gcig tu dmyal gyi gnas lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi skor ba gcig na/ lcags kyi khang pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su skyes bu gcig lus la me 'bar zhing / gan rkyal du 'dug pa la/ lcags brag chen po nam mkha' nas 'bab pas 'tsher ba dang / lcags kyi glang po che me 'bar bas —96—

skyes bu gcig rdzi ba dang / lcags kyi sog le 'bar bas skyes bu gcig gcod pa dang / lcags kyi tho ba me 'bar bas/ skyes bu gcig gi mgo phye mar byed pa dang / phyogs de nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'bab pa dag 'bri ste/ lhas sbyin sdug bsngal myong tshul lo/ /yang phyogs gcig na skyes bu gcig gi lce shin tu che ba phyi rol tu bkrams te/ lcags kyi glang rmig pa me 'bar ba dang bcas te gshol lcags me ri bar bas rmod par byed pa'i rnam pa tsho gnyis 'bri/ phyogs gcig na nam mkha' nas char babs pa me'i dug kyis bskam pa'i tshul dang / phyogs gcig na mchu dang / de'i drung na dge slong gnyis 'bri'o/ /de dag ni ston pa dang chos la sdig bsags pas/ sdug bsngal myong tshul lhas spyin la dper mtsho ni pa'i bkod pa'o/ /(skro) yang bkod pa gzhan la/ yul tsho gnyis bar na gang gā mtshon byed chu chen pos chod pa zhig 'bri/ byang ma de'i phyogs gcig grong khyer gcig na/ skye bo mang po na ba'i tshul dang / nad bdag 'gyung po dang ma mo nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshul dang / bram ze gcig la nam mkha' nas lhas lung ston pa dang / bram zes skye bo mang po la bshad pa dang / yangs pa can gyi li tsa byi rgyal rigs kyi rnam pa can rnams 'dus nas gros byed pa dang / de nas pho nya ba bram ze zhig mngags pa dang / bram ze de yul ljongs phar phyogs de'i gtsug lag khang zhig na/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb pa dang / yang rgyal po'i phro brang gi khang bzang gnyis las/ gcig na rgyal po dang bram ze de yod pa dang /gcing/ na rgyal po de blon po 'ga' re dang / bka' mchid byed pa dang / pho brang —97—

gi phyi khyams na/ rgyal po des bram ze la byar dga' stsol zhing bka' gnang ba dang / pho brang de'i sgo gcig nas bram ze 'gro ba'i tshul dang / phyi'i khang pa gcig na blon po rnams la bram ze gtam smra ba dang / phyogs gcig na bram ze des yi ge bris te pho nya rdzong ba dang / khyim yangs pa gcig tu sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la rgyal pos gdugs tshod gsol ba 'bri/ de'i phyogs gcig tu ston pa la rgyal po zhu ba gsol ba'i tshul dang / sgo drung du ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' gnang zhing / de'i nang du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ phyogs de nas chu bo de'i 'gram du sleb sleb kyi bar la lam rnams la phyag dar byed pa dang / me tog dang spos sogs mchod pa'i bkod pa 'bri/ yul tshur phyogs de nas kyang chu 'gram bar du/ de ltar byed pa 'bri/ de nas grong khyer na lan da na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du kun tu rgyu rgan po gcig the tshom gcod pa dang / de dge slong du gyur pa 'bri/ song ma'i dbyug pa zer ba'i grong khyer chung ngu zhig tu/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing / slob ma rnams la chos gsung pa 'bri/ de nas chu bo'i 'gram grong khyer yod pa'i phyi nang mchod rten yod pa gcig gi nang nas sangs rgyas bzhugs/ skye bo sna tshogs pa mjal du 'ong ba dang bram ze gcig gcig gis mchod pa 'bul ba dang / grong khyer de'i phyi rol phyogs gcig na/lha mang po sa la 'bres rgyag pa gzigs pa dang / grong khyer de'i dbus na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang / nam mkha' la 'phags nas chu 'gram du spru/shogs pa dang / chu bo'i 'gram de na sangs rgyas la gdugs 'dzin pa mang po dang / yul tshur phyogs kyi chu 'gram na yang ston pa'i dbu gtsug tu gdugs 'dzin pa mang po —98—

dang / chu'i steng na klu gdugs 'dzin pa mang po dang / nam mkha' la rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams gdugs 'dzin pa dang / de las kyang mtho ba'i nam mkha' la brgya byin 'khor bcas gdugs 'dzin pa dang / chu de la gru gzing gnyis byas te/ de gnyis la dge slong rnams 'gro ba dang / chu'i dkyil nas sbrul mang po sprul mgo'i gdengs kha byas pa gcig la gcig reg pa'i gdeng kha'i zam pa byas pa'i steng nas bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gcig 'byon pa 'bri/ yul tshur phyogs kyi chu 'gram der gdugs yod pa'i yas mar gang rigs gcig tu/ston pa bzhugs gdan med pa sa gnon mdzad pa zhig 'bri/ yang chu 'gram de nas rgyal po smra chen 'dzin pa zhes bya bas gser gyi mchod sdong gru bzhi shin tu ring ba bzo khyad can dang / de la dge slong gzhan rnams lta zhing / gcig rgyab bstan nas chos gos 'tshems pa 'bri/ sa stong de khar bcom ldan 'das kyi sku drung du/ dge slong rnams chos nyan pa zhig kyang bya'o/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra dad pa la bkod pa'i sde tshan no/ /(ze) de nas yul ljongs tshur phyogs der/ yul sgra gcan mtshon byed grong khyer chung ngu zhig tu/ ston pa bzhugs zhing 'khor rnams la chos ston pa'i sar/ nam mkha' nas ne tso zhig 'phur ste 'ong pas/ sku mdun du 'dug ste/spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba 'bul ba dang / ne tso phar ldog pa na 'ol bas bsad de/lhar skyes ston pa la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ba dang / spong byed kyi grong khyer mtshon pa'i grong khyer gcig gi ltag na a mra'i tshal mtshon byed kyi gtsug lag khang na ston pa 'khor bcas bzhugs shing / lam bar de nas bud med —99—

bzang mo rta pa zhig 'khor rta pa bud med mang pos bskor te sangs rgyas mjal bar 'gro ba dang / ston pa'i sku mdun du zhu ba zhu ba dang / de nas phyogs gcig nas/ yab sras mjal ba'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ shing rta mi dang bcas pa/sngo ser dkar ljang dmar ba 'khor du ma dang bcas te ston pa mjal du yong ba 'bri/ yang phyogs gcig na bram ze gcig la/ li tsa byi mang pos gos re re ster ba dang / gos de rnams bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang / li tsa byi shing rta nas babs pa de rnams la ston pas chos gsung pa dang / grong khyer spong byed kyi sgo bzhi po'i sgo them la dgra bcom pa re res zhabs bzhag ste gzungs mdo 'don pa dang nad gtong pa'i 'byung po thams cad rgyang ring du bros pa dang / khyim yangs pa gnyis su sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ sngar gyi bud med bzang po des/ gdugs tsho de gsol pa dang / cig shos su li tsa byi de rnams kyi gdugs tshod gsol ba 'bri/ grong khyer de'i rgyab na/ 'od ma can gyi grong mtshon byed kyi grong chung ngu gcig gi ltag na/ shing sha pa'i nags tshal gyi dbus na ston pa cung zad sku bsnyung ba'i tshul mdzad pa dang / dge slong mang po yul thor bu pa so so na bsam gtan byed pa 'bri/ de nas yul lus 'phags kyi grong khyer mi thi lar gshegs shing / skyes pa'i rabs gsung pa'i bkod pa dang / sa la zhes bya ba bram ze kho na'i grong gcig tu/ bsod snyoms 'bul ba med par lhung bzed stong pa gyur pa dang / bdud sdig can mi'i gzugs dang gtam gsung zhing / bdud de rlung 'tshub lta bur byas te yal ba dang / yul sdig pa can du gshegs te/gyad mang pos/ pha bong shin tu che ba zhig mes bsregs pa dang / lcags kyi brko —100—

zhing gsil ba dang / thag pas 'then pa dang / gzu byed pa sogs yod pa ltar/ston pa byon pa dang / ston pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong gis mkha' dbyings mthon por 'phangs pa dang / de la mi mang po lta zhing 'jigs pa'i tshul byed pa dang /de bye mar song bye ma'i phung po byung ba dang / slar yang lam gyi logs gzhan zhig tu/ pha bong sngar bzhin du 'byor ba dang / de la mi'i lag pa'i shul yod par ston par mdzad pa dang / gyad de rnams 'dus pa la chos gsung pa rnams 'bri/bar der yul so sor byon pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod kyang 'brir ma lang /shing sdong shin tu che ba yod pa'i grong gcig tu/ ston pa la bud med gcig gis bsod snyoms 'bul zhing chos ston la 'od zer steng 'og gnyis su song nas gtsug tor du nub pa dang / khang pa'i phyi rol du bram ze la chos ston pa rnams 'bri/ de nas gi ba li zhes bya ba'i nags khrod du/ lo ma'i spyil por ston pa bzhugs pa dang / ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' stsole ba dang / nags gcig na bram ze mang po gnas pa'i sar/ dge slong de sbrul gyis gdengs ka bdun du byas te gnas pa dang / bram ze'i drang srong de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du chos nyan pa dang / de nas ku dra'i yul gyi nags tshal na bzhugs pa dang / skye bo mang po 'dus te chos ston pa dang / de'i phyogs gcig na dge slong gcig gis rgyal po la chos ston pa dang / de nas grong khyer glang po can du bram ze gcig gis ston pa la bstod pa 'bul te/ 'od zer steng 'og tu spros te gtsug tor nub pa dang / yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas chos gsung pa la bram ze gcig ri chung gcig gi rtse nas lta ba dang / ston pas bram ze la bka' —101—

bkod mdzad pa'i tshul dang / bram zes khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu sbyin sreg gi thab kha bzhag pa'i 'og gi sa 'bru ba dang / de nas tsan dan sa mchog gi mchod sdong thon pa dang / mchod sdong de dang ston pa'i sku tshad mnyam par byung ba dang /mchod sdong de la dus ston chen po byed pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das bram ze'i grong la gshegs pa'i tshul dang / phar phyogs grong khyer gcig na/ skye bo du ma 'dus pa la/ mu stegs can rnams gtam smra ba dang / de rnams dmag myol ste tshur 'ong ba la/ rgyal rigs rgan po gcig gis gtam smra ba dang / bar gyi nags gseb gcig na dmag rnams bsdad pa la/ rgan po des me bting zhing /de rnams kyis me bsad kyang ma gsod pa dang / ston pa phebs pa'i phyogs nas me zhi ba dang / dmag mi rnams go phud de ston pa la chos nyan pe dang / bram ze'i grong du phebs nas skye bo rnams kyis mchod pa dang / nag po grong du sangs rgyas bzhi'i gtan/ stan gcig gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang / gnod spyin gyi gnas gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung na gnod spyin mang pos skor ba la/ gnod spyin glang chen stobs zhes bya ba gcig tshur yong ba dang / gtsug lag khang lnga brgya mtshon byed kyi gtsug lag khang mang por/ 'khor dge slong mang po la rgun 'brum sogs shing 'bras 'bul ba ste/ de dag ni yangs pa can rnams 'jis/sa pa las skyabs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(mi) gtsug lag khang de'i nang du sangs rgyas yang dag 'jog la bzhugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang phyag na rdo rje lhan cig tu nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / nags tshal sngon po yod pa gzigs shing / yul gcig na —102—

gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi skye bo mang po la gnod pa byed pa las/ mi rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'gram na gnod spyin de yang 'dug pa dang / yang gnod sbyin de la dgos su chos gsung pa dang /gtsug lag khang rtsig pa dang / de kha 'dra ba gzhan yang gnyis 'bri/ yang nags tshal dang 'bab chu du ma yod pa zhig na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang steng nas mtshon cha'i char phab pa me tog gi tshal du gyur pa dang / klus du ba btang ba las/ches che ba sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang / des me sbar ba tu sa ches che ba sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes brag ri'i rtse mo la rdo rje 'phangs pas/ri nyil zhing / klu'i gnas rnams non pa dang / yang klu rnams 'bros par rtsom pa las/ mtha' mes 'khor ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du klu sog ma med de/ chung ma dang / bu dang mna' ma dang 'khor dang bcas te skyabs 'gro dang / bslabs pa zhu ba'i tshul bya/ de'i lag gcig na/ phyag na rdo rjes/ rdo rje gsor bas gar mdzad pa 'bri/ yang bcom ldan 'das dang phyag na rdo rje lhan cig nam mkha' la gshegs shing / mtshal sngon po mtsho dang bcas gzigs pa dang mtsho gcig na klu'i pho brang gnyis yod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das mtsho nang du byon pa la klu de gnyis chos nyan pa/ klu'i pho brang gi rgyab phyogs na mtsho la sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ klu de gnyis lta ba dang / yang sangs rgyas dang phyag na rdo rje nam mkha' la gshegs te/ ri gcig rgal ba'i pha rol na/ yul ljongs chung ngu zhig 'bri/ yul de'i zur gcig na gnod spyin mo srin mo 'dra ba zhig gis byis pa mang po za ba'i tshul la/ g.yas phyogs su mdung —103—

zhags pa gcig 'bri/ yul de'i 'dabs na sangs rgyas la bram ze dang khyim bdag mang pos mchod pa byed cing chos nyan pa dang / yang phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing / yang phyogs gcig na bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ba' zhig gi gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs thogs nas sangs rgyas la zhu ba'i tshul dang / de dag gi 'gram na gnod sbyin mo srin mo'i lus can de yang chos nyan pa'i tshul bya/ logs gcig na bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo de kho na la chos ston pa dang / mi rnams kyi gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i tshul bya/ gzhan yang yul ljongs gcig na/ srin po srin mo mang po la chos ston pa dang / yang gcig na klu rnams 'dus pa la chos ston pa dang / yang gcig na lha sna tshogs 'dus pa dang / yang gcig na gnod sbyin sna tshogs 'dus pa dang / yang gcig na mi'am ci sna tshogs 'dus pa dang / yang gcig na 'byung po gzugs sna tshogs 'dus pa dang / yang gcig na nam mkha' lding sogs bya sna tshogs 'dus pa dang / yang gcig na lha ma yin dang lha min gyi bud med sna tshogs la chos gsung pa ste/ skabs der mi ma yin gyi gtso bo mthu che ba/rdzu 'phrul che ba 'bum phrag bdun cu don bdun brtul ba mtshon byed do/ /de dag las 'byung po gzugs sna tshogs bcos pa ni/ 'di lta bu dag yin te/ seng ge la sogs pa mgo brnyan sna tshogs dang / mgo mi la lus dud 'gro sogs su 'dug pa dang / lus gcig la mgo mang po dang / mgo gcig la lus mang po dang / lus mgo med dang / mgo lus bral ba dang / lag mang dang / lus phyed pa dang / phrag mig dang / mig mang dang / rkang mang dang / rkang gcig dang /—104—

rkang med dang / kha mang po dang / rkang lag la sogs pa yan lag srog chags sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug pa rnams so/ /de nas nam mkha' la phyag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tshur byon pa dang / gtsug lag khang gcig gi nang du bcom ldan 'das mnyam bzhag mdzad cing / sgo drung na dge slong gcig yod pa dang / phyi khyams na dge slong mang po bzhugs pa 'bri ste/ 'di ni thun gcig la/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa ste/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud du gshegs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(rtso) de nas gtsug lag khang de'i 'gram nas sangs rgyas dge slong gcig dang gshegs pa dang grong khyer chung ngu gnyis rim gyi brgyud nas/ ri gcig na nags tshal sngon po yod pa/ gcig ston par mdzad pa dang / grong khyer gcig gi 'dabs su byon pa la/ sngon por gyur zhes bya ba'i bram ze gcig gis bstod pa 'bul ba dang / bram ze de la chos ston zhing 'od 'phro ba dang / bram ze mang po gros byed pa dang / yang de rnams bram ze la smod pa dang / sangs rgyas grong khyer du phebs la khad pa las/ grong khyer gyi sgo drung na lha mo gcig lus gcer bur phyung nas 'dug pa dang / grong khyer gyi g.yon phyogs sa stong gcig la 'byon pa dang / ri chung gcig gi phug na bzhugs pa dang / ri'i rgyab kyi nags nang na/ byis pa bong bu la zhon pa dang / bong bus byis pa za ba dang / ri de'i 'gram tshur phyogs na/ sangs rgyas la 'khor mang pos bskor zhing mchod pa 'bul ba la/ de'i 'gram na gnod spyin te/ 'byung po bong bu'i mgo can zhig la/gzhan yang gnod spyin nyis stong lnga brgya mtshon byed kyi gnod sbyin mang po thal —105—

mo sbyar ba 'dri/ de nas mi rnams kyi phyogs gcig tu gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bzhengs pa dang / phyogs gzhan gcig tu nyis stong lnga brgya bzhengs pa mtshon byed gtsug lag khang chung ngu mang po bzhengs pa tsho gnyis/ de nas yul ljongs gzhan zhig na/ zhing pa mang po zhing rmod pa'i phar 'gram na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dang / de'i phyogs gcig sa stong gcig la sangs rgyas bzhugs shing / zhing pa rnams 'dus pa la/ sangs rgyas chos ston pa dang / phyogs gcig na glang thams cad gnya' shing chu thag bcad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mtha' skor du 'khod pa dang / nags gcig na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i drung du bram ze dpon slob mang po zhig chos nyan pa dang / nye skor de na rta dkar pos drangs pa'i shing rta dag yod pa/ de nas bran mo rgan mo zhig khron pa nas chu 'dren pa dang / kun dga' bos lhung bzed du chu slong ba dang / zur gcig tu bud med mchog dang /rgan mo de ston pa la chos nyan pa dang / bram ze gcig gi zlum ra chu'i gang ba dang / de ston pa la chos nyan zhing dge slong du gyur pa ste/ bcom brlag dang o ta la sogs su byon pa'i bkod pa'o/ /(tsho) de nas yul ljongs gcig na nem pa la sogs pa'i shing gi nags tshal gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i drung du rgyal po 'khor bcas kyang thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i lam phyogs lam gnas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas tshur yong ba dang / phar 'gro ba gnyis char gyis/ pho brang gi nang du rgyal pos blon po rnams la bka' sgo ba dang / khang pa'i phyi khyams na kha zas mang po bsham pa dang / phyogs gcig gi khang bzang na rgyal po gnyid log pa dang /—106—

de'i nam mkha' la 'od skor gcig gi nang na/ grong khyer gyi mtha' rgyal po rang gi rgyu mas dkris pa gcig gi hal mtshan gyis phra mor 'bri/ de nas khang bzang gi phyogs gcig tu/ rgyal po dang bram ze zhig gtam smra ba dang / khang bzang gi nang zhig na rgyal po gcig por 'dug pa dang / pho brang gi phyi nol du mi mang po bsags pa na/ blon pos bka' sgo ba dang / grong khyer che chung mang po'i srang kha na/ dge slong gnyis te brda' sprod pa'i tshul dang / pho brang de'i sgo nas dge slong gnyis brda' sprod pa'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs gcig na tshong pa rta khal mang po can yong pa dang / tshong pa de rnams khal spog nas 'dug pa'i sar/ tshong dpon dang dge slong gcig gtam smra ba'i tshul dang / ri nags tshal can gcig gi 'gram na/ dge slong gcig gis dge slong rnams la tshul shing 'grem pa dang / ston pa'i drung du dge slong gnyis zhu ba byed pa dang / de gnyis phyogs gzhan gcig la 'gro tshul dang / ri de'i sked pa tsam na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa la tshong dpon de 'ong nas/ so so nas phyag 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ phyogs gcig tu bu mo gcig gis nas brdung zhing / dge slong zhig sa steng mtho ba gcig na bzhugs nas de tsho la chos 'chad pa'i rnam pa dang / ri'i rtsa ba na rta lnga brgya mtshon byed rta mang po yang bcom ldan 'das la lta zhing skad 'byin pa'i tshul dang / de dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig na bu mo lnga brgya mtshon byed bu mo mang po yang thal mo sbyar zhing smon lam 'debs tshul byed/ yang sngar gyi pho brang de'i 'khris su/ khang bzang de 'dra rung gi sgo tha dad na phyogs kyi pho nya pa mang po yod pa dang /sgo bsrung gcig la gnas brtan gcig gi gtam smra ba dang / sgo nang ma gcig —107—

la sgo bsrung gis 'khrid de/ dge slong de 'gro ba dang / rgyal po'i drung na yang yang dge slong yod pa 'bri/ sngar gyi ri de'i 'khris su ri de ka 'dra ba zhig la phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas kyi drung na/ dge slong gcig mchil ma 'byin pa'i tshul/ ston pa'i phyag g.yon du lhung bzed bsnams/ g.yas kyi nas 'bru gcig dge slong de la gnang ba'i tshul bya/ sngar gyi dge slong phar phyogs gnyis po tshur 'ong pa dang / ri de'i phyogs gcig na rgyal po 'khor bcas ston pa la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul byed/pho brang steng ma de'i phyogs gcig na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la/ rgyal po des bsod snyoms 'bul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas yul gzhan la gshe/gas pa'i tshub/ 'bri/ ri steng ma de'i phyogs gcig la/dge slong rnams kyi lo ma'i spyil po dang / rtsa'i spyil po dang / rang shong khang bu dag bshig par brtsams pa las/ ston pas bzlog pa dang / bkod pa de dag dang ri nags kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs chung ngu gcig na/ ri rtse gsum pa gcig la dge slong gnyis bzhugs shing / brgya byin gyi bdud rtsi 'dren pa 'bri/ de dang phyogs mi gcig pa ljongs snga ma de dang ri nags kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs gcig na phar shing rta 'bras kyi bkang ba dang / mi mang po 'gro ba'i mdun nas/ dge slong gi gzugs can gcig gi bzlog pa dang / yang shing rta song ba la char pa dang / 'obs chen po'i rgyun la ma thar ba rnams 'bri ste/ grong khyer sgra mthar dbyar gnas pa'i bskor ro skor ro/ /(dza) yang bkod pa gcig la/ chu 'gram gcig la ston pa 'khor bcas gshegs shing / chus shing sdong chen po khyer ba gcig dang / chu 'gram na —108—

ston pa 'khor mang po chos gsung pa'i 'khris na/ gnag rdzi rgan po gcig chos —nyan zhing 'khar ba sa la btsugs pa/ sbal ba zhig gi steng du khel ba dang / sbal ba lhar skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pa dang / de dang nye ba'i ri sul mang po gcig na phar rgan po de song bas phyugs rdzi la sogs pa'i mi mang po 'bros pa dang / grong gcig gi mi rnams go cha gyon pa dang / rgan pos gnag phyugs rnams bdag po so so la gtod pa'i tshul dang / tshur lam rgan pa de phyugs rdzi mang pos skor nas ston pa'i drung du sleb la khad pa/ ston pas chos gsung pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / 'od 'phro ba 'bri'o/ /de nas chu bo chen po ga d+ma'i steng la bcom ldan 'das res gru dang res chu la zhabs bzhag gin phebs pas ngang pa mang po bskor ba byed pa dang / nya mang po bskor ba byed pa dang / rus sbal mang po bskor ba byed pa dang / ston pas kyang chos gsung pa'i rnam pa dang / ga ba'i tshur 'gram du phebs pa na/ de rnams lhar skyes pa ston pa la chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / yang phyogs gcig na yi dwags lus keng rus lta bu lto ba che zhing gdong dang lus skras g.yogs ba/ kha khab mig tsam/ mdog nag phra thor re ba mang po la bcom ldan 'das kyi chu bo ston par mdzad pa dang / de rnams kha chen por song ba la/ dge slong gcig gi chu blud pa dang / de dag shi nas lhar skyes pa la chos ston pas bden pa mthong ba 'bri/ yi dwags kha khab mig tsam ni rgya gar gyi ri mo khungs ma las/ sbrang bu'i mchu ltar ring ba'i rtse na/ kha'i bug ga yod pa'i rnam pa bris 'dug go /de nas ji skad du/gzhon nu skye dang glang chen skra/ /dpung rgyan ldan dang nor bu can/ /sa la stobs —109—

dang sa la'i stobs/ /gser bre dang ni gnas bcas dang / /thug pa dang ni mnyan yod dang / /ma dros grong khyer si rgyu dang / /yangs pa can ni tha ma yin/ /zhes yul mang por byon par bshad pa las 'di tsam zhig 'bri ste/ bram ze dbul po zhig zhing rmo ba'i sar/ bu mo zhig gi thug pa bskyel ba dang / de dang nye ba'i lam na sangs rgyas 'byon pa dang / bram zes thug pa sangs rgyas la phul ba dang / thug pa de khron pa rnying pa gcig tu blug pas khron pa khengs pa dang /thug pa de sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gsol yang nyung du ma song zhing / khron pa nas slang pa 'thul ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bram ze la chos ston pa dang / kho'i zhing gi nas sogs lo thog thams cad gser 'ba' zhig tu skyes pa dang / ston thog rgyal po dang bgo bsha byas pas/ rgyal po'i de rnams 'brur song / bram ze de rnams gser du 'dug pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ yang thon mkhan gcig gi lcags te rgyang ring po nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / de dag nye bar ston pa bzhugs shing sa 'og nas/ lha dang klu rnams kyi rin po che'i sgrom bu'i snod byung ba dang / de kha phye ba'i nang nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring srel ma nyams pa thon pa la/ skye bo mang po phyag mchod byed cing lta ba dang / yang de sa 'og tu nub pa dang / phyogs gcig nas rgyal po 'khor bcas 'ong pa dang ldog pa gnyis 'bri ste/ lho phyogs lnga len kyi ga d+ma'i tshugs gshegs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /('i) de nas khyim khang bzang can gcig na khyim bdag gcig gis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gdugs tshod gsol zhing / phyi sgo nas sprang po mang po 'jug tshad pa la/ sgo srung bas bsrung ba dang / sprang po gcig sprang po gzhan —110—

rnams gyi skrod pa dang / de phyags dar gyi phung po'i gseb na mgo la rma byung nas 'dug pa dang / ston pa dang nyan thos gcig de'i 'khris su gshegs nas/ de la kha zas stsol ba dang / sprang po ston pa'i phyi bzhin du 'gro ba dang / gtsug lag khang du ston pa'i de la bka' stsol ba dang / de dong tse gnyis thogs nas me tog gi ra ba'i sgo drung na 'dugs pa la/ mi gcig gis gtam smra ba dang/ dong tse de la gtad de me tog ut+pal mang po blangs te/ gtsug lag khang du 'gro ba dang /sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun rnams la des ut+pal re re 'bul ba dang / de nas sprang po de sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / phyogs gcig tu mnyam bzhag byed cing lus las 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ ston pa 'khor bcas yul gzhan du gshegs pa dang / yul ljongs der rgyal po'i pho brang zhig tu mchod ston gsol ba dang / ri bo nags tshal can la sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs pa nga/nga phyi ra bas skor ba'i rdo chal yangs pa zhig tu/ phyogs gcig na sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod ston gsol ba dang / phyogs gcig tu bram ze dang khyim bdag mang pos sangs rgyas la zhu ba 'bul ba dang / de'i phyi rol gyi sa la/ ston pas dge slong gcig la bka' bsgo ba dang / nags gseb gcig la dge slong 'gro zhing mtsho gcig gi 'gram du zas za ba dang / lhung bzed 'khrud pa dang / phyogs gcig na skyil krung bcas nas 'dug pa la/ mar+sā che'i char 'bab pa me tog gi char par song / du ba 'thul ba dang me 'bar ba 'bri/phyogs gcig tu klu la dge slong des chos gsung pa 'bri/ de dag ni klu ar mra —111—

chu ngogs pa brtul ba'i bkod pa ste/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan no/ /(di) de nas khyim khang bzang can zhig gi nang na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la khyim bdag cig gis gdugs tshod gsol ba dang / sgo drung du 'od srung chen po phyags dar khrod gyon pa sgo bas ma btang ba dang/ 'gram gcig tu mu lto ma mdze mo zhig gis 'bras khu 'od srung la phul ba dang / phyogs gcig tu 'bras khu 'od srung la phul ba de gsol ba dang / de dga' ldan gyi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas ston pa la chos nyan pa dang / 'od srung la rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pho brang du bsod snyoms gsol ba dang / yang gtsug lag khang du sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ rgyal pos mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod de/na bza' gser gyi mdog can phul ba dang / zas kyi lhag ma sa la bo ba rnams mul lto ba rnams kyis khyer ba dang / rgyal po bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdun na 'dug cing / mul lto ba gcig sgo khang na 'dug pa dang / yang de kha dang 'dra ba gcig la/ rgyal po phyogs gzhan du 'byon zhing / sgo srung gi mul lto ba rnams sprod pa dang / yang gtsug lag khang gi nang na sangs rgyas la rgyal po zhu ba mdzad pa dang / de ma yin pa'o gtsug lag khang gcig tu sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ bza' btung dang / na bza' dang / sman dang / mar me dang / 'khru mar gyi bum pa la sogs pa mang po zhig 'bul ba dang / sprang mos gyo mog tu mar me spar te/ khyams su bzhag nas smon lam 'debs pa dang / phyogs gzhan gcig na mar me gzhan rnams shi gyo mog gi mar me de ches 'bar zhing 'od —112—

zer 'phro ba/ ston pa'i zhal las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ gtsug tor du thim pa dang / dge slong gcig gi chos gos kyi dras g.yob pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis bzlog par mdzad cing / shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung ston pa dang / yang gtsug lag khang gcig tu/ ston pa'i drung na rgyal po gsal rgyal thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa rnams 'bri ste/ 'ga' zhig byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa'i skabs so/ /9) de nas grong brdal me tsu ru di mtshon pa'i grong dang / gcug lag khang na ston pa chos gsung pa dang / de'i khang bzang na ston pas rgyal po gsal rgyal la chos gsung pa dang / sgo drung nas bram ze gcig shing rtar bzhugs ral gri dang / rnga yab cod pan thogs te 'gro ba dang / shing drung bskam se ba gcig na/ ston pa bzhugs/ rgyal po dar bab gcig phyag 'tshal ba dang /dmag tshur yong ba dang phar ldog pa dang / grong khyer gcig tu ston pas skyes pa bud med mang po la chos gsung pa dang / 'od 'phro ba 'bri/ shākya lhag ma rnams bden pa la bkod pa'i skabs so/ / dzo('i) yang rgyal po'i pho brang dang bcas pa na/ pho brang nang na rgyal pos bram ze la gsung 'byon pa ngang / grong khyer gyi phyi rol bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ ston pa dge 'dun rnams la chos ston pa'i sku mdun du/ bram ze de yang zhu ba zhu ba'i tshul bya/ de nas ston pa 'khor bcas lam la phebs pa'i tshul dang /ga sgo'i lho phyogs kyi grong khyer gcig gi dbus su bzhugs shing bram ze des mchod ston gsol ba dang / grong khyer de'i nub sgo nas byon/ byang phyogs su —113—

'khyogs/ ga d+ma'i tshur 'gram nas mi snang bar mdzad pa dang / g.yin skye bo sna tshogasang pa ni/ sdod gru dang / shing leb dang / ra skyal sogs la 'jus te ga ṅga la 'gro ba te/ tshur 'gram nas mi snang ba sogs kyi rigs 'di la/ rnam pa gsal ba zhig 'bri dka' bar 'dug kyang / 'di ltar bya ste/ tshur 'gram tu sku gsal po gcig dang 'ja' 'od ban bun gyi dkyil na rib se ba zhig 'bri/ phar logs su yang 'od kyi dkyil na rib se zhig dang / de drung na sku gsal ba 'od 'phro ba zhig 'bri/ ga d+ma'i byang ngos yangs pa can mtshon pa'i grong khyer gyi nang na/khang pa chen po gcig la khang bzang du ma yod cing sgo bzhi pa/ grong khyer de'i ltag na gtsug lag khang yod pa na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhugs shing /khyim bdag gcig dang li tsa byi mang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bka' mchid 'bul ba'i tshul dang / grong khyer gyi dbus kyi khang pa chen po de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'i khang bzang bzhi kar na/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la mchod ston gsol ba/ shar ma na khyim bdag cung zad rgan nyams yod pa zhig lho ma na khyim bdag mo gcig nub ma na gzhon nu gcig byang ma na bu mo gcig rnams thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul 'bri/ phyogs bzhi'i sgo nang nas dge slong re re lta ba'i tshul dang / sgo bzhi'i phyi na li tsa byi 'ga' re 'ga' re 'dus te gtam smra ba 'bri/ sgo nang phyogs bzhi char na phyi khyams re yod pa la g.yog pho mo las kyi mtha' sna tshogs byed pa dag 'bri'o/ /de nas yul ljongs de'i phyogs sba dang / snyug ma'i nags mang po yod pa'i grong khyer chung ngu gcig gis 'gram gyi skyed mos tshal na/ ston pa nyid bzhugs shing / glo rten la cung zad snyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang /— 1/4—

sku mdun du dge slong gcig zhu ba zhu ba dang / grong chung sna tshogs dang / phug dang / shing drung rtsa spyil sogs yul ljongs de'i gnas ma nges pa rnams na dge slong mang po dag 'khod pa'i tshul 'bri'o/ /de dag dang nye ba'i mtsho 'gram zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa dang / sngar gyi grong khyer che ba de phyogs su bsod snyoms la 'byon pa dang / tsa sa la'i mchod rten gyi 'khris shing drung gcig tu bzhugs pa nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsole ba dang / kun dga' bo cang mi zhu ba dang / de nas yang shing drung gcig na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs/ shing drung gzhan gcig na kun dga' bo 'dug pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na bdud sdig can thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul gyi 'dug pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i ltas chu 'khrugs pa dang / ri 'gul dang / khang pa 'khyogs pa sogs 'bri'o/ /yang de'i phyogs gcig tu dge slong gcig gis dge slong thams cad bsdus shing / ston pa'i drung du 'dus nas chos nyan pa dang / de nasaphar lam la gshe/gas shing / yangs pa can la phyi ltas kyi gzigs pa'i tshul 'bri ste/ rgyal bo'i khab dang yangs pa can gyi gdul bya mthar phyin pa'i sde tshan no/ /9) de nas ru rta'i grong dang / dum bu'i grong dang / a mra'i grong dang / dzam bu'i grong dang / rdzi grong dang / shur pa'i grong dang / longs spyod kyi grong dang / grong chung brgyad po rnams su gshegs nas/ shing sha pa'i tshal na bzhugs/ der yang sa g.yos skar mda' lhung / phyogs dmar zhing 'bar bar gyur/ bar snang nas lha rnams rnga brdung ba/ de nas gyad yul sdig pa can —115—

gshegs pa ste/ ston pa 'khor bcas lam la phebs tshul dang / dza lu dka'i tshal zhes bya ba skyed mos tshal 'dra ba gcig na bzhugs pa dang / gyad dang skye bo mang po 'ong zhing / ston pa'i spyan sngar chos nyan pa dang / de'i mtha' cig tu mgar ba'i bu btsun pa zhu ba 'bul ba dang / de nas yang phyogs gcig tu btsun da'i khang pa'i khyams su/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la lcags gzhong gi snod nas/ 'bras can bzang po zhu ba dang / yang ston pa 'khor bcas yul gzhan la gshe/gas te/ chu zhig brgal ba dang / mi ring bar gzims pa'i tshul dang / kun dga' bos gsol lhung du chu bo de nas chu len pa'i tshul dang / shing rta mang po chu'i phar logs su 'gro ba dang / chu de'i zhabs 'khrud pa dang / yang lam du bzhugs pa la/ gyad g.yog mang po dang bcas pa cig mjal ba dang /ston pas de la ston pa dang / de ras gser mdog zung gi na bza' 'bul zhing /sku la gsol ba dang / de nas ston pa'i sku shin tu kha dog gsal ba mtshon byed du 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba la dge slong rnams gyi the tshom zhu ba dang / de nas chu bo gcig gi nang du bzhugs te/ sku khrus mdzad pa dang / chu 'gram du na bza' gcig pas bzhugs pa dang / btsun da'i the tshom gcod pa dang / chu bo de'i bar 'gram gyi phyogs gcig tu gzims pa'i tshul las/ drung du kun dga' bo bzhengs pa dang / de nas yang phar byon te yul ljongs gcig gi smad na gyad kyi grong khyer yod pa/ stod na skyed tshal 'dra ba ljon shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mtha' gnyis na/ sa la'i sdong po shin tu che ba yod pa/ de'i dbus su gzims khri dbu sngas dang bcas pa bshams shing / tshal der phebs pa dang /—116—

khri la gzims pa'i tshul dang / grong khyer de'i phyogs gcig na/ gyad mang po 'tshogs pa la dge slong gcig gis gtam smra ba dang / gyad bud med 'khor dang bcas pa yar yong ba dang / tshal de'i phyogs gcig tu de dag la chos gsung pa dang / tshul gyi phyi rol tu kun dga' bos gyad rnams la bslabs pa'i gnas 'bogs pa dang / de rnams grong khyer du ldog ste 'gro ba dang / yang swā la zung gi tshal snga ma bzhin tshar gcig bris/ ston pa glo rten la snyes pa'i tshul gyi sa la bzhugs shing / sku mdun na dge slong lus las 'od cher 'phro ba zhig 'dug pa dang / de langs te phyi la 'gro ba dang / kun dga' bo bzhugs khri'i rkang la 'jus te/ spyan chab 'byin pa'i tshul dang / de'i g.yon zur phyogs thag ring ba zhig gi nam mkha' la/ sprin gyi sgribs pa'i gseb nas/ ri rab kyi rtse sum cu rtsa gsum gyi grong khyer mtshon byed la/ gzhal med khang zhig na dri za pi waX brdung ba zhig dang / sgo drung na yang de 'dra ba'i be+e khu rla'i pi waX brdung ba zhig bya/ de dang dri za'i sgo zung gtam smra ba dang / khang bzang nang gi dri za de la yang / sgo srung des gtam smra ba 'bri/ de nas dri za'i rnam pa de gnyis khang bzang gi phyi rol du/ pi waX gi rgyud yongs rdzogs yod par brdung ba dang / rgyud phyed tsam bcad snyam byas te brdung ba dang / gcig rgyud thams cad bcad nas 'khris su bzhagagacig gi rgyud bcad kyang phyag tu thogs nas glu len pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i phyogs gcig na ston pas dri za de la chos ston pa'i rnam pa zha/ swā la zung gi tshal dang de'i bar gsar ris phra mo zhig gi sbrel lo/ /sā la zung gis tshal steng ma de'i sgo drung na/ kun tu rgyu rgas 'khog pa zhig dang / dge slong zhig gtam 'dri ba dang /—117—

tshal de'i nang phyogs gzhan zhig na/ ston pas kun tu rgyu de la chos gsung pa dang / de'i lus las 'od 'phro zhing / de dge slong du gyur/ tshal gyi phyi rol du de mnyam bzhag bcas te mya ngan las 'das pa/ mu stegs can rnams kyi mu stegs pa'i gzugs su mthong ba'i bkod pa gcig g.yin rnams kyi dge slong gi gzugs su mthong ba'i bkod pa gcig mu stegs rnams kyi khyogs btegs kyang ma thegs/ rdzing bu'i dbus su rdo rtegs la bzhag nas zhugs la 'bul rgyu'i rdzing gi chu la bying zhing / chu'i srog chags kyis smugs pas chu 'gram nas don cing bros pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis khyogs kyang theg chu la bying zhing srog chags kyis gnod pa med pa/ mu stegs kyi me spar bas ma 'bar/ dge slong rnams kyis spar bas 'bar ba la skye bo mang po lta ba 'bri/ yang swā la zung gi tshal gsum pa zhig kyang byas te/ gzims khris steng du gzims pa dang /sku'i mtha' dge slong rnams kyis skor ba la/ gzims pa'i ngang nas chos gsung pa dang / nam mkha' la bzhugs nas/ sku stod kyi na bza' gsol nas dge slong rnams la ston pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ de'i mtha'i g.yas g.yon rgyab steng phyogs rnams lha'i khrom chen po go ma tshams med pa dang /mdun gyi phyogs tshal gyi phyi na mi'i 'gro ba 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ skyes pa bud med sogs gnas pa dang / bya dang gcan gzan dang ri dwags dang / rta glang la sogs srog chags du ma yod pa'ang 'bri/ mchod pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa thogs pa dang / nam mkha' nas me tog gi char shas che ba dang / gos dang rin po che dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad kyi char pa yang tho re ba 'bri/ de nas —118—

de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs gcig nas/ lcags kyi sgrom bu dkyus ring po kha gcod can kha gcod kyi steng du gzo khyad kyi khebs dang ldan pa/ gyad kyi btegs pa la thegs pa dang / mchod pab mang po 'bul ba dang / slar btegs pas thegs pa'i tshul dang / sgrom gyad brgyad kyi btegs nas/ mtha' skor du mchod pa byed mkhan mang pos skor/ ras bal gyi khur thogs pa mang po dang / ras kha dog sna tshogs mang po dang / gser gyi bum pa thogs pa sogs kyis skor nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang / grong khyer gcig gi nub sgo nas 'dzugs pa'i tshul dang / dbus nas 'gro ba'i tshul dang / shar sgo nas 'thon pa'i tshul dang / chu bo gcig brgal 'gro ba'i tshul dang / chu'i pha rol mchod rten gyi 'gram du bzhugs su gsol/lam de dag thams cad du me tog dang / spos dang na bza'i char 'bab pa dang /nam mkha' nas lha rnams rol mo brdung ba'i bkod pa bya/ der shing gi phung po'i steng du lcags kyi sgrom bu bzhag ste/ mi rnams kyis me spar ba'i tshul byas pa las/ me ma 'bar ba'i rnam pa 'bri/ de'i drung du dge slong zhig gis gyad la sogs pa'i mi rnams la gtam smra ba dang / de rnams mchod pa byed pa/ yang de kha'i khris su dge slong 'od srung chen po dge slong mang po'i 'khor gyi skor nas yong ba dang / lcags kyi sgrom bu kha phye nas gdung la lta ba dang / ras zung lnga brgya mtshon byed 'bul ba dang / yang kha bkab ste sgrom bu de tsan+dan gyi phung po'i steng du bzhag me rang 'bar du byung ba'i tshul bya/ de nas yang de dang nye bar gser gyi bum pas 'o ma blug te me bsad pa dang / sol ba'i dbus nas me tog gi sdong po chen po zhig skyes pa dang / gdung sgrom slar kha phye bas tshems che — 119—

ba bzhi ring bsrel gyi phung po dang / chos gos gnyis kha dog ma nyams shing ma tshig par 'dug pa dang / phyogs gcig tu ring bsres de dag gser gyi bum par bcug ste/ khri chen po la bzhag ste mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de dag las zhugs la zhen pa dang / gdung sgrom kha phye ba dang / gser gyi bum par ring bsrel bcug pa'i gnas skabs de dag las/ dge slong dang skye bo dang lha mang po mtha' skor ba'i tshul bya/ de dag ni mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar bstan pa'i sde tshan no/ /(ri) de nas yang bkod pa g.yin yul ljongs gnyis yod pa zhig bya ste/ tshur phyogs de'i dbus na grong khyer dang / chu rlung dang / phar phyogs na mchod rten dang / gser gyi bum pa 'od 'phro ba la/ skye bo mang po mchod pa byed pa 'bri/ grong khyer gyi nang na gyad go mtshon thogs pa dang / bud med rgan gzhon rnams kyang mda' gzhu dang ral gri thogs pa sogs 'bri/ rta dang glang po dang shing rta bshams pa dang / grong khyer gyi phyi rol dang / yul ljongs phra mo mi 'dra tsam bdun dang / dmag tsho tshan bdun yod pa la/ gnyis kyi mgo mi bram ze yin la/ gzhan dmag dpon rgyal rigs kyi rnam pa 'bri'o/ /de rnams re re'i drung du/ bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa gcig rim gyi song nas so sor gtam smra ba'i tshul dang / sngar gyi bum pa mchod pa dang bcas pa'i nye skor der/ bram ze gnyis gyad gnyis/ rgyal rigs bzhi rnams mtha' nas skor ba dang / dbus su gser gyi bum pa kha phye nas/ bram ze des de dag cha brgyad du bgo ba dang de dag so so'i lag tu gser gyi bum pa sku gdung gi gang ba re re gtod pa dang / bram —120—

ze gcig gi gdung sol rnams 'phyer ba dang/ bram ze rgan pa de nyid kyis lcags kyi sgrom bu 'byer ba dang/ grong khyer gyi dbus su gyad de rnams gyis mchod rten byed pa dang / dmag tsho bdun po de dag kyang / sku gdung gi bum pa glang po che la bkal te mchod pa dang bcas nas gyes 'gro ba'i tshul dang / rgyal po'i tshul can gnyis kyis tshems mche ba re thogs te 'gro ba dang /tshems mche ba gcig lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi thogs nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ de nas ra sogs kyi chod pa'i yul ljongs gcig tu/ dmag tsho gcig rnams chu bo gcig gi 'gram du khru ma btab te gnas pa las/ sku gdung gi bum pa dang tshems mche ba gcig klus khyer te/ klu rnams chu la song ba'i bkod pa dang /yul ljongs gnyis yod pa'i phar phyogs der/ grong khyer rgyal po'i pho brang dang bcas pa'i 'khris na skyed mos tshal gcig dang / skyed mos tshal der bram ze gcig gi bkod pa byas nas/ ri mo mkhan gyi ri mo 'bri ba'i tshul de yang sku bltams pa dang / bdud brtul ba dang / chos snye bor bskor ba dang / cho 'phrul dang / lha babs dang / myang 'das kyi bar du bris pa mtshon byed gnyis ri mo phra mos hal tshon du bri/ gzhong pa mar khus bkang ba bdun dang tsan+dan gyi lde gus bkang ba gcig bshams/ der rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang byon zhing / bram ze des ri mo la rten bshad byed pa'i tshul bya/ de nas rgyal po de 'gyel ba dang /mar khu'i nang du lus bcug pa dang / tsan+dan gyi lde gu'i nang du bcug pas sos pa'i tshul 'bri/ de'i phyi rol tu glang po che la chibs pas kyang lhung ba'i tshul bya/de nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu/ dpung yan lag bzhi mdun du bshams/ rgyal po —121—

nyid khri la 'dug mdun du bram ze yod pa la bka' gnang ba'i tshul bya/yul de kha'i phyogs gcig gi ri la/ 'od srung chen po mnyam bzhag byed pa dang /sa'i mthil la 'od srung 'khor dge slong mang pos skor nas/ yul ljongs tshur phyogs la chas pa'i rnam pa dang / yul ljongs gnyis po'i bar de dag tu 'od srung 'khor bcas la/ ras zung 'bul ba mang po byung ba'i bkod pa dang / rgan zhugs gcig tshur yong ba'i rnam pa yang bya/ 'di la rgyus sde tshan gong ma dang 'brel ba yin yang yul ljongs kyi bkod pa phyi ma dang 'brel bar bya dgos pa yin/ de dag ni sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i bskor ro/ /(li) yang bkod pa gzhan ni/ gyad gyi grong na 'od srung chen po'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi la chos ston pa'i tshul dang / nam mkha' nas lha rnams 'phya smod byed pa'i tshul dang / 'od srung chen pos dge slong gzhan zhig la bka' stsal te/ des kyang dge slong tshogs pa la khrims su bca' ba smra ba dang / 'od srung lam gzhan gcig la byon/ dge slong des gtso mdzad pa'i dge slong gzhan rnams lam gcig shos de la yong ba'i tshul bya/ yul ljongs phar phyogs der rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar 'od srung 'byon pa dang / rgyal pos pho brang gi rtse nas mthong bas sangs rgyas dran te 'phyongs pa dang / 'od srung gi sprul pas bar snang la bzung ste sa la bzhag pa dang / pho brang gi nang du 'od srung khri la bzhugs pa'i drung du rgyal po 'dug pa dang pho brang de'i g.yas phyogs su bya rgod phung po'i ri dang / dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi bar n+ya gro rda'i phug ces bya ba/ phug pa chen po gcig dang / mtha' skor du phug chung mang po yod pa/ dge slong rnams —122—

der 'ongs pa'i tshul dang / phug pa chen po'i nang du 'od srung chen po la dgra bcom pa rnams kyis skor ba/ phug chung rtsa spyil/ lo spyil sogs na dge slong sna tshogs pa yo byad dang ldan pa dang / yo byad spyor mi sogs kyang 'bri/ phyogs yangs pa gcig tu 'od srung dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ dge slong chen po gcig la 'od srung gi gtam smra zhing tshul shing gtod pa/ dge slong de sa sgang gzhi gcig gi phyogs bzhir blta zhing / mchil ma 'byin pa dang / de la 'od srung gi gtam smra ba dad / phug de kha 'dra ba gsum gyi bkod pa 'bri ste/ gcig tu khri'i steng na snam sbyar mang po brtsegs pa la/ kun dga' bo bzhugs shing / dgra bcom pa rnams kyis mtha' bskor te chos nyan pa dang / nam mkha' nas lha dang mtha' bskor nas 'byung po rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i bkod pa bya/ gnyis pa der gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ nye ba 'khor gtso bor byed/ gsum pa der gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'od srung gtso bor byed/ de rnams yul bkod snga ma de la yod par byed cing / de dag las gzhan phyogs chu dang ri sogs mang pos chod pa/yul chung zhig gi nags kyi dbus na khang bzang yod pa zhig na/ dge slong gcig mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i mdun na/ dge slong gcig langs te gtam smra ba 'bri/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la me dpung bzhi 'bar pa'i phyogs bzhi nas sgro rgyun bzhi 'bab pa gcig na/ yul grong gcig na skyes mos tshal gcig tu dge slong gcig mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la/ slob mas mdun nas gdams ngag smra ba dang / de dang phug kyi sa phyogs kyi bar der/ dge slong dpon slob gnyis phar —123—

'byon pa dang / tshur ldog pa gnyis ka 'bri ste/ de dag ni 'od srung gis mdzad pa bka' bsdu dang po'i skor ro/ /('i) de nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs phyi ma rnams la/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos mdzad pa mtshon byed/ 'phags pa nyid rin po che'i khri la bzhugs nas/ 'khor rnam bzhi'i tshogs dang / lha klu gnod sbyin sogs 'dus pa la chos ston pa 'bri/ sha na'i gos can gyis mdzad pa mtshon yang de kha dang 'dra ba zhig 'bri/ nyer sbas kyi mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas/ 'di 'bri bar bya ste/ ri nags tshal gyis brgyan pa/ phug pa dang gtsug lag khang yod pa gcig bya/ der dgra bcom pa des/ rab byung dang skye bo mang po la chos ston pa dang /sa mthil du yul grong ngo bo gcig yin kyang bkod pa so sor 'bri dgos te/chung ngu drug tsam bya ste/ dang po 'bru'i char/ gnyis pa gos kyi char/ gsum pa dngul/ bzhi pa gser/ lnga pa nor bu/ drug par 'dod yon sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab cing mi mang po yang ri nas babs te grong de dang de dag tu 'gro ba 'bri/grong bdun po ni/ grong khyer che bar byas te/ de'i dbus kyi phyogs gcig na gar mkhan pho mo mang po la skye bo mang po thams cad lta ba dang phyogs gcig na de dag gi mgo dang mgrin pa la dge slong de dag gcig gis me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dogs pa dang / phyogs gcig na gar mkhan de rnams kyi mgo dang mgrin pa ya khyi ro rus ba/ mi ro rus ba btags shing / lus kyang rgas 'khogs su bris la/ skye bo thams cad sna bkag cing gdong phyir phyogs pas 'dug pa dang /phyogs gcig na gar mkhan tshul can bdud de rnams dgra bcom pa de la phyag —124—

'tshal ba dang / logs gcig na/ dgra bcom pa las dma' ba tsam na sangs rgyas bzhengs sku 'dra ba la/ dgra bcom pa thal mo sbyar ba lha'i gzugs 'gyel ba dang / rlung 'tshub sna lngar yal ba rnams 'bri/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol du/ khri mthon po la dgra bcom pa de bzhugs shing / 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba la chos ston pa/ 'od zer gyi phyogs thams cad khyab pa dang / yang ri dang phug sogs snga ma de kha 'dra ba zhig la/ phug pa de shing bu phra mos phal cher khengs pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi nang du dgra bcom pas slob ma dge slong mang po la chos ston pa 'bri/ de dag ni nyer sbas kyis bdud brtul zhing sa steng dgra bcom pas khyab par mdzad pa'i skor yin no/ /dhi dhi ka ra dang / nag po dang / legs mthong rnams kyi mdzad pa yang / kun dga' bo'i skabs kyi de kha dang 'dra ba de 'bri/da ni bris sku'i gtso bo la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa 'bri tshul ni/ dbus su ston pa nyid khri rgyab yol sogs bkod pa lhun chags shing / sku tshad che la 'tsham pa/ rgyab yol rgyan sna drug sogs ji ltar mdzes pa dang / srog chags bzhugs gdan ni/ srog chags rin chen pad+ma nyi zla dar gyi blo stan zhes gdan drug brtsegs su byed pa legs shing / sgog chags ni seng ge kho na'am/ glang seng spel/ rin chen ni rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma nyi zla go bar zad/ dar gyi blo stan ni/ zab chen gyi phyi g.yogs byas pa'i/ 'bol gdan lta bu stan nang tshad can no/ /sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi rim pa dang po la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'bri ste/ sku'i g.yas su 'jam dbyangs dang / spyan ras —125—

gzigs/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po dang / phyag rdor zhi ba'o/ /de la kun bzang sku mdog dmar po/ bum pa dang pad+ma dmar po nyi mas mtshan pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi dbu'i thor gtsug rtse dang / ston pa'i sku dpung mnyam pa tsam rim pa gnyis pa la/ nyan thos chen po bzhi 'bri ste/ mchog zung / kun dga' bo/ /'od srung ste bzhi'o/ /yang na sgra gcan 'dzin/ 'od srung/ ka ta'i bu/nye ba 'khor/ de rnams phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i rnam pa byang sems nyan thos de dag bzhengs pa bzhugs pa ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham pas chog /rim pa gsum pa bzhugs khri'i 'og thad la yong pas/ mdun gyi dbus su rgyal po dang / btsun mo 'dud pa'i rnam pa dang / g.yas su tshangs pa ser po sha nyams rgyas pa/ gdong bzhi ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ phyag 'og ma gnyis na ril ba spyi blugs dang /dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can/tshangs skud dang ldan pa/ de'i rgyab tu khyab 'jug sngon po/ phyag 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang / be con dkar bo 'dzin pa/ zhi ba rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/g.yon phyogs kyi dang po brgya byin ser po dpral pa mig gcig phred la yod pa/phyag 'og ma gnyis na 'jig rten pa'i rdo rje dgu pa dang / rin po che 'dzin pa zhi ba dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i rgyab tu dbang phyug dmar po yid tsam khro ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug la zla bas brgyan pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sbrul gyi do shal can mgul rgyan gyi dbus na thod skam yod pa/ rgyan lhag ma rin po che ste/ de ltar lha bzhi char yang / phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ yon bdag la sogs pa —126—

'bri na de'i ji ltar 'os pa 'bri/ go skabs yangs na 'khor phra mo'i rigs/sems dpa' sems ma/ dge slong / dge slong ma/ skyes pa/ bud med/ klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa 'bri zhing / bar snang la gser gyi me tog gi char dang / ngang pa/ ngur ba/ rma bya/ khrung khrung la sogs rin po che'i phreng ba dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / 'bras bu'i snye ma mchus 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon du cha yod pa 'bri/ steng gi nam mkha' mtho sa la/ sprin gseb nas lha dang lha mo mang pos mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'o/ /gang ltar yang lhun zhing brjid chags pa/ mthong ba tsam gyi dad pa 'dren pa 'bri bar bya'o// //de ltar na ston pa'i rnam thar bris yig 'di ni/ sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug phun tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung gi bskul nas/ kun dga' snying pos pho brang chen por nges par brjod pa'o/༈ su sti/ mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i rnam thar mchog /'gro kun rab dga'i sa la 'god pa'i ched/ /snying po'i don mthong blo gros yangs pa yis/ /rgya mtsho che bas chu rlud 'babs pa bzhin/ /mi zad par du sgrub pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug sems can thams cad kun/ shwakya'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa'i tshul rnams dang / /ring por mi thogs de 'dra kho nar shog/ //sarba maṅga laX/ /

brjod pa mthong bas don ldan rab tu dga' ba dang bcas pas dad pa'i nyin byed phyogs brgyar 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru budha bo dhi sa te khyuX bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa shākya seṅge shākya'i rgyal po gang de'i mdzad pa mdo tsam brjod pa/mthong bas don ldan rab tu dga' ba dang bcas pas dad pa'i nyin byed phyogs brgyar 'char ba zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la yang dag par phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dbang klu bdag mi yi gtso sogs khams gsum kun gyis zhabs la bshud/ /rnam pa du mar rtag tu shar ba'i mtshan bzang sku ni mtshungs pa med/ /legs gsungs dbyar skyes rnga sgras srid 'dir ma rig gnyid log kun sad de/ /yang dag snang bas phyogs kun khyab mdzad thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas bskal par gzhan phan kho na'i bdud rtsis thugs rgyud gtams pa khyod/ skad cig tsam yang bdag don ma dgongs 'on kyang go 'phang mthar thug brnyes/ /ngo mtshar gnas des yid phrogs gyur nas 'phrog byed dang bcas mig gsum gyis/ /nyin rer mgon khyod gus pas bsten te de slad nyid ni mnyam med lags/ /mtha' dag shes bya ma lus mkhyen mod mkha' mnyam snyad phyir ya mtshan ci/ /'bad rtsol bral yang dpag yas 'gro la gang 'dul —128—

'phrin las 'jug 'di mtshar/ /yid bzhin nor lhar gcig pu'i mthu nus khyad 'phags bsam mi khyab mnga' ba/ /'dren khyod thugs rje'i char kyi zegs mas 'jig rten kun du dge bar mdzod/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na grags/ /dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa'i/ /zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gshugs/sdug bsnga la rgya mtsho gting mtha' med brgal ba/ /'gro ba'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzad pa dkon mchog snod/ /mang po'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya/ /de la 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / srid pa dang zhi ba kun gyi skyabs gnas gcig pu pa mnyam med sha kya thub pa 'dis ni/ ma lus pa'i sems can thams cad thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar bzung ste/ sngon byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa nas brtsams bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis shin tu rgyas pa mthar thug pas rdzogs par mdzad nas/ ḍi/nga khams 'dir yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bstan pas/ skye 'gro mtha' yas pa grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa la 'god par mdzad de/ de yang 'di skad ces/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'dzam bu gling pa'i skye dgu mir gyur pa rnams tshe lo brgya pa la thug pa/ skye bo rnams mchog tu dbang po rno zhing brtson 'grus dang / brtul ba dang dran pa dang blo gros dang rig pa dang shes rab dang snying —129—

stobs ches lhag par gyur pa kho na dag 'dus shing tshogs pa ltar gnas pa dang /chos la skul ba'i rkyen mang la/ shin tu ches snyigs mar gyur pa'i skyon yang med pa'i gnas skabs shig tu/ stobs bcu mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das 'di 'jig rten du byon no/ /zhes grag go /'dir sdoms ni/ tog dkar gyur dang rigs mchog gzigs pa lnga/ /lhums su 'jug dang lhums na bzhugs pa dang / /bltams dang ser skyar gshegs dang lung bstan sogs/ /bzo yi gnas la sbyangs dang sgyu rtsal 'gran/ /grags 'dzin dge ba'i snying po sa 'tsho ma/ /nges 'byung rkyen gzigs ting 'dzin bsgrubs pa dang / /ri dwags skyes dang srung bskor khyim nas byung / /rang byung lam tshol dka' ba spyad pa dang / /sku lus mthu bskyed byang chub snying por gshegs/ /bdud bcom ye shes mchog brnyes dal bar bzhugs/ /gsol btab thog ma'i chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /nye ba'i lnga sde sogs dang lam bar gtam/ /ral pa can stong gzugs can snying pos bsu/ /mchog zung e la'i 'dab dang 'phags rgyal dgongs/ /me skyes btsas dang 'bar ba'i brag phug bstan/ /zas spyin chos mthong rgyal byed tshal bzhengs dang / mnyan yod gshegs dang gsal rgyal dad la bkod/ /yab sras mjal dang shāka rigs bud med dang / /dga' bo dge slong ma tshogs slob ma can/ /'od zer can byon pad+ma'i snying po btul/ khye'u gnyis klu zung gsal rgyal gnod las skyabs/'brog gnas lag brgyud sgra sgrogs seng ge btul/ khred bu ser skya'i gtam dang 'od srungs che/ /stan phyed stsal dang lhan cig gnas pa tshol/ /spre'u gnyis —130—

cho 'phrul che dang drang srong sde/ /lnga len gnyis bsdums sha za stong btul nas/ /'dus pa che sogs tshong pa lnga brgya gnyis/ /lha babs bzang byed gshe/gas dang dpal sbed dang / /me skyes rab byung 'phrog ma ka pa ni/ /gdengs can bden mthong ko sha zhir byon dang / /mu tig can dang bu ram shing 'phel dang / /lhas byin rdzu 'phrul dge 'dun dbyen bsdums mdzad/ /rgyal po'i log spyod lhas byin log sgrub dang / /nor skyong 'dul mdzad 'tsho byed 'phags sar bzhagargyal chen drang srong bcas dang sor 'phreng dang / /legs 'ongs byis pa gsod dang 'od srungs mchod/ /dbul mo lung bstan rgyal po'i nga rgyal bsal/ /ma skyes dgra skyabs de nyid dad la bkod/ /lhas byin lung bstan mchog zung der byon gtam/ /yangs par 'jug dang spong byed bde bar mdzad/ /mi thil sogs dang rngo 'phangs n+ya gro sogs/ /bram ze'i grong sogs de bzhin byang phyogs btul/ /bcom rlag bskor dang o ta lar byon sogs/ /dgra mtha' lnga len lam dang dbul po sogs/ /rgyu ba lung bstan shākya lhag ma grol/ /bram ze gang po mi nyams rgyu bdun dang / /spong byed lam zhugs sha pa'i tshal bzhugs dang / /nor can 'du byed btang dang rtswa can lam/ /der bzhugs mdzad pa rab dga' rab bzang dang / /myang 'das zhugs la bzhen dang cha brgyad bgos/ bka' bsdu 'od srungs zhi dang sha na'i gos/ /kun dga'i mtha' dang bka' bsdu gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di thog mar blo la byang bar bya'o//de ltar na dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar por gyur pa dang /1 rigs mchog tu gyur pa shākya'i rigs kyi gtam dang /2 gzigs pa lnga la gzigs pa —131—

dang /3 dga' ldan nas 'phos te lhums su 'jug pa dang / 4 yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa'i gnas skabs dang / 5 lu zhi'i tshal du sku bltams pa dang / 6grong khyer ser skyar gshegs pa dang / 7 drang srong nyon mongs med kyis lung bstan pa sogs dang / 8 bzo'i gnas la sbyangs pa dang / 9 sgyu rtsal gyi stobs bstan pa dang / 10 btsun mo grags 'dzin ma khab tu bsten pa dang / 11 shing dge ba'i snying po'i gtam dang / 12 sa 'tsho ma btsun mor gyur pa dang /13nges par 'byung ba'i rkyen bzhi gzigs pa dang / 14 zhing pa'i sar bsam gtan bsgrubs shing dur khrod gzigs pa dang / 15 btsun mo ri dwags skyes kyi gtam dang / 16 theg bdun du srung mas bskor ba dang / 17 khyim nas mngon par byung ba dang / 18 rab tu byung zhing ngan spong gi gnas su gshegs pa dang /19 mu stegs can dang lhan cig lam 'tshol bar bstan pa dang /20 dka' ba rnam pa bdun spyad pa dang /21 dka' thub grol te 'o thug gsol bas sku lus mthu bskyed pa dang / 22 byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan gyi lam du gshegs pa'i gtam dang /23 bdud btul ba dang /24 bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa dang / 25 nags khrod du thugs las chung pus dal bar bzhugs pa dang / 26tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab ste wa ra ṇa sir gshegs pa dang /27 lnga sde la chos 'khor dang po bskor ba dang /28 nye ba'i lnga sde la sogs pa'i lo rgyus dang /29 wa ra ṇa si nas ma ga dhar 'byon pa'i lam bar gyi gtam dang /30 ral pa can stong btul ba dang /31 rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba dang /32 mchog zung gcig 'khor du 'dus pa dang /33 klu e —132—

la'i 'dab btul ba dang /34 ka kyi ya na 'phags rgyal 'dul bar mngags pa dang /35 khyim bdag me skyes btsas pa'i gtam dang /36 'bar ba'i phug tu brgya byin la sogs pa lha rnams la chos bstan pa dang /37 khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin bden pa la bkod pa dang /38 des rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bzhengs pa dang /39 ston pa nyid mnyan yod du spyan drangs pa dang /40 rgyal po gsal rgyal dad pa la bkod pa dang /41 yab sras mjal ba'i skabs dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud chen po dang /42 shwaka rigs kyi bud med phal pa rnams la chos bstan pa dang /43 gcung dga' bo rab tu byung pa'i skor dang / 44 skye dgu'i bdag mo la brten te dge slong ma'i dge 'dun bstan pa dang / 45 grong khyer slob ma lta bur gshegs pa dang / 46 nub phyogs 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten du byon pa dang / 47 bram ze pad+ma'i snying po chos la bkod pa dang / khu8khye'u gnyis kyi gtam dang / 49 mod gal bu mngags te klu dga' bo nye dga' btu'/ ba dang /50 rgyal po gsal rgyal klu'i gnod pa las skyabs pa dang / 51gnod sgyin 'brog gnas btu'/ ba dang / 52 lag brgyud bden pa la bkod pa dang / 53 rgyal po u tra ya ṇa la sogs pa grong khyer sgra sgrogs ba'i skor dang /54 seng ge ral pa can btu'/ ba dang / 55 shed bu ser skya chu srin nya'i rigs can du gyur pa'i gtam dang / 56 'od srungs chen po 'khor du 'dus pa'i gtam dang / 57 phyis 'od srungs chen po la stan phyed stsal ba dang / 58 kun dga' po lhan cig gnas par bstan pa dang / 59 sprelus sbrang rtsi phul ba gnyis dang / 60 cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i lo rgyus btul pa dang / 61 drang —133—

srong lnga brgya btul pa dang / 62 lnga len gyi rgyal po gnyis bsdums pa dang /63 sha za stong btul ba dang / 64 'dus pa chen po la sogs pa dang / 65tshong pa lnga brgya pa sde gnyis skyabs pa dang / 66 cho 'phru/la chung bar grags pa lha las babs pa dang / 67 grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs pa dang / 68 khyim bdag dpal sbed btu'/ ba dang / 69 me skyes rab tu byung ba'i skor dang / 70gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma'i gtam dang / 71 rgyal po ka pa ni 'khor bcas dgra bcom pa la 'khod pa dang / 72 khyim bdag gdengs can bden pa mthong ba dang / 73 grong khyer ko'u sha zhi zhabs kyis bcags pa dang / 74 sing gha la'i rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can gyi lo rgyus dang / 75 ma ga dh+wa bzang mos yul bu ram shing 'phel du spyan drangs pa dang / 76 lhas byin gyis rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs pa dang / 77 dge 'dun gyi dbyen bsdums pa dang / 78 rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i log spyod dang / 79 lhas byin gyis log sgrub byas kyang gnod pa mi mnga' ba dang / 80 glang po che nor skyong btul ba dang / 81 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos bden pa la bkod pa dang / 82 rgyal chen bzhi drang srong stong dang bcas pas bden pa mthong ba dang / 83 sor mo'i 'phreng ba can btul ba dang / 8khu'aphags pa legs 'ongs kyi lo rgyus dang / 85 chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la dbyar gnas mdzad pa dang / 86 rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'od srung chen po mchod pa dang / 87 dbul mo zhig sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa dang / 88 rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi nga rgyal bcag pa dang / 89 rgyal po ma skyes dgra gnod pa las skyabs pa dang / 90 ma skyes dgra rtsa ba med pa'i dad pa la bkod pa dang /—134—

91 lhas byin gyi gtam rgyud 'phros dang / 92 mchog zung gi dmyal ba'i rgyud gzigs pa dang / 93 yangs pa can du gshe/gas pa'i lam khar byung ba'i gtam dang / 94 yangs pa can pa rnams bde bar mdzad pa dang / 95 yul mi thi la sogs su byon pa dang / 96 yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams btul/ ba dang / 97 n+ya gro dha'i grong sogs su gshegs pa dang / 98 bram ze'i grong du byon pa sogs dang / 99 byang phyogs kyi rgyud btul ba dang / 100 /bcom rlag tu byon pa'i skor dang / 101 yul o ta lar byon pa sos/sa/ dang / 102 grong khyer dgra mthar dbyar gnas mdzad pa dang / 103 lho phyogs lnga len gyi lam du byung ba'i gtam dang / 104 bram ze dbul po la sogs pa'i 'o rgyus dang /105 las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa dang / 106 shākya lhag ma rnams gro/la ba la bkod pa dang / 107 bram ze gang po la sogs pa byang chub tu lung bstan pa dang / 108 mi nyams pa'i rgyu bdun gyi rnam grangs gsungs pa dang / 109yangs pa can gyi lam du zhugs pa'i skabs dang / 110 'od ma can gyi byang phyogs shing sha pa'i tshal du bzhugs pa dang / 111 khyim bdag nor can gyi gtam dang / 112 sku che'i 'du byed btang ba dang / 113 rtsa can du bzhud pa'i lam gyi mdzad pa dang / 114 rtsa can nyid du byon pa'i mdzad pa dang / 115dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' btul ba dang / 116 kun du rgyu rab bzang dgra bcom pa la bkod pa dang / 117 yongs su mya ngan las 'das par bstan pa dang / 118 sku gdung zhugs la phul ba dang / 119 sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa dang / 120 bka' bsdu ba dang po'i gtam dang / 121 'od srung chen —135—
