po mya ngan las 'das pa dang / 122 sha na'i gos can rab tu byung ba dang /123 kun dga' bo'i mdzad pa tha ma dang / 124 bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa ji ltar mdzad pa ste/ 125 rmad du byung ba'i gtam brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de las dang po dga' ldan du lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar por gyur pa'i tshul ni/ de yang sngon skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo nyi khri thub pa'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srungs 'jig rten du byon/ de'i dus na 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bya bar gyur/ de nas 'phos te dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi ston pa byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur te/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung nas/ dga' ldan na gnas pa rnams gtso cher gyur pa'i lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams rab tu smin pa'i phyir/ yang dag pa'i chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas brtsams te 'dzam bu gling pa rnams tshe lo brgya pa la gnas pa'i bar du dga' ldan gyi gnas de nyid du sku lus kyi rten de kho nas bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa rigs mchog tu gyur pa ni/ dus der chu klung skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba chu bo ga d+ma'i 'gram/ grong khyer chen po ser skya gzhi zhes bya bar/'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i brgyud las byung ba/ shākya rigs la rgyal po seng ge 'gram zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed do/ /de la sras bzhi ste/ zas gtsang dang / zas dkar dang / bro bo zas dang / bdud rtsi zas so/ sras mo yang bzhi ste/ gtsang ma dang / dkar mo dang / bre bo mo dang / bdud rtsi mo'o/ shwakya'i grong khyer lhas bstan na ni/ shākya legs par rab sad zhes bya ba rgyas srid skyong ba —136—

las/ rgyal po de gnyis kar yang rgyal srid bde zhing phun sum tshogs pa chos dang ldan pas rgyal srid skyong ngo / /seng ge 'gram ni bdag gi brgyud la 'khor los bskyur ba'i rgyal po byung yang ci ma rung zhes smon par byed do/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad kyang / seng ge 'gram dang gnyen du 'gyur bar smon no/ /legs par rab sad la bu mo mchog tu gyur pa zhig btsas pa na/ skye bo thams cad kyis 'di ni mi'i bu mo ma lags te/ las thams cad kyis sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul lo zhes zer bas/ de'i ming sgyu 'phrul mar btags shing / mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ 'di la bu btsa' ba ni stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang phyis legs par rab sad kyi btsun mo la snga ma las kyang ches lhag pa'i bu mo btsas par gyur te/ de'i ming lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen po zhes btags shing / 'di las ni sras skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa 'khrung par 'gyur zhing / de ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur ro /nes lung bstan to/ de nas phyi zhig na legs par rab sad kyis rgyal po seng ge 'gram la 'phrin du springs te/ bdag la mchog tu gyur pa'i bu mo gnyis shig mchis pa las/ gang bzhed pa zhig gzhon nu zas gtsang gi btsun mor bzhes shig /seng ge 'gram gyis slar springs pa/ de gnyis ka yang gzhon nu zas gtsang la dgos pa zhig yod mod kyi/ re zhig chung ba blang ste cig shos kyang tshogs la brtag par bya'o zhes springs nas sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ gzhon nu zas gtsang ma'i btsun mor blangs so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig gi tshe/ shākya rnams kyi dgra skya seng zhes bya —137—

ba'i rgyal rigs ri khrod pa dag yod de/ de rnams 'dul bar gzhon nu zas gtsang mngags shing / shākya'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang dam pa sbyin par khas blangs so/ /de nas skya seng gi tshogs rnams legs par thul te 'khor ba na/shākya'i tshogs kyis rgyal po seng ge 'gram la dam pa ci bzhed dris pa na/ shākya rnams ni rigs mnyam pa las chun ma bzhag par mi bya ba'i khrims dang ldan pa yin na/ gzhon nu la mchog blang bar bya rgyu ni rigs mnyam pa las chun ma blang ba yin no/ /de nas shākya'i tshogs pa rnams kyis kyang gnang ba byin nas/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa/ dpal dang 'byor pa chen pos gzhon nu zas gtsang gi btsun mor blangs so/ /phyi zhig na rgyal po seng ge 'gram 'das te/ sras kyi thu bo rgyal po zas gtsang ma rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la longs spyod cing / de'i mnga' 'bangs rnams kyang mchog tu 'byor zhing bde ba rgyal po snga ma las kyang lhag pa tsam du gyur to/ /gsum pa gzigs pa lnga la gzigs pa ni/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar por gyur pas/ 'dzam bu gling du gzigs pa rnam pa lnga la gzigs te/ rigs dang yul dang dus dang brgyud dang bud med la gzigs pa'o/ /de yang rigs kyi mchog shin tu btsun par bkur ba'i rgyal rigs dang /yul gyi mchog yul dbus kyi grong khyer dam pa dang / dus kyang yid 'byung ba dang skyo shas che zhing ha cang rab snyigs ma lnga bdo ba yang ma yin pa tshe lo brgya pa dang / brgyud ni mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud pa yang yin la/ pha mes dang ma mes kyi tshogs zung dag la bdun brgyud kyi bar du skyon med pa dang / yum ni —138—

bud med kyi skyon kun spangs/ yon tan kun tshang ba las/ khyad par du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bcur lhums su 'dzin nus pa'i bsod nams bsags pa dang / sngon gyi rgyal ba la mchod nas sangs rgyas kyi yum du 'gyur bar smon lam btab pa ste de dag dgos pa las/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la de yang tshang bar gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems pas dga' ldan du gnas pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i lha rigs drug la lan gsum du 'di skad ces bsgrags te nga ni dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs 'di nas 'phos te/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi bur gyur nas bdud rtsi rtogs par bya yi/ khyed cag bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams yul dbus kyi mir nying mtshams sbyar ba longs shig /ces so/ /der dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol te byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen par mdzod cigad lta 'jig rten ni sdig pas gos pa/ skye dgu ni ma rungs pa'o/ /dzaskru'i gling ni 'od srung rdzogs byed dang / gnag lhas kyi bu kun du rgyu dang / yang dag rgyal ba can smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu dang / mi pham skra'i lwa ba can dang / ka ta'i bu nog can dang / gnyen gyi bu gcer bu pa ste rtog ge pa drug dang /bram ze rgyus rgyal dang / bram ze gnag ldeg dang / bram ze bzang ldan dang /bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe dang / bram ze pad+ma'i snying po dang / bram ze dmar po ste rjes su sgrog pa drug dang / rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dang / kun du rgyu rab bzang dang / bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal dang /drang srong nyon mongs med dang / lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can te/ snyoms 'jug pa drug go /de ltar bco brgyad kyi dkrugs pa lags so/ /dga' ldan gyi —139—

gnas 'dir dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa'i chos kyi khri bsham par bgyi na/ 'dir chos ston zhing bzhugs na legs so/ /zhes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas grogs po dag de'i phyir rol mo'i cha byad thams cad rdungs shig /de rnams kyis rol mo thams cad brdungs pa na/byang chub sems dpas kyang dung 'bud dang mdzad nas/ 'di rnams las sgra lhag par tshe ba gang yin/ gsol pa/ dung gi sgra lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/dung gi sgras rol mo'i sgra gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du/ ngas kyang de dag zil gyis mnan te/ bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par bya'o/ /seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan tshogs ni du ma mjoms/ /rdo rje gcig gis brag rtse du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lta min dbang po du ma 'joms nyi ma gcig gis mun pa du ma rnam par sel/ khyed cag las bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams grong khyer drug tu nying mtshams sbyor ba longs shig /ces so/de dag gi tshe bar snang la rgyu ba'i lha rnams kyis/ da ste lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsgrags pas/ de'i tshe dzasbu'i gling na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya tsam bzhugs pa/ de dag phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu 'dus nas wa ra ṇa sir byon/ da ni sangs rgyas myur du 'byung bas bdag cag gis 'gro ba'i don bya mi dgos so snyam du dgongs nas/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das so/ /gdung la rang byung gi me sbar te/ nam mkha' la song ba las ring srel rnams sa'i steng du lhung bar gyur to/ /—140—

bzhi pa dga' ldan nas yum gyi lhums su 'pho ba ni/ de nas dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis/ gal te mgon po khyod dzaskru'i gling du gshegs na/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i gnas 'di ngan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ deng phyin chad ma pham pas chos ston par 'gyur zhes/ rgyal ba ma rgyal pa las rgyal ba byams pa la/ nyid kyi cod pan bskon te rgyal tshab tu bskos so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tso4 lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sku la gzi mdangs bskyed cing / lhums kyang gtsang mar byas so/ /chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la bab ste/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo yang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yang dag pa blangs shing gnas la byang chub sems dpa' yang nam kyi gung thun la glang po che thal kar mche ba drug pa'i gzugs su sprul nas yum gyi lhums su zhugs so/ /de'i tshe sa chen po g.yos shing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od kyi snang bas khyab par gyur/ yum gyi mnal lam du glang po che mchog gis yum nyid kyi g.yas phyogs kyi rus dral nas zhugs pa dang / steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / ri brag chen po la 'dzeg pa dang / skye bo mang po rang la phyag byed pa'o/ /de'i nangs par rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos blon po rnams mngags te rmi lam ston mkhan dang / bram ze ltas mkhan rnams bkug ste/ de rnams la rgyal pos dris pa na/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ ltas 'di las sbyar na/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sras zhig bltams par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa lhums na bzhugs pa ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang —141—

chub sems dpa' lhums su bzhugs pa de la/ sku'i srung mar lag na ral gri dang / lag na mdung dang / lag na mdung thung dang / lag na mda' bo che ste/lha'i bu dpa' zhing brtul phod pa bzhi bzhag go /de nas yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pa na yang mi gtsang bas ma sbags shing / nor bu be+e sdu ru'i dbus su tshon skud sna lnga bzhag pa ltar khye'u'i lus phun sum tshogs pa mtshan dang ldan pa de nyid yum gyi sku lus kyi phyi rol nas kyang ma bsgribs par gsal bar snang ba dang / dus de nas brtsams te ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yum nyid bslab pa'i gnas lnga la gnas shing 'dod pa la yid gtod pa med do/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul pho brang gi skyed mos tshal du yo byad dang 'byor pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas te sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba'i rkyen thams cad spangs te/ dga' tshal gyi lha'i bu mo bzhin du gnas pa las/ nam zhig na rgya mtsho bzhi'i chu btung bar 'dod pa skyes nas/ rgyal po la zhus shing des mtshan mkhan rnams la dris pas/lhums su zhugs pa 'di'i mthu lags te/ 'dis shes bya'i rgya mtsho 'thung bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te chu de la ma blud na cird 'gyur/ /gsol pa/ yan lag ma tshang ba zhig btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ nga zas gtsang ma bu yan lag ma tshang bar bya ba ga la zhig snyam ste/kun du rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba sgyu 'phrul gyi rig sngags la byang ba zhig bos nas/ des sngags kyis sprul pa'i rgya mtsho bzhi bstan te/ de'i chu blud nas tshim par byas so/ /de bzhin du btson thams cad thar bar bya'o snyam pa yang rgyal pos btang / skye bo du ma sbyin pas tshim par bya'o snyam pa yang rgyal pos de bzhin —142—

du mdzad/ gzhan yang skyed mos tshal sna tshogs gzigs par 'dod pa sogs la yang de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /drug pa sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar lhums su zla ba bcu lon te/ ljon shing dang me tog thams cad ni rab tu rgyas/ bya rnams ni dga' bas skad 'byin/ shing sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu smin zhing dud par gyur/ dpyid zla tha chung gi yar ngo la bab pa na/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mos bsams pa bdag lhas bstan gyi skyed mos tshal du 'dug par bya'o snyam/ rgyal po la zhus pas rgyal pos kyang gnang ste/ grong khyer lhas bstan dang nye ba'i lum+bi ni'i tshal du 'byin par chas nas rin po che sna bzhi'i khyogs bshams pa la 'dug cing g.yog mo du mas yongs su bskor/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang dpung yan lag bzhi dang bcas te/ser skya gzhi'i grong khyer nas 'phags te/ lum+bi ni'i tshal du bzhud do/ /de nas mdo gzhan las 'byung ba ltar na tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i dus rgyu skar rgyal gyi rkang pa dang po la bab pa na/ sku bltams zhes 'byung ngo / /gang ltar yang yum gyis kun du gzigs nga/sa shing mya ngan 'tshang me tog rab tu rgyas pa zhig gzigs te/de'i yal ga la phyag g.yas pas bzung ste bltams par 'dod pa na/ brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ yum 'di ni ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pas thabs shig bya'o snyam rlud dang char drag btang bas skye bo'i tshogs rnams gud du song ba na/ brgya byin bdag nyid ma ma rgan mo'i cha byad du sprul nas mdun du bsdad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yum la gnod pa med par sku bltams/ yum gyi dku g.yas pa brtol te byon pa ni/ dper ni skyes bu zhig sgo phye ste/ phyir rol du 'thon nas —143—

yang sgo bcad pa bzhin bltams zin pa na rma'i sgor mngon pa cung zad kyang med do/ /de nas brgya byin gyis ri dwags kyi pags pa'i sle mos byang chub sems dpa'i sku bzung bar brtsams pa la brgya byin gyi dregs pa zhi ba'i phyir rdo rje'i skur byin gyis brlabs pas bzung ma nus nas 'dar bar gyur pa la/ ko'u shi ka nga thongs shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' ni ngo tsha khrel yod kyis brgyan pa'i phyir/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' gsol ba dang bcas pas yin gyi/ gcer bur ma yin no/ /de ltar bltams ma thag tu sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ 'od kyi snang ba chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur to/ /de ma thag tu phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun 'bor bar mdzad de/'di skad ces/ 'di ni shar phyogs yin te mya ngan las 'das pa'i thog mar 'gro bar bya'o/ /'di ni lho phyogs yin te 'gro ba thams cad kyi yon gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /'di ni nub phyogs yin te nga'i skye ba'i tha ma yin no/ /'di ni byang phyogs yin te srid pa'i mtsho las brgal par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas nam mkha' nas chu'i rgyun bsil ba dang dro ba gnyis dbu'i steng du 'bab cing sku khrus gsol la/ lha rnams kyis gdugs dkar po dang / rnga yab dang /me tog dang / spos dang / na bza' dag gis kyang mchod/ rol mo'i sgra yang bsgras sa so/ /yum gyi sku mdun du chu mig chen po yang byung ste khrus mdzad do/ /de ltar sku bltams par gyur pa'i 'od zer de/ ri bo kun 'dzin gyi phug pa na/ drang srong nyon mongs med rang gi tsha bo slob mar gyur pa mi byin dang lhan cig bsam gtan byed pas/ phug de snang bas khyab pa mthong ste/ 'di ni nyi ma —144—

thams cad dag /cig car shar bar gyur tam ci/ /zhes sogs mi byin gyis dris pa na/ nyon mongs med kyis/ nyi ma'i 'od ni rgyun du rno/ /bu cig snang ba'i 'od 'di dag /yan lag reg na bde bsil bas/ /nges par thub pa de yi 'od/ /ces sogs smras pas/ mi byin byang chub sems dpa' 'phral du blta bar 'dod pa skyes pa la/ da lta lha dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyis bskor zhing bzhugs pas/ 'o skol gyis skabs rnyed par mi 'gyur gyi/ ser skya gzhir byon pa'i tshe blta bar 'gro'o/ /zhes byas so/ /de'i tshe nyi ma de nyid la phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po rnams la bu skyes te/ byang chub sems dpa' sku bltams pa'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa la de ltar yin pa ma gtogs par rang rang gi bu'i mthu las byung ba yin no snyam nas/ ma ga dhar rgyal po pad+ma chen po'i bu la ni gzugs can snying po/ /mnyan yod du rgyal po rtsibs kyi ring 'phur gyi bu la ni gsal rgyal/ ko sha zhir rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu la ni shar pa/'phags rgyal du rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu la ni rab snang ste/ 'od kyi snang bas khyab pa las gras nas so sor ming btags so/ /gang gi nyin par byang chub sems dpa' bltams pa'i zhag de la/ bzang ldan la sogs par shākya'i bu lnga brgya yang btsas/ shākya gzhon nu ma lnga brgya dang / rgyal po'i rim gro ba rnams la bu mdun pa la sogs pa lnga brgya dang / bran mo la mdun ma la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya yang btsas/ glang mo lnga brgya yang phru gu 'brangs/ rta rgod ma lnga brgya yang rte'u 'brangs/ gter lnga brgya yang kha bye/ khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis kyang dpya phul lo/ /de nas rgyal pos bdag gi bu btsas pa na don thams —145—

cad grub par gyur pas/ gzhon nu'i mtshan don thams cad grub par btags so/ /zhes brjod de de ltar grags so/ /bdun pa grong khyer ser skyar gshegs pa ni/ gnod sbyin shākya 'phel zhes bya ba ser skya na gnas pa/ shākya rnams kyi rigs lha ru mchod pa zhig yod pa/ shākya'i bu bu mo gang skyes kyang dang por de la phyag 'tshal ba'i srol yod pas/rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du byed par brtsams te/ gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa' rin po che sna bzhi'i khyogs la spyan drangs/ rgyal po dang blon po sogs 'khor tshogs du ma dang bcas nas ser skya gzhi'i gnas su zhugs so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' ser skya gzhir zhugs pa na/ shākya gtum po rtsub pa gzo lum can ca co chen por dag kyang spyod lam dul zhing zhi ba dang / mi smra bar gnas par gyur te/ dper na brtul zhugs la rab tu byang pa'i thub pa bzhin du gyur to/ shwakya ma rungs pa rnams thub pa ltar gnas pa yang byang chub sems dpa'i mthur shes nas/ mtshan shākya thub par btags so/ /de nas gnod spyin shākya 'phel gyi gnas dang nye bar byon pa na/ gnod spyin de rang gi gzugs kyis gnas khang gi phyi rol tu thon nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la gshugs shing phyag 'tshal ba skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis mthong nas/ shākya rnams kyi lha gnod sbyin 'dis kyang zhabs la bshud pas/ gzhon nu 'di ni lha'i lha'o zhes/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs lha'i lhar btags so/ /de nas gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa' ma ma brgyud po rnams la rjes su gtang cing / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed la/ yab kyis kyang phang du bzhes te yang —146—

yang rtog par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe bram ze ltas mkhan sogs brtag pa mkhan thams cad bos te dris pa las/ phal cher gyis sku la skyes pa chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par shes nas/ mtshan 'di dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po'i 'gro ba ni gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /gal te khyim du gnas na ni 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal por 'gyur la/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung ston no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sku bltams nas zhag bdun lon pa na/ yum sku nongs te/ de ma thag tu sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i rigs gya nom par 'khrungs par gyur to/ /dus de tsam nas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sku blta bas ngoms pa med pa/ gsung snyan zhing 'debs pa/ spyan mi 'dzum zhing nyin mtshan kun du kho ra khor yug tu gzigs pa/ don zab mo'i tshig dang yi ge dag so sor 'byed par mdzad do/ /brgyad pa drang srong chen pos lung bstan pa sogs ni/ de nas drang srong nyon mongs med slob ma mi byin dang lhan cig byang chub sems dpa' lta ba'i phyir mas pa na/ ji tsam bar du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ongs kyang / ser skya dang nye bar sleb pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzi byin gyis non te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro bar ma nus nas rkang gis song ste/ grong khyer ser skya'i pho brang gi sgor son pa dang / sgo ba la sbran no/ /des kyang rgyal po la rig par byas pa na/ rgyal pos bkur bsti dang bcas te nang du spyan drangs/ stan mchog la bzhugs su gsol/yang dag pa'i gtam gyis kun du dga' bar byas te/ drang srong chen po dgos pa —147—

ci zhig gi phyir 'dir byon/ des smras pa/ khyed kyi sras blta bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ da ltar gzhon nu nyal gyi/ ma sad kyi bar du bzhugs shig /smras pa/ lha mnal ba nyid blta'o/ de nas drang srong gis bltas pa na/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ma btsum par gzugs rnams la gzigs pa mthong nas/ drang srong gis smras pa/ rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni/ /mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid/ /mig la yun ring mi gnas so/ /zhes te/ des kyang skyes bu mchog tu rig par byas shing / de nas ma ma'i gtso mos drang srong la gtad cing / des kyang legs par brtags nas/rgyal po la smras pa lha gzhon nu 'di la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung ji ltar bstan/ rgyal pos skyes bu chen po 'di'i 'gro ba gnyis te zhes sogs sngar gyi rnams rgyas par bshad pas/ drang srong nyon mongs med na re/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'grul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor los bsgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gzhan yang mtshan so gnyis po mi gsal tsam yod na 'khor los bsgyur bar 'gyur mod/ 'di ni shin tu gsal ba'i phyir sangs rgyas so/ /de nas drang srong nyid kyi mngon shes kyis brtags pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i sngon rol du/ rang nyid 'chi bar mthong ste/ i kyi dga' ston mi thob par shes nas/ mig nas mchi ma phyung ngo / /de rgyal pos mthong nas gzhon nu'i sku la dog pa 'tshal par dogs nas rings pa rings par dris pa na/ drang srong des smras pa/ rdo rje'i ser ba drag po babs kyang gzhon nu —148—

'di la gnod par mi 'gyur gyi/ mi dbang bdag gi rgud pa mthong nas ni/ /gang phyir zhi ba mi thob bdag du mod/ /chos kyi mdzod mchog 'di dang phral nas ni/ /don ma thob par bdag ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs smras so/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ lam srang thams cad brgyan zhing mdzes par byas/ rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas grong khyer gyi phyi sgo'i mthar bskyal/ drang srong nyon mongs med rang gi gnas su song zhing rdzu 'phrul yang bskyed do/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' ma ma'i pang du bzhugs shing / gser gyi gzhong par 'bras chan dang sha bsres pa gsol ba na/ ha cang mang du gsol na ma zhu bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ ma mas bkag kyang ma khegs/ snod 'phrog par brtsams kyang 'phrog ma thub/ rgyal po dang btsun mo sgyu 'phrul dang / blon po sogs skye bo gzhan du mas kyang ma thub ste/gser gyi gzhong pa la thag pa btags te/ glang po che gcig nas lnga brgya'i bar du 'dogs par byed pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i phyag g.yon gyi mdzub mos gser gyi gzhong pa nas bzung ste then pas/ glang po che lnga brgya kha phyir phyogs te phyag gis drangs par gyur to/ /phyag g.yon gyis glang po che lnga brgya 'dren pa las na/ phyag gnyis kyi glang po che stong 'dren par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de'i tshe glang po stong gi stobs can zhes mtshan btags so/ /dgu pa bzo'i gnas la sbyangs pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor lnga brgya dang lhan cig yi ge'i slob dpon srin bu'i go cha'am kun gyi bzhes gnyen gyi ye ge'i grwar byon pa na/ /des ye ge gcig bris te phul bas/—149—

'di ni ngas shes kyi gzhan dag smros shig /des kyang yig rigs lnga brgya'i bar du bris te phul bas kyang / de bzhin du gyur te/ des gsol pa/ 'jig rten ni yi ge 'di tsam spyod kyi gzhan ni bdag gis ma 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas yi ge bris nas de la bstan pas/ des ma shes te/ bka' stsal ba/yi ge 'di ni 'jig rten du byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po byung ba na dar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe nam mkha' nas lha tshangs pas kyang de de bzhin no zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtsis gyi slob dpon srang sgrub kyi drung du byon nas/ des rtsis kyi gnas bstan pa thams cad byang chub sems dpas snga nas mkhyen zin zhing / des cha tsam yang ma rig pa'i grangs dang rtsis kyi gnas dpag tu med pa byang chub sems dpas gsungs so/ /de bzhin du nyid kyi zhung po bzang len la/ glang po che gnyar zhon pa la sogs pa dang / 'phongs gyi slob dpon lhar bcas la gnas lnga la sogs pa mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor rnams slob pa na/ byang chub sems dpas ni/ slob dpon rnams gyis bstan pa la ma bltos par rang mkhyen pa yin la/ shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya rnams kyis ni/ legs par bslabs shing byang bar gyur to/ de la gnas lnga ni/ rgyang nas 'phog pa dang sgra grags par 'phog pa dang / gnad du 'phog pa dang / mi 'chor bar 'phog pa dang / tshabs che bar 'phog pa'o/'on kyang lhas byin ni gdug pa'i sems dang ldan par rig nas/ gnad du 'phog pa slob dpon gyis ma bstan to/ /bcu pa sgyu rtsal gyi stobs bstan pa ni/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ shākya —150—

gzhon nu lnga brgya phyir byung ba na/ shākya gzhon nu gzhan rnams lhas byin gyis stobs 'gyed pas bskyel ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' phyogs der byon nas/lhas byin phyag gis bsnams te/ gnod pa med par rgyang ring du 'phangs pas/rkang pa gyen du bstan nas gan rkyal du ltung ngo / /zhes pa 'di mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las bshad do/ /de nas yangs pa can pa'i li tsa bi rnams kyis glang po che mtshan ldan zhig rnyed nas/ zas gtsang gi sras 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur gyi/ de'i mthu las glang po che rin po che 'di byung bas de kho na la 'bul lo zhes pho nya mngags te/ ser skya'i gzhir phyin nas pho brang gi sgo glang po che de khrid nas bsdad pa na/ lhas byin phyir byung bas mthong ste glang po dam pa 'di ci zhes dris pa na/ de dag gis sngar bzhin bsnyad pas lhas byin phrag dog skyes te/ de 'khor los sgyur bar ma song ba'i sngon rol nas glang chen 'bul lam zhes thal lcag bsnun nas glang po che bsad do/ /dga' bos de mthong nas/ lhas byin gyis ni rang gi mthu bstan gyi/ bdag gis kyang bstan no snyam nas de'i mjug ma nas bzung ste khyer nas gom pa bdun tsam song nas ma/tha' cig tu bor ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byon te/ de gzigs nas dri ba mdzad pa na sngar bzhin rgyas par bsnyad do/ /'o na bdag gis kyang mthu sad par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas de'i mjug ma nas phyag gis bzung ste bteg nas rgyang du 'phangs pas/ lcags ri rim pa bdun dang 'obs rim pa bdun 'das te rgyang grags tsam gyi pha rol tu lhungs shing / phyogs der sa la gshong bu dod pas glang bo'i gshong zhes grags shing der mchod rten yang byas so/ /de nas gzhon nu — 151—

rnams nags su phyin te ral gris shing gcod pa'i sgyu rtsal ston pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' yang der byon te/ gzhan rnams kyis shing bcad pa na bcad kha mtho dman can du gyur pas bcad tsam nyid nas 'gyel/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnams mtho dman med cing yo 'khyog med par bcad pas ma 'gyel bar sngar bzhin 'dug go shwakya g.yin rnams kyis de mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpas gcod ma thub bo snyam gcod pa'i rig pa mi mkhyen no zhes smod cing gleng bar brtsams pa na/ rlung ser bu zhig langs nas byang chub sems dpas bcad pa'i shing de dag dus gcig tu chom zhes 'gyel pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu rnams mda' tshabs 'gran pa la zhugs te/lcags kyi ta la bdun dang / lcags rnga bdun dang / lcags kyi phag gzugs gcig rnams 'ben du btsugs te so sor mda' 'phangs ba las/ lhas byin gyis ta la gcig phigs/ dga' bos gnyis phug ste/ gzhan sus kyang de las lhag pa ma phug go /byang chub sems dpas lcags mda' 'phangs pa dang /'ben de thams cad phug nas slar yang rgyang ring por song zhing mda' des sa la phug ste/ mdas phug pa'i bu ga nas klu rnams kyis ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chu phyung bas de la mda' chu khron pa zhes grags shing der yang mchod rten byas so/ /de nas mtshan mkhan rnams kyis gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa da ste lo bcu gnyis su rab tu ma byung na/ gdon mi za bar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por ཿra ro/ /zhes lung ston to//bcu gcig pa grags 'dzin ma khab tu gsol ba ni/ de nas rgyal po —152—

zas gtsang mas blon po rnams dang bgros te/ yul gyi bud med bzang mo 'os par gyur pa thams cad gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa'i spyan sngar phab ste/gang la dgyes pa de btsun mor blang ngo / /de'i thabs kyang gzhon nu 'di ni sbyin pa la dgyes pas/ rgyan gyi rnam grangs dag bud med rnams la spyin du stsal pa na gang la dgyes par 'gyur ba shes so/ /zhes bgros nas gza' skar dang tshes grangs sogs rab tu dge ba la sa phyogs yangs par seng ge'i khri bshams pa la byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pa phung por sbungs te bzhag rigs kyi gtso bo gtso bo thams cad kyis zhabs 'bring byas/ cho rigs bzang po'i bud med thams cad so so'i 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i cha byad dang rgyan gyis spras nas 'ongs pa la/ re re bzhin byang chub sems dpas rgyan gyi rnam grangs re stsal to/ /der shākya lag na be con gyi bu mo grags 'dzin ma song ba la/ phas smras pa/ gzhon nu rgyan ster gyis songs shig /des smras pa/ 'o skol la rgyan ma mchis sam/ smras pa/ ma yin mod/ gzhon nu bud med 'dam par mdzad do/ /des smras pa/ 'dam yang rung mi 'dam yang rung /de kho na bdag gi khyim thab lags so/ /smras pa/ de lta na nges par songs shigade nas grags 'dzin ma de ni bud med thams cad kyi nang nas lha'i bu mo ltar gzi brjid dang ldan pas gzhan kun gyi rjes su 'ongs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas rgyan thams cad bstsal zin nas sor gdub rgya rtags can kho na lus pa de la bstan pa dang / de bzhugs khri'i skas la 'dzegs nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag nas rang gi blangs so/ /de nas blon po dang yul gyi gtso bo rnams —153—

kyis 'dis gzhon nu'i thugs dang bstun pa nus so zhes rgyal po la gsol pas/lha mo grags 'dzin ma 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa btsun mor blangs so/ /bcu gnyis pa shing dge ba'i snying po'i gtam ni/ gang gi tshe/ chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba na shing dge ba'i snying po zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /de'i phyir grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi dang lhas bstan gyi bar du 'bab chu ro hi ka'i 'gram na shing dge ba'i snying po de byung nas/ nyi ma gcig la yang khru brgyar skye ba/ de ring skyes pa rnams nangs par nyi ma ma shar bar du sen mos kyang bcad du rung la/ de nas mtshon gyis kyang mi chod/ mes kyang mi 'tshig pa zhig yod do/ /dus dus su chu klung 'brubs pas shing de'i rtsa ba'i sa rnams drus te bar skabs der rlung gi shugs kyis 'gyel bas chu bcad de/ lhas bstan du ni chu dkon la/ ser skya gzhir ni chu ches pas gnod do/ /der skye bo'i tshogs kyis shing de dbyung bar brtsams kyang bskyod par ma nus pa la/ rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis zas gtsang la pho nya mngags te/ lha gzhon nu ni mthu dang ldan par shes na shing 'gyel ba de blta bar rigs so/ /zhes zhus pa na/ zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kho bos ni gzhon nu la bka' stsal bar mi nus so/ /der 'dun pas gsol ba/ lha bdag la gnang ba stsol shig dang gzhon nu rang nyid 'byon par 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /de nas 'dun pas bsgos nas/ 'bab chu'i 'gram du shākya gzhon nu rnams so so'i skyed mos tshal byas te/ gzhon nu rnams so so rang rang gi skyed mos tshal du song ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' yang rang gi skyed mos tshal du gshegs pa na/ lhas byin gyis ngang pa zhig nam mkha' la —154—

'phur ba la mda' bsnun pa byang chub sems dpa'i skyed mos tshal du lhung ba na/mda' phyung zhing sman gyis gsos te btang ngo / /lhas byin gyis 'phrin du bskur ba/ ngang pa de ni ngas sngar bzung ba yin pas tshur skur zhig byang chub sems dpas slar springs pa/ ngas ni sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste sems can thams cad bzung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas lhas byin bcom ldad 'das 'khon pa'i sems lhag par 'dzin pa de nas byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis skye bo'i tshogs chen po mngags te/ de rnams kyis shing chun par brtsams pa'i ca co chen po byung ngo / /de byang chub sems dpas gsan te 'dun pa la dris pas des ji ltar gyur ba rgyas par gsol lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu rnams dang lhan cig shing 'don par gshegs pa na/ shing gi 'gram gyi khung bu zhig nas sbrul gdug pa zhig thon te byung ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnod kyis dogs nas 'char kas ral gri bsnun nas sbrul gyi sked pa nas bcad do/ /sbrul gyi dbugs 'char ka la phog pas kha dog nag por gyur te nag po 'char ka zhes grags so/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu rnams kyis shing de 'byin par brtsams pa las/ lhas byin gyis 'bad pas cung zad g.yos so/ /dga' bos cung zad bteg go /gzhan gang gis kyang de bas lhag pa ma nus te/ byang chub sems dpas phyag gcig gis blangs de steng gi nam mkha' la 'phangs pas shing de dkyil nas chag ste dum bu gnyis su gyur nas 'bab chu'i phar 'gram tshur 'gram du lhung bar gyur te/ chu klung sngon bzhin du bde bar 'bab bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas skye bo'i —155—

tshogs la shing 'di ni bsil ba'i rang bzhin te mkhris pa'i nad sel zhing / shu ba dang phol mig sogs la byugs na zhi bar 'gyur gyi dum bur byos la khyer shig de rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du byas so/ /bcu gsum pa sa 'tsho ma btsun mor bzhes pa ni/ de nas shākya gzhon nu rnams shing rtar zhugs nas ser skya gzhir 'gro ba na/ ltas mkhan rnams kyis da ste gzhon nu don grub lo bdun nas rab tu ma byung na 'khor los bsgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung ston no/ /de'i tshe shākya dril bu sgra'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma zhes bya ba bud med rin po che zhig steng gi khang bzang gi gzhi nas lta bzhin du 'dug pa gzigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs kyi mthe bos shing rta mnan te rta la sogs pa 'dren byed rnams kyis 'dren ma thub bar shing rta mi g.yo bar 'dug go /byang chub sems dpa' sa mtsho ma la gzigs shing rtog pa na phyag na bsnams pa'i lcags mda' phye mar mdzad do/ /des kyang byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing rtog pas yengs ma thabs su rkang pa'i mthe bos khang bzang gi thog mthil la bsnun pas thog brdol bar gyur to/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de mthong bas/ bud med 'dis ni gzhon nu'i thugs dang bstan par nus so/ /zhes zer ba'i gtam de rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas lha mo sa 'tsho ma 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs so/ /bcu bzhi ba nges par 'byung ba'i rkyen ni/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na byang chub sems dpas kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kye kha lo sgyur ba bzhon pa bzang po myur du shoms shig /skyed mos tshal du 'gro'o/ /des kyang bka' —156—

bzhin 'tshal zhes ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bshams te/ dus la bab pa na shing rtar zhugs te byon pa'i lam du mi rgas shing 'khogs pa ga bar ba la brten nas 'gro ba gzigs so/ kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ 'di ci/ gsol pa/ lha 'di ni rgas pa zhes bya ste ring por mi thogs par 'gum pa'o/ /'o na nga yang rgas pa'i chos las ma 'das sam/ lha yang bgres pa'i chos las ma 'das so/ /bka' stsal pa shing rta phyir sgyur zhig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /der pho brang du byon nas/ nga rgas pa las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces thugs ngan du dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la gzhon nu skyed mos tshal du dgyes sam zhes dris pa na/ sngar gyi tshul rgyas par gsol bas rgyal bos bsams pa/ ltas mkhan rnams kyi tshig bden par mi 'gyur grang / gshone nu 'di rab tu byung bar 'gyur du 'ong gi bdag gis 'dod pa'i yon to lnga phal mo che zhig byin te rab tu mi 'byung bar bya'o snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' la 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis bstabs so/ /de nas yang de dang 'dra ba las shing rta la chings te skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs pa na/ mi nad pa nad kyis gdungs pa/ skya bo sbab sbab po rid pa zhig gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/ 'di ci/ gsol ba/ lha 'di ni bro 'tshal ba zhes bgyi'o/ /nga yang nad kyi chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang bsnyung pa'i chos las ma 'das so/ /yang pho brang du gshegs te/ nga yang nad las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces dgongs so/ /de nas 'dod pa'i yon to lngas bstabs pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs te skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs pa —157—

na/ mi ro khyogs la bteg nas khyer zhing / steng nas ras kyi g.yogs/ mdun nas me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo mang po yang mdun nas 'gro/ mya ngan byed pa rnams phyi bzhin 'brang ba gzigs nas/ 'di ci/ lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /nga yang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang 'grongs pa'i chos las ma 'das so/ /yang pho brang nyid du gshegs te/ nga'ang 'chi ba'i chos las ma 'das pa lta zhes dgongs so/ /zhes pa nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis bstabs so zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bsams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rgyu'i stobs can yin mod kyi/ rgyu'i stobs r+ṣa po yang rkyen la ltos pas rab tu 'byung bar bskul lo snyam ste/ rab tu byung ba skra bregs shing gos bur smig gyon pa khyim nas khyim du bsod snyoms la 'jug pa zhig sprul lo/ /de nas yang sngar bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs te skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs pa na/ rab tu byung ba skra bregs shing gos bur smig gyon pa lag na lhung bzed thogs pa rgyu zhing 'gro ba gzigs so/ /'di ci/ lha 'di ni rab tu byung ba ste/ dul ba legs pa la sogs pa yin no/ /'o na 'di'i phyogs su shing rta sgyur cig des kyang bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes de phyogs su phyin pa na/byang chub sems dpas de la dri ba mdzad pas/ des kyang rab tu byung ba'i tshul rgyas par gsol bas/ byang chub sems dpas legs so stsal te yang phyir ldog ste pho brang du gshegs nas/ e ma ho/ bdag ni khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam du spro ba dang bcas pas don de nyid dgongs so/ /—158—

bco lnga pa zhing pa'i sar bsam gtan bsgrubs pa sogs ni/ yang rgyal pos kha lo sgyur ba la dris pa la sogs pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ rgyal pos da ni bdag gis gzhon nu zhing pa'i grong du btang nas sems g.yeng bar bgyi'o snyam nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la gzhon nu tshur shog khyod zhing pa'i grong du song la las kyi mtha' la ltos shig /ces brjod pa na byang chub sems dpa' rga nad 'chi ba gsum gyis thugs 'byung / rab tu byung ba la ni mngon par zhen yang yab zas gtsang gi tshig gsan nas shing rtar zhugs te zhing pa'i grong du gshegs pa na/ lam khar gter lnga brgya kha bye ste/ gzhon nu bdag cag ni khyed kyi nye du'i gter lags kyi bdag cag bzhes shig ces pa'i sgra byung ngo / /bka' stsal ba/ khyod kyi nga la dgos pa med kyi song zhig gang gis nga la 'chi ba'i gtam/ smras pa/ /de dag shi ba'i gtam du gyur pa yin/ /bdag kyang shi nas ring po mi thogs par/ /gzhan dag gis kyang gtam du 'gyur ba 'ong / /zhes gsungs/ de nas gter de rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs so/ /de rjes zhing pa'i grong du byon te wo las kyi mtha' la gzigs pa na/ wo pa rnams rkang lag ser kar song zhing / glang rnams kyang ngal zhing rmos pa sogs gzigs nas thugs snying rje chen po 'khrungs te/ khyed rnams bde ba la reg par mnos shig ces zhing pa rnams kyang btang / rmon pa rnams kyang bkrol lo/ /de nas zhing pa rnams sdug bsngal ba gzigs pas kyang thugs lhag par 'byung ste shing dzaskru'i grib ma la bzhugs pas bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin shugs 'byung la mngon du mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin —159—

de la mnyam par bzhag ste bzhugs pa na/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' mi spong bar shing gzhan gyi drung na sdod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal pos bsams pa/ da ni gzhon nu ring zhig thogs te gro'i dus las yol gyi blta bar 'gro'o zhes shing rtar zhugs te byon nas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du phyin pa na nyi ma gung yol bas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma shar du gzhol yang /dzasbu'i grib mas byang chub sems dpa'i sku lus ma btang bar grib ma shar du ma yol ba rgyal pos gzigs nas/ rgyal pos byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la phyag mdzad do/ /ji ltar bltams tshe sa ni g.yos pa dang / /dzasbu'i grib mas khyod sku mi gtong ba/ /blo chen khyod kyi ya mtshan gnyis 'di ste/ /kun gzigs khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin las bslangs nas shing rtar zhugs/ grong khyer du gshegs pa'i lam dur khrod kyi phyogs la byung bas mi ro rnam par bam pa la sogs pa gzigs pa na/ shin tu thugs skyo ba bskyed pas shing rta de nyid la bzhugs bzhin du skyil krung bcas nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /yang rgyal pos ting nge 'dzin las bslangs te ser skya'i gzhir gshegs pa na mtshan mkhan rnams kyis/ da ste gzhon nu zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te de yi bzang po gzigs bzhed na/ /de slad dgung bdun bar du srungs shig dang / /mi dbang gdugs ni brdal bar gyur pa lta'i/ /rin chen sna bdun 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces sogs smras so/ /—160—

——— bcu drug pa btsun mo ri dwags skyes ba zhes pa ni/ de nas grong khyer gyi nang du tshur phebs pa na/ shākya dus legs kyi bu mo ri dwags skyes zhes bya ba bud med mchog zhig dkar khung nas lta zhing 'dug pas byang chub sems dpa' mthong ste/ kye ma 'di yi yum bde zhing / yab de yang ni bde ba yin/ /kye ma gang gi khyim thabs gyur/ /bud med de yang mya ngan 'das/ /zhes smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni zhi ba myang 'das kyi tshig de gsan pas dgyes te/ mu tig gi phreng ba de la 'phangs pa dkar khung nas song ste de'i mgul du 'khris so/ /de skye bo'i tshogs kyis mthong ste rgyal po la zhus pas ri dwags skyes 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs te/ mdor na btsun mo'i mchog gsum la 'khor nyi khri nyi khri ste btsun mo drug khri'o/ /bcu bdun pa srung mas bskor ba ni/ de nas rgyal po zas gtsang sku mched dang bcas pa rnams gros byas te/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa ci nas kyang rab tu mi 'byung ba'i thabs bsams nas grong khyer chen po lcags ri dang 'obs rim pa bdun bdun gyis bskor/ sgo 'phar rnams lcags la byas shing dril bu sgra chen po 'gyung ba dag btags pas sgo phye na dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu sgras khyab 'gro bar byas/ pho brang gi phyi'i skas spo bar rung ba nub mo mi lnga brgyas bsdog cing / snga dro mi lnga brgyas 'dzugs dgos pa yang byas/byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzang du bud med mchog gi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te glu dang gar dang rol mo sna tshogs pa sbyor du bcug blon po'i tshogs dpung yan lag bzhi dang lhan cig ra ba'i phyi rol khor yug tu spyan —161—

pa byed cing / ma.ā+oṃ mo ni rgyal po zas gtsang dpung dang bcas pas shar sgo'i phyi rol nas srung ngo / /de bzhin du nub phyogs nas zas dkar/ lho phyogs nas bre bo zas/ byang phyogs nas bdud rtsi zas 'khor dang bcas pas srung ngo / de thams cad du 'dram po ste lta nyul byed pa po ni shākya ming chen yin te/ des mtshan mo'i thun dang pa la shar sgo song ste/ 'di na su zhig mel tshe byed/ rgyal bo zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kho bo mel tshe byed do/ /des smras pa/ lha mel tshe mdzod cig khyod la legs par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gnyid log ro dang mtshungs/ /gnyid log bdud kyi dbang du song / /'di ni mi nyal rtag tu mkhas/ /de bas ma nyal mel tshe byos/ /zhes smra zhing phyogs gzhan gsum dang blon po rnams kyi sar yang song zhing mel tshe la skul bar byed do/ /de bzhin du thun gzhan la yang ngo / /de nas nam langs pa na/ dgung bdun las gcig ni thal te drug lus so zhes tshul des zhag drug ni yongs su 'das/ bdun pa'i nub mo lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ched du brjod pa'ang byas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du/ bdag la phyis mu stegs byed la sogs pa g.yin dag gang gi phyir bud med kyi mchog drug khri spangs te rab tu byung bas/ 'di ni skyes pa ma yin no zhes kha zer bar byed do snyam du dgongs nas btsun mo'i mchog grags 'dzin ma la sras bskrun par mdzad/ des kyang mngal sems can dang ldan par shes kyang nangs par snyan du gsol snyam mo/ /bco brgyad pa khyim nas mngon par byung ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ bdag dang bud med khyim nyal ba'i/ /tha ma deng gi 'di yin —162—

te/ /phyin chad khyim du bud med dang / /nga ni lhan cig mi gnas so/ /de nas bud med rnams glu gar dang rol mos dub ste gnyid du song / skra yang zhigasgren mor phyung ba dang / kha chu 'dzag cing sla col du smra ba sogs gzigs pas de thams cad la mi sdug pa'i 'du shes rnyed do/ /skabs der skye rgu'i bdag mo la zla ba gzas zin pa dang / nyi ma shar nas shar du nub pa dang / skye bo mang pos bdag la phyag byas pa dang / rang nyid ngu zhing rgod pa rmi'o/ /grags 'dzin ma la rmi lam brgyad rmi ste/ khyim gyi gdung chag pa dang / mal khri chag pa dang / lag gdub chag pa dang / so lhags pa dang / lan bu zhig pa dang / khyim nas dpal song ba dang / zla ba gzas bzung ba dang / nyi ma shar phyogs su nub pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' la mnal lam lnga rmis te/ ri rab la sngas mdzad cing sa gzhi gzims mal du mdzad pa dang / phyag g.yas nub kyi rgya mtshor bcugagayon shar gyi rgya mtshor bcug zhabs rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du brkyangs pa dang / 'greng ba zhes bya ba'i rtsa ring po zhig sku'i lte ba nas skyes te nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags pa dang / bya lus dkar la mgo nag pa mang pos zhabs la gshugs shing ldag la/ bya sna tshogs phyogs bzhi nas 'ongs te sku mdun du 'dus pa na thams cad kha dog gcig tu song ba dang / mi gtsang ba'i ri'i steng nas bdag nyid 'chag par mdzad kyang mi gtsang bas ma gos pa'o/ /der byang chub sems dpa' thugs dgyes te/ ngas rmi lam 'di lta bu rmi na/ ring por mi thogs bar bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs so/ /der grags 'dzin mas rmi lam rnams gsol ba na/ der yid mi bde ba rnams —163—

bsal ba'i phyir rmi lam mi bden pa'i don can du gsungs/ de nas byang chub sems dpas da ni bdag gdon mi za bar nags su 'gro bar bya dgos pas/'di la zur gyis bstan no dgongs te grags 'dzin ma la phyogs mtshon pa tsam gsungs pa na/ grags 'dzin mas gsol pa/ lha khyod gang du bzhud pa der bdag bkri bar gsol/ byang chub sems dpas zhi ba'i dbyings la dgongs nas de bzhin du bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te/ de ltar na dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs so/ /de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa yang shes/ rab tu 'byung ba'i dus kyang shes nas bzhengs su gsol ba dang / nags su gshegs par bskul ba na/ bka' stsal pa/ da ltar dmag gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor zhing bsrungs na ji ltar bgyid/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ ji ltar khyod ni gegs med par/ /de nyid nags su gshegs 'gyur ba/ /bdag cag tshangs sogs bcas pa yi lha rnams kyis ni de bzhin bgyid/ /ces gsol bas byang chub sems dpa' dgyes te bzhengs so/ /de nas brgya byin gyis skye bo rnams gnyid kyis myos par byas shing / skas chen po mi lnga brgyas 'dzugs dgos pa de gnod sbyin lnga rtsen gyis btsugs/ byang chub sems dpa' skas de las babs te shod kyis gzhir phebs/ mdun pa gnyid du song ba bslangs te/ rta sngags ldan longs shigakho bo ni nags su 'gro'o/ /des gsol pa/ lha khyed ni skyed mos tshal gyi dus ma bab/ des pa khyod dang 'khon pa 'ga' ma mchis/ khyod la dgra bo su yang ma mchis par/ /dgung phyed khyed la chibs pas ci zhig bgyi/ /byang chub sems —164—

dpas nga'i tshig ma gcog cig ces gsungs kyang / mtshan mo 'jigs su rung ngo zhes chibs pa mi len no/ /de nas lan dang yang lan mang po byas na skye bo rnams gnyid sad par 'gyur ro bsnyam du dgongs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyis sngags ldan bzung bar brtsams pa na/ des kyang byang chub sems dpa' dka' thub kyi gnas su gshegs par rig nas mi dga' bas 'bros shing / rkang pas 'phra ba dang 'jing kyog byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas sngags ldan gyi mgo la phyag gis bzhabs nas/ sngags ldan tha ma yi ni khur long ste/ /dka' thub nags su ma thogs nga skyol zhig /byang chub thob nas myur du 'gro ba kun/ /bsam gtan rnam thar char kyi tshim par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas rnal du 'dug pa na de la sga bstad do/ /de nas brgya byin gyis lha'i bu 'gram dang / nye 'gram dang / lo ma dang / lo ma gyon pa ste lha'i gyad bzhi spyan 'dren par bskos so/ /byang chub sems dpas de dag gi stobs dris pa na/ de dag rim pas sa gzhi chen po dang / rgya mtsho chen po bzhi dang / sa la gnas pa'i ri thams cad dang / rtswa dang shing thams cad khur du thogs par nus zhes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs sa la bzhag pa de bzhi char gyis stobs bskyed kyang sgul bar ma nus nas ngo mtshar cher skyes so/ /de lta bu mthong zhing thos nas 'dun pa yang ngo mtshar skyes te drung du 'ongs/ byang chub sems dpa' sngags ldan la chibs/ mdun pa yang chibs rgyab tu bskyon nas lha rnams kyi mthus dang sngags ldan steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags pa na/ pho brang na gnas pa'i lha rnams mchi ma phyung ngo / /de nas sgo gzhan nas byon na —165—

gzhon nus tha ma'i dus na yang nga la ma ba lhas so snyam yab rgyal po thugs chad par 'gyur dgongs te/ shar sgo'i phyogs rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sar phebs so/ /der zas gtsang mnal thug pos non te ma rig go /byang chub sems dpas yab la 'di skad ces/ gus pa ma mchis pa ma lags te 'jig rten rnams sdug bsngal las yongs su sgrol ba'i slad du lags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de lta bu'i tshul ming chen gyis mthong ste/ mchi ma dang bcas pasagazhon nu 'di ni rigs pa ma lags so zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ming chen ngas bskal pa grangs med gsum du dka' ba du mas sems can gyi don du byang chub bsgrubs na/ da ni nga ci'i phyir khyim du 'dug 'di ni nges te dka' thub kyi tshal du 'gro'o/ /der bka' drag po stsal bas/ ming wo gyis slar zhu bar ma spobs te/ deng du rgyal po zas gtsang dang / shwakya dag ni thams cad kyis/ /yang dang yang du bsams pa yi/ /re ba 'bras bu med par gyur/ /zhes sogs smre sngags 'don bzhin grags 'dzin ma la sogs gnyid las bslang bar brtsams kyang gnyid ma sad cing / rgyal po zas gtsang la sbran kyang mnal ma sad la/ phyogs thams cad du khus btab kyang 'brog dgon par 'o dod bos pa bzhin du su'ang gnyid ma sad cing 'ga' yang lan ster ba med do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chibs kyi rkang lag bzhi nas lha'i gyad bzhis bteg nas/ gzugs khams kyi lha rnams ni spyod lam dul bas g.yas phyogs nas 'gro/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams ni g.yon phyogs nas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'gro/tshangs pa dang brgya byin nyid chibs kyi mdun nas spyod lam rang bzhin bas 'gro —166—

zhing / gzhan yang nam mkha'i mthongs nas lha rnams kyis rol mo dkrol zhing /me tog gi char 'bebs pa la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas lha rnams la legs so stsal zhing / lha rnams kyis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' la khyed kyis nam bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes pa de'i tshe bdag cag la'ang dgongs shig ces zhus shing / byang chub sems dpas kyang zhal gyis bzhes so/ /bcu dgu pa rab tu byung ba ni/ de nas glang po che'i rta stangs kyis phyogs kun tu gzigs te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ /lam gyi mchog ni ma thob par/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ni slar/ /nga ni 'jug pa mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi lam thun gnyis la bgrod de chibs las babs/ rgyan bkrol te mdun pa la bka' stsal pa/ rgyan dang rta khyer la slar ldog cig /mdun pa gdong mchi mas gang bzhin du gsol pa/ seng ge stag gis gtams pa dang / /phyugs rjes gang ba'i nags tshal du/ /'ba' zhig sku gnyen dang bral bar/ /'phags pa ji ltar spyod par 'gyur/ /bka' stsal pa/skye rgu 'di na skye na'ang gcig pu ste/ /de bzhin 'chi na'ang gcig pur 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di na gcig pus sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te/ /'khor ba la ni grogs yod ma yin no/ /zhes sogs gzhan yang zhus lan mang du mdzad do/ /de nas ut+pal sngon po 'dab ma lta bu'i ral gris nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bregs te nam mkha' la bor ba brgya byin gyis blangs te lha'i gnas su dus ston btsugs shing / phyogs der mchod rten yang byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i —167—

zhabs la rta'i rgyal po sngags ldan gyi lces bldags shing / de'i mgo la phyag tshogis byugs nas/ ngas byang chub thob nas khyod la byas pa gzo bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ mdun pa la khyod kyis bsngags ldan pho brang du ma bkri shigamadun pa skad 'dzer zhing mig mchi mas gang ste/ sngags ldan khrid nas yang dang yang du byang chub sems dpa' la phyi mig lta zhing slar song ngo / /zhag bdun gyis grong khyer ser skyar phyir 'khor te mdun pas bsams pa/ bdag rta dang lhan cig song na smre sngags chen po thos pas bdag dbugs brnangs te 'chi bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ rang nyid skyed mos tshal du 'dug ste sngags ldan btang ngo / /des skad bton pas skye bo'i tshogs rnams phyir byung ste bltas pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' ma mthong bas/ de rnams kyis rta'i rgyal po'i mgul du 'jus shing smre sngags 'don pa dang dud mo'i sgra ches pas/ sngags ldan de dbugs 'gags shing brnangs te shi ba bram ze las drug la brtson pa zhig gi rigs su nying mtshams sbyar ro/ /de nas brgya byin rngon pa rgan po'i cha byad du sprul te/sngon rang sangs rgyas nas shing gi lha'i bar du bcol ba'i ngur smrig gi gos shig yod pa de lus la gyon/ lag na mda' gzhu thogs te lam khar bsdad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas gos rin po che 'di rab tu byung ba la mi 'tsham zhing /sha na'i ngur smig gi gos de rab tu byung ba la 'os par gzigs nas brje bar bka' stsal te/ brgya byin rngon pa'i gzugs kyis zhabs la gshugs nas ngur smrig gi gos phul/ des kā shi ka'i na bza' blangs te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su mchod pa chen po btsugs so/ /bur smrig gi gos de sku la mi 'tsham pa —168—

la 'tsham par gyur cig snyam du dgongs pas sku dang 'tsham par gyur to/ /de nas rab tu byung ba'i cha byad kyis drang srong ngan spong gi bu'i bsti gnas su gshegs so/ /de la bsti gnas der de'i lo bcu gnyis kyi sngon rol nas tā la'i shing la sogs pa ljon shing rnams kyi me tog dang / 'bras bu dang lo ma gser gyi rang bzhin du chags pa las/ nyi ma de nyid kyi snga dro nas shing phal par gyur to/ /der drang srong de dag sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa las/ byang chub sems dpas sems khong du chud pa'i rgyu dri bar mdzad pas/ gser gyi ljon pa rnams shing phal par gyur pas so zhes gsol to/ bka' stsal pa/ gang gi mthus bsti gnas kyi shing rnams gser du 'gyur ba'i skyes bu de ni da nangs snga dro rab tu byung nas/ da ni de la de 'dra ba dgos pa med pas de ltar gyur la/gal te de rab tu ma byung na ni/ tshal de ni de'i skyed mos tshal du 'gyur ba zhig go /des byang chub sems dpa' la yun ring du brtags na/ gang gi mthus de ltar gyur pa'i skyes bu de ni 'di /rdzob na'o snyam du shes nas/ dri ba zhus pa la/ de ltar nges so gsungs/ de nas des gdan la spyan drangs nas me tog dang 'bras bus bstabs so/ /nyi shu pa lam 'tshol bar bstan pa ni/ de nas gnas der cung zad bzhugs nas/ bka' stsal pa/ 'di nas ser skya la ji tsam/ gsol ba/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis so/ /der ha cang thag nye drags so snyam du dgongs nas chu bo ga rgo brgal te ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa nas mthar gyi rgyal po'i khab tu byon/shing ka ra bī ri'i lo ma la lhung bzed byas nas grong khyer du bsod snyoms kyi —169—

phyir zhugs so/ /de rgyal po gzugs can snying pos khang bzang gi rtse nas mthong ste/ rgyal po'i khab 'dir rab tu byung ba ji snyed zhig gnas pa yin yang / 'di lta bu'i spyod lam mdzes pa ni/ gzhan 'ga' yang med do snyam nas ched du brjod pa yang byas shing / ri drung gi shing skya seng ngam pa ṭa la'i sdong po'i drung na bzhugs so/ /rgyal pos rtog mkhan gyi pho nya dag btang ste/ der bzhugs par shes nas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i drung du byon/dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur ba'i gtam mdzad nas/ rgyal po na re/ gzhon nu lang tsho dang po la bsod snyoms spyod pa mi mdzes kyi/ bdag gis 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'bul bar bgyi ste/ nyid kyi rigs rus sogs ji ltar yin dris pa na/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po gangs ri nye ba na/ yul gyi ljongs ni 'khru dag dang / /nor rnams kun gyis gang ba yi/ /ko sa la zhes grags pa yod/ /bu ram shing pa nyi ma'i rus/ shwakya dag ni de na gnas/ /rgyal po nga ni rgyal rigs te/ /nga ni 'dod pa don mi gnyer/ /zhes dang / rgyal po nga ni byung ma thag tu yang / /'dod pa rnams la mi dga'i blo bskyed na/ /'jigs byed chos kyi dgra bor gyur pa dag /bor ba de ko slar yang ji ltar blang / /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs/ gsol pa/ brtul zhug/ba / 'dis ci zhig bced lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ gsol pa/ gang gi tshe khyed gyis de thob na bdag la dgongs shig bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /de nasabyang chub sems dpa' bya rgod phung po'i ri dang nye ba'i drang srong sna tshogs pa'i bsti gnas su gshegs te/ drang srong rnams me lngas gdung ba dang / rkang pa ya —170—

gcig 'greng ba sogs dka' thub ji tsam spyod pa de byang chub sems dpas nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur du spyad de/ drang srong wo po dang / dge sbyong wo po zhes mtshan du grags so/ /de rnams mtho ris tsam don du gnyer bar mkhyen nas/lam 'di ni nus pa ma yin pa slar lhung ba log par zhugs pa'o snyam du dgongs nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur ba'i bsti gnas su gshegs te/ ring 'phur las ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar tshun chod kyi gdams ngag zhus te/de'i nub mo de nyid la thob par mdzad nas/ nangs par ring 'phur la khyed kyis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di kho na mngon du byas sam/ gsol pa de kho na'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ ngas kyang de mngon du byas so/ /der ring 'phur na re/ 'o na 'o skol mtshungs shing mnyam ste/ tshur spyon gnyis kas 'khor 'di yongs su drang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes rab tu dga' zhing mgu ba dang / brjed par byas so/ /der byang chub sems dpas lam 'di tsam gyis ni shes par mi nus mthong bar mi nus/ rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam du dgongs te/ rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi gnas su gshegs so/ /der yang thams cad ring 'phur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ de'i drung du 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min gyi skye mched ces bya ba srid rtsi'i ting nge 'dzin thob par mdzad pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lhag spyod kyi gnas nas phyir byung ste gzhan du bkyi shogs so/ /nyer gcig pa dka' ba spyad pa ni/ de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sem sa dpa'i phyogs su lta nyu9/ ba mang du btang ba las/ byang chub sems —171—

dpa' la rim gro byed pa'i g.yog med cing / gcig pur 'thalas shing 'dug go zhes thos nas/ rim gro byed pa mi sum brgya btang shing / rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis kyang mi nyis brgya btang ngo / /de nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas te nags su rgyu ba na/ skye bo mang po dang lhan cig tu gnas pas bdud rtsi mi thob par mkhyen nas/ yab kyi phyogs las gsum dang / yum gyi phyogs las gnyis khrid/ lhag ma rnams phyir bkye ste/ de rnams drang srong gi cha byad du bsgyur ba dang lhan cig grong khyer ga ya'i lho phyogs steng rgyas kyi grong rdal rgyu zhing gshegs nas/ chu klung nai nāñca na'i 'gram/ ne'u sing yid du 'ong ba mtha' nags tshang tshing dang shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan par gzigs nas/ nags khrod 'dir bdag gnas la spong ba bya'o snyam du dgongs nas shing drung zhig tu bzhugs so/ /der tshems la tshems gtad/ ljags rkan la sbyar/ thugs kyis thugs bzung ste shin tu mngon par bsdams pa na ba sbu'i bu ga nas rdzus gyi rgyun byung bar gyur to/ /de ltar dka' ba spyad pas tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa nyams su myong yang zhus pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ sku ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar bzhag pa yin/ g.yeng ba ma yin gyi thugs brtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas dus gnyis pa la rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan bsgom par brtsams te sbyor ba la zhugs pa na/dbugs 'byung rngub bkag pas rlung thams cad spyi bor song ste/ dbu la zug rngu mi bzad pa lcags kyi phur bus btab pa lta bu byung ste/ zhus pa ma yin pa sogs gong bzhin/ dus gsum par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dngos —172—

thob pa'i tshe rlung bkag pa na snyan gyi bu ga gnyis nas rgyu ba ni/ mgar ba'i sbud pa bus pa bzhin no/ /de ltar tshor ba mi bzad pa myong yang zhum pa ma yin pa sogs gong bzhin/ dus bzhi pa la rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan mthar phyin pa la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ rlung rgyu ba bkag pas phyal shin tu rgyas par gyur te/ dbu la zug rngu dang sku'i khong du chu gri rnon pos dral ba lta bu'i tshor ba dang /me'i dong du dpyangs pa lta bu'i zug rngu nyams su myong yang zhum pa ma yin pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /dus lnga par kha zas ngan ngon chang chung gsol ba ni/mon sran rde'u 'am/ rgya sran nam/ 'bras la sogs pa bskol ba'i khu ba gsol ba/ de nyid kyi mdangs ma yal gyi bar du phyi ma mi gsol ba'o/ /de'i tshe lha rnams kyis ba sbu'i bu ga nas mdangs sgrub par zhus pa las/ kha zas spangs te mdangs sgrub pa bdag gir byed pa ni/ tshul 'chos rdzun pa log pa gzhan bslu ba yin par dgongs te/ mdangs sgrub pa phyir bzlog par mdzad do/ /des sku lus shin tu skem zhing smya bar gyur kyang zhum pa ma yin pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ji ltar sku lus nyam chung bar gyur zhe na/ sku lus ni ldum bu a si ta dang / ka li ka'i sdong bu kun nas bskams na 'jums par gyur pa lta bu dang / dbu yang 'bar 'bur can sku ba rnyings pa lta bu dang / spyan 'bras phug tu song ba khron pa'i skar ma lta bu dang / sku'i rtsibs ma mtho dman du gyur la/ sgal tshigs skra'i lan bu lta bur gyur zhing bzhengs par bzhed na mdun du bub cing / bzhugs par bzhed na rgyab tu 'gyel bas sku'i stod smad res mos su brten zhing 'jog dgos pa dang / ba skru'i rtsa ba rnams rul bas sku la phyag gis byugs pa na ba sbu —173—

sa la lhags par 'gyur ba'o/ /de nas sngon gyi kha dog bzang po gang yin pa de yang nub par gyur te/ lha gsum zhig der lhags nas gcig gis go ta ma ni nag po zhig go /de bzhin du sngo sangs zhig go /smug po zhig go /zhes smra'o/ /der dpe gsum zhig thugs la shar te/ chu nang gi shing shin tu rlon pa la btsubs kyang me mi 'bar ba bzhin du/ lus sems gnyis kar 'dod pa la chags pas grol bar mi nus pa dang / de bas cung zad tsam gsher chung ba'i shing rlon pas kyang de dang 'dra ba ltar/ lus 'dod pa las thag bsrings kyang sems kyis ma bsrings na grol bar mi 'gyur ba dang / shing bskams btsubs pas me 'byung ba ltar lus sems gnyis kar 'dod pa las thag bsrings pas ni/ shes pa dang mthong ba dang reg par nus par dgongs so/ /de nas dus drug par cung zad mnal ba na shin tu rtsub pa'i rtswa'i stan la gzims shing / g.yin snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ til la sogs pa 'bru gcig gsol te/ de'i mdangs ma yal gyi bar du 'khru gnyis pa mi gsol bas sku lus snga ma las kyang ches zhus par gyur to/ /de ltar kha zas phra mo'i dka' thub mdzad de zhus pa ma yin pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gis nyin re bzhin mi nyis brgya lnga bcu re rtog par gtong zhing / lhas bstan nas kyang de tsam re gtong ste/nyin re bzhin phyir 'khor ba rnams kyis gtam skyel bar byed na/ rgyal po zas gtsang lhag par thugs ngan du mdzad cing / btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyang rtswa'i stan la nyal ba dang / grags 'dzin mas kyang rgyan rnams bor te/ ji ltar dka' ba spyod pa'i tshul la zhugs so/ /de nas rgyal pos grags 'dzin ma'i lhums na —174—

sras yod pas/ de la gnod par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod pa'i phyir/ grags 'dzin ma la dka' ba spyod pa'i tshul sus kyang ma smra zhig /gtam skyel ba rnams kyis kyang nga nyid ma gtogs su la yang / byang chub sems dpa'i dka' thub kyi tshul ma brjod cig ces bka' bsgos so/ /rgyal po rang nyid kyis gsan pas nang du thugs ngan du 'gyur yang rnam 'gyur sbas te/ gtam gzhan gyis btsun mo'i 'khor bcas rnams 'brid par byed do/ /de nas dus bdun pa la dka' spyad 'di tsam gyis kyang mi chog go snyam du dgongs te/ kha zas shin tu ngan pa zhes bya ba be'u 'o ma 'thung ba rnams kyi chu dang lci ba'i ril bu phra mo re gsol/de'i mdangs ma yal bar phyi ma mi gsol lo/ /cung zad mnal bar mdzad pa na/dur khrod du gshegs nas mi ro bam pa dbu sngas su mdzad do/ /de'i tshe sngar bas kyang sku lus rid cing / sku lus rlan gsher med pa ltar gyur la/ grong khyer gyi gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma dang / phyugs rdzi dag 'ongs te ras bal dang / me tog dang ril bu dag snyan du bcug ste shing bus bdas nas shangs kyi bug nas 'byin par byas/ shangs kyi bu gar bcug nas snyan du 'byin pa sogs phar 'dren tshur 'dren du byed do/ kha cig dag ni kyai phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la ltos zhes sku la bong ba dang / gseg mas 'thor bar byed kyang gsan pa dang gzigs par yang mi mngon no/ /'on kyang zhus pa ma yin sogs gong dang 'dra bar bzhugs so/ /nyer gnyis pa dka' thub grol ba ni/ de ltar dka' ba spyod pa'i dus lo drug 'das nas 'di snyam du da ltar gang su dag sdug bsngal spong bar 'dod pa —175—

thams cad ni 'di tsam du zad de/ 'di yang shes pa dang mthong ba dang byang chub la reg par nus pa ma yin no/ /bdag sngon zhing pa'i grong du bsam gtan bsgrubs pa de lta bu la brten nas byang chub sgrub par nus na/ rid cing nyams chung bas de yang bskyed mi nus te/ lus mdangs stobs dang ldan par bya'o dgongs nas dbugs 'byung rngub ci bder mdzad cing / 'bras chan sogs kha zas/ rags pa yang gsol/ til mar gyis byug shing chu 'jam po sa khrus mdzad do/ /der rim gro pa lnga po ma dad par gyur te/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong go ta ma 'di ni spong ba las nyam pa yin te/ da ni 'dis cung zad kyang thob par mi nus so zhes/ byang chub sems dpa' bor nas wa ra nā srir song ste/ lnga sde zhes grags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rim gyis sku'i mthu bskyed nas sde can gyi grong du gshegs so/ /der yul de'i dpon po sde can zhes bya ba la bu mo dga' ma dang dga' stobs ma zhes bya ba gnyis yod do/ /de gnyis bud med rin po che ltar phun sum tshogs pa yin la/ de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur bar 'gyur ba ni thos/ rab tu byung ba ni ma thos la/ bud med gang dag tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs 'di dang 'di lta bu dag lo bcu gnyis su bsten zhing / de rdzogs pa na 'o thug gi mchog bcos te/ dka' thub kyis dub pa'i drang srong la phul na/ de'i btsun mor 'gyur ro zhes thos nas/ de dag gis brtul zhugs blangs nas dus der lo bcu gnyis kyang rdzogs pas/ba mchog stong yod pa rnams bzhos te/ ba stong po de nyid la blud do/ /de rnams bzhos nas lnga brgya la blud do/ /de yang lnga brgya bo de nyid la'o/ /de bzhin du/—176—

nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / brgya nyer lnga dang / drug cu rtsa gsum dang / sum cu tsa gnyis dang / bcu drug dang brgyad de lan bcu drug nying khur byas pa'i 'o rma rnams shel snod du bskol ba'i tshe/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis mdo la mthu bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i sman blugs so/ /'o ma bskol ba de la 'khor lo dang bkra shis dang g.yung drung 'khyil ba la sogs pa dge ba'i gzugs du ma byung ngo / /de kun tu 'tsho ba pa nye bar 'gro zhes bya bas blangs kyang ma byin no/ /de nas nangs par shel snod nas gser gyi yol gor blugs so/ /de'i tshe brgya byin bram ze'i cha byad du sprul te 'ongs pa dang / tshangs pa dang gnas gtsang ma'i lha zhig kyang 'ongs te/ bu mo gnyis kyis brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs can la 'o thug de 'bul bar brtsams pa na/ de na re/ ci bdag la sbyin nam/ 'on kyang bdag las ches mchog tu gyur pa la spyin de gnyis gyis smras pa/ ches mchog la 'bul lo/ /'o na tshangs pa chen po la phul shig tshangs pa la 'bul bar brtsams pa na yang snga ma skad zer te/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha la 'bul bar brtsams pa na/ des kyang snga ma ltar las/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul cigade nas de gnyis byang chub sems dpa'i drung du chas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chu klung nai rnga lja nar sku khrus mdzad de/ sku nyams chung bas bzhengs par mi spyod pa na/ chu 'gram na shing a rdzu na yod pa'i yal ga lha rnams kyis mnan te bshud pa la phyag gis 'jus te bzhengs nas chos gos gsol te chu 'gram na bzhugs so/ /der de gnyis kyis 'o thug phul ba bzhes te/ bka' stsal pa/ yol go 'di yang btang ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ btang ba lags —177—

so/ /byang chub sems dpas 'o thug gsol nas/ gser gyi yol go bkrus te chu klung der bor ba klu rnams kyis blangs so/ /der brgya byin mkha' lding gi cha byad du sprul nas/ klu las yol go phrogs te sum cu rtsa gsum du mchod pa chen po btsugs so/ /de nas bka' stsal pa/ sbyin pa 'dis ci zhig don du gnyer/ bu mo de gnyis kyis gsol ba/ shākya gzhon nu 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba de'i khyim thab du'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ de ni 'dod pa spangs te rab tu byung zin to/ /gsol pa/ 'o na de'i bzhed pa'i don thams cad grub par gyur cig de ltar 'o thug mchog de gsol ba tsam gyis sku nyams stobs dang ldan zhing / gser gyi kha dog sogs sngon bzhin du gyur to/ /nyer gsum pa byang chub snying por gshegs pa ni/ de nas brag ri me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa zhig tu bzhugs pa na de ma thag tu ri de nyil lo/ /lha rnams kyis gsol ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa ni sa gzhan gyis bzung bar mi nus te/ 'di dang nye ba phyogs 'di lta bu zhig na rdo rje'i gdan mchis te da ni der bzhud cig de nas lhas lam bstan pa bzhin bzhud pa na zhabs gang bzhag sar pad+ma dag byung ngo / /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las chu babs te pad+ma'i rdzing dag tu gyur to/ /de nas yang gshegs te zhabs kyi goms pa bor ba nas chen po 'di 'bar ba'i snod la dbyu gus bsnun pa bzhin sgra 'byung ngo / /bya tsa rka dang ri dwags dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' la skor ba byed/ lha rnams kyis kyang char zim bus chag chag 'debs shing ser bu 'jam po dag gtong bar byed do/ /chu klung ni rañja nar klu'i rgyal po dus can zhes bya ba —178—

dus gzhan thams cad du long ba las/ 'jig ga rten du sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshe mig thob ste sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig la sogs pa'i yang zhal mthong ba zhig go /skabs der des mig gis mthong bar gyur zhing / sa chen po sgra sgrog pa'ang thos nas rang gi gnas las byung ste sa steng du 'thon nas rgyang ring po kho na nas bcom ldan 'das mgong ba na/ nges par sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar shes nas des smras pa/ bdag gis sngon ni mthong ba yi/ /sangs rgyas mthu chen de rnams dang / /thub pa khyod ni mthong gyur na/ /de dag tha dad dbyer ma mchis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher bstod do/ /de nas yang gshegs pa na lha'i rgyal po'i 'jug pa rtswa 'tshong bkra shis dang mjal te/ ri spos ngad ldan las blangs pa'i rtswa 'jam zhing reg na bde ba khur gcig yod pa/ byang chub sems dpas rtswa de bslangs pa na/ des kyang gus pa dang bcas pas phul de nas byang chub snying por gshegs te rdo rje'i gdan la 'dzegs nas/ shing a shwat+pa byang chub shing gi drung der bzhugs gnas su rtswa'i bam po de bskyur stabs su bor ba na srab 'thug med par g.yas phyogs su 'khyil te 'dug go /ltas 'di dag las na da ni gdon mi za bar bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas skyil krung bcas sku drang por bsrangs dran pa mngon du bzhag nas bzhugs te/ ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyil krung gzhig par mi bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' bar mdzad do/ /nyer bzhi pa bdud btul ba ni/ de'ang bdud sdig can la rgyal mtshan gnyis yod de/ dga' ba'i gnas dang dogs pa'i gnas so/ /de las skabs —179—

'dir dogs pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yos pas/ bdud kyis brtags pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par mthong nas/ bar chad bya ba'i phyir skra 'dzings shing sha na'i gos kyis smad g.yogs pa'i 'phrin pa zhig sprul nas rings rings skad du grong khyer ser skya ni lhas byin gyis mnan/ pho brang ni bcom/ shākya rnams ni kha btags na/ khyod ci'i phyir gnas btab ste 'dug ces smra'o/ /der thugs la 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems dang rnam par 'tshe ba ste mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gsum skyes na/ de bdud kyi dkrugs mar mkhyen nas dge ba'i rtog pa gsum gyis zil gyis mnan no/ /de nas bdud nyid 'ongs te/ khyed kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes ga la thob/ ces zer/bka' stsal pa/ sdig can khyod kyis mchod spyin gcig byas pas kyang 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug tu gyur na/ ngas bskal pa grangs med gsum du mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma byas/ sems can rnams kyi phyir mgo dang lag pa nas/ dbyig dang gser la sogs pa'i bar du thams cad yongs su btang na/bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par mi 'gyur re kan/ bdud kyis smras pa/ re zhig ngas de ltar byas pa'i dpang po ni khyod yin la/ khyod kyi de la dpang po su zhig yod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag g.yas pa bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bskyed pa sa la reg par mdzad de/ nga'i dpang po ni sa 'di yin no/ /de nas sa'i lha mo sa brtol te byung nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin no zhes smras pa dang / bdud sdig can bag 'khums shing sems khong du chud nas song ngo / /de nas sdig can gyis bskul te bdud —180—

nyid kyi bu mo sred ma dang / dga' byed ma dang / dga' spyod ma rnams mngags te/ de rnams lha'i bu mo'i mchog yin la/ bud med kyi g.yo sgyu rnams ston par brtsams pa na/ de dag rgan mor 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs/ phyis ston pa la mos pa bskyed pas grol lo/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis bdud kyi rigs kyi 'byung po thams cad sbran te/ bdud kyi dpung chen po gdong dang gzugs sna tshogs pa ma sto cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa dpa' zhing gtum la mi bsrun pa bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug sngon du bdas shing / sdig can rang nyid mda' gzhu rna ba'i bar du bkang ste 'ongs nas byang chub sems dpa'i mtha' bskor te 'dug go /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas 'byung po rnams kyis mtshon cha 'phangs pa dag ni ut+pal dang pad+ma la sogs par gyur/ ri 'phangs pa ni me tog gi khang brtsegs su gyur/ rlud gdug pa dang rdo char phab pa ni gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bsgribs/ phyag dar dang mi gtsang ba'i char phab pa yang dri zhim po'i rdzas rnams su gyur te bdud kyi gnod pa thams cad brdugs/ de nas bdud kyi dpung de rnams phyogs de nas gyes so/ /bsam gtan gyi tsher ma sgra yin pas/ bdud kyi mthus byang chub kyi shing shel las grub pas song zhing / rlud gis bskyod pas sgra 'byin pa na/gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis lo ma re re nas bzung ste sgra med par byas so/ /'on kyang bdud de dag da dung gnas pa la gtsang ma'i lha dag gis bdud de dag khor yug gi pha rol tu bskrad na/ de dag gis rgyang ring po nas 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra wo po phyung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnod —181—

kyis dogs nas/ lha rnams kyis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar du shing ka tam pa'i nags 'thug pos bskor bar sprul lo/ /de nas thams cad mi snang bar song ngo / /nyer lnga pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam gyi thun dang po'i skabs de nyid du mnyam par bzhag ste rab kyi mtha'i bsam gtan la brten nas rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang lha'i rna ba bsgrubs so/ /gung thun la gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang lha'i spyan bsgrubs shing / de nas thun tha ma la zag zad kyi mngon shes bsgrubs/ bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas thams cad mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs par gyur to/ /de nas bdud kyi rigs kyi lha rnams kyis grong khyer ser skyar byang chub sems dpa' grongs so zhes bsgrags pas thams cad mya ngan du gyur pa la/ dkar po'i lha rnams kyis shākya thub pa ni ma nongs te/ da ni bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes so zhes bsgrags pas thams cad dga' ba skyes so/ /de ltar sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyang brnyes/ zla ba la yang sgra gcan zhugs/ grags 'dzin ma'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin yang btsas shing / bdud rtsi zas kyi bu kun dga' bo yang btsas so/ /de'i tshe sa r+ṣa po ni rab tu g.yos/ phyogs thams cad ni 'od gyi snang bas khyab par gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams phan tshun gyi bar na/ mun pa mun nag tu gyur pa thams cad kyang snang bas khyab par gyur to/ /grong khyer ser skyar yang —182—

spyin gtong gi khang pa brtsigs shing / sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byas/dga' ston rgya chen po yang bsgrubs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te skyil krung gcig gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad do/ /nyer drug pa nags khrod du dal bar bzhugs pa ni/ de nas bdun phrag gnyis pa la bab pa na myongs ris kyi lha gnyis shig 'ongs nas/ gcig gis/ded dpon g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba po/ /sdig pa mi mnga' bzhengs shig 'jig rten gzigs/ /rin chen chos ni 'tshal bar 'gyur mchis kyi/ /bde gshegs chos kyi mchog 'di pond du gsol/ /cig shos kyis kyang de dang rjes su mthun par bstod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ zhi ba'i bde ba la ched du brjod pa mdzad nas rnam par grol ba'i dga' bde sku nyams su bstar zhing zhag bdun phrag gnyis par yang skyil krung ma zhig par bzhugs so/ /de nas zhag/ bdun phrag gsum pa la bab pa na/tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po zhes bya ba gnyis shing rta lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig rdo rje'i gdan dang nye ba'i lam nas 'gro ba las/ tshong dpon de dag nyid kyi grogs po shi nas lhar skyes pa dag gis de gnyis la lung bstan zhing bskul nas/ tshong dpon de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ste/ sbrang rtsi dang lde gu dag 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol zhes zhus so/ /de nas dgongs pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang lhung bzed kyi lhung bzed kyi snod du bsod snyoms bzhes kyi/ mu stegs byed bzhi du snyim pa dang slong phor du ma yin no/ /de'i tshe 'jig —183—

rten skyong ba bzhi pos de rig nas rdo las byas pa'i lhung bzed mi ma yin gyis bcos pa gsal zhing gtsang ba dri ma med pa re re thogs nas ston pa la phul lo/ /de'i tshe gcig kho na las bzhes na gsum mi dga' bar 'gyur la/ gnyis las ni gnyis dang / gsum las ni gcig mi dga' bar mkhyen nas bzhi char bzhes te de rnams lhung bzed gcig tu 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas lhung bzed der tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang pos bsod snyoms phul ba dag bzhes te/ de gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba la bkod/ sbyin pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i chos bstan to/ /de nas chu klung ni nā ñja na'i 'gram du gshegs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /sbrang rtsi dag lde gu ni hro nang slong bas/ de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa cung zad sku snyung bar gyur ba na/ bdud sdig can 'ongs te mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa na/ ngas 'khor rnam pa bzhi ma bsten zhing tshangs par spyod pa'i lam skye bo rnams la ma bstan gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da'o zhes gsungs pas/ bdud yid mi bde bas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i 'og tu lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shing dzaskru'i tshal nas sman gyi mchog a ru ra blangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phul zhing gsol bas de ma thag bsnyun zhi zhing / shin tu bzod la lhag par 'tsho bar gyur to/ /de nas bdun phrag bzhi pa la bab pa na/ glo bur du sprin chags te yul ngan byung ba na/ klu'i rgyal po btang bzung gi gnas su gshegs te rlung la sogs pas sku la mi gnod pa'i phyir klu de rnams rang gi lus kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la dkris shing gdengs ka byas te 'dug go /de nas yul ngan sangs pa na lha'i lus su bsgyur zhing —184—

gus pas bshud nas bsnyun gsol bar byed pa la dben pa'i dga' bde las brtsams te chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas bdun phrag lnga pa la bab pa na/byang chub snying por gshegs te rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi don la dgongs bzhin du zhag bdun skyil krung gcig gis 'da' bar mdzad nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ ched du brjod pa'ang mdzad do/ /de nas bdun phrag drug pa'i dus la bab pa na/ bdag gis rtogs pa'i chos zab mo 'di ni gzhan gyis khong du chud par dka' ste/ gal te bdag gis gzhan la bstan par gyur kyang des mi rtogs pas bdag nyid dub pa tsam du zad kyi/ de bas na bdag gcig pu dgon par gnas par bya'o snyam du dgongs te thugs las chung ngur bzhugs so/ /nyer bdun pa tshangs pa chen pos gsol ba btab ste wā rā na snyir gshegs pa ni/ de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas de shes te/ 'jig rten 'di ni ma rungs par 'gyur ro snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du song ste/ gsol pa/ ma ga dhar ni sngon chad chos byung ba/ /dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas par rtogs/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la/ /dri ma med pas rtogs pa bshad par mdzod/ /ces pa la/ ngas tshogs chen pos rtogs pa 'di gzhan rnams kyis rtogs par mi 'gyur zhes/ dang por zhal gyis ma bzhes so/ /yang tshangs pas/ 'jig rten na mchog dang 'bring dang dman pa dag yod pas rab 'bring dag gis chos thos na rtogs par 'gyur la/ ma thos na nyams par 'gyur ba lags pas nges par chos gsung bar zhus pa na/ ston pa nyid kyis ye shes kyi gzigs pas kyang de ltar dgongs te/ bka' stsal pa/ bdud —185—

rtsi'i sgo mo dag ni dbye bar bya/ /to par su 'dod som nyi sol cig dang / /tshangs pa mi rnams la ni gya nom chos/ /klan ka mi stsal mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pas tshangs pa dga' ba skyes mi snang bar song ngo / /gang gi tshe theg bdun phrag bdun pa la bab pa na/ ring 'phur dang lhag spyod la dgongs pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis kyang gsol te/ ring 'phur 'das nas ni theg bdun/ lhag spyod 'das nas ni zhug gcig lon par dgongs te/ kye ma de gnyis ni shin tu stes ma 'grig ste/ de dag gis nga'i chos thos na bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur ba zhig da ni gzhan la ston dgos na/ lnga sde rnams nga sngon dka' ba spyod pa na gus pa dang bcas pa yin pas/ de rnams la bstan par bya'o dgongs te byang chub kyi shing drung nas bzhengs te rim pas ljongs rgyu zhing kā shi'i yul du gshegs so/ /lam du kun tu 'tsho ba pa nyer 'gro dang mjal te/go ta ma khyed kyi dbang po ni dwangs/ bzhin gyi mdog ni yongs su dgapags pa'i mdog ni rab tu gsal na/ khyod kyi ston pa ni gang / bka' stsal pa/nga dang 'dra ba yong med kyi/ /nga la slob dpon 'ga' med do/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas nga gcig pu/ /yang dag byang chub dam pa thob/ /ces sogs so/ /nyer brgyad pa chos 'khor thog ma bskor ba ni/ de nas wā rā ṇa sir byon te/ de'i tshe drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags na lnga sde dag 'khod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byon pa rgyang ring po nas mthong ste phan tshun du khrims su bcas pa/ go ta ma bya ba mang po mang pos 'tsho ba de 'ong gi /de la smra bar mi bya/phyag mi bya/ ldang bar mi bya/ stan bstab par mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan —186—

'das khad nye bar byon pa na gzi brjid ma bzod de/ thams cad langs shing phyag phul nas/ gcig gis ni gdan bshe mes/ gcig gis ni bsus te na bza' blangs/ kha cig gis ni zhabs bkrus/ shes ldan go ta ma byon pa legs so/ /gdan bshams pa la bzhugs shig ces zer ro/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe dang ldan pa zhes sam gdung nas mi smos par gdams so/ /de nas de rnams kyis 'di skad ces/ khyed sngon dka' ba spyod pa na khyad par cung zad kyang ma thob na/ da ni khyed mi brtan zhing bya ba mang la mang du za ba sogs kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis nga'i dbang po gsal ba sogs sngon las gzhan du gyur ba ma mthong ngam ngas ni bdud rtsi thob bo/ dge slong dag rab tu byung bas mtha' 'di gnyis la brten par mi bya ste/ 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang / ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' 'o/ /dbu ma'i lam la brten dgos te/ de'ang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe dge slong lnga las snga dro gnyis la gdams ngag 'bogs shing gsum bsod snyoms la 'jug ste/ bsod snyoms des ston pa dang bcas pa'i drug char 'tsho bar byed la/ phyi dro ni gsum chos nyan zhing gnyis bsod snyoms la bzhugs nas/ bsod snyoms des dge slong lnga po dag 'tsho bar byed de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni rang bzhin gyis phyi dro mi gsol lo/ /ze/ nas de dag gi skabs su dang por bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa bzlas pa lan gsum ste bcu gnyis su bskor bas kun shes koṇ+ḍi n+ya dang / lha brgyad khris bden pa mthong ngo / /de'i rjes su kornyi rgya la/ ko spyi n+ya khyod kyis chos kun shes —187—
