'phya ba'i don du sgra byas so/ /der nyan thos mchog la brnyes pa bsal ba'i ched du bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ 'od srungs khyod ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa yin gyi/ nga'i stan phyed la 'dug cig ces ston pa nyid kyi bzhugs gdan gyi phyed kyi mtha' la bzhag go /de nas 'od srung chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa rig nas/ rgyal bas stan phyed bstab par mdzad pa de cung zad tsam dang du blangs nas/ slar langs te ston pa'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ 'khor tshogs kyi nang du zhugs te chos nyan to/ /de ltar ston pas stan byed bstabs pa ni dus der brnyas pa bzlog pa'i don du mdzad pa ltar byung yang / shugs la rgyal tshab tu bskos pa'ang yin no/ /nga dgu pa lhan cig gnas pa bstan pa ni/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo ni chos nyan pa na dad pas bsam pa gcig tu bsdus pas spyi bo'i phol mig 'tsho byed kyis dral ba yang ma rig go /tshe rabs lnga brgyar mtshan ma'i bstan bcos drug khri bslabs pas rtags dang mtshan ma rtog pa la shin tu mkhas shing gsal la rnam par 'byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to/ /yang bcom ldan 'das shing swā la can gyi bram ze'i grong khyer na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe nyan thos chen po mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su/ ston pas nam zhig na nga rgas 'khogs 'khor rnam pa bzhi la gdams ngag 'bogs pas dub par 'gyur gyi/ nga'i rim gro pa thugs la 'thad pa rang gi don nyams par mi 'gyur ba zhig spro ba skyed cigade'i tshe kun shes ko de na bzhengs te/ bdag gis de ltar bgyid lags zhus pas/ ko di n+ya khyod nyid la'ang rim gro pa dgos kyi stan la 'dug shig de —292—

bzhin du rta thul nas bzung ste/ gang po'i bar la lnga brgya'i bar du de skad gsungs/ de nas mong gal gyi bus ston pa'i thugs gang la gtad brtags pas kun dga' bo la gtad par mthong ste/ shā ri'i bu la'ang khug da de/ rang cag dong la de la spro bar bya'o/ /der de gnyis song nas shā ri'i bus kun dga' bo la khyod ston pa'i rim gro byed par spro'am/ don chen por 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das ni bsnyen zhing bzod par dka' ba ste/ des na bdag mi spro'o/ /mo thil gyi bus ston pas thugs dgongs khyod la gtad do/ /kun dga' bos 'di skad ces/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i na bza' bdag gir mi bya ba dang /mgron du bos pa bdag gir mi bya ba dang / ston pa la blta zhing bsnyen bkur ba'i phyir dus ma yin pa cung zad kyang med par gnang na rim gro byed par spro'o/ /de nas don de mod la gyi bus ston pa la gsol ba na/ legs so stsal te chos gos dang kha zas kyi rgyus nga la rnyed bkur byed do zhes kha zer bar mi 'gyur te/ kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin no/ /gzhan yang ston pa yang dag 'jog la bzhugs pa dang / bzhengs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas pa gang la gnas pa yang 'phags pa kun dga' bos shes te/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos cig yin no/ /drug cu pa spre'u sa sbrang rtsi phul ba gnyis ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yul sgra gcan gyi gnas drang srong kun dzi ka'i nags na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bla gab med par lhung bzed rab tu mang po bzhag pa la/ spre'u zhig shing las babs te der song ba dge slong rnams kyis spre'u sa lhung bzed bcag gis dogs —293—

te bzlog pa las/ ston pas dge slong dag spre'u 'di dran pa dang ldan pa yin pas ma zlog cig /ces bka' stsal/ de nas spre'u des bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed blangs te/ shing swā la'i sdong po la 'dzegs nas sbrang bu la gnod pa med par sbrang rtsi'i dwangs ma blangs te lhung bzed bkang nas ljon shing las babs te/ ston pa la phul ba na ma bzhes te/ des phyogs gcig tu song nas/srog chags shi ba'i yan lag phra mo yod pa dag bsal nas yang phul/ der yang ma bzhes pa na/ yang lhung bzed blangs te mtha' gcig tu song nas chu gtsang mas bran te phul ba na/ ston pas phyag tu bzhes shing gsol bar mdzad do/ /der spre'u de dga' mgu rangs pas phyi nur phyi nur du gar byas shing / ston pa la dad bzhin du khron par lhung ste shi 'phos nas/ grong khyer de nyid du bram ze las drug la brtson pa zhig gi chung ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar/ de phyis btsas pa na khyim du sbrang rtsi'i char babs/ de'i ming gnas 'jog gi bu sbrang rtsi can zhes btags/ de nas phyis yun ring zhig na de rab tu byung ste nyin re bzhin 'bad brtson med par sbrang rtsi lhung bzed gsum gsum rnyed par gyur te/ dang po ni sangs rgyas la 'bul/ gnyis pa ni dge 'dun la'o/ /gsum pa ni bdag nyid grogs dang bcas pa longs spyod de/ des mthar dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /yang lo rgyus gzhan thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ bcom ldan 'das yul yangs pa can spre'u'i rdzing 'gram gyi khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs so/ /spre'u bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu lta bas rgyab tu ma bltas te khron —294—

par ltung ba'i sngar bzhin las/ shi nas lhar skyes te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ongs nas me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ ston pas kyang chos gsungs pas des bden pa mthong zhing ched du brjod pa byas so/ /da ltar na gcung dga' bo btu'/ ba dang / shākya mo lnga brgya rab tu byung ba dang / slob ma lta bur gshegs pa dang / 'od zer can du gshegs pa dang / 'dod pa mthun par byon pa dang /dga' bo nyer dga' btul/ ba dang / 'brog gnas btul/ ba dang / u tra ya ṇa btul/ ba dang / seng ge btul/ ba dang / nya pa snga brgya bden/ rte5 la bkod pa dang /'od srung chen po 'khor du 'dus pa dang / spre'u sa sbrang rtsi phul ba snga ma ste/ 'di rnams yab sras mjal ba'i rjes su byung zhing cho 'phrul chen po'i sngon du gsal bas/ spyir thams cad bar skabs der byung ba yin gyi/ de dag re re'i snga phyi'i go rim ni rtogs par dka' bas 'dir bsgrigs pa ni bshad pa'i go rim tsam mo/ /re gcig pa cho 'phrul chen po ni rags rtsis kyi dbang du byas na/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar gyi dus phyed ni 'das/ phyed ni lus pa'i dus su cho 'phrul chen po nas lha babs kyi bar bstan pa yin te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe skye bo thams cad kyis sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun la mchod pas/ mu stegs byed rnams kyi bsod snyoms dang rnyed pa ngan par gyur to/ /der bdud sdig can gyis bsams pa/ ngas yun ring po nas go ta ma la glags bltas kyang ma rnyed de/ da ni mu stegs can rnams la mtho brtsam mo snyam —295—

nas/ 'od srung rdzogs byed kyi drung du kun tu rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu'i gzugs su sprul nas me 'bar ba dang / 'od 'byin pa dang / char 'bab pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan te/ gdan la 'khod nas dga' ba dang mgu ba'i gtam byas so/ /de bzhin du mu stegs ston pa drug las gzhan rnams kyi gzugs kyis kyang rim pas 'ongs te cho 'phrul bstan to/ /de'i tshe rdzogs byed kyis bsams pa/kye ma bdag gcig pu nyam chung bar zad de/ gzhan 'di dag ni mthu che ba rdzu 'phrul che ba'o snyam/ de bzhin du gzhan lnga po'i sar yang cho 'phrul de kho na 'dra bar bstan pas ston pa drug po so so nas bdag gcig pu nyam chung gi gzhan rnams rdzu 'phrul che'o snyam mo/ /de nas dus g.yin zhig na ston pa drug lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i skabs shig tu 'di skad ces gros gleng bar gyur te/ shes ldan dgasngon ni rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad kyis bdag cag la bkur sti byed pa yin na/ da ni go ta ma la byed kyi bdag cag la ma yin pas/ dge sbyong go ta ma 'di bdag cag gis mi'i chos bla ma'i cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i phyir bkug ste/des rdzu 'phrul gcig ston na bdag cag gis gnyis ston pa la sogs pa nyis 'gyur gyis lhag pa bstan par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas de dag rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i drung du song ste rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba byas nas/ lha bdag cag kyang rdzu 'phrul dang ye shes can du smra/ go ta ma yang rdzu 'phrul dang ye shes can du smra ba lags na/ bdag cag lhan cig rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ston du chug cig bdag cag lam gyi phyed du 'gro la/ go ta ma yang lam gyi phyed du khug gcig rgyal pos 'di skad du/ kyai ro dang 'dra ba khyed rnams kyis kyang —296—

sangs rgyas la rdzu 'phrul 'gran nam/ de nas ston pa drug phyir song ngo yang lan cig gzugs can snying po sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal bar 'gro ba'i lam du ston pa drug song nas sngar ltar smras pas/ don 'di la khyed nga la lan gsum gyi bar du zer na/ khyed rnams smyugs te btang ngo byas pas/ de dag phyogs de nasasong ste/ rgyal po 'di ni go ta ma'i phyogs byed kyi/ mnyan yod kyi rgyal po gsal rgyal de ni gzu bo'i zhes thos na/ dus lan cig der 'gro bar bya'o zhes so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ ston pa rgyal po'i khab nas mnyan yod du ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te rgyal byed kyi tshal du byon to/ /de'i rjes nyid nas ston pa drug po yang song ste/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi thad du phyin nas sngar bzhin brjod pas/rgyal pos de ltar na bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus te bya yi re zhig sdod cig de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal sangs rgyas kyi drung du phyin nas/ zhabs la phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ btsun pa mu stegs can rnams 'di skad ces mchi na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul bstan du gsol/ mu stegs can rnams 'thag tu gsol/ zhes sogs zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po nga ni dge slong rnams la yang khyim pa la rdzu 'phrul ston zhig ces mi zer gyi/ dge ba ni ma spyoms shig sdig pa ni bshogs shig ces ston no/ /lan gnyis su zhus kyang de skad gsung pa la/ lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ zhag bdun nas dus la bab par mkhyen nas de bzhin du bka' stsal to/ /rgyal pos mu stegs can dag la/ ston pa zhag bdun nas cho 'phrul ston par 'gyur gyi/ khyed rnams la bsham dgos pa ci yod pa gyis shig der mu stegs rnams kyis bgros —297—

pa/ go ta ma da lta cho 'phrul mi ston par zhag bdun gyi dus 'debs pa 'di ni/yang na ni go ta ma 'bros/ yang na ni grogs 'tshol ba yin/ gal te bros na ni der zad la/ re zhig bdag cag grogs btsal bar bya'o zhes gleng nas/ phyogs 'tshol ba'i phyir thams cad so sor bkram ste song ngo / /de nas de dag da ni zhag bdun las gcig 'das te drug lus so/ /gnyis 'das te lnga lus so zhes sogs sems brtan par gnas pa med de song ba las/ grong khyer rtswa can ku sha'i grong du kun tu rgyu rab bzang can du song ba na/ bdag cag gis dge sbyong go ta ma cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i phyir bos kyis grogs gyis shig /des smras pa/de ni ma legs te dge sbyong de ni rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba'o/ /nga sngon dal gyis 'bab ba'i mtsho 'gram na nyin mo gnas shing / bsod snyoms blangs te mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram du za ba'i tshe/ der gnas pa'i lhas chu bcus te ster ro/ /go ta ma'i slob ma dge tshul skul byed kyis phyag dar khrod kyi gos ma dros pa'i 'gram du 'khrud pa na/ de na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis khrus khu blangs nas lha rang rang gi mgo bor 'debs so/ /de'i cho 'phrul gyis nga yang pham par byas na/ bdag cag gi mkhan po rnams dang yang mi mnyam mo/ /zhes smras pas/ 'di yang go ta ma'i phyogs so snyam ste song ngo / /de nas nags tshal gcig na drang srong mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa lnga brgya yod de/ de rnams la grogs gyis shig byas pas/de dag gis kyang grogs bya bar khas blangs te/ nam ran pa'i dus na brda thongs shig byas so/ /de nas mu stegs rnams rab tu mgu ste song ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pha sbun nu bor gyur ba gzhon nu nag po zhes bya ba zhig pho —298—

brang dang nye bar song ba las btsun mo'i 'khor zhig gis khang thog nas me tog gi phreng ba rnying pa bor ba de la phog pas blon po phra ma mkhan rnams kyis/ nag po ni lha'i btsun mo dang 'khri'o zhes smras pa na/ rgyal po rnams ni ma brtags par spyod pa mang bas nag po'i rkang lag gcod du bcug gzhi mdo zhig na de nye du ngu bas bskor zhing 'dug go /phyogs der ston pa drug po snga phyir rim can du 'ongs pa la/ nye du rnams kyis 'di gsos par mdzod ces byas pa la/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'gro'o/ /'phags pa kun dga' bo phyogs der byung ba na/ de dag sngar bzhin zer bas kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la zhus shing /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa bzhin du kun dga' bos gzhon nu nag po'i sar song nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog yin pa'i bden pas nag po'i yan lag sngon bzhin du gyur cig ces brjod pa'i mjug kho nar sngon bzhin du sos par gyur te/ skye bo thams cad kun dga' bos mu stegs phams par byas so zhes zer ro/ /de nas gzhon nu nag po ston pa'i spyan sngar song zhing / ston pas chos bstan pas phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu yang thob/ rdzu 'phrul yang bsgrubs so/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis khyim du khrid par brtsams pa la/ bdag sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur bgyid cing 'di nyid du sdod do/ /rgyal pos kyang gnang ste kun dga' ra ba zhig gi nang du 'chag pa'i spyod lam gyis 'dug pas/ dum bu'i kun dga' ra ba zhes grags so/ /de ltar rgyal pos zhag bdun po'i bar la mnyan yod dang rgyal byed tshal gyi bar di cho 'phrul gyi khang pa chen po lha'i khang bzang dang rjes su —299—

mthun par byas shing / bzhugs khri gser las grub pa rin po che du mas spras pa yang bshams so/ /mu stegs can gyi dge bsnyen sogs ston pa drug po'i phyogs 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i cho 'phrul gyi khang pa drug rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / gdan khri drug kyang bshams zin to/ /de nas nyin zhag brgyad pa la mu stegs can rnams rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor nas/shin tu snga bar 'ongs te rgyal po la/ bdag cag ni 'dir mchis lags na/dge sbyong go ta ma 'gug tu gsol/ zhes pho nya btang bas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa 'dun khang du song ste bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bya ba spyan 'dren du btang ngo / /de la ston pas khyod song shig nga 'ong ngo / /zhes gsungs nas/ bram ze bla mas tshur 'ongs pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das bya ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar nam mkha'i dkyil du 'phags nas cho 'phrul khang pa'i 'dun khang du gshegs so/ /skye bo thams cad kyis de mthong nas ngo mtshar ba'i sgra 'byin zhing / rgyal pos ston pa drug la bcom ldan 'das kyis cho 'phrul bstan zin gyi/ khyed rnams kyis ston zhig ces so/ /de'i mod la dum bu'i kun dga' ra ba pa ste gzhon nu nag pos ri spos ngad ldan nas a mra'i sdong po yal ga lo 'bras su rgyas pa/ bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pas brgyan pa zhig cho 'phrul khang pa'i byang phyogs su bzhag go /de bzhin du khyim bdag ngan legs sbyin zhes bya ba phyir mi 'ong thob pa zhig gis kyang sum cu rtsa gsum nas lha'i shing gi yal ga blangs nas lho phyogs su bzhag go/ de dag la yang rgyal pos sngar bzhin brjod pas/ cho 'phrul de go ta ma'i lags sam/ bdag cag gi lags sus 'tshal zhes spyi —300—

brtol smra bar byed do/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pas zhag bdun gyi dus 'debs pa yang cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i gdul bya rnams 'du bar 'gyur ba'i dus la dgongs ba ste/ der cho 'phrul chen po blta bar spro ba'i mi dpag tu med pa yang 'dus/ lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /dri za dang / grul bum dang / mi'am ci dang / lha ma yin dang 'byung po grangs med pa dag kyang 'dus par mkhyen pa na/ ston pas zhabs bkrus te 'dun khang gi nang du gshegs nas me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pas sgo 'phar gyi gseb nas me 'od byung zhing / de las mched pa bzhin du cho 'phrul khang pa'i phyi nang thams cad kha dog dang dbyibs dang 'od kyi spro ba rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i me dpung du 'bar bar gyur pa na/ cho 'phrul khang pa mes tshig go snyam nas mu stegs can rnams rab tu dga' zhing / go ta ma mthu dang ldan na 'di zhi bar bgyid grang ces smra'o/ /de ma thag me lce'i cho 'phrul bsdus pa na/ dri ma nag nog mi mdzes pa thams cad ni me 'od kyis sbyangs/ 'dun khang sngar bas kyang gsal zhing mdzes la dri ma med par snang ngo / /de nas rgyal po dang skye bo thams cad yid dga' ba skyes te/ rgyal pos de dag la ston pas rdzu 'phrul bstan zin gyi/da khyed rnams kyi res la bab bo byas pas de dag spobs pa med de cang mi smra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs g.yas pa dri gtsang khang gis sa la bsnun pas sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa na/ sngar ston pa drug gis phyogs su btsal ba'i drang srong lnga brgya gangs ri dang nye ba'i nags khrod na gnas pa de rnams/ der sa g.yos pa de ston pa drug gis brda btang ba yin no snyam ste nam —301—

mkha'i lam las 'phur zhing 'ongs pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snang ba'i 'od zer chen po bkye ba la bstad de 'ongs pas sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong ba tsam gyis shin tu dad de/ sa la babs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te 'dug pa la chos bstan pas bden pa mthong zhing / rab tu byung bar gsol ba btab pa la tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs te/ slar yang gdams ngag bstan pas thams cad kyang de nyid du dgra bcom pa thob bo de nas ston pa dgra bcom gsar pa lnga brgya pos kyang bskor te/ cho 'phrul gyi 'dun khang gi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rdzu 'phrul len gyi ma dge bsnyen ma dang / khyim bdag ngan pa legs sbyin dang / dge tshul skul byed dang /dge tshul ma rjed med dang / dge slong ma ut+pa la'i mdog dang / 'phags pa mong gal gyi bu rnams re re nas mu stegs can 'di dag bdag gis 'thag tu stsal/lha dang mi rnams dga' bar yang bgyid/ skye bo dam pa rnams yi rang bar bgyi'o zhes zhus pa na/ ston pas mu stegs byed rnams nga 'bod kyi/ khyed ma yin pas sems khral chung ngur 'dug cig ces zlog par mdzad do/ /de nas 'khor dpag tu med pa'i dbus der bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gsal rgyal la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal bo chen po nga la mu stegs can dang lhan cig cho 'phrul ston par gsol ba 'debs pa su yin/ rgyal pos stan las langs te thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ btsun pa bdag lags te bstan du gsol/ skye rgu kun la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur lags so/ /zhes so/ /de nas ston pa mnyam par bzhag ste/gdan las mi snang bar gyur nas phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' la spyod lam bzhi —302—

mdzad pa dang / me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te 'od zer drug 'gyed pa dang / me 'bar zhing chu 'khrug pa sogs zung gi cho 'phrul dang / gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa du ma bstan nas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /rdzu 'phrul 'di ni nyan thos rnams dang thun mong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bla na med pa'i cho 'phrul ston par gsol ba 'debs pa su yin/ rgyal pos sngar bzhin gsol bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas pa sa la reg par mdzad pas sa 'og nas klu rnams kyis phul ba'i gser gyi pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i chu ba dang rdo rje'i ze ba can zhig sa brtol nas byung ste/ pad+ma de'i snying po la bcom ldan 'das nyid bzhugs so/ /pad+ma'i sdong po yang shin tu che bar gyur te/ 'og min gyi bar du khyab pa las/ g.yas g.yon sogs phyogs kun du rab tu rgyas nas pad+ma chen po lnga brgyar gyur pa la sprul pa'i sangs rgyas lnga brgya bzhugs so/ /de la sangs rgyas kha cig ni me 'bar/ la la ni 'od gsal bar mdzad/ gzhan dag ni char 'bebs/ 'ga' zhig ni glog 'byin/ de bzhin du kun shes par lung ston pa dang / zhu ba zhu ba dang / lan 'debs pa dang / 'chag pa dang / bzhugs pa dang /bzhengs pa dang / gzim pa la sogs pa mdzad pa tha dad pa dang / cho 'phrul tha dad pa dpag tu med pa zhig ston no/ /der byis pa gzhon nu tshun chad dang /srog chags phra mo tshun chod kyis kyang mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /der rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo 'bum phrag du ma dag dang / nam mkha' la lha 'bum —303—

phrag du ma gnas pa rnams mig mi 'dzum par lta zhing bstod dbyangs byed/ rnga bo che dag rdung / dung sgril ma dag 'bud/ rol mo sna tshogs pa 'khrol/ la la glu len/ la la gar byed/ lha rnams kyis rin po che'i me tog dang / me tog sna tshogs pa dang / dri zhim po'i phye ma rnams dang / lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs dang /rgyan sna tshogs kyang 'thor bar byed/ a la la zhes sgra bsgrags so/ /byol song rnams kyang yid bde ba skyes te rang rigs kyi sgra skad sna tshogs pa sgrog ste/ glang po che ni 'bod/ rnga mong ni lhong / rta ni 'tsher/ rma bya yar ba sogs byed de thams cad rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / sprul pa rnams kyis cig car du/ ji srid nyi ma ma shar ba/ /de srid srin bu me khyer gsal/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba na/ /mog mog por 'gyur gsal mi 'gyur/ /ji srid de bzhin gshegs ma byung / /rtog ge pa rnams sngon gsal te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten snang / /rtog ge mi gsal de'i slob min/ /zhes so/ /dge slong dag cho 'phrul chen po mi snang bar 'gyur gyi/ mtshan ma zung cig dge slong rnams kyis yang mtshan rtags su bzung ste/ de ma thag tu mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos mu stegs byed rnams la/ da khyod kyi res la bab kyi rdzu 'phrul ston cig de nas rdzogs byed ni gnag lhas kyi bu la gru sugs byed/ des ni yang dag rgyal ba can la/ des ni skra'i lwa ba can la/ des kyang nog can la/ des kyang gnyen gyi bu la/ des kyang rdzogs byed la ste/ cang mi smra'o/ /rgyal pos kyang lan gsum du bskul bas/ sngar ltar gru sugs lan gsum byed cing / de dag —304—

yul yul por gyur la/ zhum zhing sems khong du chud la gdong smad de 'dug go/de'i tshe gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje 'khor de nyid 'dug pas/ blun po 'di rnams yun ring po nas bcom ldan 'das la mtho 'tsham nga sa 'di rnams 'bros par 'gyur ba'i thabs bya'o zhes te/ nye skor gzhan gang la 'dro med par mu stegs rnams gang 'dug pa dang / gang song sar char rlung drag po mi bzad pa btang ba dang / rdo rje me 'bar ba thogs pa'i gnod sbyin mi bzad pas phyi bsnyegs byed par yang mthong nas/ shin tu bred de phyogs thams cad du 'thor zhing bros so/ /gnag lhas kyi bu la sogs pa ni ri phug tu'o/ /rgyal ba can la sogs pa ni rtswa tshang tshing du'o/ /mi pham la sogs pa ni nags thibs por ro/ /nog can ni 'dun khang du'o/ /gnyen gyi bu ni mgron khang du zhugs so/ /ston pas kyang /'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' ra ba ljon shing dang / /mchod rten rnams la skyabs su 'gro/ /ces sogs gsungs/ der skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos rgya cher gsungs pas/ mu stegs byed kyi dge bsnyen rang yang khri phrag dgus bden pa mthong ba la sogs pa gzha na skye bo dpag tu med pa zhig 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang / byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la dad pa la bkod do/ /'od srung rdzogs byed ni snga rol gyi dus zhig nas/ slob ma la la la ni bdag dang 'jig rten rtag par ston/ la la la ni mi rtag par/ la la la ni gnyis kar/ la la la ni gnyis min du ston pa sogs lung bstan par mi 'os pa bcu bzhir bshad do/ /dus de'i tshe char rlung gis bdas shing bros —305—

nas/ nam zhig myong rlud sangs pa na mya ngan gyi mes gdungs shing / dus gzhan zhig na rang nyid gcig pur 'gro ba la/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis gdungs te chu bsil ba 'dod nas 'tshol zhing phyin pa las/ lam du ma ning zhig gis tshig rtsub pos spyos pa na/ da ni mi'i tha ma 'di lta bus kyang spyos so snyam ste yi ho de/ rdzing 'gram du song nas bye mas gang ba'i bum pa mgul du btags te rdzing bu zab mo der mchongs nas dus las 'das so/ /de nas phyis de'i slob ma dag gis phyi bzhin du song nas btsal ba na ma rnyed de/ phan tshun 'dus nas rang cag rnams la mkhan pos lung bstan pa dag yod dam zhes blo bsdur ba na/ thams cad mi mthun par gyur te/ da ni mkhan po nyid btsal la dri bar bya'o zhes 'tshol du song ba/ rdzing bu de dang nye bar sleb pa na/ bu mo zhig dang 'phrad de de la dris pas/ ngan song sems can dmyal ba pa/ /lag pa brkyangs nas 'gro ba yi/ /rdzogs byed de ni chus g.yengs te/ /rkang lag skya bor gyur zhing 'dug /ces zer ba na/ de dag cang mi zer bar rdzing bu'i 'gram du phyin pas/rdzogs byed de ltar shi ba mthong ste/ de la yid brtan pa'i slob ma rnams/mkhan po'i de kho na nyid 'di bden te/ gzhan dag ni gti mug go zhes de dag kyang bye mas gang ba'i bum pa mgul du btags nas rdzing der mchongs te shi'o/ /de nas lhag ma de dag mtha' 'khob tu bros shing sngar gyi rdzogs byed dang rus dang ming gcig pa zhig ston par bskos nas sngar bzhin ston pa drug gi tha snyad du byas te yul dbus rnams su ngo tsha bas phal cher mtha' 'khob tu gnas par byed do/ /—306—

re gnyis pa drang srong lnga brgya btul ba ni/ yang mnyan yod dang nye ba'i nags khrod cig na/ drang srong lnga brgya tsam sgyin sreg byed pas gnas so/ /de dag 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ spyin sreg gi thab kyi nang thams cad du/ ston pa'i spyos rjes re mthong zhing me spor bar mi nus par byin gyis brlabs pa na/ drang srong rnams na re/ rjes 'di'i mthu las bdag cag gis me spor bar ma nus te/ 'di ni mthu che bas na/ lha chen po'i rjes yin yang dag go snyam ste/ zhabs rjes de nyid la bsreg rdzas phul bas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus me rang 'bar du gyur te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la thug par song bas/ drang srong rnams ya mtshan gyur te gnas pa na rjes de lta bu me thab kyi drung nas rgyal byed kyi tshal la thug gi bar du mthong bar mdzad pa na/ drang srong rnams kyang de'i rjes bcad de rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /der bcom ldan 'das mthong bas shin tu dad pa la/ yang dag pa'i chos gsungs pas thams cad kyang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob/ de nas tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu yang mngon du byas so/ /re gsum pa lnga len gnyis bsdums pa ni/ yang lho phyogs lnga len dang /byang phyogs lnga len gyi rgyal po gnyis rtag tu mi mthun par gnas pa las/ rgyal po gsal rgyal ni de gnyis ka'i mdza' bskes yin no/ /de nas 'di gnyis ji ltar bsdum par bya snyam pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ni ma dul ba 'dul ba yin pa'i phyir gsol ba gdab bo snyam nas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar song ste gsol ba btab pas cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod —307—

nas mi snang par mdzad de rgyal po gnyis kyi sa mtshams su gshegs nas/ de gnyis 'thab pa'i sems skye ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas/ so so'i dpung yan lag bzhi go bskon te 'ongs pa la/ lho phyogs pa rnams la ni byang phyogs pa rgyal te/ lho phyogs pa rang nyid shin tu pham par byas par mthong ba dang / byang phyogs pa'i dmag rnams kyis kyang / /lho phyogs pa'i dpung stobs dang ldan pas/ /byang phyogs pa nyid pham par mthong ba de lta bur byin gyis brlabs nas/so so'i rgyal po shing rtar zhugs te 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ba las/ gcig gis gcig mi mthong bar byin gyi brlabs so/ /de nas zhabs la phyag byas te 'khod pa la dus gcig tu chos bstan pa na/ lho phyogs lnga len gyi rgyal po la bden pa bzhi'i gtam du gyur te/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob cing / tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa'i bar du gyur la/ byang phyogs lnga len gyi rgyal po la bla na med pa'i byang chub la spro ba'i gtam du gyur te/ des zla ba gsum du sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs shing / mjug tu zhal zas ro brgya pa'i gdugs tshod bshams/ bcom ldan 'das la na bza' 'bum ri ba dang /dge slong rnams la yang ras zung re re phul te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang legs so bka' stsal te/ rgyal po de ma 'ongs pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya bar lung bstan to/ /re bzhi pa sha za stong btul ba ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal bo'i khab —308—

kyi 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod dang ma ga dha'i bar gyi sa mtshams/ dgon pa'i lam nyam nga ba zhig na sha za stong phrag gcig gnas nas mi dang dud 'gro'i skye bo shin tu mang bo dag kha ldon par byed do/ /de thos nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gzugs can snying po la bskul/ gzugs can snying pos ston pa'i drung du phyin te yul ma ga bhā dang / ko sa la'i bar gyi sha za ma rungs pa'i tshogs pa chen po 'di rnams 'dul du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas cang ma gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po song nas mi ring bar bcom ldan 'das rgyal bo'i khab nas mi snang bar mdzad de/ sha za rnams kyi gnas shing swā la'i nags khung du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed par mdzad pa na/ rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs shes te/ rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po rang nyid 'khor gnod sbyin dbang che bar grags pa rnams dang lhan cig ston pa'i spyan sngar song nas sku'i drung na lubon do/ /de'i tshe sha za'i tshogs rnams kyis thag ring po nas rang gi gnas sangs rgyas gyis mnan pa mthong nas mi sdug pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pa ston gyin rgyugs te 'ongs na/ nye bar phyin pa'i tshe rnam thos kyi bu gnod spyin dbang che ba mang po dang bcas pa rnams kyis sha za de rnams btags shing gtses pa na/ de dag skrag cing dngangs pas bros pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs thams cad me lce chen pos 'khor bar sprul pas de'i tshe 'bros pa'i gnas ma rnyed de/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la gus pas skyabs su song zhing / ston pas kyang gang zhig thos —3glu—

na sha za rnams kyi sems rgyud dge bar 'gyur ba'i chos bstan pas de dag rab tu dad pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas yang dag par blangs so/ /re lnga pa 'dus pa chen po bstan pa sogs ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal na dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig bzhugs te/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i chos ston par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe lha dbang ches che bar grags pa thams cad dang / gzhan yang 'byung po mthu chen rnams 'dus so/ /de nas tshangs rigs kyi lha bzhi 'ongs nas ched du brjod pa'ang byas/ ston pas kyang sngon gyis sangs rgyas rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i rnams la'ang da ltar gyi bzhin du 'dus pa 'di lta bu 'dus so zhes ched du brjod pa'ang mdzad nas/ de'i tshe slob ma zhes bya ba lnga brgya pa phrag gnyis dang /brgya dang bcu ste de dag ni lha mthu che ba 'ba' zhig yin te de rnams dang /nags tshal gyi gnod sbyin stong phrag bdun dang / gser can gyi rigs stong phrag drug dang / shar phyogs rnam rgyal gyi tshal nas 'ongs pa'i ri mnyam zhes bya ba stong phrag gsum ste/ gnod sbyin lha'i rigs stong phrag bcu drug go /rgyal po'i khab kyi gnod sbyin chu srin zhes bya ba 'khor 'bum phrag mang po dang / kun gyi bzhes gnyen dang / kun gyi lha 'khor mang po dang bcas pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi sras dgu bcu rtsa gcig re dang bcas pa dang / slu byed la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i g.yog tu gyur pa'i sde dpon shin du mang ba dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / 'jog po la sogs pa'i —310—

klu'i rgyal po shin tu mang po dang / klu rgyal zil gnon len la sogs pa mkha' lding gi rgyal po mang po dang / thags bzang ris dang / rab bkra la sogs pa nas stobs ldan gyi bu brgyad dang bcas pa'i bar du lha min gyi rgyal po go bgos pa rnams dang / chu lha mo la sogs pa lha'i bud med brgya dang / 'jug sel sbun gnyis dang / zla ba dang nyi ma la sogs pa gza' skar brgya dang / zhi ba mo dang dka' bzlog ma la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma brgya dang / sngo sangs ma dang phag mo la sogs pa ma mo brgya dang / dkar mo dang rgyal byed ma la sogs pa gnod sbyin mo brgya dang / bde byed dga' ldan la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khams gong ma'i lha tshogs brgya dang drug cu dang / tshangs pa chen po dang kun 'gyed gzhon nu la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha mang po dang / thams cad kyi tha mar 'ongs pa nag po sde bo che 'jigs byed chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so/ /de ltar grangs su smos pa de dag kyang dbang che ba che bar grags pa gtso bo gtso bo rnams kyi grangs yin gyi/ der 'dus pa 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa lha thams cad kyi grangs ni ma yin no/ /phan tshun 'dus pa'i shar phyogs lta bu phyogs gcig gi mtha' nas gcig shos nub phyogs lta bu'i mtha' lha rnams kyi mig gis kyang mi mthong ba'i rgya chen po 'dus so/ /de dag 'dus nas yun ring du gnas shing / rang rang gi bsam pa dang mtshungs pa bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos dri ma med pa'i char chen po phab pa/ de'i tshe lha la sogs nga/'i 'byung po thams cad rma/chog gi dad pa nga/nga / skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas la bkod cing / lha ches mang pos bden pa mthong ba dang / 'byung po mang ngo/ zhig byang chub—31/—

tu sems kyang bskyed/ rang rang gi rig sngags dang srog gi snying po thams cad kyang mdongs gsol du phul te/ 'ga' zhig dam la bzhag pa dang / 'ga' zhig chos kyi srung mar bsko ba la sogs pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas thams cad rang rang gi gnas su gyes par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro ba kun la shis pa brjod par yang mdzad do/ /'di ni snyus pa chen po'i mdo bstan pa'i dus te/ theg pa thun mong las ni 'dus pa chen po'i mdo nyung zad tsam zhig yod pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /yang de rjes su sku'i skye ba lnga brgyar yab tu gyur pa'i bram ze rgan po zhig bden pa la bkod nas tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /re drug pa tshong pa lnga brgya gnyis ni/ yang mnyan yod nas tshong pa lnga brgya zong khyer te yul gzhan du song song ba las nags khrod chen po gcig tu phyin pa na/ de na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gdug pa can rnams kyis rlung nag chen po mun sros pa lta bu btang zhing / 'jigs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pa mngon sum du bstan te tshong pa rnams kyi thog tu rgyugs pa na/ tshong pa thams cad ches skrag ste lha'o cog la gsol ba 'debs so/ /der dge bsnyen zhig yod pas/ kyai skyabs ma yin pa la skyabs btsal bas ci bya/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su songs shig /ces smras pas de thams cad kyis/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo bdag cag skyabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ de rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis glang po che'i sna zhags lta bu'i phyag brkyangs te nags khrod de nas tshong pa lnga brgya rdzas dang bcas pa blangs te —312—

mnyan yod dang nye bar 'jog par mdzad do/ /tshong pa de rnams yul du sleb pa na/ sangs rgyas la dad pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste 'khod pa la chos bstan pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob cing ched du brjod pa'ang byas la tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs shing / ji ltar lung phog pa ltar bsgoms pas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /de bzhin du tshong pa lnga brgya rgya mtshor song ba rlung gis bdas shing rlabs kyis bskyod nas/ rgya mtsho'i dbus kyi brag ri'i sul du mkhar ba legs par bskyabs nas dgra bcom pa'i bar du thob pa'i gtam rgyud kyang yod do/ /re bdun pa lha las babs pa ni/ gang gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa de phyin chad lha dang mi rnams sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa kho na la mngon par dad do/ /der dge slong rnams rnyed bkur mang zhing ches mang bas/ so so skye bo rnams kyi spong ba la bar du gcod par gyur pa gzigs nas/ 'byor ba dang rnyed bkur mang ches pa de nyid rgyun bcad pa'i phyir dang / yum lha'i gnas su skye ba bzhes pa de nyid bden pa la 'god pa'i phyir du/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa ri rab kyi rtse mo lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du gshegs so/ /der shing yongs 'dus brtol dang nye ba lwa ba dkar po lta bu'i rdo leb tu bzhugs te yum la sogs pa lha rnams la chos ston par mdzad do/ /'phags pa mong gal gyi bu chen po la sogs pa dge slong rab tu mang po dag mnyan yod du dbyar gnas par mdzad pa na/ der dge slong rnams kyis mong gal gyi bu chen po la/ der de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs gang du —313—

dbyar gnas par mdzad ces dris pa la sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su mdzad do zhes bshad do/ /de nas zla ba gsum 'das pa na/ 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i tshogs rnams mong gal gyi bu chen po'i drung du lhags nas/ bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das ma mthong nas yun ring lon te shin tu gdung par gyur gyi/ 'phags pa bzhud la/ bdag cag la ni der 'ong pa'i rdzu 'phrul med/ lha rnams la ni dzaskru'i gling 'dir 'ong ba la dka' ba med pa'i phyir dzasbu'i gling du gzhegs par zhus shig de nas 'phags pas rdzu 'phrul gyis song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas te mtha' cig tu 'dug nas 'di skad ces/ lha'i 'khor 'di dag ni 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pas 'dir skyes so/ /zhes zhug/ ston pas kyang de bzhin no zhes bsngags so/ /de nas lha rnams ston pa'i drung nas song ba'i 'og tu/ 'phags pa mong gal gyi bus 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i 'phrin gsol bas/ khyod song la/ zhag bdun nas grong khyer saX kā shi'i a pa dza ra'i nags u dum wa ra'i shing drung du gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes sgos shig /des skad cig la dzam+bu gling du 'ongs nas 'khor rnam pa bzhi la bshad pas/ de rnams kyis sa phyogs de byi dor byas shing mchod pa sna tshogs pa bshams so/ /de lta bu'i bar skabs zhag bdun gyi ring la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'thab bral nas 'og min gyi bar du gshegs te/ sa phyogs gzhan du 'gro bar mi spyod la gdul byar ni gyur pa dpag tu med pa yod de/ de 3dra mtha' dag la chos bstan to/ /de ltar na lha'i 'gro ba grangs med tshad med pa smin zhing grol ba la bkod nas/ slar yang yul sum cu rtsa gsum du byon pa na/ lha'i —314—

dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das dzaskru'i gling du gshegs par bzhed dam/ zhes zhus pa la de ltar ro zhes bka' stsal te des bzo bo las thams cad pa la bka' bsgos nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum nas dzasbu'i gling gi bar la dbus su be+e rje bya'i skas dang / g.yas su gser dang / g.yon du shel gyi skas byas/ de'i tshe lta tshangs pa gser gyi skas la 'bab cing gzugs khams kyi lha dang lhan cig tu sku'i g.yas nas 'gro/ brgya byin ni gdugs rtsibs ma stong dang ldan pa 'dzin zhing shel gyi skas las 'bab bzhin du 'dod khams kyi lha du mas bskor te sku'i g.yon phyogs nas 'gro/ bcom ldan 'das ni dbus kyi be+e sa zla bya' skas la gshegs te/ gal te zhabs kho nas byon na ni mu stegs dag na re/ dge sbyong go ta ma lha'i 'dod yon dang bzang mo dag mthong bas rdzu 'phrul nyams so zhes 'phya bar 'gyur la/ rdzu 'phrul kho nas gshegs na ni lha rnams kyi skas btsugs pa don med cing bsod nams mi 'phel bar gzigs nas/ bar 'ga' ni rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ res 'ga' ni zhabs kyis gshegs so/ /mi'i 'gro ba'i dri mi zhim pa ni lha rnams kyis mi bzod pa la/ ston pas tsan+dan sa mchog gi drir byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i skabs su tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor shing drung na 'dug pas mthong ste/ kye ma 'o lha 'di dag kyang deng nyid rang gi gnas su 'gyes/ mi 'di dag thams cad kyang lo brgya tshun chad la 'chi/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa ya twa myur du mya ngan las bzla'o snyam yid 'byung bas rkyen byas te bden pa yang mthong / mi ring bar dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sa la byon te bzhugs khri bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /sa phyogs thams cad 'khor —315—

rnam pa bzhi dang / rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pas yongs su bskor te chos kyi sgo du ma dag 'byed par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe 'phags ma ut+pa la'i mdog bdag dge slong ma'i gzugs kyis phyin na ston pa'i spyan sngar mi gtong ngo snyam nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas par sprul te song ba na/ 'khor rnams ya mtshan du gyur zhing rtog pa sna tshogs dang bcas pas lam phye'o/ /de 'phags ma ut+pa la'i mdog yin par tshe dang ldan pa 'char kas dri bsung las rtogs so/ /der 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam pa mthong bas/ 'khor kha cig ni lha'i srid pa la chags/ 'ga' zhig ni mi'i srid pa la chags pa las/ de bzlog pa'i phyir chos gsungs pas 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang / byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa dpag tu med do/ /bka' stsal pa/ sa rnams gcig gis thob pa dang / /lha rnams su yang 'gro ba dang / /yang na ting 'dzin thob pa bas/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mchog /ces sogs gsungs so/ /de dag ni lha las babs pa'i mdzad pa ste cho 'phrul chung ba'am/ cho 'phrul gnyis pa'am/ cho 'phrul phyi mar yang grags skad do/ /re brgyad pa grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs pa ni/ de'i tshe lho phyogs grong khyer bzang byed na mi bsod nams can drug yod de/ khyim bdag lug ces bya ba mdzod stong pa la'ang mig gis bltas ma thag gang bar 'gyur ba dang /de'i chung mas mi gcig la spyor ba'i bza' ba bcos na/ mi brgya stong la khyeb pa'i bza' bca' 'gyung ba dang / de'i bu la pa na lnga brgya pa'i snod stong pa sked —316—

par btags na/ pa na brgya stong gis gang bar 'gyur ba dang / de'i mna' mas ni dri bzang gcig sbyar na brgya stong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / bran phos ni rol gcig rmos pas rol bdun rmos par 'gyur ba dang / bran mos ni 'bru snod gang brus pas 'bru snod bdun tshar bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i tshe bzang byed pa rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ kun dga' bo nga grong khyer bzang byed du 'gro yi/ der 'gro ba dag chos gos longs shig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas par rim gyis phyogs der gshegs so/ /cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i rjes la mu stegs can rnams yul mtha' 'khob tu bros te gnas pa las/ grong khyer bzang byed na gnas pa'i mu stegs rnams kyis sangs rgyas 'byon pa thos nas rod rod por gyur te de 'dir byung na bdag cag la rnyed pa med par 'gyur gyi/ thabs zhig bya'o snyam nas/ yul de'i khyim bdag la sogs pa skye bo rnams kyi drung du song nas/ chos thob par gyur cig bltas zin gyi 'gro'o zer ba la ci yin dris pas/ khyed rnams kyi 'byor pa mthong zin gyi rgud pa ma mthong ba la 'gro'o/ /dge sbyong go ta ma sbu gri'i ser ba 'bebs shing 'ong gi khyed du ma zhig gi bu dang khyim thabs med par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams na re/ de lta na bdag cag spang bar bgyi'am bzhugs shig mu stegs rnams na re/ 'o na nye skor gyi skye bo thams cad grong khyer gyi nang du chug rtswa sngon po thams cad rngos/ mgron khang la sogs pa 'dug gnas thams cad ni bshig /me tog dang 'bras bu'i thams cad ni chod/ lteng ka la sogs pa'i chu thams cad la dug thob cig—317—

ces zer ba bzhin de dag gis kyang byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa nye bar byon pa na/ rlung gi lha rnams kyis rlung btang nas chu dug can rnams bskams/ char 'bebs pa'i lhas char phab ste yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ngo / /me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing rnams ni gsos/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha la sogs pas 'dug gnas dang yo byad phun sum tshogs par byas te/de dag kyang brgya byin gyi bkas bskul ba'o/ /de nas bzang byed pa rnams kyis rtog mkhan btang bas/ lam gyi 'byor ba rnams shin tu rgyas par mthong nas/ slar ldog ste song nas bzang byed pa rnams la smras pas/ mu stegs byed rnams na re/ go ta ma de ni sems med pa'ang 'di ltar du sgyur bar byed na/ khyed cag mi 'gyur ba srid re kan/ da ni kho bo cag 'gro'o/ /de rnams na re bzhugs shig /'o na dam tshig bca' dgos te khyed cag su yang go ta ma'i drung du mi 'gro la/ gal te su 'gro ba de la pa ṇa drug cu'i chad pa gcod na sdod do/ /yul pa de rnams kyis kyang de ltar khrims bcas so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das grong khyer bzang byed kyi lho phyogs kyi gnas na bzhugs so/ /ser skya nas bzang byed du bag mar btang ba'i bu mo zhig yod pa/des de'i nub mo ra ba'i kha nas bltas pa na sangs rgyas mun khung na bzhugs par mthong ste/ gal te ra ba 'di la skas zhig yod na mar me 'bul du 'gro ba la snyam pa na/ ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ra ba ste lcags ri'i phyi la them skas sprul pas/ de song ste spyan sngar mar me phul/ chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo de la bka' stsal pa/ khyod khyim bdag lug gi sar song la/ nad med par gyur —318

cig khyod kyi ched du nga 'dir 'ongs na ci'i phyir sgo bcad de 'dug ces gsung ngo smros shig khrims bcas so zer na/ khyod kyi bu'i sked pa las pa ṇa brgya stong zad med du 'byung na/ drug cu byin nas 'ongs mi nus sam zhes smros shig bu mo nges kyang phyir ldog ste de ltar smras pa na/ khyim bdag lug gis bsams pa/'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'o snyam ste/ pa ṇa drug cu sgo drung du ba theg nas/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i them skas de las/ babs te spyan sngar song nas chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo / khyim bdag lug gis zhus pa/ bzang byed kyi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis kyang chos 'di lta bu thob par 'gyur ram/ bka' stsal pa/ phal cher gyis thob par 'gyur ro/ /des bsams pa/ 'o na grong khyer gyi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad la phan gdags par bya'o snyam nas nam ma langs pa la grong khyer du ldog nas phyin/nangs par nam langs pa na gzhi mdor gser pa ṇa'i phung po chen po sbungs te su zhig bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'dod pa de la chad pa gang dgos ngas gzhal lo zhes dril bsgrags pa na/ skye bo thams cad dge'o dge'o tshogs kyi khrims tshogs kyis bzhig pa la 'gal ba ci yod ces rgyugs te song ba las/mu stegs rnams kyis sgo yang bsrungs pa dang / phan tshun bdos te 'gro ma thub pa la/ gnod spyin lag na rngo rjes lcags ri la rdo rjes bsnun te dral lo/ /der skye bo thams cad dgag pa med par song ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i nye 'khor kho ra khor yug dpag tshad gcig tu mi'i 'gro bas khyab par gyur pa la/rab tu zab cing rgya che ba'i chos yun ring du bstan pas 'bras bu bzhi thob pa —319—

dang / byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa dpag tu med cing / thams cad kyang skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin pa la bkod do/ /re dgu pa dpal sbed btul ba ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe sngar gyi khye'u me skyes de'i sring mo'i khyo khyim bdag dpal sbed ces bya ba gcer bu pa'i dge bsnyen zhig yod do/ /der me skyes kyis dpal sbed la khyod kyis dge 'dun la yon phul zhig bsod nams su 'gyur ro/ /dpal sbed kyis smras pa/ khyod kyis kyang gcer bu pa gang po la yon phul zhig zer te/ de'i dge ba'i bar chad du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ me skyes kyis der khas blangs te/ gang po la zhur phyin pas gang pos bsams pa/ 'di go ta ma la sun/ bdag la dad do snyam nas khas blangs so/ /sang nyin gang pa 'khor bcas chas pa na/ dpal sbed kyis gang po la/ go ta ma ni so so'i khyim du bzhud khar them pa la 'gom pa na 'dzum ston/ de la nyan thos zhig gis rgyu 'dri/ de nas go ta mas kyang lung ston par byed de tshul des khyim pa dad par byed na/khyed kyis kyang de bzhin du mdzod cig byas so/ /de nas gcer bu pa gang pos me skyes kyi khyim du sleb ste them pa la rkang pa bzhag nas gad mo dgod do/ /gcer bu pa gcig gis rgyu dris pas/ chu bo dregs bral gyi 'gram na skyes pa'i shing cig la gnas pa'i spre'u zhig spre'u mo la chags pas ded pa na/ spre'u mo 'dred de chu la shor ba na spre'u de yang chu la mchongs te shi'o/ /de la nga ni sems can rnams 'dod pa'i rgyus sdug bsngal lo snyam mo zhes so/ /me skyes kyis de thos nas/ 'di la kyal ka zhig bya'o snyam ste gang po la tshod ma 'bras chan gyis —320—

bkabacas drangs/ 'khor rnams la 'bras chan gyi steng du tshod ma yod par byas te drangs pas/ za ba'i dus la bab kyang gang po ni kho bo la tshod ma med do zhes sdod do/ /der bran zhig na re/ mthong bya min pa mthong bar byed/ /mthong bar bya ba mi mthong ngo / /dregs bral 'gram gyi spre'u mthong la/ /phor ba'i nang gi tshod ma min/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas mchod ston zin pa na gang pos/ spyin bdag si/sa ni sbyin pa'i dus/ /dge sbyong gzhan ni za ba'i dus/ /lhag ma gzhan la 'ong ba'i dus/ /bsod nams mi dge yod ma yin/ /zhes yon bshad yin pa ltar byas nas smod par byed do/ /de me skyes kyi sgo srung kyis thos nas/ 'di la kyal ka zhig bya'o snyam nas 'bras khu sgo them la pho nas bzhag go /de nas gang po phyir byung ba na 'bras khu la 'dred pas sgo them la mgo brdabs te rma byung ngo / /de nas dpal sbed can du song nas/ me skyes kyis nga 'a/ 'di 'dra bar byas so/ /da ni lan du go ta ma 'khor dang bcas pa 'joms par bya'o zhes gros byas nas/ dpal sbed kyis go ta ma de gal te thams cad mkhyen pa yin na ni ngas mgron du bos na khas mi len no/ /gal te khas len na ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin pas sla'o snyam/ de nas de ston pa'i drung du song ste zhus pas/ ston pas mkhyen bzhin du gnang ngo / /der dpal sped dga' ste khyim du song nas sgo'i phyi khyams su dong chen po brus te/ de'i nang shing ka ti ta'i me mdag gis bkang /de'i kha shing rab rib dang rtswa dang sas bkab ste mi mthong bar byas/ gal te me'i dong 'dir bsad ma thub na/ dug spyin no snyam ste bza' btung thams cad la dug sbyar te bzhag go /der me skyes kyi sring mos ci byed dris pa na/ nangs —321—

par dgra gsod de go ta ma'o/ /'o na mdza' bo su yin byas pas/ 'dis gsang shor bar 'gyur snyam ste/ de khyim gyi phug mdzod zhig gi nang du bcug ste sgo lcags btab bo/ /de nas nangs par gang pos gcer bu ba mang po dag bos te/de dag dpal sped kyi khang pa'i yang thog na 'khod do/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon la su yang mi 'gro bar byas/ de nas ston pa nyid kyis sna drangs te dge 'dun dang bcas pa dpal sped kyi khyim du gshegs pa na/ 'od ma'i tshal gyi lha dang / lam du rgyal po'i khab kyi lhas mi 'byon par zhus kyang me dang dug gi gnod pa med par bka' stsal te phebs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis me'i dong gi steng du zhabs bzhag pa na/ me'i dong de ni dwangs pa'i rdzing bu pad+ma la sogs pa me tog sna tshogs kyis khebs pa chu bya sna tshogs rgyu ba zhig tu gyur te/ lha rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' nas me tog gi char phab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das pad+ma de dag gi lte ba la zhabs bzhag ste phebs pa'i phyi nas nyan thos rnams kyang 'ongs so/dpal sped kyis de mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes pa la/ gang po na re/ khyod go ta ma'i sgyu ma la dad dam/ dpal sbed na re/ 'di lta bu'i sgyu ma sgrub tu rung na khyod kyis kyang ci'i phyir mi ston zer ro/ /de nas gang po la sogs pa gcer bu pa rnams skyengs te ngo tsha bas sgo gzhan zhig nas rings pa rings par bros so/ /me skyes kyi sring mo ni bar der shin tu yid mi bde ste gnas pa las/ der dpal sbed kyis sgo phye ste tshur shog /ston pa la phyag tshol zhig zhes byas kyang dang por yid ma ches/ lan gnyis lan gsum du smras pas yid ches te/ dpal sped —322—

rang nyid ston pa'i spyan sngar 'gro ba ngo tsha bas me skyes kyi sring mos dpal sped khrid de bzod par gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas cung zad bzhugs shig kha zas 'di dag ni dug sbyar ba lags kyi/ gdugs tshod da sdod gshe/ma dgos so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag des 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dug kyang bor na/ dug phal pa 'dis ci byar yod/ gang sbyar ba de khyer la shog cig /der saX pra snya zhes pa'i sgra byung nas/ kha zas dug can de nyid gsol to/ /dpal sped kyis bsams pa/bcom ldan 'das dug gsum spangs pa yin yang / 'khor thams cad kyis ni ma spangs pas dge slong rnams la dug gis gnod do snyam na/ su la'ang ma gnod de ngo mtshar cher skyes/ de nas bshos gsol zin pa na/ dpal sbed kyis chos nyan pas bden pa mthong nas/ de phyin chad mu stegs byed rnams kyi ni sgo bcad/'khor rnam pa bzhi la ni sgo dbye'o zhes bsgrags so/ /bdun cu pa me skyes rab tu byung ba ni/ khyim bdag me skyes ni/ rang gi pha 'das pa'i rjes su sngon rang gi ma shi ba'i phyogs der mchod rten yang byas/lha'i dpal 'byor nyams su myong ste/ de'i khyim na nyin mtshan gyi bye brag med de/rgyal po gzugs can snying po khyim der phyin pa na zhag bdun lon yang nyin mo gcig tu 'du shes pa byung / phyis ma skyes dgra rgyal srid la 'khorwa da nas/ me skyes kyi khyim dang rgyal po'i pho brang lan bdun du brjes kyang ma skyes dgra gang du bsdad pa ni phal par 'gyur/ de'i khyim ni sngar bzhin du lha'i gzhal med khang par gyur pas dmag btang ste 'phrog par brtsams pa na/ khrab can rnams de'i —323—

khyim gyi bya 'dabs khab len la byas pas drangs te dril bu ltar 'phyang ngo / /zhes kyang grag go /de nas des longs spyod thams cad sbyin par btang ste ston pa'i spyan sngar song / tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa thob pa'i bar du gyur to// don gcig pa 'phrog ma'i gtam ni/ yang ma ga dhar gnod spyin lnga rtsen la/ gnod spyin sa ti'i bu mo dga' byed ma bag mar btang ba las/bu gcig nas lnga brgya'i bar du rim pas btsas so/ /de'i dus na dga' byed ma bu'i nga rgyal gyis lnga rtsen la yang mi nyan zhing / khyim thabs rang gyes su song nas ri bo dang nags tshal dang ljongs ma nges pa dag tu rgyu'o// de nas ma ga dhar bud med bu chags pa thams cad mngal gyi sems can zhig bu btsas pa thams cad kyang shi ste gcig kyang ma 'tsho'o/ /ltas mkhan rnams kyis gnod spyin 'khrugs pas gtor ma gyis shig par bskul bas/ der rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad kyis grong khyer rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ lha dang gnod spyin cher mchod kyang ma phan te rgyal po'i khab kyi lha rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ khyed rnams la gnod spyin mo dga' byed gnod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das la de 'dul bar zhus shig de nas skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis 'di ni ma ga dha pa'i bu rnams 'phrog par byed pas 'phrog ma'o/ /zhes 'phrog ma'i ming gis 'bod par byed do/ /der ma ga dha'i sprum ma thams cad yul gzhan du 'bros par brtsams pa na/'phrog ma rang nyid 'jigs pa'i gzugs dngos su bstan te lam bkag pas 'bros ma nus so/ /de nas ma ga bhā pa rnams kyis bskul te rgyal po gzugs can snying pos ston pa la gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma 'dul bar gsol ba btab bo/—324—

bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'dul ba'i dus su dgongs te cang mi gsung pas gnang ngo / /de nas snga dro re dus shig bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du bsod snyoms la gshegs nas phyi dro'i dus la bab pa na gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma'i gnas su gshegs so/ /de'i tshe 'phrog ma rang nyid bu gzhan rnams dang bcas pa spyod yul du song / /bu tha chung dga' byed ces bya ba de gcig pu khyim na 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' byed la lhung bzed kyis bkab ste bzhag cing / des gzhan dag mthong la gzhan dag gis de mi mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas de ma thag tu 'phrog mas 'ongs kyang / bu dga' byed ni ma rnyed nas khyim gyi kho ra khor yug tu btsal yang ma mthong ngo bu gzhan rnams la dris kyang mthong ba med de/ de mig mchi mas gang bzhin du rgyal po'i khab kyi grong dang / tshong 'dus dang lam srang rnams su rgyug cing / kye hud bu zhes skad phyung yang lan ster ba med cing ma mthong ngo / /de nas grong khyer chen po drug dang ri nag po dgu 'das shing / gling gzhan rnams dang / gser gyi ri bdun dang / ri rab kyi bang rim rnams su btsal yang ma rnyed de/ ri rab kyi rtse mor phyin nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi grong khyer du 'jug par brtsams pa na/gnod spyin lag na rdo rje rnams kyis bkag go /de nas lcang lo can du song nas gnod spyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos bu la dris shing gsol ba btab pa na rnam thos kyi bu na re/ khyod kyi gnas su nyin par su 'ongs/ 'phrog mas smras pa/ dge sbyong go ta ma byon to/ /'o na songs la de la skyabs su song dang / des khyod la bu dga' byed ston par 'gyur ro/ /de skad thos nas 'phrog ma rang nyid srog stor —325—

ba las slar rnyed pa ltar gyur nas rang gnas su song / /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas nas/ kye dge sbyong go ta ma/ bdag la bu dga' byed bstan du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ khyod la bu mang zhes grags na ji snyed cig yod/gsol ba/ lnga brgya mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'o na gcig med pas lta ci nyes/ gsol ba/ bu dga' byed de ma mthong na khrag dron mo skyugs te mchi'o/bka' stsal pa/ khyod bu dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra shes bzhin du g.yin gyi bu ci'i phyir bza'/ gang la bu gcig las med pa de dag bsad na sdug bsngal ci 'dra bar 'gyur/ de nas des kyang bka' bzhin bgyid par dam bcas/ ma ga dha pa rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas rnams yang dag par blangs pa na des kyang dga' byed mthong bas dga'o/ /de phyin chad ma ga dha'i skye bo rnams la gnod pa de zhi bas bde bar gyur to/ /don gnyis pa rgyal po ka pi na btul ba ni/ yang bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi yul gser gyi sa zhes bya ba na rgyal po ka pi na zhes bya ba'i sras ka pi na chen po rgyal srid la bkod de/ de ni blo gsal ba yid gzhungs pa/ dpa' ba/ brtul phod pa/ dmag tshogs stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug yod pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad thub par nus pa/ rgyal phran khri phrag sum cu rtsa drug la dbang byed pa yod de/ 'on kyang yul dbus dang 'grul ba med do/ /skabs de'i dmag tshogs zhes bya ba ni dmag mi sde tshan gyi tsho chen po re'i ming ngo / /skabs der mnyan yod kyi tshong pa 'ga' zhig yul der —326—

phyin nas ras bzang po yug chen bzhi rgyal po la phul bas/ rgyal pos yul dbus zhes bya ba zhes dris pa na/ yul dbus ni mnyan yod dang rgyal po'i khab la sogs pa'o/ /der rgyal bo ka pi na chen pos bsams pa ngas yul mtha' thams cad dbang du byas na de rnams ci'i phyir nga la phyag 'tshal du mi 'ong da ni de dag kyang mnga' 'og tu gzhug par bya'o snyam/ yul dbus na rgyal po su che dris pas/ mnyan yod kyi rgyal po che'o zhes byas so/ /der ka pi nas rgyal po gsal rgyal la pho nya btang ste/ nga'i mthu dang gzi byin gyis dzasbu'i gling na gtogs pa thams cad dbang na/ khyod ci'i phyir pho nya yang 'grul bar mi byed/da ste zhag bdun na nga dang phrad par shog cig gzhan du na dmag drangs te khyod kyi yul med par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /der rgyal po gsal rgyal ches skrag ste/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas gtam de thams cad rgyas par gsol ba na/ pho nya ba de nga'i drung du srings shig gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis kyang pho nya ba de la/ dbus kyi rgyal po'i nang nas ches che ba ni nga ma yin gyi/ches che ba'i 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhig 'di dang mi ring ba na bzhugs pas de'i drung du songs shig /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal byed tshal ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen por sprul/ bcom ldan 'das nyid 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / mong gal gyi bu chen po blon po rin po che'i rnam par byas shing / ji ltar gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpung dang / g.yog dang / longs spyod thams cad sprul lo/ /deng pho nya bas nang du 'ongs na shin tu la/ rnga rngi ra mod kyi/ 'on kyang wen gyi yi ge phul lo/ /—327—

'phrul gyi rgyal po des yi ge de rdog pas mnan te/ nga ni gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po yin na/ rgyal po glen pa de ci'i phyir nga'i bka' mi nyan/ khyod song la nga 'di skad ces bka' stsal to smros shig da ste zhag bdun na phyag 'tshal du 'dir shog cig gal te mi 'ong na khrims dang sbyar ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas pho nya de phyir song ste ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par bsnyad pa dang / rgyal po ka pi na rab tu skrag cing 'gyod par gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang da dung cung zad bgam mo snyam ste/bdag rgyal phran sum khri drug stong dang lhan cig mchi'am/ de'i phyed dang lhan cig mchi bka' stsol cig der rgyal phran phyed dang lhan cig tu chas te shog cig ces byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po ka pi na rgyal phran khri brgyad stong gis bskor te mnyan yod du bcom ldan 'das 'khor los sgyu rgyal gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar lhags so/ /de nas phyag byas shing 'dug pa na/ rgyal po 'di'i byad gzugs ni bdag pas ches lhag mod/ stobs ci 'dra snyam pa na/ blon po rin po che la khyod kyis gser sa'i rgyal po la gzhu sbyin zhig gsungs pa ltar des kyang spyin pa na/ rgyal pos lag gis kyang ma theg rgyud kyang ma bsgyur ro/ /de nas 'phrul gyi rgyal pos gzhu de phyag tu bzhes te/ gzhu rgyud sbrengs pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten du sa g.yos shing / mda' gcig 'phangs pas mda' lngar gyur pa'i rtse mo las 'od zer grangs med pa byung / 'od zer re re'i rtse mo la pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam byung zhing / pad+ma re re la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin po che sna tshogs dang cas pa re re byung ngo / /de'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod pa sogs cho 'phrul —328—

mtha' yas pa bstan to/ /de nas rgyal po ka pi na 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nga rgyal chag cing sems rab tu dad par gyur pa na/ cho 'phrul brtul te sangs rgyas nyid kyi sku dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis phyogs kun tu bskor ba dngos su bstan te chos gsungs pas thams cad kyis rgyun du zhugs pa thob/rgyal po ka pi na chen po rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol ba 'debs pa la/ tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs shing ring por ma thogs bar dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so/ /don gsum pa khyim bdag gdangs can bden pa la bkod pa ni/ yang yul ko sha sbyi na khyim bdag nor bzang zhes bya ba zhig rkang pa kho nas 'gro zhing las kyi mtha' la brtson pa las/ rgyal po shar pas de'i skad kyi gdangs las gser 'bum yod par shes nas ming gdangs can du btags shing blon por bskos so/ /dus lan cig rgyal pos de'i sems brtag pa'i ched du chad pas sdigs kyang mi rigs pa'i las la mi 'jug pas rgyal po gting nas zhe mgu ste dam pa ci dgos zhes dris pa na/ bdag ci dgar bsod nams dag bgyid par stsal du gsol/ rgyal pos kyang gnang ngo / /dus de'i tshe lho phyogs nas drang srong lnga brgya tsam yul dbus su 'ongs pa la/ lam khar chu med pas skom ste ljon shing gcig la chu slong pas lag pa g.yas pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig gis gser gyi snod nas chu spyin pa ngoms par 'thungs te cung zad lam du 'phags pa na/ 'dri ba'i blo skyes te slar ldog nas khyod las gang gis 'dir skyes zhes dris pas/ kho bo bzo bo zhig tu gyur pa na slong mo ba rnams la mgon med zas —329—

spyin gyi khyim bstan/ der de dag gis bza' btung mang po thob pa la/ bdag gis rjes su yi rang byas pas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lhar skyes so zer ro/ /yang drang srong rnams kyis 'ongs pa na/ bkres skom gyis nyen te ljon shing gcig la zas slong pa na/ de las sgra byung ste phyogs 'di lta bu na jing bu yod/de'i 'gram gyi shing drung na bza' ba yod kyi longs shig zer/ de bzhi du byung nas zos 'thungs pas tshims te yang cung zad phar ldog nas snga ma bzhin dris pas/ sngon mgon med zas sbyin gyi zho'i bum pa dge 'dun la 'grim pa'i lag bde ba byas pa dang / zas skom zhim po thob pa'i phyir bsnyen gnas blangs te yan lag gzhan rnams ni thub/ gzhan gyis nan tan chen pos zar bcug pas dus min gyi kha zas srung ma thub ste/ gso sbyong de ma ral na sum cu rtsa gsum du skye ba yin pa las/ ril ba des rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lhar skyes so zhes zer ro/ /der drang srong rnams bgros te/ bdag cag brtul zhugs la gnas kyang 'bras bu cir 'gyur mi shes na/ 'di ni de 'dra yi/ 'dis gang las gso sbyong blang ba'i khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin de'i drung du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas de dag rim gyis song nas/ thog mar khyim bdag gdangs can gyi sar song zhing sngar gyi lo rgyus zugad pas ngo mtshar skyes te gdangs can yang rgyal po shar pa la zhus nas/ drang srong de dag dang lhan cig mnyan yod du phyin te/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis kyang bkur bsti dang bcas te bsus nas/ sngar gyi gtam dag rgyas par glengs shing bsnyen gnas len par 'dod pa la/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis khyed rnams nga las bsnyen gnas len nam/ bco rdo pa ldan 'das las len —330—

zhes/ dris pa la/ slar dris pa/ khyim bdag nyid kyis su las blangs/ des smrasapa bcom ldan 'das las so/ /'o na bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das las so zhes zer te khyim bdag mgon med zas sgyin gyis de rnams khrid nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin/ ston pas kyang de rnams la chos bstan pas gdangs can gyis rgyun du zhugs pa thob cing drang srong lnga brgya po tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /don bzhi pa grong khyer ko sham+bhi pa rnams btul ba ni/ de nas gdangs can gyis bcom ldan 'das yul ko sha sdir gshegs su gsol/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur bgyi'o/ /bka' stsal pa de na gtsug lag khang yod dam zhes sogs mgon med zas sbyin gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ tshe dang ldan pa skul byed gdangs can dang lhan cig mngags te song ngo / /de nas gnas kyi mtshan nyid rgyal byed tshal dang 'dra ba zhig tu gtsug lag khang yang de dang phyogs 'dra ba zhig brtsigs/ bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren pa'i shul lam du mchod yon sgreng ba sogs bkod pa phal cher mgon med zas sbyin gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gtsug lag khang de yang phul te mchod pa du mas mchod nas rang gi khyim du song ngo / /der 'phags pa sku la byed la/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun bka' stsal te/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la kun dga' ra ba 'bul ba dang (〈tho〉waṃ) 1der gtsug lag khang brtsig tu 'jug pa dang 2gnas mal 'bul ba dang 3rjes su mthun pa'i yo byad 'bul ba dang 4slo bur du 'ong ba dang 'gro bar chas —331—

nga la sbyin pa gtong pa dang 5nad pa dang nad g.yog la sbyin pa dang 6yul ngan dang char pa 'bab pa'i tshe sbyin pa'o 7 rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams kyi gzhi chen po bdun ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gnas 'di lta bu bzhugs so zhes thos nas dga' ba dang 1tshur gshegs pa rtsom par thos nas dga' ba dang 2 lam du bzhugs pa thos nas dga' ba dang 3 grong der byon pa thos nas dga' ba dang 4 zhal mthong nas dga' ba dang 5 chos thos nas dga' ba dang 6 skyabs 'gro'am bslab gzhi nod pas dga' pa'o/ (〈pho〉 ) de'i tshe gdangs can ni dad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan yang / de'i 'khor rnams phal cher dkon mchog gsum la mi dad do/ /bran mo mgu byed ma zhes bya ba de kho na sangs rgyas la dad pas/ ston pa la ras ma phul nas smon lam gdab pa'i rkyen dang / khyim bdag des dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyid pa'i tshul shing brims pa'ang blangs/khyim bdag gi ngag la nyan nas yo byad mkho rgu dge 'dun la phul bas bran mo mgu byed ma khyim gyi bdag mor bskos so/ /yang sngon lag brgyud 'brog gnas shi nas sngo sangs ma ko sha sbyir ldog pa na/ rgyal po shar pas gtsun mor blangs te/ rnyed bkur ma lnga brgya dang / nyin re la pa ṇa stong stong gi yo byad dang / khang bzang me tog gi so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas ring zhig lon pa'i skabs te/dus der bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sham+bhi'i yul gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag mang po zhig 'bras bu bzhi la bkod cing skye bo phal cher dad pa mchog la bzhagargyal po la sogs pas yang mchod par byed pa na/ sngo sangs ma'i g.yog mo sgur —332—

'jog ces bya ba yod de/ de dang 'dris shing shes pa'i spos 'tshong gi khye'u dad pa can zhig gis ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i sar sgur 'jog gis kyang song ste/ gdugs tsho de 'brim grogs kyang byas/ chos nyan pas sgur 'jog gis rgyun du bzhugs pa thob bo/ /sngar des pa na'i rin brku ba las/ de nas brtsams te ma brkus par khyer te sngo sangs ma la gtad pas/ yo byad mang po byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ rgyu myo/ zhugs thob pa go bar byas te deng ma brkus pas so/ /'o na khyod kyis nyin re bzhin sangs rgyas la chos nyan la/ de kho mo la smros shig /der sngo sangs ma seng ge'i khri la 'dug gzhan rnams kyang stan la bsdad/ gral gyi tha mar sgur 'jog 'greng bzhin pas chos ston no/ /de ltar lan mang du song ba na/ sgur 'jog sangs rgyas la chos nyan du byung ba la/bka' stsal pa/ da phyin chad 'di skad ces/ ston pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs par byas nas thugs su chud pa de/ gus pa dang zhe sa med par mi ston no gyis shig gal te gus par nyan na ston cig de'i nub mo sgur 'jog gis de skad smras pas/ seng ge'i khri la stan nang tshang can bting / de la sgur 'jog bzhag btsun mo lnga brgya po rnams stan spangs te gus tshul gyis nyan pas btsun mo sngo sangs ma la sogs pa mang pos phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob/ kha cig gis phyir 'ong dang kha cig gis rgyun zhugs thob bo/ de nas sngo sangs ma 'khor bcas pa sangs rgyas blta bar 'dod de rgyal po la zhus/ rgyal pos kyang sangs rgyas la zhus pa na/ btsun mo'i pho brang gi nang du gshegs par ma gnang ngo / /der khang bzang me tog gi so can la dkar khung lnga brgya btod de/ sangs —333—

rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang de dang nye ba'i lam srang na gshegs pa na/ btsun mo lnga brgya po rnams kyis spos dang me tog dang na bza' la sogs pa du mas mchod par byed do/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ bram ze'i kun du rgyu ma du zhesabya ba'i bu mo dpe med ma zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ pha bram zes dpe med ma de ston pa la 'bul bar brtsams pa la/ de'i ma bur ma zhes bya bas yang yang bzlog kyang ma to te ston pa'i drung du de khrid nas song ba na/ ston pas de 'jam po'i gtam gyis mi thul par mkhyen nas/ nga re zhig bdud kyi lha mo sred ma la sogs pa la yang ma chags na/ blo dang ldan pa mi gtsang ba'i rang bzhin 'di la rkang pas kyang reg par mi bya'o gsung / der dpe med ma khros nas yud tsam de ka la lus sbom zhing skra 'greng ba dang / mig mching bu lta bur gyur to/ /de nas de rgyal po shar pa'i btsun mor blangs te rgyal po la sprid pa byung ba na/ sngo sangs mas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe med mas lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes byas nas/ dpe med mas rgyal po dang sngo sangs ma'i bar du phra ma mang po byas so/ /rgyal po de btsun mo gnyis kyi sar res mos kyis zas za ba la/ sngo sangs ma'i dus la bab pa na/ bya bas bya gong ma sreg gson po gtad pas/ rgyal po na re dpe med ma la gtod cig des ni kho mo'i res ma yin no/sngo sangs ma la gtad pas/ kho mo ni srog mi gcod kyis songs shig /der dpe med mas bya ba'i lag nas bya blangs te rang gi g.yog mo gcig sngo sangs ma'i khang pa'i 'og tu bya de gsod du bcug nas/ 'di skad du/ go ta ma'i phyir du gsod cig bsgos pas sngo sangs mas bsad do zhes brdzun bsgrigs te/ gong —334—

ma sreg gi sha rgyal po la gtad do/ /der rgyal po shar pa khros te mda' gzhu bkang nas sngo sangs ma'i sar song ba la/ sngo sangs mas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rgyal pos mda' 'phangs pa lan dang po lam gyi phyed du lhungs/ gnyis pa slar ldog ste rgyal po'i drung du lhungs/ gsum pa 'phen par brtsams pa la/ ma 'phen zhig khyed rang la gnod do byas pa na/ 'o na khyod lha mo'am/ gnod sbyin mo sogs yin nam/ ma yin te/ bdag ni nyan thos phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob pa yin zhing / lnga brgya po 'di dag kyang bden pa mthong ba'o/ /der rgyal pos sngo sangs ma la dam pa ci bzhed dris pa na/ sring mo'i 'du shes stsal du gsol/ des de bzhin du bya'o zer nas/ rgyal po sngo sangs ma la chos las byung ba'i dad pas mchog tu gus pa dang bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pas bstabs so/ /sngo sangs ma dang rgyal po shar pa'i gtam rgyud 'phros gzhan rnams ni re zhig bzhag go /don lnga pa mu tig can bden pa la bkod pa ni/ ston pa mnyan yod na bzhugs te gang gi tshe/ sing gha la'i gling gi rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can chen mor gyur zhing / blo gros gsal ba dang yid gzhungs pa dang bya ba thams cad la mkhas par gyur pa de'i tshe/ yul dbus nas 'ongs pa'i tshong pa rnams kyis sing gha la'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar/ mtshan mo gnas btab ste 'dug pa las/tho rangs kyi dus na ched du brjod pa la sogs pa'i mdo rnams bton pas/ mu tig can gyis dkar khung nas thos te/ shin tu yid bde ba skyes pas/ nangs par rgyal po la zhus nas tshong pa rnams bos te/ yul dbus kyi rol mo dag —335—

longs shig byas pa na/ tshong pa rnams kyis lha mo de ni rol mo ma lags/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'o/ /der mu tig can sangs rgyas zhes bya ba sngon ma thos pa gsar du thos pas/ dga' bas sbu zeng zhes byed par gyur te sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ci 'dra zhes dris pa na/ tshong pa rnams kyis rgyas par bshad do/ /der dad pa bla na med pa thob nas/ dus gzhan zhig na tshong pa rnams tshong zin nas yul du ldog 'gro ba'i tshe mu tig can gyis ston pa la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig phul te/ de'i yang 'di skad ces/ lha dang lha min mi yis phyag byas pa/ /skye dang bsnyungs dang bsnyengs las nges 'byung zhing / /gtso bo grags pa rgya cher rab grags pa/ /drang srong bdud rtsi'i cha las thugs rjes gnod/ /ces so/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis mu tig can gyi zhu ba'i 'phrin yig de bcom ldan 'das la phul/ don rnams zhib tu gsol to/ /der ston pas tshong pa rnams la khyed rnams slar sing gha lar 'dong pa'i tshe/ nga la smos shig ces bka' stsal to/ /yang dus gzhan zhig na tshong pa rnams zong bsgyur zin nas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar song ste gsol bas/ ston pas ri mo mkhan dag la ras kyi gzhi la nyid kyi sku gzugs 'brir stsal ba na/ de dag gis mtshan ma bzung bar ma nus te/ der sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba'i 'od zer spros pa ras gzhi'i steng du phog pa la/ bzo bo rnams kyis tshon bkye ste legs par zin to/ /rgyal po u tra ya ṇa'i skabs bzhin du yi ge bris pa las/ 'dir 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi tshig bris pa lhag por 'byung / /tshong pa rnams la de'i don rgyas par gsungs nas/ khyed dag las gcig cig sngon du song ste/ sing gha la'i rgyal po la ras bris 'di mu tig can —336—

—la skyes su bskur ba yin gyi/ sa phyogs yangs par skye bo'i tshogs bsdus la/bkur bsti chen pos bris sku 'di khroms shig /mu tig can gyis 'di dang 'di ci yin zhes 'dri na/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes rjod cig /de nas bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes zer nas tshong pa rnams song ste/ sing gha la'i rgyal po la smras pas/des kyang sa phyogs legs par bstar/ rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa bshams/ skye bo'i tshogs rnams bsags nas rin po che'i khri'i steng du bris sku zhal phye bas/ skye bo thams cad skad gsangs mthon pos/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sgrog cing thams cad dad pa la bkod/ mu tig can dad pa'i shugs kyis mig mchi mas gang zhing /'di dang 'di ci zhes so sor dris pa la tshong pa rnams kyis de dang de rgyas par bshad pas/ mu tig can gyis rten 'brel lugs 'byung dang / lugs zlog gi don bsams shing / tshong pa rnams kyis lan gsum zlo bar byas pa las lan gnyis ni bsams/ gsum pa ma bzlas pa'i sngon rol bar skabs der rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can gyis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /der ched du brjod pa'ang byas nas/ yang nam zhig tshong pa rnams slar ldog pa'i tshe/ bdag gi ming gis sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshol/ bsnyun dris la/ mu tig mchog bre bo che gsum po 'di phul la/ cha dang po ne sangs rgyas/ gnyis pa ni chos/ gsum pa ni dge 'dun la 'bul lo zhes rjod cig zer ro/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis des ji skad bsgo ba bzhin du phul/ kun dga' bos skyes 'di gang las byung zhus pas/ ming chen gyi g.yog mo skyed ma rgyal po'i bu mor skyes pa des bskur —337—

pa yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi sku skal ni dri gtsang khang gi zhal ba la sogs pa gtsug lag khang gi bya ba gyis shig chos kyi skal pa ni chos 'dzin ba'i gang zag rnams la'o/ /dge 'dun gyi skal ba ni dge 'dun la mnyam par bgos shig /ces bka' stsal to/ /don drug pa ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod ni/ khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin la/ bu mo ma ga dha bzang mo zhes bya ba/ bud med kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba cher bsags pa cig yod do/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel na/ tshong dpon gyi bu khyu mchog spyin zhes bya ba yod de/der gcer bu pa rnams las ma ga dha bzang mo'i che ba thos so/ khyu mchog sbyin de gcer bu pa'i cha byad du brdzus byas nas mnyan yod du song ste/ ma ga dha bzang mo ci 'dra ba blta ba'i phyir/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du slong ba la zhugs pa na/ ma ga dha bzang mos kyang kha zas sbyin par phyin pas khyu mchog spyin ma ga dha bzang mo la dga' bas snyug thags kyi zhwa'i nang du kha zas blangs so/ /der ma ga dha bzang mos shes bzhin med par slong mo len pa 'di su zhig snyam nas de tshig rtsub pos spyos pa na/ de yang gdong smad de song nas grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du sleb ma thag khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la ma ga dha bzang cho/ slong bar btang / zas spyin gyis 'di 'os pa ma yin yang mi gsol ba'i thabs med snyam bcom ldan 'das la gsol bas/ gal te ma ga dha bzang mo 'di bu ram shing 'phel du song na skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba shes so zhes gsung pa thos pas/ nye du rnams la go bar byas nas —338—

bu ram shing 'phel du bag mar gtang ngo / /der ma ga dha bzang mo khyim gyi bya ba la bzhugs nas mi ring ba na sgyug mo na re/ deng mchod gnas brtse(sa gsol ba la blta bar shog cig zer bas/ der nyan thos chen po dag byon no snyam ste 'ongs pa na/ mu stegs gcer bu pa nags kyi ma he 'dra ba mgo bo'i skra btogs pa dag mthong nas/ ma ga dha bzang mo ngo tsha zhing gdong phyir phyogs nas/ 'di lta bu'ang mchod gnas yin na mchod gnas ma yin pa ji lta bu zhig ces so/ /sgyug mos smras pa/ khyed kyi yul na ches khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhig yod dam/des smras pa yod de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so zhes rgyas par bshad do/de dag gis smras pa/ 'o na nangs par kho na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nged cag rnams kyis mthong ba'i thabs yod dam/ bzang mos smras pa/ bshos gtsang sbyor zhig dang sang spyan drang ngo byas nas khang thog tu mchod pa rnams bshams/ gsol ba btab pas/ mchod rdzas rnams nam mkha' la song ba dang /ston pa'i spyan sngar byung ba dang kun dga' bos dri ba zhus shing / 'di nas dpag tshad brgya drug cu na grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel nas 'ongs so zhes sogs dang /der sang nyin rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod dgos par bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa gang po kun da ut+pa tas rdzu 'phrul gsar du bsgrubs pa sogs sngar slob ma lta bur gshegs pa'i skabs kyis 'gro la/ de nas de'i nangs par/ dge slong rnams rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pas yang dag par chas te/ kun shes koṇ+ḍi n+ya ni rta mchog gis drangs pa'i shing rtar zhugs te glog 'gyu zhing char 'bebs pa dang bcas te byon pa na/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i gyos sgyug dang / rgyal —339—

po la sogs pa yul de'i skye bo rnams kyis mthong nas/ ma ga dha bzang mo la dris pa/ khyed kyi ston pa de 'di yin nam/ smras pa/ ma yin te/ 'di ni kun shes ko di n+ya yin no/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gres sbyar te/'od srung chen po ni brag ri shing dang bya dang me tog dang 'bab chu sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la bzhugs te nam mkha' las byon to/ yā ri'i bu ni seng ges drangs pa'i shing rta la bcibs te byon to/ /mong gal gyi bu ni glang po che sa srung la chibs par sprul to/ /ma 'gags pa ni gser gyi pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam pa/dngul gyi ge sar dang be+e rje bya'i sdong po can gyi nye ba la bzhugs te'o/ /byams ma'i bu gang po ni bya khyung gis drangs pa'i shig rta la'o/ /rta thul ni lhung bzed thogs te spyod lam zhi bas thams cad dad pa bskyed cing byon to/ /nye ba 'khor ni gser gyi tā la'i nags kyi gseb las so/ /kā skye'i be+e 'a rje bya' khang brtsegs kyi nang du zhugs te'o/ /gsus po che ni khyu mchog gi shing rtas so/ /srung dbang gi bu ni ngang pa'i shing rtas so/ /bye ba nyi shu pa ni ri dwags kyi tshogs kyis khyab pa'i nags tshal dang bcas nas so/ /sgra gcan zin ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i cha byad kyis so/ /de dag la sogs pa lnga brgya'i bar du sna tshogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis byon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer gser gyi mdog lta bu spros te dzasbu'i gling thams cad khyab par mdzad cing / mnyan yod nas bu ram shing 'phel gyi bar du thag ring ba dang / ri la sogs pa gang gis kyang sgrib pa med par phan tshun gyi mi thams cad kyis dngos po phra mo thams cad kyang mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /bcom ldan —340—

'das nam mkha' la gshegs pa na phyag na rdo rje ni sku'i phyi bzhin du 'ong la/steng nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams dang / 'og nas ni 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang / g.yas nas tshangs pa dang / g.yon nas brgya byin dang / mtha' skor du dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dang / shin tu dga' ba dang / mig sbyin la sogs pa dri za rnams kyis rol mo sna tshogs pa phul/ gzhan yang lha dang klu la sogs pa sde brgyad rnams kyis mchod pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas te byon pa na/ mnyan yod nas bu ram shing 'phel gyi bar der mi dang mi ma yin pa'i srog chags stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun bden pa la bkod nas/ grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel la sgo bco brgyad yod pa'i sgo re re nas bcom ldan 'das re re byon pa'i cho 'phrul bstan te ma ga dha bzang mo'i khyim du byon nas gdugs tshod gsol to/ /der skye bo'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das ma mthong nas khyim gzhig par brtsams pa na/ khyim de dang grong khyer de shel gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas thams cad kyis mthong bar mdzad pas ma bshig go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul der/ nyin theg mang por bzhugs te/ ma ga dha bzang mo la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos bstan pas/ lus can bgrang bar dka' ba zhig 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang / byang chub gsum la gzhol bar gyur to/ /der rgyu zhus pas/ sngon rgyal po kṛ spo'i rmi ltas bcu zhes grags te/ sdom ni/ glang chen khron pa phye dang tsan+dan dang / /kun dga' ra ba glang phrug spre'u gnyis/ /brgyad bkag 'thab dang ras yug ma nyams pa/ /ma 'ongs shākya'i bstan la 'gyung ba'i ltas/ /rmi ltas de dag bram ze rnams kyis log par —341—

bstan pa la/ rgyal po'i sras mo gser phreng can gyis bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la zhus shig par bskul bas/ rgyal pos kyang de'i tshig nyan te de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung nyid la zhus pas/ phyi ma'i dus kyi ltas su lung bstan te rgyal bo kri kri yid bde ba dang dge ba la bkod do/ /de'i dus kyi gser phreng can ma ni da lta ma ga dha bzang mo 'di'o zhes lung bstan to/ /de rjes grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel nas mi snang bar mdzad de de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rgyal byed kyi tshal du snang bar mdzad do/ /don bdun pa lhas byin gyis rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mu ge nyam nga ba byung ste/ dge slong rdzu 'phrul yod pa rnams kyis/ mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram nas shing dzasbu'i 'bras bu dang / byang sgra mi snyan nas ma rmos pa'i 'bras swā lu dang / lha'i yul nas bdud rtsi'i zas dag blangs te rang yang longs spyod cing gzhan dag la yang bgo bsha' byed do/ /der lhas byin gyis de lta bu mthong nas bdag kyang rdzu 'phrul thob par bya yi snyam ste ston pa'i spyan sngar song nas/ bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas ston pas/ khyod lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang /lhag pa'i sems pa dang / lhag pa'i shes rab la brtson par gyis shig rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan yang 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa na des bsams pa/ ston pas bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lung mi 'bogs so snyam nas 'phags pa kun shes kyi drung du song nas sngar bzhin zhus pa na/ des kyang ston pa'i thugs dgongs dang /lhas byin gyi sems la bltas pas lhas byin sdig pa'i sems dang ldan par —342—

shes nas/ lhas byin gzugs tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan yang 'byung ngo / /de dag la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i bar du de'i sems la brtags na sdig sems can du mkhyen nas rdzu 'phrul gyi lung gsal bar ma phog go /des bsams pa/ 'od srung stobs bcu pa 'di bdag gi nu bo'i mkhan po yang yin/ drang po'i rang bzhin can yin pas ston par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ phyogs gzhan zhig na 'od srung stobs bcu pa yod pa'i sar song ste zhus so/ /nyan thos rnams kyi mngon shes ni ma brtags na mi 'jug pas/ des ma brtags par rdzu 'phrul gyi gdams ngag gnang ste/ lhas byin gyis kyang dben par song nas bsgrubs pas/ bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing rdzu 'phrul yang bsgrubs so/ /da ni rgyal po'i bu ma skyes dgra dbang du bya'o snyam ste ma skyes dgra'i pho brang du yang yang 'jug pa'i tshe res 'ga' ni glang po che'i gzugs kyis/ res 'ga' ni rta'i gzugs kyis/ re 'ga' ni khye'u dang / bu mo dang / 'dab chags la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i gzus/sa kyis 'ong ba dang 'gro bar byed cing / dge slong gi gzugs kyis gdan la 'dug par yang byed do/ /res 'ga' ni khye'u gser gyi sked rgyan can du gyur nas ma skyes dgra'i pang du 'gre ldog byed cing / ma skyes dgras de'i khar mchil ma ldugs na des kyang mid par byed do/ /der ma skyes dgras bsams pa/ lhas byin 'di ni ston pa bas kyang rdzu 'phrul che'o snyam mo/ /snga dgongs bzhin lhas byin tshur 'ongs shing phar 'gro ba na ma skyes dgras shing rta lnga brgya tsam gyis bsu zhing skyes la/ kha zas btsos pa lnga brgya tsam 'bul bar byed do/ /dus lan cig lhas byin gyis —343—
