bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams bdag gis kha drang bar bya'o snyam pa dang / yang dge slong rnams kyis lhas byin la khyod kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od srungs stobs bcu pa las byung na/ khyed de'i drung du mi 'gro'am zhes byas pa na/ kho bo nyid kyi brtson 'grus kyis 'grub pa yin gyi/ nga la des ci zhig byas zhes smras so/ /de ltar na slob dpon la drin du mi bzo ba dang /dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa'i sems ngan pa skyes pa des lhas byin gyi rdzu 'phrul de ma thag nyams shing / slar sor chud pa'i nus pa yang med par gyur mod/ de ltar nyams pa re zhig lhas byin nyid kyis ma shes so/ /don brgyad pa dge 'dun gyi dbyen byung ba bsdums pa ni/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na lhas byin gyi sems la/ bcom ldan 'das 'di rgas 'khogs su gyur pas 'khor rnam pa bzhi'am 'khor gyi phyed bdag la gtod par 'gyur grang snyam ste/ 'khor slong ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du 'ong bar chas so/ /dge slong nog can zhes bya ba tshangs pa'i lhar skyes pa zhig yod pa des de shes te/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la mong gal gyi bu bzhugs pa la sbran te ston pa la zhus shig ces bskul lo/ /des kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis song ste zhus so/ /der lhas byin grogs ko ka li la sogs pa dge slong bzhi dang lhan cig rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba gzigs nas/ mong gal gyi bu tshig srungs shig ces bka' stsal zhing / mong gal gyi bu sngar gyi gnas su song ngo / /de nas mi ring bar lhas byin gyis sleb ste bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das bgres 'khor gas pas 'khordo ra rnam pa bzhi la gdams ngag 'bogs pa —344—

bsnyel gyi/ 'kho(ra rnams bdag la gtad na thugs las chung ngus bde ba la reg pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zhus so/ /de 'jam pos go bar bya ba'i dus ma yin par dgongs nas bka' stsal pa/ nga re zhig 'khor rnams bum pa bzang po lta bu'i shā ri'i bu dang mong gal gyi bu la'ang mi gtod na/ gti mug can ro dang 'dra ba mchil ma za ba khyod la gtod re kan/ der lhas byin khong khro ba drag po skyes nas lan gsum du mgo cogs nas/ 'jal to snyam du bsams pas phyir song ngo / /de nas ston pas kun dga' bo la bka' stsal te/ kun dga' bos dge slong rnams bsdus nas/ su zhig nyes par bshad pa'i chos 'dul ba la dag par lta ba de dag dang lhan cig tu 'grogs par yang mi bya/ da ni khyed cag rnams tshar bcad cing zil gyis mnan nas smra yi/ tshig gi lam bzod par gyis shig ces sogs log pa'i rjes su mi 'gro bar gdams so/ /de'i tshe lhas byin grogs dge slong bzhi dang gros byed de/ 'o skol gyis dge 'dun dbye bar nus na bdag cag tshe 'dir phun sum tshogs par 'gyur zhing /shi ba'i rjes su yang go ta ma mthu che ba la'ang de ltar byas so zhes grags pa chen po 'byung ngo / /der kha cig dge 'dun dbye bar mi nus so zhes zer la/ yang kha cig 'di ni nus te dge slong rgan pa rnams la ni yo byad dag spyin/ gzhon pa rnams kyang zing zing gis bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab nas ri ga ya'i drung du byon to/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'bras sā lu sog ma'i sbubs su smin pa/ shing rta lnga brgya tsam bkang ste bcom ldan 'das la phul ba na/ lhas byin gyis de mthong ste ma skyes dgra la/ nga yang —345—

'khor mang po dang bcas te ljongs rgyu zhing 'ong na/ da ltar rgyal pos go ta ma la byed pa bzhin du khyod kyis kyang nga la gyis shig ces zer la/ ma skyes dgras kyang khas blangs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byon ma thag pa dang /sku tshe'i mjug dang / mchog zung gcig ma bstan pa'i dus dang / bstan pa la lta ba dang tshul khrims kyi skyon ma byung ba'i dus dang / mtshams ma bcad pa'i dus su ni dge 'dun gyi dbyen mi 'byung la/ skabs der chos 'khor bskor nas re zhig lon zhing / sku che'i mtha' ma rang la yang ma bab pa dang / mchog zung gcig kyang yod/ tshul khrims dang lta ba'i skyon yang byung bas dge 'dun gyi 'byen 'byung du rung ba'i dus yin la/ grogs dge slong bzhi dang bcas pa'i phyir dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed nus so zhes g.yin la bka' stsal pa lhas byin gyis thos nas lhag par yang dge 'dun dbye ba'i phyir brtson par byed do/ /der dge slong lnga brgya yo byad zang zing gis mgu bar byas te lhas byin dang lhan cig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba las/ ma skyes dgras kyang 'bras shing rta lnga brgya gang ba dang yo byad mang po bstabs so/ /tshul de ston pa'i snyan du gsol bas/zhing bzang po bor nas zhing ngan pa la mchod pa'i sngon gyi lo rgyus dang / skye bo ngan pa rnyed bkur gyis phung bar 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'ang bka' stsal to/ /der lam gyi phyed kyi sa phyogs yangs par lhas byin nyid gral gyi dbus su 'dug /dge slong lnga brgya dang lhan cig 'dus shing za bar byed do/ /de nas ston pa mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs shing / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams ni dbye bar mi nus pas so so skye bo dge ba can shas che ba'i dge —346—

'dun dang thabs gcig tu gshegs te/ rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar gnas par mdzad de/ de'i tshe rim gro byed pa ni 'phags pa sgra gcan zin no/ /bar skabs de dag tu lhas byin dang de'i rjes su 'brang ba dge slong bzhi po dag la ston pa'i bkas/ dge 'dun gyis gzhums te bsgo ba dang / bzlog ste bsgo ba byas kyang de dag dge 'dun dbyen la brtson pa 'dor bar mi byed do/ /dbyar gnas pa de'i dze mu ge'i nyam nga ba byung ste/ dge slong rdzu 'phrul thob pa rnams sngar bzhin byed la/ bcom ldan 'das ni zla ba gsum du nang du yang dag 'jog par bzhed pas/ bsod snyoms stob pa dang gso sbyong gi tshe ma gtogs su yang spyan sngar mi 'gro'o/ /der so so skye bo'i dge slong lnga brgya po de dag la/ lhas byin gyis yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs so/ /zla ba gsum 'das pa na lnga brgya po rnams lhas byin gyis lam thag cung zad cig tu khrid nas 'di skad ces/ dge sbyong go ta ma ni nyan thos rnams la dgon pa ba dang / bsod snyoms pa dang / phyag dar khrod pa dang / chos gos gsum pa dang / bla gab med pa nyid rnams grol ba thob par 'gyur zhes smra na/ gang su dag brtul zhugs lnga po de dag mi 'dod pa de ni dge sbyong go ta ma las ring du gyur gyi/ da tshul shing longs shig byas pas/ der lnga brgyas tshul shing blangs so/ /de nas lhas byin langs te song ba'i rjes la lnga brgya po'ang 'brangs so/ /der sgra gcan zin gyis bzlog kyang de dag na re/ ge 'di lta bu byung na/ ston pa ni mi snang ba na bzhugs/ bdag cag lhas byin gyi mthus srog dang ma bral ba yin mod/ gzhan du na gcig kyang gson par mi 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /de nas lhas sbyin gyis rang gi blos bcos pa'i brtul —347— ri

zhugs lnga bsgrags shing / lnga brgyas kyang tshul shing blangs so/ /gnas lnga ni/ 'o ma dang / sha dang / lan tsha spong ba ste gsum dang / gos dras shing drubs pa mi gon pa dang / grong mtha' na gnas pa'o/ /de ltar brtul zhugs lnga bsang ba de ni dge 'dun bye ba'i tshad do/ /de nas lhas byin 'khor dang bcas pa cung zad 'phags te rgyal po'i khab tu gtogs pa spyod yul yangs pa gcig tu gnas bcas nas rang nyid khri la 'dug sangs rgyas ltar bcos/ ko ka li ka dang /khaṇ+ḍa dra bya gnyis mchog zung gcig gi tshul ltar bcos nas g.yas g.yon du bzhag dge slong lnga brgya po de dag gis mtha' bskor nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba ltar bcos pa'i chos ston pa ltar byed do/ /gang dge 'dun bye ba'i dus nyid na/ sa g.yos/ skar mda' lhung / sgra 'byin no/ /de ltar dge 'dun bye nas ma bsdums bar gyi zha spru/ gcig po de la sde snod gsum gyi lung 'bogs pa dang /klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / don sems pa dang / thar pa'i sa bon bskyed pa'i rgyun chad/ nges pa la sngar ma zhugs pa rnams mi 'juga'abras bu ma thob pa rnams mi thob/ 'dod chags dag ma bral ba rnams mi 'bral/ zag pa ma zad pa rnams zad par mi 'gyur te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gcig tu chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad cing / lha mi'i 'gro ba thams cad yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pas gnas so/ /de'i tshe mchog zung gcig lho phyogs kyi ri la dbyar gnas pa las/ sa g.yos pa'i rgyu brtags pas dge bdun bye bar shes te rdzu 'phrul gyis ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs nas/ bdag cag dge 'dun bsdum par bgyi ba'i don du 'ongs so/ /zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das —348—

kyis legs so stsal te/ gang zag bzhi tshangs pa'i bsod nams skyed de/ sngon med pa'i sa phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten byed pa dang / der gtsug lag khang byed pa dang / dge 'dun bye ba bsdum pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'o/ /de nas mchog zung phyogs der song ngo / /nye bar phyin pa na lhas byin gyis de mthong ste/ da ni nyan thos chen po 'di gnyis kyang mngon du byas na/ nga nyid thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar the tshom med do snyam yid rab tu dga' zhing nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / rgyags pa skyes te ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya ste dge slong gnyis po de la gru sugs byas nas bskrad de mchog zung gcig g.yas g.yon du bzhag go /de nas mi ring ba na lhas byin ni bcom ldan 'das kyi lad mo zlos te 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces/ nga ni rgyab cung zad mi bde yi/ de bsal dgos kyi/ khyod kyis 'khor rnams la chos ston cig zer nas/ bla gos bzhi ltab tu btang snam sbyar sngas su bcug nas gnyid log go /der shā ri'i bus lhas byin gnyid 'thug pos non zhing gan rkyal du 'dug sngur pa'i sgra 'byin par byin gyis brlabs nas 'khor rnams la/ khyod rnams kyi ston pa 'di'i gnas skabs 'di lta bu la ltos shig /der mong gal gyi bu nam mkha' la 'phags te rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mang po bstan pas 'khor rnams dad cing 'dun par byas/ shā ri'i bus chos bstan pas 'khor rnams skyo ba skyes shing ston pa la dad pa dang / lhas byin spong par 'gyur ba'i chos kyang bshad nas/ dge slong de thams cad kyang sngar zas ngo dang nor ngo la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa spangs te lhas byin gyi rjes su —349—

zhugs pa'i rang gi spyod pa la ngo tsha yid 'byung / sangs rgyas la mchog tu dad pa skyes so/ /de nas mchog zung gis lnga brgya po khrid nas 'ongs te/ de'i tshe ko ka li kas lhas byin longs shig 'khor phrogs so zhes smra zhing thabs du ma byas kyang lhas byin yun ring du gnyid ma sad pa las/ ring zhig song nas sang ngo / /de nas zhe sdang drag pos ci bzhin bsnyegs nas 'ongs pa na/ shā ri'i bus lam bar der ngam grog 'jigs su rung ba zhig sprul pas ma thar te lhas byin slar ldog nas ko ka li ka la spyo zhing rdeg par byed do/ /lnga brgya po de dag lhas byin spong zhing ston pa la 'dun pa'i sems bskyed pa na dge 'dun bsdum pa'i tshad de/ dge 'dun bye ba de'ang ring du mi gnas te nyin zhag gcig gi nang du bsdum pa yin no/ /de nas mchog zung gis dge slong de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khrid de/ ston pas de dag shin tu 'gyod cing mnong ba'i gnyen por yang dag par spro ba bskyed/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gi chos bstan pas 'gyo de pa bsal te rgyun du zhugs pa nas dgra bcom pa'i bar la bkod do/ de'i tshe lhas byin gyis rgyal po'i khab kyi skye bo rnams la 'tshe ba sna tshogs pa rgyun du byed la/ gang gtses pa de ston pa'i snyan du gsol mkhan gtong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa kun dga' bo mngags te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi lam po che dang gzhi mdo sogs su lhas byin nam lhas byin gyi phyogs 'tshe ba byed pa po de dag ni sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang 'brel ba ma yin no zhes bsgrags shing / des rdzu 'phrul nyams pa'ang go bar byas so/ /—350—

don dgu pa ma skyes dgra'i log spyod ni/ de nas lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra la khyod kyi pha ni skra kha dog lan gsum du 'gyur yang 'dod yon la zhen pas bu la rgyal srid mi gtod kyi/ da pha rol gnon par gyis shig ces sogs phra ma mang po dag 'jug par byed do/ /ma skyes dgra yang de la nyan te rgyal po gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das la 'jam 'phul ba'i phyir 'od ma'i tshal du 'gro ba la/ ma skyes dgras rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'phangs pas 'jam gyi rdzi'u la thug ste chag pa dang slar ldog go /ston pas mong gal gyi bu la bka' stsal pa ste/ mong gal gyi bus grong khyer tsam par gru 'dzin gyi bu bye ba nyi shu pa la bsod snyoms slong par bzhed de/ de nyi ma la lhar 'dzin pa yin pas nyi ma la phyag byed pa'i dus su mong gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil brtol nas babs pas/ des nyi ma'i lha'o snyam ste khyed nyi ma yin nam/ zhes dris pa la/ nga ni thub pa'i nyan thos te khyod gyis bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms phul zhig gsung / bcom ldan 'das de su/ der rgyas par bshad pas gro zhun skyes bye ba nyi shu pa de lhag par dad pa skyes nas lha'i zas dang mtshungs pa'i bza' ba snod du btsos pa lnga brgya phul ba mong gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyis khyer te ston pa la phul lo/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos snod du btsos pa'i zhal zas phyi ma khyer te spyan sngar 'ongs tsa na 'od ma'i tshal thams cad dri zhim pos khyab par 'dug nas/ lha dag mchod pa la 'ongs sam zhes zhus pa na/ gru 'dzin gyi bu las mong gal gyi bus bsod snyoms blangs pa ste/ de ni bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa yin no zhes rgya cher bsngags so/ /de nas ston pas —351—

gsol ba'i lhag ma rgyal po la yang bstsal te/ rgyal pos kyang gsol ba na sngon chad de 'dra ba'i kha zas ma myong ste/ ched du brjod pa yang byas so/ /der ma skyes dgra la skye bo thams cad 'phya ste/ 'di yab kyi dgrar 'gyur zhes ma skyes pa nas lung bstan na sngon nas ci'i phyir mi bkum/ kha cig na re/ lung bstan pa thams cad bden nam ci/ rgyal pos ma nyes te lhas byin gyis nyes so/ /gzhan dag na re/ rgyal po dang lhas byin gyis kyang ma nyes te/ 'di gnas nas bskrad par ma byas pas dge 'dun gyis nyes so/ /der rgyal pos bsams pa/ bdag gi lus ngan pa 'di la brten nas ston pa dang dge 'dun la mi snyan par brjod snyam yid zhum par 'dug go /de nas lhas byin gyis rtag par bskul te/ ma skyes dgra pha rol gnon pa'i las kho nas dus 'da' ste/ dang por yul tsam pa ma skyes dgra la byin pa dang / de nas ma ga dha yang ril bor byin pa dang / de nas bang mdzod rnams kyang byin pa dang / de nas 'jam por smra ba rnams kyis kyang ma bzlog ste/ yab kyis tshig rtsub pos bzlog par byas na/ der ma skyes dgra khros te yab btson khang du bcug go /de la skabs 'di'i pha rol gnon pa zhes bya ba ni/ dus da lta'i rgyal po ngan pa kha cig gam/ blon po log pa'i khrims byed pa rnams gyi spyod pa ltar mi 'os pa'i dpya' bsdud/ mi 'os pa'i chad pa gcod/ ma rungs pa chad pa 'os pa la gnya' rengs su 'jug bzang po rnams ni smad cing sdigs/ ngan pa rnams ni mgo dpangs gtod/ ltogs 'dod chen pos rgyal khams rlag par byed pa'i ming ngo / /de nas btson khang du yab la zas skyel ba yang bkag pa dang / yang ma skyes dgra nyid kyi ma btsun mo lus 'phags mos —352—

rkang ba|dub kyi sbubs chus bkang ba dang / lus la lde gus byugs te song nas zas skom de tsam gyis 'tsho ba yin pa las de'ang bkag go /de nas bza' btung med kyang bcom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po'i ri la zhabs 'chag par mdzad de de'i 'od zer dkar khung nas 'jug cing / /rgyal pos kyang dkar khung (〈zhi〉rkechung ngu )nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mthong bas/ dga' ba skyes te des 'tsho'o/ /de nas dkar skar khung yang bkag pa na/ ston pa'i sku'i 'od zer bsdu ni khang gi ser kha nas 'jug cing mthong bas 'tsho ba las de'ang bkag cing / sbu gris rkang pa la rma byung ba na/ rgyal po thugs sdug bsngal gyis shin tu gdungs pa la/ ston pas mong gal gyi bu mngags te des rdzu 'phrul gyis bsdun khang du song nas ston pa'i bkas/ rgyal po la nad med par gyur cig ngas khyod la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba gang yin pa de ni sngar nas byas zin te ngan song las thar bar byas so/ /'di ni rang gi las kyi 'bras bu myong ba yin pas/ las skyabs su gyis shig /ces so/ /bka' de med par shes nas rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa kha zas bzang bo gang na yod/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha'i gnas na'o/ /de nas mong gal (〈dze+e〉 rtse gyi bu ) byon ma skyeng dgra'i bu 'char byed bzang po sor mo'i rtse mo la phol mig byung ste ngu'o/ /ma skyes dgras de'i sor mo khar bcug pa las phol mig kha nang du brdol ba dang sa la pho bas rnag khrag mthong ba na de lhag par yang ngu'o/ /der lus 'phags mos smras pa/'di ni rigs brgyud la yod de/ khyod kyang sngon 'di 'dra bar gyur ba las yab kyis skrag nas dus kyi dogs nas rnag khrag khar mid pa yin no/ /der ma skyes —353—

dgra zhe sdang dang bral zhing / bdag gi yab de 'dra bar bdag la byams na/yab gson no zhes zer ba de la rgyal srid kyi phyed sbyin no zhes smras pas/ skye bo mang po zhig rab tu dga' bas bzhi khang gi phyogs su rgyugs pa na/ gzugs can snying pos ca co'i sgra chen po tshor bas dngangs te dus las 'das nas de ma thag rnam thos sras kyi pang par skyes te bdud rtsi la longs spyod do/ /rnam thos bus khyod su zhig ces dris pas/ nga ni rgyal ba khyu mchog go zhes smras pas mtshan de bzhin du grags so/ /der ma skyes dgra yab 'das pa'i mya ngan mi bzad pas non te/ de gso ba'i phyir blon po rnams gyis lho phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i gar mkhan zhig bos te gar byed du bcug kyang mya ngan ma sangs te/ gar mkhan rnams phyir byung ba na phyogs der sangs rgyas byon pa mthong ste dad pa skyes nas rdza rnga brdungs shing gar byas so/ /ston pas 'od zer spro bsdu mdzad nas gar mkhan de rang sangs rgyas rnga sgra zhes bya bar 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /brgyad cu pa lhas byin gyi log sgrub ni/ de nas lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra la ngas khyod rgyal srid la bskos zin gyi/ khyod kyis nga sangs rgyas su skos shig /rgyal po smras pa/ ston pa ni gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug na/ khyod la de med do/ /de nas lhas byin gyis gser mgar bkug ste/ kho bo'i lus gser gyis g.yogs shig /des smras pa/ 'di la tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa 'byung na de brnags par phod dam zer ba na/ phod par bya'o byas nas/ der tsarmi zhes bya ba'i 'bru mar gyis lus byugs/ gser bzhu ste gyim 'bag gis byugs pas sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong ngo / /yang rgyal po ma skyes dgra la sngar bzhin smras —354—

pas/ ston pa'i zhabs mthil la 'khor lo'i mtshan ma yod na/ khyod la med do/ /lhas byin gyis lcags mgar bkug ste/ kho bo'i zhabs mthil la 'khor lo'i mtshan ma 'bri nus sam sogs gong dang 'dra/ des bsams pa/ 'di ni shed stobs dang ldan pa ste zug rngu byung na rdog pas bsnun te gsod pa'i gnas kyang yod do snyam/ rtsig pa la bu ga byas pa'i tshu rol nas lhas byin gyi rkang pa bcug pa'i phar phyogs nas/ yang lcags kyi 'khore lo me la bsregs pa lhas byin gyi rkang mthil du bslan nas 'khor lo'i mtshan ma byas te sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong ngo / /de nas lhas byin gyis rgyal po la ngas khyod rgyal srid du bzhug na/ khyod kyis nga sangs rgyas su bsko ma thub kyi/ da ni kho bo nyid kyi go ta ma gsod kyi/ khyod kyis re zhig su la'ang ma smra zhig zer ro/ /der lho phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor mkhan zhig gi slob dpon la/ lhas byin gyis/ kyai 'khrul 'khor mkhan/ gla mi lnga brgyas drangs te/ rdo tshes che ba 'phen pa'i skyogasa'achari nus sam/ des kyang nus so zer ro/ /de la mu tig gi do shal srang brgya stong phrag ri ba zhig byin/ gla mi stong phrag gcig btsal nas/ so sor gla byin nas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i drang thad phar ngos kyi ri'i steng du sgrogs bcas shing / de 'phen pa'i mi lnga brgya yang ba theg bya rgod phung po'i ri'i g.yas g.yon gyi lam po che dang 'brel ba'i sa gnad 'doms pa zhig tu mi nyis brgya lnga bcu bzhag gzhan yang lam srang 'dus pa sogs gnasagazhan dang gzhan du yang mi nyis brgya lnga bcu bkram ste bzhag de dag la gal te go ta ma skyogs 'phangs pas bsad par ma nus na/ khyed cag su'i sar go ta —355—

ma byung na yang gsod cig ces bsgos/ 'di rnams kyis ma nus na bdag rang gis bya'o snyam nas rang nyid kyang ral gri rnon po thog nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug ste phyogs kun tu lta zhing nyul lo/ /der 'khrul 'khor gyi slob dpon mi lnga brgya dang bcas pas skyogs su la 'phang dris pas/ go ta ma la 'phang ngo zer bas/ de rnams de bas shi ba yang sla snyam ste/ lhas byin gyis mi mthong ba'i lam btsal ba na/ ri'i phar phyogs g.yang sa yin yang / ston pas phyogs der skas sam them skas sprul pas mi lnga brgya po de las bros so/ /'phongs kyi slob dpon yang mu tig gi do shal khur nas de dag gi snyi bzhin song / /de dag ston pa'i spyan sngar song ba na/ chos bstan pas thams cad kyis bden pa mthong / skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod do/ /lhas byin gyis bsgugs shing yang yang bltas kyang / skyogs ma 'phangs nas/rang nyid kyis mi lnga brgya khrid nas ri la 'dzegs te/ sgrogs bcas pa'i sar phyin pa na/ khrul 'khor mkhan gyi slob dpon yang bros/ lnga brgya po yang chos nyan pa mthong ste lhag par yang sems 'khrugs so/ /mi lnga brgya po yang ston pas bros shig par bka' stsal te gzhan du bros song / bcom ldan 'das bla gab med pa nas ri'i phug tu gshegs te bzhugs/ lhas byin rang nyid 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas skyogs drangs te rdo chen po mi bzad pa 'phangs pas/gnod spyin lag na rdo rjes sgrogs rdo la rdo rje bsnun pas phye mar bshig 'on kyang dum bu che ba zhig sku la lhung du cha ba la/ rgyal po'i khab kyi gnod sbyin ku sī ras 'dzin rgyu yin yang / rdo de nyid gnod sbyin de la phog pas dus las 'das —356—

te sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lhar skyes so/ /der rdo'i dum bu phra mo yar ba zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthe bong la phog ste rma byung zhing / sku mtshal gyi rgyun yang babs/ gnod spyin kum+bi ra lhar skyes pa de nyid ston pa'i spyan sngar chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyi bsnyun brtag pa'i phyir 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos dus gsum du sku drung du 'gro'o/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi skye bo rnams sman gyi khyad par 'di bzang ngo / /'di lta bu bzang ngo zhes gleng ba las 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ mod la gdangs ba'i sman zhig yod de mi rnyed do/ /de ci tsan dan sa mchog go /der tshong dpon gcig la sngar tsan dan sa mchog mang du yod pa btsongs zin te/ lhag ma cung zad cig tshags byas nas yod pa rgyal po la dgos pa'i dus byung la/ gal te 'bul rgyu ma byung na mgo gcod du 'ong snyam sbas nas bzhag pa zhig yod do/ /gal te ston pa la phul ba ma skyes dgras tshor na gsod du 'ong snyam yang bsad na'ang bla ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'bul lo snyam song nas phul bas bzhes pa na des dga' ba dang mgu bas smon lam btab ste song ngo / /tshong dpon de rang sangs rgyas tsan dan zhes bya bar lung bstan zhing / da dung sku mtshal ma chad de/ bud med dang po ba bu thon bu btsas pa'i 'o ma btab na phan no zhes bya ba las/ rgyal po'i khab na de lta bu'i bud med 'o ma nyung ba rang gi bu yang mi ngoms pa zhig yod pa des thos nas/ 'o ma phul na bu 'chi/ ma skyes dgra dang lhas byin gyis thos na nga yang gsod snyam pa las shi'am bsad kyang bla'i snyam nas snod gsar par 'o ma bzhos te phul lo/ /'o ma 'bul ba'i bu mo de rang sangs rgyas 'o ma sbyin pa zhes bya bar lung —357—

bstan no/ /'on kyang da dung sku mtshal ma chad nas/ kha cig nas sman dag 'debs/ 'ga' zhig ni sngags dag 'bul bar byed de/ 'on kyang ma phan pa na 'od srung stobs bcu pas bden pa gsol bar zhus pas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ngo / /der 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyi thugs la ni/ /sras dang dgra bo mtshungs zhe na/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su/ /rma yi 'dzag pa chad par shog /de ltar bden pa gsol ma thag tu sku 'tshal rbad do/ /de nas lhas byin 'khor lnga brgyar bcas pa dang / ma skyes dgra ma gtogs skye bo thams cad dga' 'o/ /lhas byin gyis skyogs 'phangs pa'i tshul dge slong rnams kyis brjod pa na/ ko ka li ka na re/ khyed rnams byung rgyal du smra bar byed dam/ lhas byin ni shing ga ge mo'i drung na bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas te/ bdag nyid chen po de de lta bu ga la byed ces so/ /ma ga dha'i yul mtha' pa rnams kyis kyang lhas byin gyis kyang de ltar byas pa thos nas go mtshon thogs nas lhas byin gsod pa'i phyir 'ongs so/ /'jig rten na ni byams pa dang sdang ba dang bar ma dag 'byung ba chos nyid yin pas lhas byin la bya gtong ba byung ste des kyang bsams pa/ da ni bros pa'am 'thab bar mi nus nas kyi/ thabs 'di bzang ngo snyam nas shing drung du spyod lam zhi bas ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ltar byed do/ /skye bo rnams kyis 'ongs pa na de ltar mthong ste/ 'di ni dul bar gnas na sngar gyi gtam de mi bden no snyam phyir ldog go /lhas byin gyis pags pa gser mdog tu bsgyur ba nas brtsams te/ 'di'i bar gyi gtam re re bzhin du sngon gyi rgyu mthun pa'i —358—

gtam rgyu re yang gsungs so/ /der lhas byin sdug bsngal gyis non te bdag gi sgrogs 'phangs pa ni don med chen po zhig byas te go ta ma de yang bsad par ma nus la/ skye bo kun gyis kyang tshor bas bdag nyid ngan pa'i grangs su bgrong ngo snyam mo/ /gya gcig pa glang chen smyon pa btu'/ ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /ma skyes dgra la glang po che nor skyong zhes bya ba klu'i glang po che'i bu yin pa ches stobs dang ldan zhing che rungs ba zhig yod pas phyir byung res kyis mi phyugs mang po gsod pa zhig go /de nyin re bzhin phyir mi 'don la/ gal te nangs par phyir 'don na do nub skye bo thams cad la dril sgrog par byed do/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi khyim bdag phyug po gcig gis sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa nangs par gdugs tshod la spyan drangs shing /zhal gyis bzhes so/ /lhas byin gyis de thos nas glang po che 'dul mkhan la mu tig gi do shal srang brgya stong ri ba cig byin nas/ nangs par dge sbyong go ta ma byung ba na glang po che nor skyong rbod cig /de na re/ bdag gis de ltar bgyi mod/lha la'ang 'ol byi mkhyen par mdzod cig /lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra la'ang rig par byas pas/ ma skyes dgra na re/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ma dul ba 'dul ba yin no zhes ma thos sam/ lhas byin na re/ de lta na thog ma kho nar nga 'dul grang na/ de ma dul ba 'dul ba ma yin gyi nor skyong rbad dgos so/ /des kyang khas blangs 'dul sbyong mkhan la'ang go bar byed te/ nangs par glang po che nor skyong phyir gtong gi /rang rang bsrung ba la sgrims shig ces dril bsgrags —359—

so/ khyim bdag des bsams pa/ bdag ni skal pa ngan te sangs rgyas lan cig spyan drangs pa yang 'di dang thug go /'on kyang g.yos byas te yar khyer te drang ngo snyam/ sang snga bar song ste ston pa la zhus pas de bzhin gshegs pa la glang po che'i 'jigs pa med do zhes gsungs pas rab tu dga' ste song ngo / /der bcom ldan 'das dge slong lnga brgya dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab tu gi shogs pa na glang po che nor skyong rbad do/ /de yang 'gying zhing skad bton te shugs ci yod pas sangs rgyas kyi phyogs su rgyugs so/ /lhas byin dang ma skyes dgra gnyis khang bzang gi steng na lta zhing 'dug la/ lhas byin dga' ste/ glang chen tsa ya la bltas na/ khyod ni glang chen mthus brdzis pas/ shwakya'i bu khyod de ring du/ /nyan thos bcas te re snyam med/ /ces zer ba la bcom ldan 'das kyis/ stobs bcu'i stobs ldan rmad byung ba'i/ /stobs kyi mthu la da ltos shigaces bka' stsal nas phyag g.yas kyi sor mo lnga las seng ge ral pa can lnga sprul te de'i dri tshor ba tsam gyis nor skyong skrag nas gar bab tu bros pa na/ phyogs thams cad rab tu me 'bar bar mthong ste 'bros ba'i gnas ma rnyed cing /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i gnas kho na zhi bar shes nas dal bus zhabs drung du song ngo / /der dge slong ga༈ lnga brgya rnams ni glang po che khros pa mthong bas phyogs bzhir bros/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo gcig pu ston pa'i drung na 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gis glang po che nor skyong la byugs par mdzad de/ khyod sngon nyes par spyad pas dud 'gror skyes la/ da dung gzhan gyi srog bcad pas 'gro ba cir 'gyur zhes sogs chos bstan nas/ nga la dad —360—

par gyis shig dud 'gro'i skye gnas las thar par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/de nas glang po che de sangs rgyas la shin tu dad par gyur te rab tu dga' bas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /ston pa khyim bdag de'i khyim du gshegs pa na de'ang sgo drung du sdod do/ /des ston pa ma mthong bas khyim gzhig par brtsams pa na/ ston pas khyim de shel gyi rang bzhin du sprul pas sku shin tu gsal bar mthong ste de la dga' bas lta zhing 'dug go /der dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod gsol/ yon bsngo ba mdzad de phyir gshegs pa na glang po che nor skyong yang ston pa'i phyi bzhi du song ngo / /der ma skyes dgras/ sngar yul gzhan gyi rgyal pos nga la gnod mi nus pa ni glang po che 'di'i mthu las yin na/ da ni khyod kyis med par byas so zhes lhas byin la gyong brdal lo/ /de nas rgyal pos grong khyer gyi ra ba'i sgo ched la glang po che sgor zhig zer/ de ltar byas pas glang po che nor skyong sangs rgyas ma mthong bas rang gi sna shal rang gi rdog pas brdzis te shi nas/ ḍi ma thag rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi lhar skyes te ston pa'i drung du mchod par 'ongs/ chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo / /skabs de dag tu bcom ldan 'das rgyal bo'i khab kyi grong khyer du nyid rer phebs pa la ma skyes dgra lhas byin dang bcas pas ston pa 'khor bcas la cung zad kyang gnod mi nus mod/ khyi gtum po rbod pa la sogs pa kyal ka dang bkur sti ma yin pa kho na rtag par byed kyang / rgyal po'i khab kyi sems can mang po'i don yod pas de bar du re zhig bzhugs pa yin no/ /gya gnyis pa 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos bden pa la bkod pa ni/ sngon —361—

'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos la rgyal po gzugs can snying pos lan gnyis dang /skabs 'di dag tu ma skyes dgras lan gcig ste sman pa'i rgyal por lan gsum du dbang bskur ro/ /der dregs pa skyes te bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen pa yin mod/ sman gyi las la ni bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'dra'o snyam ste de'i phyir bden pa ma mthong ngo / /de nas 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang spos ngad ldan dag mthong ngam/ gsol ba ma mthong ste blta bar 'tshal lags/ ston pa'i chos gos kyi grwa la 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos kyis 'jus te/ston pa bar snang la gshegs pas yud tsam cig gis ri de dag tu phebs te/ de na sman rnam pa sna tshogs sgron me bzhin 'od 'bar ba gzigs so/ /der 'tsho byed la sman longs shig par bka' stsal ba na/ de mi ma yin gyi gnod pas 'jigs pa las gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la 'tsho byed gnod pa las srungs shig par bka' bsgos so/ /des sman rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag blangs te/ sngar sman gyi rnam pa mi shes pa gang yang med snyam pa la/ sngar ma mthong zhing mi shes pa'i sman shin tu mang po zhig mthong ngo / /de nas ston pa'i spyan sngar de rnams khur te 'ongs pa la/ ston pas dri smed mdzad pas shes pa rnams kyi bka' mchid rgyas par gsol/ de nas gzhan rnams ma shes pa la/ re re bzhin ston pas 'di'i ming 'di skad ces bya/ nad 'di la cho ga 'di lta bus phan par 'gyur ro sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / nga rgyal chag ste de bzhin gshegs pa ni yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i sman pa'i rgyal po bla na med pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod cing —362—

ston pas kyang chos bstan pas gzhon nu gsos kyis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /de nas slar rgyal po'i khab tu phebs pa na/ ri spos ngad ldan dang /ri kha ba can gyi gnas shin tu bsil ba dang sman gyi ngad des de bzhin gshegs pa grang nad kyi ser mas bsnyun par gyur pa la/ 'tsho byed kyis ut+pa la so gnyis zhes bya ba'i bkru sman dri mnams pas chog pa dag phul zhing / bu ram dang a ru ra'i khu bas rim pas bsnyun gdangs so/ /bar skabs der re zhig rgyal po'i khab tu gdul bya'i don che ba med pa dang ma skyes dgra 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab cing/ btang snyoms nyid 'dul ba'i thabs su dgongs pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor du mas yongs su bskor ba rgyal po'i khab nas 'phags te rim gyis mnyan yod kyi ljongs rgyu zhing rgyal byed kyi tshal du gshegs so/ /gya gsum pa rgyal chen bzhi btul/ ba ni/ de nas skabs shig na bcom ldan 'das yul u dum pa'i nags su bzhugs te gnas par mdzad pa las/nyin par rdzing bu dal 'bab ces bya ba'i 'tsho 'gram du phebs te bzhugs so/ /der ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa na/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus shes nas/ gnod sbyin lnga rtse nas mtsho dal 'bab kyi 'gram du ston pa'i bzhugs khri bshams pa dang / phyogs de na drang srong ke na'i bu gnas pas de la 'byung po rnams kyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i phyir bskos so/ /des de ltar byas te 'dug pa na/ ke na'i bus su'i phyir gdan shom dris pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir du'o zer/ khyod ci la sdod/ drang srong khyod nyid bsrung ba'i phyir du'o/ /de dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ 'byung po mang po 'du bar 'gyur bas so 'o na —363—

go ta ma sus srung / de ni gzhan gyis srung mi dgos te de nyid kyis gzhan rnams srung bar mdzad do/ /de nas ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa der byon te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs/ phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa 'ongs nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches thu ba bkang ste/ bcom ldan 'das la phul nas phyogs phyogs su 'khod do/ de la yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po ni yul dbus pa'i rigs yin la/ mig mi bzang dang rnam thos sras ni mtha' 'khob pa'i rigs yin pas bag chags sad pa'i khyad par yod par dgongs nas so so'i skad kyis chos bstan pas/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bden pa mthong zhing / gzhan yang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa cig smin zhing grol bar mdzad do/ /de nas ston pas dgongs pa/ da ni mya ngan 'das pa'i dus la khad gyis nye yi/ bstan pa lha kho na la gtad na bag med pa'i skyon dang / mi kho na la gtad na tshe thung ba'i skyon gyis yun ring du mi gnas pas gnyis ka la gtad do snyam du dgongs nas/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa khyed rnams kyis srungs shig ces bka' bsgos pas de bzhis kyang dga' ba'i yid kyis khas blangs te/ yul 'khor srung gis shar phyogs nas/ /'phags skyes pos lho phyogs nas/ /mig mi bzang gis nub phyogs nas/ /rnam thos kyi bus byang phyogs nas srung ba'o/ /de nas 'phags pa 'od srung chen po la bstan pa mtha' dag gi bya ba rnams gtad pa dang / kun dga' bo la yang khyod kyis bstan pa'i don bya ba la brtson par gyis shig ces bsgo bar mdzad do/ /de lta bu drang srong —364—

ke na'i bus mthong zhing thos nas rab tu dad de chos nyan pas/ des kyang phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob bo/ /de nas ke na'i bus bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la sang gdugs tshod gsol ba'i phyir nub mo sta gon byas pa na/ de'i sring mo'i bu drang srong ri bo zhes bya ba der 'ongs pa dang stes 'grig ste/ ci khyed grogs rnams mgron du 'bod dam ces sogs dris pas/ ma yin te sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan 'dren no/ /der sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis sbu zing zhes byed cing / sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun ji lta bu yin dris pa na/ des kyang rgyas par bshad do/ /de nas ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa der byon pa na/ ri bo 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rab tu dad de rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /ke na'i bus de ltar mthong nas/ khyod rab tu byung ngam/ byung ngo / /der ke na'i bus kyang bsod snyoms gsol zin pa na/ yo byad lhag ma thams cad yongs su btang ste 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ ston pa nyid ni drang srong las rab tu byung ba stong phrag gcig po de dag dang lhan cig tu 'bab chu rab tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i 'gram du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /der dge slong lnga brgya ni tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na chen po la gtad/ phyed dang nyis brgya ni mong gal gyi bu la gtad/ phyed dang nyis brgya ni shā ri'i bu la gtad do/ /de rnams kyis gdams ngag bstan pas/ ka pi na'i rnams kyis dgra bcom pa thob/ mong gal gyi bu'i rnams kyis phyir mi 'ong dang / shā ri'i bu'i rnams kyis rgyun zhugs thob bo /de ya nga dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad par yin te/ dbang po rtul po de dag shā ri'i bus —365sgro

bskyangs pas rgyun zhugs thob kyi/ ka pi na lta bu gzhan gyis bskyangs na/ drod tsam yang thob par mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /gya bzhi pa sor 'phreng can btul ba ni/ yang mnyan yod du bram ze'i khye'u mi gdung ba zhes bya ba gyad chen po'i tshad du phyin pa'i stobs can mi stong phrag kyang thub par nus pa/ nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba yang mchongs pas zin zhing / rta mchog gi 'gros dang ldan pa zhig yod do/ /de bram ze'i slob dpon gcig slob ma lnga brgya dang bcas pa zhig yod pa la/ rig byed dang rig pa'i khyad par dag slob pa las yud tsam gyis byang bar gyur to/ /de nas skabs der bram ze'i slob dpon de 'khor dang bcas pa sbyin bdag gcig gi sar zla ba gsum du mgron du gnyer ba las khye'u mi gdung ba khyim gyis so rtsis la bzhag go /der slob dpon gyi chung ma des khye'u de la 'dod pa'i dus btab pa na/ de ni dran shes bzhin dang ldan zhing / sdig pa la 'dzem pas de dang du ma blangs pa dang / bud med des 'khon du bzung ste bram ze'i slob dpon 'ong ba'i snga rol na khri'u dra ba can la nyal/ gos mrus po bgos/ lus la rma phyung ste 'dug go /de nas bram ze 'ongs te dris na/ mi gdung bas 'di ltar bgyis so zhes brdzun du smras pa na/ 'di ni blon po'i bu chen po stong thub yin pas dngos su rgol bas mi nus kyi/ rang 'chi ba'i thabs zhig bya'o snyam ste bram ze des mi gdung ba la dga' dga' ltar byas te mi ring ba'i dus shig nang la gsang ba'i chos gcig pu zhig yod pa sngon chad gzhan la ma bstan pa de/ da khyod la bstan gyi/ khyod kyis nyin zhug bdun du mi stong gi mgo bo chod la/ sor mo re re blangs nas phreng —366—

ba byas te lus la dkris na tshangs pa'i lha mngon sum du mthong nas tshe 'phos ma thag tu tshangs pa'i lhar 'gyur ro/ /zer ba la/ rig pa ma yin par shes nas mi gdung bas thog mar lan gcig dang gnyis su bzlog go /slob dpon des nga la yid mi ches pa lta zhes spyos nas smyo byed kyi sngags kyis btab pa'i ral gri gcig sa la btsugs pa na/ khye'u me mi gdung ba rab tu khros pa'i sems skyes so/ /der ral gri thogs nas sgo'i phyi rol du rgyugs nas mi 'phrad dgu bsad pa dang / mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa dgu bsad de sor mo'i phreng ba yang byas so/ /de ltar zhag bdun du kha zas med cing 'byams pa khye'u de'i mas thos shing /gzhan su'ang de'i drung du 'gro ba ma rnyed nas ma de nyid zas thogs nas de'i drung du song ba na/ des ma yang bsod par bsams te ral gri thogs nas rgyugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong phal ba'i gzugs kyis de'i drung du byon pa na/ sor phreng can de ston pa'i rjes su rgyugs so/ /sangs rgyas dal bus gshegs pa la des bang thag pa nas rgyugs kyang rjes ma zin te/ dge slong sdod cig ces bos so/ /nga ni rtag tu sdod na khyod ni mi sdod do ces bka' stsal nas/slob dpon sdig pa can gyis log par bstan pa las khyod gyi sems ni bslus so/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa tsam gyis sdig pa'i las kyis shin tu 'gyod pas ral gri sa la bor/ rgyang ring po nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su song / de nas sku dngos su bstan pas lus sa la brdabs nas nyes pa mthol zhing bshags/chos bstan pas sor mo'i phreng bas bden pa mthong bar gyur la/ tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa thob ste/ ston pa yang de —367—

dang lhan cig rgyal byed kyi tshal du gshegs so/ /de'i tshe sor mo'i phreng ba'i ming thos pa tsam gyis skye bo thams cad skrag go /der rgyal po gsal rgyal dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas te sor mo'i phreng ba can 'dul ba'i phyir chas nas 'ongs so/ /rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi thad du sleb pa na/ snyan pa bzang ldan gyi dbyangs shin tu snyan pa thos nas glang po che dang rta rnams kyang de nyan zhing mi 'gro'o/ /de nas de blta zhing nyan pa'i phyir gsal rgyal yang rgyal byed tshal du song nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus te/ snyan pa bzang ldan la pa ṇa stong phrag brgyad cu'i yon sngar phul te/ phyis dge slong de'i zhal bltas so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po gar 'gro zhes bka' stsal pa na/ sor mo'i phreng ba 'dul lo zhes zhus pas/ de ni da lta rab tu yang byung / dgra bcom pa thob nas gnas khang na 'dug go /de nas rgyal po 'khor bcas sor phreng can lta ba'i phyir song ste/ sgo drung du sleb pa na/ des lud pa'i sgra phyung bas rgyal po 'khor bcas skrag cing dngangs nas sa la chems zhes 'gyel lo/ /de nas de'i sngon gyi skyes rabs sogs bka' stsal nas/ 'di dgra bcom pa thob kyang ba sbu'i bu ga nas me 'bar zhing gnas khang gi nang rab tu gang ste/ khyod song la dge slong gcig la lcags kyi lde mig sor phreng gi sgo'i bu gar chug cig ces smros shig /de ltar byas pa na skad cig de nyid la lde mig zhu'o/ /yang skabs 'dir sor phreng gi ming thos pas rab tu skrag ste sprum ma rnams bu btsa' bar mi nus la/ glang mo rnams kyang phru gu mi btsa' bas/ sor phreng gis srog gcod spangs pa'i bden stobs brjod pas de dag btsas pa sogs mdo gzhan las bshad de theg pa chen por glan pa'o/ /—368—

gya lnga pa legs 'ongs kyi lo rgyus ni/ de'i tshe chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la khyim bdag rtog ldan zhes bya ba yod pa'i bu legs 'ongs zhes bya ba de/ phyis mu lto bar song ste/ mi nyes 'ongs su grags so/ /des phyi zhig na mnyan yod du 'ongs pa na rang gi skrun zla mo che ba zhig mgon med zas sbyin gyi mna' mar gyur pa yod na des kyang ma bltas so/ /lan cig sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa'i skabs/ khyim bdag gis kyang sgo srung la/ deng dge 'dun la gdugs tshod gsol ma tshar bar du mu lto ba ma btang cig byas so/ /mu lto ba rnams dang lhan cig legs 'ongs de yang slong du 'ongs pa na sgo bas bkag go /der mu lto ba rnams na re/ 'di ni mgon med zas sbyin zhes grags na/ de ring ci'i phyir zlog par byed/ bdag cag gi nang du nyes 'ongs zhugs sam ltos shig /bltas pas 'dug ste gzhan rnams kyis legs 'ongs brdungs shing mgo la phor bas rma yang byung / lag pa nas khrid de phyags dar gyi phung po'i khrod du dor ro/ /der bka' stsal pa/ srid pa tha ma pa yang 'di 'dra na/ srid pa dang srid pa'i yo byad gyis ngoms par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma zhol cig /de'i las kyi mthus kun dga' bo yang brjed de lhag ma ma bzhag go /der ston pa'i lhung bzed kyi lhag ma cung zad cig yod de/ bka' stsal pa/ song la legs 'ongs bos shig der bos pas/ lan ster pa gzhan mang du byung la/ des ni ming brjed de lan mi zer ro/ khyim bdag rtog ldan gyi bu legs 'ongs tshur shog byas pas/ des rang gi sngon gyi ming dran te/ legs —369—

'ongs sgra ni skyud gyur na/ /gang la 'dir ni mchis par gyur/ /nges par ma legs zad gyur zhing / /legs pa 'byung bar gyur yang dag ces sogs smra'o/ /kun dga' bos ston pa'i drung du de khrid nas phyin/ ston pas pham phabs chung ngu zhig stsal/ 'di chung ngo snyam pa na khyod ma tshim bar du 'di zad par mi 'gyur ro gsung ste zos pas tshim mo/ /de nas kham lhag ma gcig gnang ba na/des blangs pas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas ston pa'i phyi bzhin song ba na bka' stsal pa/ khyod la pa ṇa yod dam/ de brjed de gsol pa ma mchis so/ /yang bka' stsal pa/ gos kyi grwa la ltos shig /bltas pas pha'i grogs po tshong pas byin pa'i pa ṇa dag 'dug ste gsol pas/ rgyal bu dum bu ba la ut+pal sngon po nyos la shog gcig gsungs pa ltar des kyang phyin pa na/ dang po sgo nang du 'jug tu mi ster ba la/ bdag ni snga yi/la mi sgrub ste/ /pad+ma bdag la dgos pa med/ kho bo kun mkhyen grags ldan pa/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i pho nya yin/ /zhesasmras pas 'o na ci 'dod pa khyer cig des kyang ut+pa la'i khur po khyer te spyan sngar phyin pa na/ ut+pa la dge 'dun la brims shig gsungs pa/ des dge 'dun la brims pas dge slong rnams mi len pa la/ 'di'i las sbyang ba'i phyir longs shig ces bka' stsal pas blangs so/ /de ma thag tu legs 'ongs kyis zad par sngon po'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing rab tu byung nas mi ring bar dgra bcom pa thob ste/ dgra bcom pa gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba/ mthu che ba/ rdzu 'phrul che bar gyur to/ /gya drug pa byis pa gsod kyi ri la dbyar gnas mdzad pa ni/ legs —370—

'ongs rab tu byung ba'i skabs 'di'i de ma thag ni min par snang la/ sog ma med btul ba'i rjes su yin par shin tu gsal yang / lo rgyus 'di dang 'brel che bas 'dir bshad na/ der mu stegs can dag na re/ go ta ma ni nga'i bstan pa mdzes so zhes zer na da ni mu lto ba yang rab tu byung ngo zhes 'phya'o/ /der ri rab lta bu'i nyan thos la smod pa mi rigs pas 'di'i yon tan bsgrag go snyam du dgongs nas/ kun dga' bo yul ngan sbong gi bu'i ljongs rgyu bar spro ba dgachos gos kyi las gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa yul ngan spong gi ljongs rgyus te rim gyis chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir byon nas/ yul pa rnams kyis gdugs tshod gsol/ mchod pas mchod nas 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'brog gnas dang sog ma med la sogs pa gnod sbyin dang klu gdug pa can dag kyang btul na/ klu a mra chu ngogs pa 'dis bdag cag la yun ring du gnod pa bgyis na/ 'di 'dul du gsol zhes zhus so/ /de nas gnas su phebs te kun dga' bo la/ klu de 'dul bar spro ba la tshul shing brims shig ces bka' stsal ba las/ tshul shing brims pa na re zhig ston pa nyid kyis kyang ma bzhes so/ /gnas brten rnams kyis brtags pas/ legs 'ongs la dgongs pa gtad par shes nas so so nas ma blangs so/ /legs 'ongs kyis de shes nas stan phyed las 'phags te blangs so/ /bka' stsal pa/ klu de ni gdug pa can yin gyi/ lus kyi dbang po srungs shig de nas nangs par 'phags pa legs 'ongs bsod snyoms blangs te klu'i gnas a mra'i chu ngogs su song ngo / /klus bsam pa/ 'dis nga shi bar —371—

thos sam ci/ 'on kyang glo bur rgyus med pa yin grang snyam mo/ /de nas der zas kyi bya ba byas nas/ klu 'di ni gdug pa can yin pas 'khrugs par bya'o dgongs te/ lhung bzed bkrus nas zas kyis sbags pa'i 'khrud ma'i chu/ klu'i gnas su blugs pas klu khros te de ma thag rdo rje rtse gcig pa la sogs pa mtshotshicha dang me mdag gi char phab pas gnas brtan legs 'ongs ni byams pa'i tingange 'dzin la bzhugs te/ de rnams me tog gi char du gyur/ phyag dar khrod mi gtsang ba'i char phab pa ni spos su gyur/ klus du ba btul ba na/ gnas brtan gyis de bas kyang che ba'i du ba btu'// me spar ba na/ gnas brtan legs 'ongs me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pas phyogs de snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis legs 'ongs ni me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan to/ /klu de mtshon cha zad pa na/ 'bros par brtsams pa las/ phyogs thams cad mes 'khor bar 'dug ste/legs 'ongs kyi zhabs kyi drung 'ba' zhig zhi bar mthong nas der 'khod do/ /btsun pas bdag la mtho brtsams so/ /legs 'ongs na re/ ma yin te khyod kyis brtsams so/ /yon to 'di lta bu ma thob na ci 'dra bar 'gyur gsung /de nas klu de lhung bzed du bcug ste thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis klu de la chos bstan/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod/ yul ngan spong gi bu dang chu srin byis pa gsod kyi skye bo rnams la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos shing des kyang khas blangs so/ /de nas skye bo rnams kyis ston pa la klu btu'1 lam zhus pa na/ ngas min gyi legs —372—

'ongs kyis btul lo/ /de sngon bkren pa'i dus na nye dur khas blangs te yo byad ster ba su yang med mod/ skabs der/ 'o na 'di ni bdag cag gi phu bo'i bu'o/ /bdag cag gi zhang lnga'o/ /bdag cag gi tsha bo'i zhes sogs de'i mngon par mtho ba mthong ba na nye dur sgrog pa mang po byung zhing / bar bur than thun dang bca' ba dag phul lo/ /de nas legs 'ongs la brten te/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la dgung bdun du yul pa spyis gdugs tshod gsol zhing /de nas rgyal bu rtog ldan gyis kyang mchod par byas so/ /gzhan yang gnas 'dir bcas pa dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud mang du yod do/ /gya bdun pa gsal rgyal gyis 'od srung mchod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal du bzhugs pa na/ khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin gyis/ ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /de'i tshe 'od srung r+ṣa po 'brog dgon pa nas byon te/ skra dang kha sbu ring zhing gos phyag dar khrod gyon nas byon pa sgo srung bas kyang ngo ma shes te nang du ma gtang ngo / /'od srung de nas phyir ldog ste skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba'i lam du/grong gi phyi nyug ma zhes te/ phyogs nas 'ongs ba'i grong sprang mo mdze nad kyis thebs pa zhig gis rang gi slongs pa'i 'bras kyi khu ba phul lo/ /der sprang bu lhung ba sol du phyin pas/ sor mo chad de der lhung ngo / /des bsams pa/bdag gi ngo srung ba'i phyir lhung bzed du blangs pa ma gtogs/ gsol bar mi 'gyur snyam pa na/ 'phags pas de mkhyen te phyogs de nyid du gsol bar mdzad do/ /grong nyug ma de yang rab tu dga' zhing dad pas che'i dus byas te dga' —373—

ldan gyi lha'i nang du skyes/ ston pa'i drung du chos nyan pas bden pa mthong ngo / /gtam de rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos te 'phags pa 'od srung chen po la mchod pa du mas kyang mchod/ 'od srung chen po'i ched du sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la zhag bdun du gdugs tshod gsol bar zhus shing / ston pas gnang ba yang stsal/ nangs par snga bar sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa rgyal po'i bkad sar byon te gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /der rgyal po rang nyid kyis lag bstar te kha zas bzang po dag 'brims par byed pa mu to ba zhig gis mthong nas/ der rgyal po de de lta bu'i dge ba'i las byed pa la mu to ba de dang ba dang rjes su yi rang ba khyad par can skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po chos nyan pa'i phyir 'ongs pa la/ chos kyi gtam gyis dga' bar mdzad nas yon bsngo ba dang sbyin pa bshad pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po khyod kyi ming nas sngo'am/ de ring khyed pas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed pa de'i ming nas bsngo/ rgyal pos bsams pa/ de ring 'di na bdag pas bsod nams ches mang du bskyed pa de su yin snyam/ de'i ming nas bsngo bar zhus pas rjes su yi rang byed pa'i mu to ba de'i ming nas bsngo bar mdzad do/ /de ltar nyi ma drug gi bar du mdzad pas rgyal po sems khong du chud pa la/ blon po mkhas pa rnams kyis/ sang nyin ci nas kyang lha'i mtshan nas bsngo bar 'gyur ba de ltar 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o byas nas blon pos las byed pa rnams la/ de ring kha zas ches bsod pa mang po sta gon gyis la 'brim pa na/ phyed dge slong rnams kyi lhung bzed kyi nang du 'ong ba dang / phyed sa la bo ba de ltar gyis shig ces bsgos pa ltar byas pas/ mu to ba —374—

dag zas sa la bo ba dag sdud pa'i phyir chas pa na/ phyag tshad 'brim pa dag gis phyir bskrad do/ /der sngar gyi mu to ba de sems 'khrugs pas snga ma ltar dad pas rjes su yi rang ba ma byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po yang yon phul ma thag bdag gi ming nas yod bshad pa mi mdzad do snyam nas yon bshad pa mnyan par song ba na/ ston pas rgyal po'i ming nas smos te/ glang po shing rta rta dang dpung bu chung //zhon nas grong khyer yul bcas 'khol byed pa/ /zan dron lan lam̐ dag gis ma btab cing / /snum bag yon pa'i mthu ni yin par ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu zhus pas/ sngon gsal rgyal 'di byis par gyur bas rang sangs rgyas la zan dron lan tsha med pa zhig phul bas/ sngar sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i rgyal po lan drug dang / gnyan yod kyi rgyal po lan drug byas shing / las kyi lhag mas da lta'ang rgyal por gyur to zhes lung bstan to/ /gya brgyad pa dbul mo sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa ni/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gtam de brgyud nas thos pas/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du song nas/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bdag gis zla ba gsum du na bza' dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / bsnyun sel ba'i sman dag gi yo byad rnams 'bul bar zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gnang ste/ rgyal po yang rab tu dga' nas mchod pa'i yo byad bsgom pa'i sta gon byed pa'i tshe ca co'i sgra r+ṣa po byung ba na/ dbul mo grong nyug ma bu mo slong ba gcig gis thos nas ci yin dris pas/ gzhan dag gis rgyas par bsnyad do/ /dbul mo des kyang skye bo rnams la cung zad cung zad bslangs pas/—375—

'bru mar nyung ngu dag rnyed pa/ gyo dum gyi nang du blugs/ mar me gtams nas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa bla na med pas phul te 'chag sar bzhag go /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis ji ltar ston pa shākya thub pa 'di ji lta bar/ bdag kyang tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig /'di'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i mchog shā ri'i bu dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog mong gal gyi bu dang / nye gnas kun dga' bo dang / yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang /sras sgra gcan zin dang / grong khyer ser skya dang / sku gdung rgyas par 'gyur ba de bzhin du bdag kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig ces so/ /de nas mtshan mo'i dus su mar me gzhan thams cad mnal ba na/ des phul ba'i mar me ni rab tu 'bar bar snang ngo / /ston pa mar me'i 'od la mnal bar mdzad pas 'phags pa kun dga' bos mar me de bsad do snyam ste lag pa dang chos gos kyi grwa dang rlung yab la sogs pas btab kyang de gsod par ma nus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ni rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung gis kyang bsad par mi nus na/ gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ sems mngon par 'du byed pa chen pos sbar ba yin te/ bu mo 'di ni ji ltar smon lam btab pa de lta bur shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / mar me de yang zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu 'bar zhing mchod pa g.yin thams cad zil gyis mnan te 'dug go /de'i snyan pa phyogs thams cad du rgyas par gyur pas rgyal pos kyang 'bru mar gyi bum pa —376—

stong dang / nor bu'i sgron me bzhi 'chag sa'i slad du bzhug cing / gzhan yang zla ba gsum du gdugs sna di gzhan pas ches mchog tu gyur pa gsol/ dge slong re re la chos gos 'bum ri ba re yang bskon/ 'bru mar gyi mar me mtha' yas pa yang bsgreng bar byas so/ /bu mo dbul mo de la'ang bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i yon tan la bsams nas yo byad mang po dag kyang byin no/ /gya dgu pa gsal rgyal gyi khengs pa bsal ba ni/ de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gsol ba/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di tsam bgyis na bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po bla na med pa'i byang chub ni zab pa/ blta bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba ste khyed kyi sbyin pa lan cig gis thob par mi 'gyur/ brgyas kyang ma yin/ stong gis kyang ma yin/ brgya phrag stong gis kyang ma yin/ 'on kyang khyod byang chub 'dod na spyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen zhing bkur na khyod nam zhig sangs rgyas su 'gyur grang / de nas rgyal po ngus shing gos kyis mchi ma phyis te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon sbyin pa dang bsod nams ji snyed cig mdzad lags/ bka' stsal pa/ ngas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du sbyin pa dag spyin/ bsod nams dag byas/ sangs rgyas byung ba dag mchod par byas pa dag par zhog gi re zhig bskal pa 'di la sbyin pa dag byin/bsod nams dag byas pa de nyon cig mtshams sbyar nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs mang du gsungs pas rgyal po gsal rgyal dad pa dang ngo —377—

mtshar ches bla lhag tu gyur nas rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rangs te ston pa'i drung nas song ngo / /dgu bcu pa ma skyes dgra 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ de'i tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra la mtha'i rgyal phran bcu bdun tsam blo gros gcig tu byas nas ngo log ste/ ma skyes dgra 'dis pha chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po yang bkrongs/ bdag cag rnams kyang gtses kyi/ 'di bsad pa'am rgyal srid las byung ste bskrad par bya'o zhes/ dpung yan lag bzhi'i go bskon nas 'ongs/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer phru mas bskor te 'dug go /klu sog ma med khros pas kyang ser ba phab ste lo tog rmeg med par byas/ dka' thub kyi chu lnga brgya dang / chu mig dang mtshe'u rnams kyang bskams/ chu gzhan rnams mtha'i rgyal phran rnams kyis dug btab ste rgyal po'i khab pa rnams kyis btung du mi rung bar byas/ yams nad chen po mi bzad pa mi ro skyel bar khyogs nas khyogs su 'doms pa dag kyang byung / ma skyes dgra nyid kyang nad tshabs chen po dag gis btab/ der shin tu sdug bsngal zhing yid khong du chud pa la/ ma lus 'phags mos sngar gyi tshul rnams rgyas par brjod nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas la bkur bsti ma yin pa byas pa'i mthu las yin na/ da bcom ldan 'das la bzod pa gsol cig ma skyes dgras smras pa/da ni dbyar tsha ste drung du 'gro ba'i rngo mi thogs so/ /des smras pa/ ston pa ni tsan+dan dang ste'ur mtshungs pa yin gyi/ nges par rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma skyes dgras pho nya ba zhig mngags te/ des kyang rim gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i ming gis bcom ldan —378—

'das pa phyag btsal/ bsnyun yang dris/ ma skyes dgra'i zhu ba gsol nas/ gang 'jig rten bu ngan pa ni mchis la/ pha ngan pa ni ma mchis pas/ de'i slad du thugs brtse bas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol zhes zhus pa na/ 'dul ba'i dus su dgongs te bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod nas rim gyis ma ga sdir gshegs so/ /der lha rnams kyis rlung btang ste dug btab pa'i chu rnams ni skams/ char phab pas chu bzang po dag kyang byung / sangs rgyas la dad pa'i lha mthu bo che rnams 'dus pas yams nad kyang zhi/ mtha'i rgyal phran rnams kyis kyang ston pa 'byon par thos te dmag rnams rang gnas su ldog go /ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das bsu bar song ste/ mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa chen po yang skyes/ grong khyer gyi sgo them la/ zhabs ba thegs pas sa g.yos pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan te/ de'i tshe zla ba gsum du rgyal po ma skyes dgras yo byed thams cad kyis mchod par byed cing / rgyal po'i khab 'tsho byed kyi kun dga' ra ba a mra'i tshan du dbyar gnas pas bzhugs so/ /go gcig pa ma skyes dgra dad pa la bkod pa ni/ de nas mi ring ba zhig gi dus/ dbyar zla 'bring bo'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo tshes dang gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad bzang bar gyur pa la/ mtshan mo zla 'od la ma skyes dgra blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor nas khang bzang du song ste/ dus bzang po 'di lta bu la nga kha ci zhig byas na bzang zhes 'khor rnams la dris pas/ slas kyi bud med cig na re/ 'di lta bu la 'dod pa'i yon to lnga la rol par mdzad na/ lha'i bya ba ni de lags so snyam mo/ /gzhan zhig ni grong khyer gyi shul lam rnams nyul zhing lta —379—

rtog mdzad na/ zhes dang / gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po ni dpung go bskon te dgra gzhom na zhes so/ /blon po cig na re 'od srungs rdzog byed la bsnyen bkur mdzod cig /de bzhin du blon po so so dag ston pa drug po re re nas bsnyen bkur mdzod cig ces zer ro/ /'jig rten rmongs pa rgyal po'am/ blon po la sogs pa sdig pa'i chos can rnams ni phal cher yang dag pa la mi mos shing log pa la mos pa sha stag 'byung ba ni dngos po'i stobs yin te/ yang dag pa'i dge ba la spro ba bskyed pa ni su yang med do/ /der 'tsho byed gzhon nu gsos 'khor de nyid na 'dug kyang cang mi smra'o/ /rgyal pos khyod ci'i phyir mi smra/ de na re/ bdag ni de dag lha'i mdzad pa ma lags snyam bgyid/ bdag gi a mra'i tshal na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs te/ lhas de la bsnyen bkur mdzad na do nub lha'i mdzad pa de lags so snyam mo/ /der rgyal po'i snying du babs te de ma thagaglang po che grabs gyis shig glang po che gtod cig ces bsgos pas/ glang po che glang mo lnga brgya dang bcas pa bshams/ 'tsho byed kyis glang po che kha lo sgyur ba byas/ de'i rgyab tu rgyal po bzhugs/ pho brang slas kyi mi sgron me thogs pa lnga brgya po yang glang mo re re'i rgyab tu gnas te/ phyi bzhin song nas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ba na/ lam du rgyal po dogs pa skyes te 'tsho byed 'dis nga spong byed pa la gtod par mi 'gyur grang snyam ste/ ston pa la 'khor ji tsam/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'tsho byed khyod nga la ci'i phyir gnod par mi 'dod/ 'khor de snyed yod na lud pa'i sgra skad kyang mi sgrog go /des smras pa/ ston pa sgra chung ba la dgyes pas 'khor yang sgra chung ngo / /'khu 'khrig ma mdzad cig ces dang / da glang po che —380—

thob cig 'khor gyi 'byams dang zhugs mar gyi 'od gda' ba 'di'o/ /de nas glang po che btab nas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra rkang pas kun dga' ra ba'i nang du zhugs te/ ston pa dge 'dun gyi dbus na mtsho ltar dwangs shing rnyog pa med par bzhugs 'dug pa 'tsho byed kyis rgyal po la bstan pa na/ rgyal pos kyang phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa thugs dul zhing zhi ba bzhin du bdag gi bu 'char byed bzang po yang zhi zhing dul bar gyur cig /ces zhug shing / ston pas kyang legs so stsal te/ rgyal po stan la 'khod nas the tshom dag zhus shing / ston pas kyang chos kyi bka' mchid rgya cher gsungs pas rgyal po dad pa bla na med pa la bkod/ sngon gyi nyes par spyad pa dran pas mchi ma phyung zhing ring du bshums nas/ bdag sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pas pha chos dang ldan pa bkums pa ni bdag blun pa lags te/ bdag nongs pa la nongs par gzung du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ de ni bden te 'on kyang nyes pa shes shing mthong na bshags te/ phyin chad sdom par byed na dge ba'i chos mi nyams shing 'phel ba nyid du 'dod par bya'o gsung ngo / /de ltar ston pas ma skyes dgra gzhi med pa'i dad pa la bkod de/ sang gdugs tsho de la 'byon par zhus nas song ngo / /der ston pas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ma skyes dgra 'dis mtshams med byas pa min na/ stan 'di la 'dug bzhin du bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba las/ de ltar nyams kyis khyed cag sdong dum tshig pa la yang ngan sems bskyed par mi bya na sems dang bcas pa'i yul la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes sogs so/ /sang ma skyes dgras ston pa dge 'dun —381—

dang bcas pa gdugs tshod kyis tshim par byas/ chos kyang nyan/ ston pas spyin pa la rjes su yi rang ba mdzad de gshegs so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra de gzhi med pa'i dad pa la bkod pa de phyin chad rang nyid khang steng ngam/ glang po che'i steng la sogs pa gang na yod kyang ston pa mthong na de ma thag tsham tshom med par mchongs nas 'gro'o/ /ston pas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis bar snang nas blangs te sa la 'jog par mdzad do/ /der ma skyes dgras zho shas 'tsho ba dang nang mi rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng phyin chad nga sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la skyabs su song gi ston pa 'khor ra rnam pa bzhi dang bcas pa la nam yang sgo dbye'o/ /lhas byin slob ma dang bcas pa la ni sgo chod cig ces gsungs te de bzhin du byas so/ /go gnyis pa lhas byin lung bstan pa ni/ bar 'dir 'phags ma ut+pa la'i mdog lhas byin gyis bkrongs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ der lhas byin pho brang gi nang du ma chug pas bsams pa/ ngas dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / de bzhin gshe/gas pa la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa dang / dgra bcom pa bsad pa ste mtshams med pa gsum byas kyang dgos pa cung zad kyang ma grub ste/ da dmyal bar skye'o snyam yid khong du chud do/ /der 'od srung rdzogs byed phyi ma de 'ongs nas khyod ci'i phyir de ltar 'dug lhas byin gyis sngar bzhin smras pas de na re/shākya'i nang na khyod 'ba' zhig mkhas so snyam na khyod kyang blun pa lha/ 'jig rten pha rol lta ga la yod/ khre'i ril ba spyi blugs gcig bcags nas slar mi 'byor ba dper byas so/ /byed pa po'am byed du 'jug ba po gang yang med kyi/ ye bag —382—

ma tsha zhig song la ser skya'i rgyal srid gyis shig ngas kyang blon po'i mchog bya'o zhes zer ro/ /der lhas byin log lta skyes te dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pas/ lhas byin rgyud gsor mi rung ngo zhes ston pas lung bstan to/ /de 'jig rten pha rol med snyam nas/ rang gi slob ma rnams la brtul zhugs lnga po rgya cher bstan to zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshe/gas pa bsnyun pa'i tshul mdzad pa la/gzhon nu gsos kyis sman mar lcags mda' 'bul bar brtsams pa na bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho/ byed ngo ma myong myong ma/ gsol ba che'o/ /ya mtshan che'am/ che'o/ /shes sam/ 'tshal lags/ mi she tha/sam/ ma 'tshal lags/ de ltar ston pas dgongs te gsungs pa 'tsho byed kyis go ste/ ba mchog ran par spyod pa las bdud rtsi 'byung / de dang bsgral ba la sman mar 'byung ba 'di ngo mtshar ro/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang / chos bshad pa las dge 'dun sgrub pa 'di ya mtshan che/ skye ba yod na ni 'chi bar shes/ shi ba rnams skye bar ma nges pa'o/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis/ bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje'i sku mnga' ba la/ sku che ba yin pas 'di tsam dgos so snyam ste sman mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis phul/ lhag ma dge 'dun la brims pas lhas byin yang ston pa'i de tsam dgos zer ro sangs rgyas ni rdo rje'i sku mnga' la/ khyod kyis ni de tsam mi 'ju'o byas na/ kho bo yang rdo rje'i sku can yin na ci'i phyir mi 'ju zer nas sman mar srang sum cu so gnyis 'thungs so/ /phyi nyin ston pa la 'jam gsol ba na/ yang 'gran te/ lhas byin gyis sman ma zhu bzhin du thug pa 'thungs pas ma zhu zhing sbos te gzer bas nad drag pos nyin mtshan du gnyid mi 'ong zhing 'gre ldog byed do/ /de kun dga' —383—

bos gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po'i ri phug na bzhugs pas phyag brkyangs nas lhas byin gyi mgo bor bzhag ste bden stobs gsungs nga sa de ma thag nad zhi'o/ /des phyag ngo shes te/ go ta ma sman dpyad khong du chud pa ni legs na/ 'dis 'tsho nus sam zer/ der lhas byin la shin tu zhen pa rnams kyang sangs rgyas ni byams pa dang ldan no snyam ngo mtshar du 'dzin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis khyod ston pas gsos so/ /lhas byin na re/ go ta mas dbang du byed pa'i sgyu ma shes te 'jig rten dbang du byed do/ /nga ni sman mar zhu nas nad zhi bar zad mod/ nga la des ci zhig zer ro/ /de nas phyis shākya rnams kyis lhas byin la khyod sangs rgyas la bzod pa gsol cig ces bskul bas/ des be'u'i lte ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i re gdug gis sen mo'i gseb bkang nas/ gal te go ta mas bzod pa byas na ni legs/ ma byas na dug gis zhabs la bsku'o snyam ston pa'i drung du song nas/ bzod pa gsol ba na ston pas de'i sems mkhyen te/ zhabs kyi pus mo'i lha nga man chad shel du sprul to/ /des zhabs la 'dud pa ltar byas nas dug bsku ba'i phyir sen mo btab pas shel rdo ba'i rang bzhin la thug pas sen mo chag ste/ kun gyi mthong sar dug de lhung bas de skyengs bzhin du 'di skad ces/ gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro'o/ /zhes khyed kyis gsungs pas bdag khyed la skyabs su mchi yi/ ngan 'gror song na de brdzun lags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas mi ring ba zhig na lhas byin sa la gom pa bor te 'gro ba na/ sa'i gseb nas dmyal ba'i me cung zad cung zad 'thon nas rkang pa la reg pas tsha'o tsha'o —384—

rtse thag rgyugs pa na/ de ma thag sa'i mthongs bye ste lus der chud nas dmyal ba mnar med pa'i me lce'i rtse mos lus g.yogs pas shin tu tshig ste/ ngu bzhin du kun dga' bo la bos nas nga tshig go zer ba la/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos khyod sangs rgyas la skyabs su song shig byas pa na/ de yang dmyal ba'i me dngos su mthong bas yid ches te/ bdag rus pa'i gting nas kyang sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zer te lus de nyid kyis dmyal ba song ngo / /de mnar med du bskal pa chen po gcig tu gnas par 'gyur la/ dmyal bar 'gro khar rus pa'i khong nas skyabs su mchi zhes brjod pa'i 'bras bus phyi ma'i dus na rang sangs rgyas rus pa can zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /go gsum pa mchog zung gis dmyal ba'i rgyud gzigs pa ni/ de nas dus gzhan zhig na shā ri'i bu dang mong gal gyi bu dmyal ba'i rgyud lta bar gshegs te mong gal gyi bus mnar med kyi gnas su char gyi rgyun gtun shing tsam dang / shing rta'i srog shing tsam phab kyang dmyal ba'i me lce'i tsha dbal gyi nam mkha' la bskams te sa la ma bab bo/ yā ri'i bus mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dmyal gnas chus gang bar mdzad do/ /mong gal gyi bus lhas byin tshur shog gsungs pa na/ brgya stong zhig tshur byung ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po lhas byin tshur shog byas pas/ de nas de 'ongs te mchog zung gcig gi zhabs la gshugs so/ /sdug bsngal dris pas/ mnar med pa spyi'i sdug bsngal thams cad yod kyi steng du lhag po bzhi yod de/ lcags kyi ri 'bar bas 'thag pa dang / sog le so gnyis pas gtub pa dang lcags kyi tho ba me 'bar —38bye—

bas mgo bo phye mar 'thag pa dang / phyogs bzhinas glang po che'ongs nas—'bras phye bzhin du 'thag pa'o/ /de dag kyang rim pas ston pa la sgrogs 'phangs pa dang/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / dgra bcom ma ut+pa la'i mdog bkrongs pa dang / ston pa la nor skyong rbad pa'i rnam smin yin no/ /phyis rang sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa bshad pas/ 'o na de bar du mnar med kyi sdug bsngal brnag bzod par zhes bya'o zer ro/ /ko ka li ka'i lce la thong gshol brgyas rmod pa las/ lha tshangs pas mchog zung gcig la dad pa bskyed cig par bskul yang mi nyan la/ skabs der mchog zung mthong bas zhe sdang skyed de/ sdig can 'di gnyis nga dmyal bar skyes kyang 'ong ba lta/ zhes smras ma thag tu lce la thong bzhol ltong gis rmod par gyur to/ /'od srung rdzogs byed kyi sar phyin pas mchog zung gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bdag sngon chos log bshad pas da lta lce la thong gshol lnga brgyas rmod par byed la mi yul du slob ma rnams kyis de bshad pa na lhag par yang sdug bsngal 'phel ba sogs bshad do/ /dmyal ba'i rgyud bltar byon pa'i skor 'di phyis zhig nas yin yang / lo rgyus 'brel che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dir zugad do/ /go bzhi pa yangs pa can du gshegs pa'i lam ni/ ston pa rgyal po'i khab tu byon pa na/ mi ngas gtong ba'i 'byung po rnams yangs pa can du 'phos pas der nad yams chen po mi bzad pa byung ngo / /yangs pa can gyi ca bī rnams kyi mdun na 'don bram ze mda' bo che zhes bya ba'i rmi lam du/ lhas lung bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can du byon na mi ngas sangs par 'gyur —386—

ro zhes so/ /des yangs pa can pa rnams la bshad de/ pho nya ba su gtong zhes bgros pa las/ 'dun na 'don mda' bo che nyid mngags so/ /de na re/ ma skyes dgras kho bo mo gsod dam/ tshogs pas smras pa/ yul gang na'ang pho nya ba gsod pa med do/ /de rgyal po'i khab tu phyin/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa yangs pa can du gshe/gas su gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po la rtogs shig /des gnang na 'ong ngo / /des ca bī rnams la springs pas/ khyod nyid kyis zhus shig zer bas/ de nas skabs der mda' bo che ma skyes dgra la zhus pa na/ rgyal pos der yangs pa can stongs na nga'i bsam pa tshegs chung dus rdzogs par 'gyur gyi/ mi gnang ngo zhes tshig rtsub pos spyos so/ /mda' bo che yang pho brang nas phyir phyung ste yangs pa can du ldog par brtsams pa na/ blon po shes ldan rnams kyis khyed re zhig sdod cig nged kyis lha la gsol bar bgyi'o byas nas rgyal po'i drung du song ste 'di skad du/ don de la rgyal pos gnang yang rung ma gnang yang rung ste/ bcom ldan 'das ni thugs rje chen pos sems can gcig kyang gtong bar mi mdzad na/ nges par yangs pa can du gshegs par ni 'gyur ro/ /zhes zhus pas/ 'o na khug gcig de nasades drung du 'ongs pa na/ rgyal pos smras pa/ deng dam zhig bca' dgos te/ngas bsnyen bkur byed pa dang 'dra bar khyod rnams kyis kyang byed na gnang ngo / /des de skad ca bī rnams la springs pas/ rgyal po ni gcig pu yin/bdag cag ni tshogs su gyur ba yin na ci'i phyir mi bya zhes 'phrin lan bskur ro/ /de nas rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la rjes kyi —387—

gdugs tshod gsol te/ klu sog ma med 'di bdag cag sha mkhon ma mchis pa la sha mkhon bgyid pas 'di gdul du gsol zhes zhus shing zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i tshe ston pas kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang phyogs na me tog dang 'bras bu dang chu phun sum tshogs pa dang bsod snyoms mod pa dang skye bo rnams drang po'i rang bzhin te phan yon lnga yod do/ /'di nas byang du sog ma med 'dul du 'gro'o zhes gsung ngo / /de nas ma skyes dgras rgyal po'i khab nas ga d+ma'i bar gyi lam thams cad shin tu brgyan zhing bstar bar byas/ de thos nas yangs pa can pa rnams kyis kyang ga dha'i byang ngos kyi lam rnams de bas kyang bstar par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma ga dha'i grong khyer na la dar byon te/ de nas kun tu rgyu 'dam bu'i tshong pa zhes bya ba lo brgya nyi shu lon pa dgra bcom par bkur ba zhig yod pas/ de la grogs po lha zhig gis/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung zhig byas na mi nyan te thabs shig bya'o snyam/ dri ba bzhi bo 'di dag yid kyis dris la/ gang shes pa de'i rjes su zhugs shig ces zer ba ltar/ des kyang rdzogs byed la sogs pa ston pa drug gi thad du phyin nas yid kyis dri ba dris na/ dris pa tsam yang ma shes na lan lta ga la zhig /skabs der des bsam pa/ re zhig ston pa drug gis kyang ma shes na go ta ma gsar bus ga la shes/ yang bsams pa/ brnyas par mi rung ba yang srid snyam ste spyan sngar song nas yid kyis dri ba bzhi po dris pas/ ston pas lan tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa na/ de mchog tu dad de rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /de nas 'od ma'i dbyug pa can zhes bya ba'i grong du —388—

de'i nub mo bzhugs te der bden bzhi'i chos gsungs nas/ nangs par gyi nyin grong khyer dmar bu can du gshegs te/ dmar bu can gyi nye skor mchod rten gyi gnas su bzhugs so/ /der skye bo'i tshogs la bag yod las brtsams te chos bstan nas/ de'i nangs par bram ze dbyar byed ces bya ba/ ma skyes dgra'i 'dun na 'don de/ dmar bu can gyi grong khyer rtsig pa'i kha ta byed cing gnas pa/des bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa bsod snyoms la spyan drangs te gdan bar/mas pa la bzhugs nas/ phyogs de na lha mthu che ba dag sa la 'gre bar gzigs te/ der mi mthu che ba rnams sems gzhol bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du bar ma dang tha ma la'ang ngo / /ya rabs kyi gnas kyi mchog ni 'di yin te/ 'di la me dang chu dang nang 'khrug gi bar du gcod pa gsum 'byung ngo gsung ngo / /de nas bsod snyoms kyis legs par tshims par byas te/ rgyal po'i don du dge ba bsngo bar zhus pa ltar de bzhin du mdzad do/ /dbyar byed kyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das sgo gang la gshegs pa'i sgo de la go ta ma'i sgo dang / gang gā'i chu ngogs gang nas gshegs pa de la go ta ma'i 'jug ngogs so zhes ming 'dogs so snyam pa la de dgongs shing mi legs par mkhyen nas/dmar bu can gyi dbus nas nam mkha'i lam la gshegs te gang gā'i 'gram du bzhud do/ /der ma skyes dgras mngags pa'i mi rnams kyis rtsibs brgya dang ldan pa'i gdugs lnga brgya dbu thog tu 'dzin zhing 'bul lo/ /yangs pa can pas kyang byang ngos nas gdugs lnga brgya 'dzin no/ /mi'i 'gro bas kyang 'di ltar mchod na/ bdag cag ci'i phyir mchod par mi spro zhes bsams te klu rnams —389—

kyis kyang rin po che'i gdugs lnga brgya bzung ngo / /rgyal chen bzhi bos kyang gdugs mchog lnga brgya bzung ngo / /brgya byin gyis kyang gdugs mchog lnga brgya bzung ste/ de dag re re yang ston pa'i dbu gtsug gi steng na rang rang gi gdugs 'dzin par mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i rgyu zhus pas/ rgyal po legs mthong gi lo rgyus gsungs nas/ sngar 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyis stong lnga brgyar skye ba bzhes shing / 'phrin las kyi lhag ma da lta gdugs nyis stong lnga brgya dus gcig la dbu thog tu bzung ba 'di yin no/ /deng byang chub brnyes pa 'di min na/ da dung 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyis stong lnga brgyar 'gyur ba las/de'i bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa de'i to thos rnams kyi longs spyod du rnam par smin pas bsngos te/ mu tig bre gang gis 'bras bre gang las mi khugs pa'i yul du'ang nga'i nyan thos rnams bsod snyoms kyis brel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras gaṅgā la gru zam btsugs pas/ yangs pa can pas kyang de bzhin du btsugs/ gaṅgā la gnas pa'i klus kyang gdengs ka'i zam pa btsugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang kun dga' bo ni gdengs ka'i zam pa las byon/ dge slong rnams ni gru zam gnyis po las 'ongs shing / chu bo'i phar 'gram gyis sa'i sgang mtho ba zhig tu phebs te der gzigs so/ /dge slong dag lha'i mchod sdong blta bar 'dod dam/ 'tshal lags/ phyag g.yas pa sa la reg pas/ sngon lhas bzos pa'i ma rdzo sdong dpangs su 'dom stong dang / sboms su 'dom drug cu yod pa zhig mchod sdong de'i bdag po klu rnams kyis sa steng du bsgreng bar byas so/ /de nas dge slong rnams la mchod sdong myur du nub par —3lko—

'gyur gyi rtags zung zhig gsungs pas/ der dge slong gzhan thams cad lta zhing rtog la/ dge slong legs ldan ni mi lta bar rgyab kyis phyogs nas/ phyag dar khrod kyi snam sbyar 'tshem mo/ /de'i rgyu zhus pas sngon rgyal po sgra chen kyi lo rgyus dang / phyis sangs rgyas byams pa 'byung ba'i tshul rnams gsungs/ mchod sdong yang nub bo/ /yang phar gshegs te shing sha pa'i tshal du zag med phung po lnga'i gdams pa bstan nas/ grong khyer sgra can du byon/ der lo de la mi ngas chen po byung bas dge bsnyen brtan pa la sogs pa mang po 'das so zhes thos nas/ kun dga' bos ston pa la de dag gang du skye zhes zhus pas/ dge bsnyen brtan pa la sogs pa sum brgya ni tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa lnga spangs te/ phyir mi 'ong ba thob pa yin pas gzugs khams su skye la/ la la ni rgyun zhugs yin pas 'dod pa'i lhar skye'o/ khyod de ltar zhu ba tshul dang mi mthun no zhes gsungs/ de nas a mra skyong mas ston pa 'byon par thos te/ ne tso bzhin rgyas zhes bya ba la khyod song la/ bcom ldan 'das la bsnyun gsol te/ yangs pa can du 'byon pa'i thog mar bdag gi khyim du gdugs tshod la sbyan drongs shig /ne tso de song ba dang / khye'u dag gis smad 'tshong ma'i ne tso yin no zer nas mda' 'phangs pas mda' de phyir ldog nas 'phen mkhan rnams nyid kyi thog tu lhung ngo / /ne tsos smras pa/ yul 'khor gzhan yang 'gyed pa na/ pho nya mi gsod ces grags na/ /bdag lta rgyal ba'i pho nya ba/ /lus can kun gyis gang la gsod/ /de nas de song ste ston pa'i spyan sngar bsnyun gsol/ a mra skyong ma'i zhu ba zhus/ ston pas kyang bkas gnang / ne tso sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du —391—

phyir 'ongs pa'i lam du 'ol bas bsad de rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skyes nas ston pa'i spyan sngar bden pa mthong ba'i bar du gyur to/ /go lnga pa yangs pa can pa rnams bde bar mdzad pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can gyi a mra'i tshal du phebs te bzhugs so/ /a mra skyong mas de thos te rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ 'khor bud med rnams kyis yongs su bskor te rang gi khyim nas byung ste 'ong ba gzigs pa na/ dge slong rnams la dran shes bzhin la gnas par gyis shig ces sogs yang dag spong ba bzhi rgyas par gsungs/ der a mra skyong ma 'ongs nas/ sang gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren pa'i snyan gsan phab bo/ /de'i rjes la ru bī rnams kyang shing rta rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa sogs yab sras mjal ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas nas 'ongs pa na/ dge slong sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas dang lha skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba ma mthong pa dag 'di la ltos shig gsung / de nas ca bī rnams ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs te/ chos kyi bka' ma mid stsal ba rgya cher nyan/ der bram ze'i khye'u ser skya'i bu zhes bya bas ston pa la tshigs su bcad pas bstod/ ru bī rnams kyis de la bla gos lnga brgya byin no/ka de nas li smo bī rnams kyis sang nyin gdugs tshod 'byon par zhus pa na/ thog mar a mra skyong gis spyan drangs so/ /des bdag cag bslus mod kyi/ da dung bsnyen bkur bgyi'o zer nas song ngo / /de'i rjes su ser skya'i bus bla gos lnga brgya po ston pa la phul ba la de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs shing / nangs par a mra skyong mas bsod snyoms phul te chos nyan/ kun dga' bo la bka' —392—

stsal te/ kun dga' bos yangs pa can gyi grong khyer gyi lcags ri'i sgo them la rkang pa bzhag ste/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo bton pas/ mi ngas gtong ba'i 'byung po thams cad byer zhing nad thams cad zhi'o/ /rjes su ru bī rnams kyis kyang gdugs chodi gsol ba sogs mchod pa rgya cher phul nas yangs pa can gyi nye ba'i grong 'od ma can zhes bya ba'i byang ngos shing sha pa'i tshal du dbyar gnas par mdzad do/ /dus der mu ge shin tu che bas/ bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag khyed rnams smos mgrin ji lta bu yod pa dag las dbyar gnas par byos shig /nga yang kun dga' bo dang lhan cig gnas so/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge slong rnams kyang grong dang yul tha dad pa'i gnas mal sna tshogs pa dag bsten zhing 'thor thabs su gnas so/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu sku bsnyun te/ ji tsam du 'grongs pa la thug pa de tsam du bsnyun par gyur kyang /da ltar dge 'dun 'thor bas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus ma yin dgongs te/tshor ba de ting nge 'dzin gyis zi la gyis mnan te lhag par 'tsho bar mdzad do/ /go drug pa mi thi la sogs la/ mi thi la dang swa la'i grong / /zhes bya ste/de nas zla ba gsum 'das pa na/ yul mi thi la'i a mra'i tshal du bzhugs te 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /rgyu zhus pas phyogs der ston pa nyid rgyal po lha chen por gyur pa'i skyes rabs gsungs nas/ yul lus 'phags su sangs rgyas bzhi'i gdan ston par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sā la'i grong du bsod snyoms la zhugs par mdzad pa na/ der bdud sdig can gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la bsod snyoms 'ga' yang 'bul ba 'byung ba med pa de bzhin du byas te/—393—

ji ltar lhung bzed bkrus te bzhag pa de lta bur byas so/ /de nas phyir ldog ste gshegs pa na bdud sdig can bram ze'i khye'ur sprul te sangs rgyas kyi phyi bzhin du song nas bsod snyoms kham 'ga' rnyed dam zer ba la/ bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa khyad bsad pas/ khyod kyis bsod nams min yang bsags/sangs rgyas rnams ni rgal dka' ba/ /sdig can ci ga mi shes sam/ /bdud na re/ da bsod snyoms la bzhud cig dang rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bka' stsal pa/ nga la ci yang mi dgos te/ kye ma shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /'od gsal lha rnams ji ltar bar/ /dga' ba yi ni zas za'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i sems shesaso snyam skyengs te de mi snang bar song ngo / /go bdun pa rdo 'phangs pa ni/ de nas yul sdig pa can du byon te/ der lam kha na pha bong ches che ba shin tu sra ba skye bo rnams bskor te 'gro dgos pa zhig yod pa las/ yul sdig pa can gyi gyad lnga brgya rnams pha bong de phyogs gzhan du spo ba'am rtsa ba nas bzhig par nus na/ lam yang bde zhing grags pa chen por 'gyur ro snyam nas gyad lnga brgyas thabs rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag gis pha bong de spo ba'am bshig par brtsams pa na/ de spo bar yang ma nus/ bzhig par yang ma nus so/ /phyogs der bcom ldan 'das byon te bka' stsal pa/gnas 'jog dag ci byed gsol ba/ shul lam 'di bzang por bgyid na/ pha bong 'di dor bar rngo mi thogs go /'o na ngas dor ram/ dor bar ma sgo cigader bcom ldan 'das kyis zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bos pha bong de nam mkha' la 'phangs te mig gis mi bzod pa tsam du song ba na/ gyad rnams skrag cing —394—

dngangs pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis pha bong de nam mkha'i mthongs te de nyid du phye mar mdzad nas rdul du babs pa na/ gsol ba/ rdul 'di ci las byung / bka' stsal pa/ pha bong de'o/ /ma legs so/ /'o na slar sbyar ram/ sbyar du gsol/ de ma thag lam du 'gro ba la gnod pa med cing / nye skor gyi sar rdul rnams 'byar te pha bong sngon bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas gyad rnams kyis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi stobs gang gis pha bong de 'phangs pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ yab yum las byung ba'i stobs kyis so/ /phye mar gang gis brlags lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis so/ /gang gis spyor bar mdzad pa lags/ mos pa'i stobs kyis so/ /stobs gsum po de las lhag pa'i stobs mchis sam/ yod de bsod nams kyi stobs kyis bdud bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug bcom mo/ /gzhan yang mas sam yod de ye shes kyi stobs kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad rtsad nas bcom mo/ /gzhan yang mchis sam/ yod de cho 'phrul gyi stobs kyis ston pa drug bcom mo/ /gzhan yang mchis sam/ yod de mi rtag pa'i stobs kyis shing swā la zung gi drung du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar gyi mi'i tshe dang stobs la sogs pa nyams pa la ltos/ rdo 'di ni bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi phang tshad yin te/lag rjes kyang yod do/ /zhes ston par mdzad do/ /de nas gyad lnga brgya stobs kyis dregs pa dang bral ba la cho se bstan pas de thams cad kyis rgyun du zhugs pa thob bo/ /skabs 'dir yab yum las gyur pa'i stobs kyi tshad ni/ mi dang glang phal ba men sngon po dang / /glang chen phru gu glang chen mo dang ni/ /glang chen —395—
